title: Сеты стримеров CS2: скины Dosia, Zeus, Gaules, ohnePixel и других
seoTitle: Сеты стримеров CS2: какие скины у Dosia, Zeus, Gaules, ohnePixel
desc: Какие скины у стримеров CS2: Dosia, Zeus, Edward, Mou, Gaules, ohnePixel, fl0m и kennyS. Ножи, перчатки, AWP и AK, сколько стоят сеты и как повторить стиль в 10–20 раз дешевле.
lead: Инвентарь любимого стримера зрители знают наизусть. Разобрали сеты восьми известных стримеров — от «народного» Zeus до Dragon Lore у Dosia — и как собрать похожий стиль за копейки.
md:
Стримеров по CS2 смотрят часами, и их инвентарь зрители знают лучше, чем свой: какой нож крутится в руках на каждом раунде, с какой AWP идёт ставка на клатч. Собрали сеты восьми известных стримеров — русскоязычных и зарубежных: что у них в инвентаре, сколько это стоит и как собрать похожий стиль в десятки раз дешевле.

Данные о скинах — по [ProSettings](https://prosettings.net/) на октябрь 2026 года. Стримеры часто меняют скины, иногда прямо на эфире, так что это срез, а не вечный список. Цены в тексте живые и обновляются каждые 4 часа.

## Русскоязычные стримеры

### Dosia: Dragon Lore и Doppler Phase 3

Бывший игрок Gambit и чемпион мейджора — сейчас один из самых известных стримеров CS в СНГ. Его инвентарь — классический «дорогой» сет: **AWP | Dragon Lore** в Factory New ([price name="AWP | Dragon Lore" wear="FN"]), **Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 3)** — зелёно-синий перелив, и перчатки **Driver Gloves | Diamondback** ([price name="Driver Gloves | Diamondback" wear="WW"] в Well-Worn).

- M4A4 | The Battlestar (FN) — [price name="M4A4 | The Battlestar" wear="FN"]
- Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler (Phase 3), MW — [price name="Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler (Phase 3)" wear="MW"]
- USP-S | Stainless (MW) — [price name="USP-S | Stainless" wear="MW"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream (FN) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FN"]

[skins names="AWP | Dragon Lore;Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 3);Driver Gloves | Diamondback;M4A4 | The Battlestar;Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler (Phase 3);Desert Eagle | Printstream"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** пистолеты и M4 у Dosia и так недорогие, их оставляем. Butterfly меняем на **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 3)** ([price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 3)"]) — та же фаза, цена в разы ниже. Diamondback в Battle-Scarred стоит [price name="Driver Gloves | Diamondback" wear="BS"]. А вот Dragon Lore не заменить ничем: это самая легендарная AWP в игре.

### Zeus: Blue Steel и Bloodsport

Легендарный капитан NAVI собрал самый «народный» сет из всех: главная ценность — **Butterfly Knife | Blue Steel** ([price name="Butterfly Knife | Blue Steel" wear="FN"] в Factory New), а остальное стоит копейки.

- AK-47 | Bloodsport (FT) — [price name="AK-47 | Bloodsport" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Buzz Kill (BS) — [price name="M4A4 | Buzz Kill" wear="BS"]
- AWP | Fever Dream (BS) — [price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="BS"]
- Glock-18 | Off World (MW) — [price name="Glock-18 | Off World" wear="MW"]
- USP-S | Flashback (FT) — [price name="USP-S | Flashback" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Bronze Deco (FT) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Bronze Deco" wear="FT"]

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Blue Steel;AK-47 | Bloodsport;M4A4 | Buzz Kill;AWP | Fever Dream;Glock-18 | Off World;USP-S | Flashback"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** Blue Steel есть и на дешёвых ножах: **Navaja Knife | Blue Steel** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Blue Steel" wear="FT"], **Huntsman Knife | Blue Steel** — [price name="Huntsman Knife | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]. С ними весь сет Zeus укладывается примерно в 30 000 ₽. Самое дорогое после ножа — M4A4 | Buzz Kill.

### Edward: Howl и Fire Serpent

Edward играл за NAVI в золотую эпоху, и его инвентарь выглядит соответственно — сплошная «контрабанда» и раритеты:

- M4A4 | Howl (FN) — [price name="M4A4 | Howl" wear="FN"]. Единственный скин в игре с редкостью «Контрабанда»: его больше не выпускают.
- AK-47 | Fire Serpent (FN) — [price name="AK-47 | Fire Serpent" wear="FN"]
- M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 1) — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 1)"]
- Driver Gloves | Imperial Plaid (MW) — [price name="Driver Gloves | Imperial Plaid" wear="MW"]
- AWP | Asiimov (FT) — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Fade (FN) — [price name="Glock-18 | Fade" wear="FN"]
- USP-S | Kill Confirmed (FN) — [price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FN"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries (FN) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FN"]

[skins names="M4A4 | Howl;AK-47 | Fire Serpent;M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 1);Driver Gloves | Imperial Plaid;AWP | Asiimov;USP-S | Kill Confirmed"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** Howl и Fire Serpent — коллекционные вещи, дешёвой копии у них нет. Стиль передадут **AK-47 | Fuel Injector** ([price name="AK-47 | Fuel Injector" wear="FT"]) и **M4A4 | Desolate Space** ([price name="M4A4 | Desolate Space" wear="FT"]). Нож — **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 1)** за [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 1)"], перчатки Imperial Plaid в Field-Tested — [price name="Driver Gloves | Imperial Plaid" wear="FT"].

### Mou: The Prince и Pandora's Box

Казахстанский снайпер, бывший игрок HellRaisers, — и самый дорогой AWP в нашей подборке после Dragon Lore:

- AWP | The Prince (FN) — [price name="AWP | The Prince" wear="FN"]
- Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box (FT) — [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"]. Одни из самых дорогих перчаток в игре.
- Flip Knife | Doppler (Sapphire) — сапфир, один из «камней» Doppler. Такие ножи продают по договорной цене, и она в разы выше обычных фаз.
- AK-47 | Phantom Disruptor (FN) — [price name="AK-47 | Phantom Disruptor" wear="FN"]
- M4A1-S | Printstream (FT) — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Fade (MW) — [price name="Glock-18 | Fade" wear="MW"]
- USP-S | Neo-Noir (FT) — [price name="USP-S | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream (FT) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]

[skins names="AWP | The Prince;Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box;Flip Knife | Doppler (Sapphire);AK-47 | Phantom Disruptor;M4A1-S | Printstream;USP-S | Neo-Noir"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** сапфир заменит синяя **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. Phantom Disruptor и Printstream оставляем. Фиолетовые перчатки подешевле — на странице [фиолетовых перчаток](/fioletovye-perchatki-cs2/).

## Зарубежные стримеры

- Hand Wraps | CAUTION! (MW) — [price name="Hand Wraps | CAUTION!" wear="MW"]
- AK-47 | Case Hardened (FN) — [price name="AK-47 | Case Hardened" wear="FN"]
- M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor (FN) — [price name="M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor" wear="FN"]
- AWP | Desert Hydra (FN) — [price name="AWP | Desert Hydra" wear="FN"]
- Glock-18 | Fade (FN) — [price name="Glock-18 | Fade" wear="FN"]
- USP-S | Royal Blue (FN) — [price name="USP-S | Royal Blue" wear="FN"]
- Desert Eagle | Blaze (FN) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Blaze" wear="FN"]

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Tiger Tooth;Hand Wraps | CAUTION!;AK-47 | Case Hardened;M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor;AWP | Desert Hydra;Desert Eagle | Blaze"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** Tiger Tooth на **Navaja Knife** стоит [price name="Navaja Knife | Tiger Tooth" wear="FN"] — тот же тигровый узор. CAUTION! в Field-Tested — [price name="Hand Wraps | CAUTION!" wear="FT"]. Остальное золото — в разделе [золотых скинов CS2](/zolotye-skiny-cs2/).

### ohnePixel: Black Pearl и Crimson Kimono

Главный «скиновый» стример CS: он знает рынок лучше многих трейдеров. Его сет — всего две вещи, но какие:

- Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Black Pearl) — «чёрная жемчужина», самый тёмный и редкий вариант Doppler. Цена договорная.
- Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono (FT) — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono" wear="FT"]. Одни из самых узнаваемых перчаток в игре.

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Black Pearl);Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** красно-чёрные перчатки подешевле — **Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red** ([price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]) или **Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure** ([price name="Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure" wear="FT"]). Тёмный Doppler — **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 1)** за [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 1)"].

### fl0m: Ruby, Howl и Dragon Lore

Американский стример и бывший профи, и его инвентарь — один из самых дорогих в CS:

- Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Ruby) — рубин, красный «камень» Doppler, цена договорная
- Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono (FT) — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Dragon Lore (WW) — [price name="AWP | Dragon Lore" wear="WW"]
- M4A4 | Howl (MW) — [price name="M4A4 | Howl" wear="MW"]
- AK-47 | Vulcan (MW) — [price name="AK-47 | Vulcan" wear="MW"]
- Glock-18 | Fade (FN) — [price name="Glock-18 | Fade" wear="FN"]
- USP-S | Neo-Noir (FN) — [price name="USP-S | Neo-Noir" wear="FN"]
- Desert Eagle | Blaze (FN) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Blaze" wear="FN"]

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Ruby);Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono;AWP | Dragon Lore;M4A4 | Howl;AK-47 | Vulcan;USP-S | Neo-Noir"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** Vulcan в Field-Tested — [price name="AK-47 | Vulcan" wear="FT"], USP-S | Neo-Noir можно оставить. Вместо Ruby подойдёт красно-синяя **Navaja Knife | Marble Fade** ([price name="Navaja Knife | Marble Fade"]), вместо Kimono — Rezan the Red.

### kennyS: всё в Marble Fade

Самый стильный снайпер Франции и сейчас стример. Сет собран вокруг одного цвета: **Butterfly Knife | Marble Fade** ([price name="Butterfly Knife | Marble Fade" wear="FN"]) и перчатки **Specialist Gloves | Marble Fade** ([price name="Specialist Gloves | Marble Fade" wear="FT"]).

- AWP | The Prince (FT) — [price name="AWP | The Prince" wear="FT"]
- AK-47 | Gold Arabesque (FT) — [price name="AK-47 | Gold Arabesque" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Knight — от [price name="M4A1-S | Knight"], почти всегда Factory New
- Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler (Emerald) — изумруд, цена договорная
- USP-S | Stainless (FN) — [price name="USP-S | Stainless" wear="FN"]
- Desert Eagle | Blaze (FN) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Blaze" wear="FN"]

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Marble Fade;Specialist Gloves | Marble Fade;AWP | The Prince;AK-47 | Gold Arabesque;M4A1-S | Knight;Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** Marble Fade есть на **Navaja Knife** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Marble Fade"] — и на **Gut Knife** — [price name="Gut Knife | Marble Fade"]. Перчатки Specialist Marble Fade в Field-Tested и так одни из самых доступных «дорогих» перчаток. Нож и перчатки в стиле kennyS выходят примерно в 18 000 ₽.

## Сколько стоят сеты стримеров

| Стример | Главное в сете | Примерная цена |
|---|---|---|
| Zeus | Butterfly Blue Steel, AK Bloodsport | ≈ 130 000 ₽ |
| ohnePixel | Butterfly Black Pearl, Crimson Kimono | ≈ 130 000 ₽ + нож |
| kennyS | Butterfly Marble Fade, AWP The Prince, M4 Knight | ≈ 640 000 ₽ + Glock Emerald |
| Gaules | Butterfly Tiger Tooth, AWP Desert Hydra, M4 Blue Phosphor | ≈ 460 000 ₽ |
| Mou | AWP The Prince, Pandora's Box | ≈ 700 000 ₽ + нож |
| Edward | M4A4 Howl, AK Fire Serpent | ≈ 1 030 000 ₽ |
| Dosia | AWP Dragon Lore FN, Butterfly Doppler | ≈ 1 150 000 ₽ |
| fl0m | Dragon Lore, Howl, Butterfly Ruby | ≈ 1 320 000 ₽ + нож |

Итоги — по ценам на 26 октября 2026 года. «Камни» Doppler (Black Pearl, Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald) в сумму не входят: их продают по договорной цене.

## Вопросы и ответы

**У какого стримера самый дешёвый сет?** У Zeus: если не считать нож, весь его инвентарь стоит меньше 30 000 ₽. А с Navaja Knife | Blue Steel вместо Butterfly — около 30 000 ₽ за полный сет.

**Какой скин чаще всего встречается у стримеров?** Butterfly Knife — у шести из восьми. Glock-18 | Fade — у четырёх, Desert Eagle | Blaze — у трёх.

**Как собрать сет как у стримера дешевле?** Главное правило — менять модель, а не отделку. Тот же Doppler, Tiger Tooth, Marble Fade или Blue Steel на Navaja, Gut или Shadow Daggers выглядит так же, но стоит в 10–20 раз меньше. Остальное подберёт [конструктор](/) по цвету и бюджету.

[cta color=1 budget=30000 text="Собрать сет как у стримера за 30 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

Больше сетов — в статье про [скины про-игроков CS2](/blog/skiny-pro-igrokov-cs2/) и в разделе [готовые сеты](/sety/).

en.seoTitle: CS2 streamer loadouts: Dosia, Zeus, Gaules, ohnePixel skins
en.desc: What skins CS2 streamers use: Dosia, Zeus, Edward, Mou, Gaules, ohnePixel, fl0m and kennyS. Knives, gloves, AWPs and AKs, what the loadouts cost and how to copy the style for 10–20x less.
en.lead: Viewers know their favorite streamer's inventory by heart. We broke down eight famous streamers' loadouts — from Zeus's budget-friendly set to Dosia's Dragon Lore — and how to get the look for pennies.
en.md:
People watch CS2 streamers for hours, and viewers know their inventories better than their own: which knife spins in their hands every round, which AWP is on the line in a clutch. We collected the loadouts of eight well-known streamers — Russian-speaking and international: what's in their inventory, what it costs and how to get a similar style for a fraction of the price.

Skin data comes from [ProSettings](https://prosettings.net/) as of October 2026. Streamers change skins often, sometimes live on stream, so treat this as a snapshot, not a permanent list. Prices in the text are live and update every 4 hours.

## Russian-speaking streamers

### Dosia: Dragon Lore and Doppler Phase 3

The former Gambit player and Major champion is now one of the best-known CS streamers in the CIS. His inventory is a classic "expensive" loadout: a Factory New **AWP | Dragon Lore** ([price name="AWP | Dragon Lore" wear="FN"]), a **Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 3)** with a green-blue sheen, and **Driver Gloves | Diamondback** ([price name="Driver Gloves | Diamondback" wear="WW"] in Well-Worn).

- M4A4 | The Battlestar (FN) — [price name="M4A4 | The Battlestar" wear="FN"]
- Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler (Phase 3), MW — [price name="Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler (Phase 3)" wear="MW"]
- USP-S | Stainless (MW) — [price name="USP-S | Stainless" wear="MW"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream (FN) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FN"]

[skins names="AWP | Dragon Lore;Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 3);Driver Gloves | Diamondback;M4A4 | The Battlestar;Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler (Phase 3);Desert Eagle | Printstream"]

**Get the look for less:** Dosia's pistols and M4 are already cheap — keep them. Swap the Butterfly for a **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 3)** ([price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 3)"]) — same phase, a fraction of the price. Diamondback in Battle-Scarred is [price name="Driver Gloves | Diamondback" wear="BS"]. The Dragon Lore, though, has no substitute: it's the most legendary AWP in the game.

### Zeus: Blue Steel and Bloodsport

The legendary NAVI captain has the most "down-to-earth" loadout of all: the one big item is a **Butterfly Knife | Blue Steel** ([price name="Butterfly Knife | Blue Steel" wear="FN"] in Factory New), and everything else is cheap.

- AK-47 | Bloodsport (FT) — [price name="AK-47 | Bloodsport" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Buzz Kill (BS) — [price name="M4A4 | Buzz Kill" wear="BS"]
- AWP | Fever Dream (BS) — [price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="BS"]
- Glock-18 | Off World (MW) — [price name="Glock-18 | Off World" wear="MW"]
- USP-S | Flashback (FT) — [price name="USP-S | Flashback" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Bronze Deco (FT) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Bronze Deco" wear="FT"]

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Blue Steel;AK-47 | Bloodsport;M4A4 | Buzz Kill;AWP | Fever Dream;Glock-18 | Off World;USP-S | Flashback"]

**Get the look for less:** Blue Steel exists on cheap knives too: **Navaja Knife | Blue Steel** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Blue Steel" wear="FT"], **Huntsman Knife | Blue Steel** — [price name="Huntsman Knife | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]. With one of those the whole Zeus loadout comes to about $340. After the knife, the priciest piece is the M4A4 | Buzz Kill.

### Edward: Howl and Fire Serpent

Edward played for NAVI in its golden era, and his inventory looks the part — contraband and rarities:

- M4A4 | Howl (FN) — [price name="M4A4 | Howl" wear="FN"]. The only Contraband-rarity skin in the game; it's no longer released.
- AK-47 | Fire Serpent (FN) — [price name="AK-47 | Fire Serpent" wear="FN"]
- M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 1) — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 1)"]
- Driver Gloves | Imperial Plaid (MW) — [price name="Driver Gloves | Imperial Plaid" wear="MW"]
- AWP | Asiimov (FT) — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Fade (FN) — [price name="Glock-18 | Fade" wear="FN"]
- USP-S | Kill Confirmed (FN) — [price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FN"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries (FN) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FN"]

[skins names="M4A4 | Howl;AK-47 | Fire Serpent;M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 1);Driver Gloves | Imperial Plaid;AWP | Asiimov;USP-S | Kill Confirmed"]

**Get the look for less:** the Howl and Fire Serpent are collector's items with no cheap copy. The **AK-47 | Fuel Injector** ([price name="AK-47 | Fuel Injector" wear="FT"]) and **M4A4 | Desolate Space** ([price name="M4A4 | Desolate Space" wear="FT"]) carry a similar vibe. For the knife — a **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 1)** at [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 1)"]; Imperial Plaid gloves in Field-Tested are [price name="Driver Gloves | Imperial Plaid" wear="FT"].

### Mou: The Prince and Pandora's Box

The Kazakh sniper and former HellRaisers player — and the priciest AWP in this list after the Dragon Lore:

- AWP | The Prince (FN) — [price name="AWP | The Prince" wear="FN"]
- Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box (FT) — [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"]. Some of the most expensive gloves in the game.
- Flip Knife | Doppler (Sapphire) — a Sapphire, one of the Doppler "gems". These sell at negotiated prices, several times above regular phases.
- AK-47 | Phantom Disruptor (FN) — [price name="AK-47 | Phantom Disruptor" wear="FN"]
- M4A1-S | Printstream (FT) — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Fade (MW) — [price name="Glock-18 | Fade" wear="MW"]
- USP-S | Neo-Noir (FT) — [price name="USP-S | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream (FT) — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]

[skins names="AWP | The Prince;Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box;Flip Knife | Doppler (Sapphire);AK-47 | Phantom Disruptor;M4A1-S | Printstream;USP-S | Neo-Noir"]

**Get the look for less:** a blue **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)"] — stands in for the Sapphire. Keep the Phantom Disruptor and Printstream. Cheaper purple gloves are on the [purple gloves](/en/purple-gloves-cs2/) page.

**Get the look for less:** Tiger Tooth on a **Navaja Knife** is [price name="Navaja Knife | Tiger Tooth" wear="FN"] — the same tiger pattern. CAUTION! in Field-Tested is [price name="Hand Wraps | CAUTION!" wear="FT"]. More gold in [gold CS2 skins](/en/gold-cs2-skins/).

### ohnePixel: Black Pearl and Crimson Kimono

CS's top "skin" streamer, who knows the market better than many traders. His loadout is just two items — but what items:

- Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Black Pearl) — the darkest and rarest Doppler variant. Negotiated price.

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Black Pearl);Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono"]

**Get the look for less:** cheaper red-and-black gloves — **Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red** ([price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]) or **Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure** ([price name="Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure" wear="FT"]). For a dark Doppler — a **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 1)** at [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 1)"].

### fl0m: Ruby, Howl and Dragon Lore

The American streamer and former pro has one of the most expensive inventories in CS:

- Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Ruby) — the red Doppler gem, negotiated price
- Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono (FT) — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono" wear="FT"]

title: Чёрный сет КС 2 и КС ГО: три чёрных инвентаря от 2 000 до 105 000 ₽
seoTitle: Чёрный сет КС 2 и КС ГО: готовые чёрные инвентари от 2 000 ₽
desc: Чёрный сет для КС 2 (CS2) и КС ГО на три бюджета: Black Lotus, Black Laminate, Karambit Night и Sport Gloves Nocts. Полный сет оружия — дешевле 2 000 ₽.
lead: Чёрный — самый выгодный цвет для тематического инвентаря: скины дешевле цветных, а износ на них почти не виден. Три готовых сета — от шести стволов за 2 000 ₽ до Karambit Night.
md:
Чёрный сет — один из самых «взрослых» инвентарей в КС 2 (и в КС ГО до этого): никакого неона, только матовый металл, тёмная краска и редкие светлые акценты. Его часто собирают те, кому надоели кислотные цвета. Хорошая новость: чёрные скины в среднем дешевле цветных, а износ на них почти не виден, так что можно брать Field-Tested и экономить.

Ниже — какие серии дают настоящий чёрный, три готовых сета от 2 000 до 105 000 ₽ и чего избегать.

## Какие скины считаются чёрными в CS2

Чёрный в CS2 бывает двух видов, и их лучше не смешивать как попало:

- **Матовый чёрный с узором** — Black Lotus, Black Laminate, Slate, Black Nile. Тёмная основа и тонкий рисунок поверх. Именно они дают «дорогой» вид за небольшие деньги.
- **Тёмный металл** — Night, Night Stripe, Blue Steel, Graphite. Воронёная сталь с бликами, в основном на ножах и AWP. На них потёртости почти не читаются, поэтому даже Battle-Scarred выглядит прилично.

Главные серии на оружие:

- **Black Lotus** — чёрный с тонким белым цветком: M4A1-S | Black Lotus — [price name="M4A1-S | Black Lotus" wear="FT"], USP-S | Black Lotus — [price name="USP-S | Black Lotus" wear="FT"].
- **AK-47 | Slate** — [price name="AK-47 | Slate" wear="FT"]. Самый доступный чёрный AK: тёмный камень с белыми гранями.
- **AK-47 | Black Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Black Laminate" wear="FT"]. Классика: чёрное ламинированное дерево вместо обычного приклада.
- **AWP | Black Nile** — [price name="AWP | Black Nile" wear="FT"]. Чёрная AWP с тонким египетским орнаментом.
- **Night** — тёмный металл на пистолетах: Desert Eagle | Night — [price name="Desert Eagle | Night" wear="FT"], Glock-18 | Night — [price name="Glock-18 | Night" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Slate;M4A1-S | Black Lotus;AWP | Black Nile;Desert Eagle | Night;USP-S | Black Lotus;Glock-18 | Night"]

- Desert Eagle | Night — [price name="Desert Eagle | Night" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Black Lotus — [price name="USP-S | Black Lotus" wear="FT"]

Итого ≈ 1 800 ₽. Самая дорогая часть — Desert Eagle | Night. Если хочется уложиться в полторы тысячи, замени его на любой тёмный Deagle подешевле — сет почти не пострадает. Black Lotus на M4A1-S и USP-S образует пару: одинаковый цветок на основном и запасном оружии, и инвентарь сразу выглядит собранным.

## Сет с ножом и перчатками до 15 000 ₽

Хочешь сэкономить ещё — возьми **Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged** ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged" wear="FT"]): чёрные с белыми надписями, почти на 3 000 ₽ дешевле Mogul.

## Премиальный сет до 105 000 ₽

Для полного сета меняем AK и AWP на более дорогие и берём топовый чёрный нож и перчатки:

Итого ≈ 101 000 ₽. AWP | Graphite — чистый чёрный металл без рисунка, бывает только в Factory New и Minimal Wear. Karambit | Night — тёмная сталь на самой популярной модели ножа. Sport Gloves | Nocts — чёрные с оранжевыми вставками. Это единственный цветной акцент в сете, он перекликается с бликами на металле.

Если Karambit не принципиален, **Bayonet | Night** ([price name="Bayonet | Night" wear="FT"]) или **Skeleton Knife | Night Stripe** ([price name="Skeleton Knife | Night Stripe" wear="FT"]) дают тот же стиль в 3–4 раза дешевле. Вместо Nocts подойдут **Bloodhound Gloves | Charred** ([price name="Bloodhound Gloves | Charred" wear="FT"]) — обугленная чёрная кожа без цветных деталей.

[cta color=8 budget=100000 text="Собрать чёрный сет с Karambit" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

| Бюджет | Что входит | Итого |
|---|---|---|
| до 2 000 ₽ | AK Slate, M4A1-S и USP-S Black Lotus, AWP Black Nile, Deagle и Glock Night | ≈ 1 800 ₽ |
| до 15 000 ₽ | Оружие бюджетного сета, Huntsman Black Laminate, Specialist Gloves Mogul | ≈ 13 800 ₽ |
| до 105 000 ₽ | AK Black Laminate, AWP Graphite, Karambit Night, Sport Gloves Nocts | ≈ 101 000 ₽ |

Итоги — по ценам на 25 октября 2026 года; цены в тексте живые и обновляются каждые 4 часа.

## Чего избегать

- **Karambit | Ultraviolet.** Выглядит почти чёрным на превью, но в игре отливает фиолетовым. В чёрный сет подходит только как осознанный акцент.
- **Doppler (Black Pearl).** Тёмный, но с сине-фиолетовым переливом, и стоит как полноценный дорогой нож.
- **Красные акценты.** AK-47 | Redline, M4A1-S | Hyper Beast и похожие — это уже красно-чёрный сет, а не чёрный. Для него есть [отдельный разбор](/blog/krasno-chernyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/).
- **Серые камуфляжи.** Urban DDPAT, VariCamo и подобные дешёвые скины на превью кажутся тёмными, но в игре это серая каша. Рядом с Black Lotus они выглядят бедно.

## Вопросы и ответы

**Какой самый дешёвый чёрный нож в CS2?** Huntsman Knife | Black Laminate — от [price name="Huntsman Knife | Black Laminate" wear="FT"] в Field-Tested.

**Какое качество брать для чёрного сета?** Field-Tested. На тёмных скинах потёртости почти не видны, а на металлических ножах (Night, Blue Steel) можно брать даже Battle-Scarred.

**Чем чёрный сет отличается от чёрно-белого?** В чёрном доминирует тёмный цвет, белое — только тонкие детали. Чёрно-белый строится на контрасте: Printstream, Neo-Noir, Black Tie. Готовые сеты — в статье [чёрно-белый инвентарь CS2](/blog/cherno-belyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/).

## Коротко

Чёрный — самый выгодный цвет для первого тематического инвентаря: полный сет оружия стоит меньше 2 000 ₽, износ не виден, а с ножом Black Laminate весь инвентарь укладывается в 15 000 ₽. Больше вариантов — на странице [чёрно-белых скинов CS2](/cherno-belye-skiny-cs2/) и в разделе [цветовые сеты скинов](/cvetovye-sety-skinov-cs2/).

en.title: Black CS2 Loadout: Three All-Black Inventories from $20 to $1,150
en.seoTitle: Black CS2 loadout: all-black sets from $20
en.desc: A black CS2 inventory on three budgets: Black Lotus, Black Laminate, Karambit Night and Sport Gloves Nocts. A full set of guns for under $20.
en.lead: Black is the best-value color for a themed inventory: the skins are cheaper than colorful ones and wear barely shows. Three ready-made loadouts — from six guns for $20 to a Karambit Night.
en.md:
A black loadout is one of the most "grown-up" inventories in CS2 (and in CS:GO before it): no neon, just matte metal, dark paint and the odd light accent. It's the go-to for players tired of acid colors. The good news: black skins are cheaper than colorful ones on average, and wear barely shows on them, so you can buy Field-Tested and save.

Below: which series give you a real black, three ready-made loadouts from $20 to $1,150, and what to avoid.

## Which CS2 skins count as black

Black in CS2 comes in two flavors, and it's best not to mix them at random:

- **Matte black with a pattern** — Black Lotus, Black Laminate, Slate, Black Nile. A dark base with a thin design on top. These give you an expensive look for little money.
- **Dark metal** — Night, Night Stripe, Blue Steel, Graphite. Blued steel with highlights, mostly on knives and the AWP. Scuffs barely read on them, so even Battle-Scarred looks decent.

The key weapon series:

- **Black Lotus** — black with a thin white flower: M4A1-S | Black Lotus — [price name="M4A1-S | Black Lotus" wear="FT"], USP-S | Black Lotus — [price name="USP-S | Black Lotus" wear="FT"].
- **AK-47 | Slate** — [price name="AK-47 | Slate" wear="FT"]. The cheapest black AK: dark stone with white edges.
- **AK-47 | Black Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Black Laminate" wear="FT"]. A classic: black laminated wood instead of the standard stock.
- **AWP | Black Nile** — [price name="AWP | Black Nile" wear="FT"]. A black AWP with a thin Egyptian ornament.
- **Night** — dark metal on pistols: Desert Eagle | Night — [price name="Desert Eagle | Night" wear="FT"], Glock-18 | Night — [price name="Glock-18 | Night" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Slate;M4A1-S | Black Lotus;AWP | Black Nile;Desert Eagle | Night;USP-S | Black Lotus;Glock-18 | Night"]

## Loadout under $20

Black is a rare color where a full six-gun loadout costs less than one mid-range AK:

- AK-47 | Slate — [price name="AK-47 | Slate" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Black Lotus — [price name="M4A1-S | Black Lotus" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Black Nile — [price name="AWP | Black Nile" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Night — [price name="Desert Eagle | Night" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Black Lotus — [price name="USP-S | Black Lotus" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Night — [price name="Glock-18 | Night" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $20. The priciest piece is the Desert Eagle | Night — swap it for any cheaper dark Deagle and the loadout barely suffers. Black Lotus on the M4A1-S and USP-S makes a pair: the same flower on your main and secondary, and the inventory instantly looks put together.

[cta color=8 budget=2000 text="Build a black loadout for $20" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout with knife and gloves under $165

Keep the guns, add a knife and gloves:

- Guns — same as the $20 loadout
- Huntsman Knife | Black Laminate — [price name="Huntsman Knife | Black Laminate" wear="FT"]
- Specialist Gloves | Mogul — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Mogul" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $155. The Huntsman Knife | Black Laminate is the cheapest truly black knife: the same texture as the AK-47 | Black Laminate, on a blade. Mogul is black leather with white stitching that keeps the monochrome style.

To save more, take **Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged** ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged" wear="FT"]): black with white lettering and about $30 cheaper than Mogul.

[skins names="Huntsman Knife | Black Laminate;Specialist Gloves | Mogul;Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged"]

[cta color=8 budget=15000 text="Build a black loadout with a knife for $165" btn="Open the builder"]

## Premium loadout under $1,150

For the full set we upgrade the AK and AWP and take a top-tier black knife and gloves:

- AK-47 | Black Laminate — [price name="AK-47 | Black Laminate" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Black Lotus — [price name="M4A1-S | Black Lotus" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Graphite — [price name="AWP | Graphite" wear="MW"]
- Desert Eagle | Night, USP-S | Black Lotus, Glock-18 | Night — same as the budget loadout
- Karambit | Night — [price name="Karambit | Night" wear="FT"]
- Sport Gloves | Nocts — [price name="Sport Gloves | Nocts" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $1,120. The AWP | Graphite is pure black metal with no pattern and only comes in Factory New and Minimal Wear. Karambit | Night is dark steel on the most popular knife model. Sport Gloves | Nocts are black with orange inserts — the only colored accent in the set, echoing the highlights on the metal.

If the Karambit isn't a must, **Bayonet | Night** ([price name="Bayonet | Night" wear="FT"]) or **Skeleton Knife | Night Stripe** ([price name="Skeleton Knife | Night Stripe" wear="FT"]) give the same style for 3–4x less. Instead of Nocts, **Bloodhound Gloves | Charred** ([price name="Bloodhound Gloves | Charred" wear="FT"]) work well — charred black leather with no colored details.

[skins names="AK-47 | Black Laminate;AWP | Graphite;Karambit | Night;Sport Gloves | Nocts;Bayonet | Night;Skeleton Knife | Night Stripe;Bloodhound Gloves | Charred"]

[cta color=8 budget=100000 text="Build a black loadout with a Karambit" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadouts compared

| Budget | What's in it | Total |
|---|---|---|
| under $20 | AK Slate, M4A1-S and USP-S Black Lotus, AWP Black Nile, Deagle and Glock Night | ≈ $20 |
| under $165 | Budget guns, Huntsman Black Laminate, Specialist Gloves Mogul | ≈ $155 |
| under $1,150 | AK Black Laminate, AWP Graphite, Karambit Night, Sport Gloves Nocts | ≈ $1,120 |

Totals use prices as of October 25, 2026; the prices in the text are live and update every 4 hours.

## What to avoid

- **Karambit | Ultraviolet.** Looks almost black in the preview, but has a purple sheen in game. Only use it as a deliberate accent.
- **Doppler (Black Pearl).** Dark, but with a blue-purple shimmer, and priced like a premium knife.
- **Red accents.** AK-47 | Redline, M4A1-S | Hyper Beast and the like make it a red-and-black loadout, not a black one. That has its [own guide](/en/blog/krasno-chernyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/).
- **Grey camos.** Urban DDPAT, VariCamo and similar cheap skins look dark in the preview but turn into grey mush in game. Next to Black Lotus they look cheap.

## FAQ

**What's the cheapest black knife in CS2?** Huntsman Knife | Black Laminate — from [price name="Huntsman Knife | Black Laminate" wear="FT"] in Field-Tested.

**What wear should I buy for a black loadout?** Field-Tested. Scuffs barely show on dark skins, and on metal knives (Night, Blue Steel) even Battle-Scarred is fine.

**How is a black loadout different from black and white?** In a black loadout the dark color dominates and white is only in thin details. Black and white is built on contrast: Printstream, Neo-Noir, Black Tie. Ready-made sets are in the [black and white CS2 loadout](/en/blog/cherno-belyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/) guide.

## Bottom line

Black is the best-value color for your first themed inventory: a full set of guns costs under $20, wear doesn't show, and with a Black Laminate knife the whole inventory fits in $165. More options on the [black and white CS2 skins](/en/black-white-cs2-skins/) page and in [CS2 skin color sets](/en/cs2-skin-sets-by-color/).

title: Белый сет КС 2 и КС ГО: три белых инвентаря от 3 500 до 110 000 ₽
seoTitle: Белый сет КС 2 и КС ГО: готовые белые инвентари от 3 500 ₽
desc: Белый сет для КС 2 (CS2) и КС ГО: Whiteout, Printstream, Asiimov, Karambit Freehand и перчатки Snow Leopard. Три бюджета и какое качество брать на белом.
lead: Белый инвентарь заметнее всех на любой карте, но на нём сильнее всего виден износ. Какие серии по-настоящему белые, три готовых сета и где на белом нельзя экономить.
md:
Белый сет в КС 2 (и раньше в КС ГО) — самый заметный инвентарь в игре: светлое оружие видно на любой карте, а в руках оно выглядит чисто и дорого. Но у белого есть подвох, о котором мало кто думает до покупки: на нём сильнее всего виден износ. Белый скин в Battle-Scarred легко превращается в грязно-серый.

Разберём, какие серии дают по-настоящему белый цвет, соберём три сета — от 3 500 до 110 000 ₽ — и посмотрим, где на белом можно экономить, а где нет.

## Какие скины считаются белыми в CS2

Белых серий в игре немного, и почти у каждой есть второй цвет. Задача — выбрать те, где белого больше всего:

- **Whiteout** — чистый белый без рисунка: USP-S | Whiteout — [price name="USP-S | Whiteout" wear="FT"], P250 | Whiteout — [price name="P250 | Whiteout" wear="FT"], Tec-9 | Whiteout — [price name="Tec-9 | Whiteout" wear="FT"]. Самое точное попадание в гамму.
- **Printstream** — перламутровый белый с чёрной графикой: AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"], Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"].
- **Asiimov** — белый с чёрными и оранжевыми деталями: AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"], AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"].
- **AK-47 | Frontside Misty** — [price name="AK-47 | Frontside Misty" wear="FT"]. Белые горы с голубым небом; самый дешёвый «белый» AK.
- **Freehand и Damascus Steel** — светлая сталь на ножах. Белых ножей в прямом смысле в CS2 нет, но эти отделки ближе всего.

Итоги — по ценам на 25 октября 2026 года; цены в тексте живые и обновляются каждые 4 часа.

## Износ на белом: где не экономить

На белых скинах качество решает больше, чем на любых других:

- **Whiteout и Printstream** — минимум Field-Tested. В WW и BS на белой краске появляются тёмные пятна, и скин выглядит грязным. Подробно про износ — в статье [FT или BS: что значат FN, MW, FT, WW и BS](/blog/kachestvo-skinov-cs2-fn-mw-ft-ww-bs/).
- **AWP | Asiimov в Battle-Scarred** — уже не белая, а почти чёрная (её зовут Blackiimov). Для белого сета бери только FT.
- **Ножи и перчатки** — здесь можно брать FT и ниже: светлая сталь Damascus и Freehand износ почти не показывает.

## Чего избегать

- **Светло-серые камуфляжи.** Urban Masked, VariCamo и похожие на превью кажутся белыми, но в игре это серый. Один на запасном слоте не страшен, три — и сет выглядит блёклым.
- **Яркие цветные акценты.** AK-47 | Asiimov с оранжевым ещё работает, а вот Hyper Beast или Fully Tuned уже тянут сет в другой цвет.
- **Смешение с чёрно-белым.** Если половина скинов — Neo-Noir и Black Lotus, это уже [чёрно-белый сет](/blog/cherno-belyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/). Это тоже хороший вариант, но другой.

## Вопросы и ответы

**Какой самый белый скин на AK-47?** AK-47 | Leet Museo — почти полностью белый. Из доступных — AK-47 | Asiimov и AK-47 | Frontside Misty.

**Есть ли белые ножи в CS2?** Чисто белых нет. Ближе всего светлая сталь: Freehand, Damascus Steel и Urban Masked. Самый дешёвый вариант с ножом — Ursus Knife | Damascus Steel, от [price name="Ursus Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"].

**Какие перчатки подходят к белому сету?** Driver Gloves | Snow Leopard, Driver Gloves | King Snake и Moto Gloves | Smoke Out. Из бюджетных — Smoke Out.

## Коротко

Белый сет выглядит дороже всех, но требует внимания к износу: оружие бери в FT и выше, а на ноже и перчатках экономь смело. Весь подбор по цвету — на странице [чёрно-белых скинов CS2](/cherno-belye-skiny-cs2/), другие гаммы — в разделе [цветовые сеты скинов](/cvetovye-sety-skinov-cs2/).

en.title: White CS2 Loadout: Three White Inventories from $40 to $1,200
en.seoTitle: White CS2 loadout: white skin sets from $40
en.desc: A white CS2 inventory: Whiteout, Printstream, Asiimov, Karambit Freehand and Snow Leopard gloves. Three budgets and what wear to buy on white skins.
en.lead: A white inventory stands out on any map, but wear shows on it the most. Which series are truly white, three ready-made loadouts and where not to save on white.
en.md:
A white loadout in CS2 (and in CS:GO before it) is the most eye-catching inventory in the game: light guns stand out on any map and look clean and expensive in your hands. But white has a catch few people think about before buying: wear shows on it the most. A white skin in Battle-Scarred easily turns dirty grey.

Let's go over which series give you a real white, build three loadouts from $40 to $1,200, and see where you can save on white and where you can't.

## Which CS2 skins count as white

There aren't many white series in the game, and almost each has a second color. The job is to pick the ones with the most white:

- **Whiteout** — pure white with no pattern: USP-S | Whiteout — [price name="USP-S | Whiteout" wear="FT"], P250 | Whiteout — [price name="P250 | Whiteout" wear="FT"], Tec-9 | Whiteout — [price name="Tec-9 | Whiteout" wear="FT"]. The most accurate match.
- **Printstream** — pearl white with black graphics: AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"], Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"].
- **Asiimov** — white with black and orange details: AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"], AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"].
- **AK-47 | Frontside Misty** — [price name="AK-47 | Frontside Misty" wear="FT"]. White mountains under a light blue sky; the cheapest "white" AK.
- **Freehand and Damascus Steel** — light steel on knives. There are no literally white knives in CS2, but these finishes come closest.

[skins names="USP-S | Whiteout;P250 | Whiteout;AWP | Printstream;Desert Eagle | Printstream;AK-47 | Asiimov;AK-47 | Frontside Misty"]

## Loadout under $40

A budget white loadout uses simpler light skins:

- AK-47 | Frontside Misty — [price name="AK-47 | Frontside Misty" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Worm God — [price name="AWP | Worm God" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Clear Polymer — [price name="Glock-18 | Clear Polymer" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $35. The AWP | Worm God is a pale light AWP for pennies; if your budget allows, it's the first slot to upgrade to Printstream. Clear Polymer on the Glock is transparent plastic that looks light next to white guns and costs less than a bag of chips.

[cta color=8 budget=3500 text="Build a white loadout for $40" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout with knife and gloves under $330

This is where Printstream and the Whiteout pistols come in:

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Whiteout — [price name="USP-S | Whiteout" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Clear Polymer — [price name="Glock-18 | Clear Polymer" wear="FT"]
- Ursus Knife | Damascus Steel — [price name="Ursus Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]
- Moto Gloves | Smoke Out — [price name="Moto Gloves | Smoke Out" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $310. The Ursus Knife | Damascus Steel is the cheapest knife with light patterned steel — almost white in bright light. Moto Gloves | Smoke Out are light grey and white, one of the few glove pairs that don't break a white loadout.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;USP-S | Whiteout;Ursus Knife | Damascus Steel;Moto Gloves | Smoke Out"]

[cta color=8 budget=30000 text="Build a white loadout with a knife for $330" btn="Open the builder"]

## Premium loadout under $1,200

- AK-47 | Leet Museo — [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream, USP-S | Whiteout, Glock-18 | Clear Polymer — same as the mid loadout
- Karambit | Freehand — [price name="Karambit | Freehand" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Snow Leopard — [price name="Driver Gloves | Snow Leopard" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $1,190. Karambit | Freehand is light steel with thin hand-drawn lines — the "whitest" Karambit in the game. Driver Gloves | Snow Leopard are white leather with grey spots, a perfect pair for Whiteout. The AK-47 | Leet Museo is white with black graffiti; pricey, but it's the whitest AK there is.

You can save on the knife without losing the style: **Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel** ([price name="Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]) or **Flip Knife | Freehand** ([price name="Flip Knife | Freehand" wear="FT"]) cost 2.5–4x less than the Karambit. Instead of Snow Leopard, **Driver Gloves | King Snake** ([price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FT"]) work too — white with black snake scales.

[skins names="AK-47 | Leet Museo;M4A1-S | Printstream;AWP | Asiimov;Karambit | Freehand;Driver Gloves | Snow Leopard;Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel;Flip Knife | Freehand;Driver Gloves | King Snake"]

[cta color=8 budget=110000 text="Build a white loadout with a Karambit" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadouts compared

| Budget | What's in it | Total |
|---|---|---|
| under $40 | AK Frontside Misty, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP Worm God, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Clear Polymer | ≈ $35 |
| under $330 | AK Asiimov, AWP and Deagle Printstream, USP-S Whiteout, Ursus Damascus Steel, Moto Gloves Smoke Out | ≈ $310 |
| under $1,200 | AK Leet Museo, M4A1-S Printstream, AWP Asiimov, Karambit Freehand, Driver Gloves Snow Leopard | ≈ $1,190 |

Totals use prices as of October 25, 2026; the prices in the text are live and update every 4 hours.

## Wear on white: where not to save

On white skins, wear matters more than on any others:

- **Whiteout and Printstream** — Field-Tested at minimum. In WW and BS dark patches appear on the white paint and the skin looks dirty. More on wear in [FT or BS: what FN, MW, FT, WW and BS mean](/en/blog/kachestvo-skinov-cs2-fn-mw-ft-ww-bs/).
- **AWP | Asiimov in Battle-Scarred** is no longer white but almost black (it's called the Blackiimov). For a white loadout, only buy FT.
- **Knives and gloves** — FT and lower are fine here: light Damascus and Freehand steel barely show wear.

## What to avoid

- **Light grey camos.** Urban Masked, VariCamo and similar look white in the preview but are grey in game. One on a backup slot is fine; three and the loadout looks washed out.
- **Bright colored accents.** The orange on the AK-47 | Asiimov still works, but Hyper Beast or Fully Tuned pull the set into another color.
- **Mixing with black and white.** If half your skins are Neo-Noir and Black Lotus, it's a [black and white loadout](/en/blog/cherno-belyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/) — also a good option, just a different one.

## FAQ

**What's the whitest AK-47 skin?** AK-47 | Leet Museo — almost entirely white. Among affordable ones, the AK-47 | Asiimov and AK-47 | Frontside Misty.

**Are there white knives in CS2?** Not purely white. The closest is light steel: Freehand, Damascus Steel and Urban Masked. The cheapest option is the Ursus Knife | Damascus Steel, from [price name="Ursus Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"].

**What gloves go with a white loadout?** Driver Gloves | Snow Leopard, Driver Gloves | King Snake and Moto Gloves | Smoke Out. On a budget — Smoke Out.

## Bottom line

A white loadout looks the most expensive of all but needs attention to wear: buy guns in FT or better and save boldly on the knife and gloves. Everything by color is on the [black and white CS2 skins](/en/black-white-cs2-skins/) page; other palettes are in [CS2 skin sets by color](/en/cs2-skin-sets-by-color/).

title: Розовые ножи и перчатки CS2: все варианты с ценами
seoTitle: Розовые ножи и перчатки КС 2 и КС ГО: все варианты и цены
desc: Все розовые ножи и перчатки КС 2 (CS2): Doppler Phase 2, Fade, Slaughter, Sport Gloves Vice и Overprint. Самые дешёвые от 7 000 ₽, что с чем сочетать и чего избегать.
lead: Половина «розовых» ножей на превью в игре оказываются красными или фиолетовыми. Разбираем три отделки, которые реально дают розовый, все ножи по ценам и пять пар розовых перчаток.
md:
Розовый нож — самая частая «мечта» в розовом сете, и при этом с ним больше всего путаницы. Половина ножей, которые выглядят розовыми на превью, в игре оказываются красными, фиолетовыми или вообще синими. С перчатками ещё сложнее: по-настоящему розовых пар в CS2 всего несколько.

Здесь — все розовые ножи и перчатки КС 2 (они же были в КС ГО) по ценовым группам: от самых дешёвых до топовых, с живыми ценами и тем, с чем их сочетать.

## Какие отделки ножей дают розовый

Розовый на ножах дают всего три отделки. Запомни их — и не ошибёшься:

- **Doppler Phase 2** — розово-фиолетовый глянец. Только Phase 2: Phase 1 тёмная, Phase 3 зелёно-синяя, Phase 4 синяя, а Black Pearl почти чёрный. Бывает только в Factory New и Minimal Wear.
- **Fade** — градиент от розового через фиолетовый к жёлтому. На большинстве моделей розового на лезвии больше всего. Тоже только FN и MW, причём FN часто **дешевле** MW: Minimal Wear у Fade встречается реже.
- **Slaughter** — розово-красные «разводы» на светлом металле. Самая доступная розовая отделка и единственная, которая бывает в Field-Tested.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Karambit | Fade;Karambit | Slaughter"]

## Самые дешёвые розовые ножи: до 10 000 ₽

- **Navaja Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. Самый дешёвый розовый нож в игре.
- **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"].
- **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]. Чуть дороже Navaja, но модель заметнее в руке.
- **Gut Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Gut Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"].
- **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]. Двойные ножи — розового на экране в два раза больше.
- **Gut Knife | Fade** — [price name="Gut Knife | Fade" wear="FN"].

Navaja и Gut — небольшие модели, но с Doppler Phase 2 даже они выглядят ярко: розовый глянец бросается в глаза при каждом осмотре.

[skins names="Navaja Knife | Slaughter;Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Fade"]

## Розовые ножи средней цены: 10 000–30 000 ₽

- **Huntsman Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Huntsman Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]
- **Bowie Knife | Fade** — [price name="Bowie Knife | Fade" wear="FN"]
- **Falchion Knife | Fade** — [price name="Falchion Knife | Fade" wear="FN"]
- **Huntsman Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Huntsman Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]
- **Nomad Knife | Fade** — [price name="Nomad Knife | Fade" wear="FN"]
- **Bayonet | Slaughter** — [price name="Bayonet | Slaughter" wear="FT"]
- **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]

Лучшее соотношение цены и вида здесь — **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)**: популярная модель с красивой анимацией осмотра и чистым розовым глянцем. Если нужен Fade подешевле, Bowie и Falchion дают крупное лезвие с большим розовым участком.

[skins names="Huntsman Knife | Slaughter;Bowie Knife | Fade;Falchion Knife | Fade;Bayonet | Slaughter;Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

## Топовые розовые ножи

- **M9 Bayonet | Fade** — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Fade" wear="FN"]

- **Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]
- **Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]
- **Karambit | Fade** — [price name="Karambit | Fade" wear="FN"]

Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2) — классика розового сета. Butterfly Knife | Slaughter — самый доступный «баттерфляй» в розовом.

[skins names="M9 Bayonet | Fade;Butterfly Knife | Slaughter;Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

## Розовые перчатки CS2

Вот полный список пар, которые в игре действительно выглядят розовыми:

| Перчатки | Цена (FT) | Как выглядят |
|---|---|---|
| Hand Wraps \| Overprint | [price name="Hand Wraps | Overprint" wear="FT"] | Розовые бинты с жёлто-голубым принтом |
| Specialist Gloves \| Fade | [price name="Specialist Gloves | Fade" wear="FT"] | Градиент розовый → жёлтый, как у ножей Fade |
| Sport Gloves \| Vice | [price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"] | Розовые с бирюзой, стиль Майами |
| Hand Wraps \| Slaughter | [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"] | Розово-красные разводы, пара к ножам Slaughter |
| Sport Gloves \| Ultra Violent | [price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"] | Розово-фиолетовые, ближе к фиолетовому |

**Hand Wraps | Overprint** — самый доступный вариант. **Sport Gloves | Vice** — самые узнаваемые розовые перчатки в игре. В Field-Tested они стоят в разы дешевле Factory New, а разница в игре почти не видна.

[skins names="Hand Wraps | Overprint;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Sport Gloves | Vice;Hand Wraps | Slaughter"]

## Что с чем сочетать

- **Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves | Vice.** Самая яркая и узнаваемая пара: глянцевый розовый и неоновая бирюза.
- **Fade + Specialist Gloves | Fade.** Одинаковый градиент на ноже и перчатках — сет выглядит собранным с первого взгляда.
- **Slaughter + Hand Wraps | Slaughter или Overprint.** Розово-красная гамма; Overprint дешевле и ярче.

Готовые розовые сеты с оружием на три бюджета — в статье [розовый инвентарь CS2](/blog/rozovyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/).

[cta color=2 budget=18000 text="Собрать розовый сет с ножом" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Чего избегать

- **Doppler других фаз.** Phase 1, 3, 4, Ruby, Sapphire и Black Pearl — не розовые. Если в названии нет «Phase 2», в розовый сет такой нож не подходит.
- **Marble Fade.** Красно-синий с жёлтым, а не розовый, хотя на превью иногда кажется розоватым.
- **Crimson Web и Autotronic.** Это красные отделки. Рядом с Doppler Phase 2 красный выглядит чужим.
- **Ultraviolet.** Тёмно-фиолетовый, не розовый.

## Вопросы и ответы

**Какой самый дешёвый розовый нож в КС 2?** Navaja Knife | Slaughter — от [price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. Среди Doppler Phase 2 — Navaja и Gut Knife.

**Какие перчатки розовые в CS2?** Hand Wraps | Overprint, Specialist Gloves | Fade, Sport Gloves | Vice и Hand Wraps | Slaughter. Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent — скорее фиолетово-розовые.

**Почему Fade в Factory New дешевле, чем в Minimal Wear?** Fade почти всегда выпадает в FN, а MW встречается редко. Из-за редкости MW и стоит дороже, хотя выглядит так же.

## Коротко

Для розового ножа запоминай три слова: Doppler Phase 2, Fade и Slaughter. Самый дешёвый вход — Navaja или Gut Knife, лучший баланс — Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2). Из перчаток бери Overprint (бюджет) или Vice (топ). Полные списки с ценами — на страницах [розовых ножей](/rozovye-nozhi-cs2/) и [розовых перчаток](/rozovye-perchatki-cs2/).

en.title: Pink Knives and Gloves in CS2: Every Option with Prices
en.seoTitle: Pink knives and gloves CS2: every option and price
en.desc: Every pink knife and glove pair in CS2: Doppler Phase 2, Fade, Slaughter, Sport Gloves Vice and Overprint. The cheapest from $80, what to pair and what to avoid.
en.lead: Half the "pink" knives in previews turn out red or purple in game. Here are the three finishes that are actually pink, every knife by price and five pink glove pairs.
en.md:
A pink knife is the most common "dream item" in a pink loadout — and also the most confusing one. Half the knives that look pink in the preview turn out red, purple or even blue in game. Gloves are even trickier: CS2 has only a handful of truly pink pairs.

Here are all the pink knives and gloves in CS2 (the same ones as in CS:GO), grouped by price from the cheapest to the top tier, with live prices and what to pair them with.

## Which knife finishes are pink

Only three knife finishes give you pink. Remember them and you won't go wrong:

- **Doppler Phase 2** — a pink-purple gloss. Phase 2 only: Phase 1 is dark, Phase 3 is green-blue, Phase 4 is blue and Black Pearl is almost black. Comes only in Factory New and Minimal Wear.
- **Fade** — a gradient from pink through purple to yellow. On most models pink covers most of the blade. Also FN and MW only — and FN is often **cheaper** than MW, because Minimal Wear Fades are rarer.
- **Slaughter** — pink-red swirls on light metal. The most affordable pink finish and the only one that comes in Field-Tested.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Karambit | Fade;Karambit | Slaughter"]

## Cheapest pink knives: under $110

- **Navaja Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. The cheapest pink knife in the game.
- **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"].
- **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]. A bit pricier than the Navaja, but the model stands out more in hand.
- **Gut Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Gut Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"].
- **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]. Dual daggers — twice as much pink on screen.
- **Gut Knife | Fade** — [price name="Gut Knife | Fade" wear="FN"].

The Navaja and Gut are small models, but with Doppler Phase 2 even they look bright — the pink gloss catches the eye every time you inspect.

[skins names="Navaja Knife | Slaughter;Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Fade"]

## Mid-range pink knives: $110–330

- **Huntsman Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Huntsman Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]
- **Bowie Knife | Fade** — [price name="Bowie Knife | Fade" wear="FN"]
- **Falchion Knife | Fade** — [price name="Falchion Knife | Fade" wear="FN"]
- **Huntsman Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Huntsman Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]
- **Nomad Knife | Fade** — [price name="Nomad Knife | Fade" wear="FN"]
- **Bayonet | Slaughter** — [price name="Bayonet | Slaughter" wear="FT"]
- **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]

The best value here is the **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)**: a popular model with a great inspect animation and a clean pink gloss. For a cheaper Fade, the Bowie and Falchion give you a big blade with a large pink area.

[skins names="Huntsman Knife | Slaughter;Bowie Knife | Fade;Falchion Knife | Fade;Bayonet | Slaughter;Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

## Top-tier pink knives

- **M9 Bayonet | Fade** — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Fade" wear="FN"]
- **Butterfly Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]
- **Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]
- **Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)" wear="FN"]
- **Karambit | Fade** — [price name="Karambit | Fade" wear="FN"]

The Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2) is the classic pink centerpiece. The Butterfly Knife | Slaughter is the most affordable pink butterfly.

[skins names="M9 Bayonet | Fade;Butterfly Knife | Slaughter;Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

## Pink gloves in CS2

Here's the full list of pairs that actually look pink in game:

| Gloves | Price (FT) | Look |
|---|---|---|
| Hand Wraps \| Overprint | [price name="Hand Wraps | Overprint" wear="FT"] | Pink wraps with a yellow-blue print |
| Specialist Gloves \| Fade | [price name="Specialist Gloves | Fade" wear="FT"] | Pink → yellow gradient, like Fade knives |
| Sport Gloves \| Vice | [price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"] | Pink with teal, Miami style |
| Hand Wraps \| Slaughter | [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"] | Pink-red swirls, a match for Slaughter knives |
| Sport Gloves \| Ultra Violent | [price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"] | Pink-purple, closer to purple |

**Hand Wraps | Overprint** is the most affordable option. **Sport Gloves | Vice** are the most recognizable pink gloves in the game. In Field-Tested they cost several times less than Factory New, and the difference barely shows in game.

[skins names="Hand Wraps | Overprint;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Sport Gloves | Vice;Hand Wraps | Slaughter"]

## What to pair with what

- **Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves | Vice.** The brightest, most recognizable combo: glossy pink and neon teal.
- **Fade + Specialist Gloves | Fade.** The same gradient on knife and gloves — the set looks put together at first glance.
- **Slaughter + Hand Wraps | Slaughter or Overprint.** A pink-red palette; Overprint is cheaper and brighter.

Ready-made pink loadouts with guns on three budgets are in the [pink CS2 loadout](/en/blog/rozovyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/) guide.

[cta color=2 budget=18000 text="Build a pink loadout with a knife" btn="Open the builder"]

## What to avoid

- **Other Doppler phases.** Phase 1, 3, 4, Ruby, Sapphire and Black Pearl aren't pink. If the name doesn't say "Phase 2", it doesn't belong in a pink set.
- **Marble Fade.** Red and blue with yellow, not pink, even if the preview sometimes looks pinkish.
- **Crimson Web and Autotronic.** These are red finishes; next to Doppler Phase 2, red looks out of place.
- **Ultraviolet.** Dark purple, not pink.

## FAQ

**What's the cheapest pink knife in CS2?** Navaja Knife | Slaughter — from [price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. Among Doppler Phase 2 — the Navaja and Gut Knife.

**Which gloves are pink in CS2?** Hand Wraps | Overprint, Specialist Gloves | Fade, Sport Gloves | Vice and Hand Wraps | Slaughter. Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent are more purple-pink.

**Why is a Factory New Fade cheaper than Minimal Wear?** Fades almost always drop in FN, while MW is rare. That rarity makes MW pricier, even though it looks the same.

## Bottom line

For a pink knife, remember three words: Doppler Phase 2, Fade and Slaughter. The cheapest way in is a Navaja or Gut Knife; the best balance is the Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2). For gloves, go Overprint on a budget or Vice for the top. Full lists with prices are on the [pink knives](/en/pink-knives-cs2/) and [pink gloves](/en/pink-gloves-cs2/) pages.

title: Скины про-игроков CS2: что у s1mple, NiKo, ZywOo, donk, m0NESY и ropz
desc: Какие скины используют s1mple, NiKo, ZywOo, donk, m0NESY и ropz, сколько стоят их сеты и как собрать похожий инвентарь в 5–10 раз дешевле. Живые цены.
lead: Скины звёзд CS2 — одни из самых популярных в игре: их видят миллионы зрителей турниров. Собрали, что сейчас используют шесть громких игроков, сколько это стоит и как повторить их стиль без ножа за 150 тысяч.
md:
Данные о скинах — по [ProSettings](https://prosettings.net/gear/lists/skins/) на октябрь 2026 года. Игроки часто меняют скины, а на турнирах могут играть с другими, так что это срез, а не вечный список. Фазу Doppler источник не указывает — на картинках Phase 2 для примера.

## s1mple: Asiimov и Redline

Легенда NAVI — с одними из самых узнаваемых скинов игры. **AWP | Asiimov** ([price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"] в Field-Tested), **AK-47 | Redline** ([price name="AK-47 | Redline" wear="FT"]), **M4A1-S | Fade** ([price name="M4A1-S | Fade" wear="FN"]) и **Butterfly Knife | Doppler** (от [price name="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]).

[skins names="AWP | Asiimov;AK-47 | Redline;M4A1-S | Fade;Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** AWP Asiimov и Redline и так недорогие — оставляем. Butterfly меняем на **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** за [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"] — тот же глянцевый Doppler, но в 15 раз дешевле.

[skins names="AWP | Asiimov;AK-47 | Redline;M4A1-S | Fade;Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

## NiKo: всё в Printstream

Чёрно-белый Printstream на M4 и USP, огненный **Desert Eagle | Blaze** (от [price name="Desert Eagle | Blaze"]), **Glock-18 | Fade** (от [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]) и тот же Butterfly Doppler. **M4A1-S | Printstream** — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"], **USP-S | Printstream** — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"].

[skins names="Desert Eagle | Blaze;M4A1-S | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;Glock-18 | Fade;Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** Printstream оставляем, Blaze меняем на **Desert Eagle | Printstream** ([price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]) — получается полный чёрно-белый сет. Glock Fade заменяет розовый **Glock-18 | Vogue** ([price name="Glock-18 | Vogue" wear="FT"]), нож — Navaja Doppler.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;Desert Eagle | Printstream;Glock-18 | Vogue;Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

## ZywOo: Kill Confirmed

Француз из Vitality играет с **USP-S | Kill Confirmed** ([price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FT"]) — самым популярным USP среди профи, **Dual Berettas | Melondrama** ([price name="Dual Berettas | Melondrama" wear="FT"]), **M4A1-S | Fade** и Butterfly Doppler.

[skins names="USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Dual Berettas | Melondrama;M4A1-S | Fade;Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** всё, кроме ножа, и так доступно. Butterfly на Navaja Doppler — и сет обходится в шесть раз дешевле.

## donk: Printstream и Galil Eco

Самый скромный набор в списке: **M4A1-S | Printstream** ([price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]) и **Galil AR | Eco** ([price name="Galil AR | Eco" wear="FT"]). Повторить можно почти без компромиссов — достаточно взять оба скина в Battle-Scarred.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Printstream;Galil AR | Eco"]

## m0NESY: Kill Confirmed и Glock Fade

**USP-S | Kill Confirmed** ([price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FT"]) и **Glock-18 | Fade** (от [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]). Почти вся цена — в Glock: Fade бывает только Factory New и Minimal Wear. Бюджетная замена — **Glock-18 | Vogue**.

[skins names="USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Glock-18 | Fade"]

## ropz: красный сет

Самый «цветной» инвентарь из шести — почти весь красный: **AK-47 | Bloodsport** ([price name="AK-47 | Bloodsport" wear="FT"]), **USP-S | Kill Confirmed**, **Desert Eagle | Blaze**, **Glock-18 | Fade** и перчатки **Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono** (от [price name="Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono"]).

[skins names="AK-47 | Bloodsport;USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Desert Eagle | Blaze;Glock-18 | Fade;Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono"]

**Как повторить дешевле:** Bloodsport и Kill Confirmed оставляем, Blaze меняем на **Desert Eagle | Code Red** ([price name="Desert Eagle | Code Red" wear="FT"]), Glock — на **Candy Apple** ([price name="Glock-18 | Candy Apple" wear="FT"]), перчатки — на **Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red** ([price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]). Подробнее про красный сет — в статье [красно-чёрный инвентарь CS2](/blog/krasno-chernyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/).

[skins names="AK-47 | Bloodsport;USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Desert Eagle | Code Red;Glock-18 | Candy Apple;Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red"]

## Сколько стоят сеты про и их копии

Суммы — по ценам на 20 октября 2026 года, Field-Tested там, где он есть.

| Игрок | Сет как у про | Похожий сет |

| NiKo | ≈ 328 000 ₽ | ≈ 26 000 ₽ |

Видно закономерность: почти у всех топ-игроков есть **USP-S | Kill Confirmed**, **Printstream** или **Asiimov** — это недорогие скины, с которых можно начать «профессиональный» инвентарь. Дорогими сеты делают нож, перчатки и Glock Fade.

en.title: CS2 Pro Player Skins: What s1mple, NiKo, ZywOo, donk, m0NESY and ropz Use
en.desc: Which skins s1mple, NiKo, ZywOo, donk, m0NESY and ropz use, how much their sets cost and how to build a similar loadout 5–10x cheaper. Live prices.
en.lead: Pro players' skins are some of the most popular in CS2 — millions of tournament viewers see them. Here's what six big names use right now, how much it costs, and how to copy their style without a $1,600 knife.
en.md:
Skin data comes from [ProSettings](https://prosettings.net/gear/lists/skins/) as of October 2026. Players change skins often and may use different ones at tournaments, so this is a snapshot, not a permanent list. The source doesn't specify the Doppler phase — the images show Phase 2 as an example.

## s1mple: Asiimov and Redline

The NAVI legend uses some of the most recognizable skins in the game: **AWP | Asiimov** ([price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"] in Field-Tested), **AK-47 | Redline** ([price name="AK-47 | Redline" wear="FT"]), **M4A1-S | Fade** ([price name="M4A1-S | Fade" wear="FN"]) and **Butterfly Knife | Doppler** (from [price name="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]).

[skins names="AWP | Asiimov;AK-47 | Redline;M4A1-S | Fade;Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

**How to copy it cheaper:** the AWP Asiimov and Redline are already affordable — keep them. Swap the Butterfly for a **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** at [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"] — the same glossy Doppler, 15x cheaper.

[skins names="AWP | Asiimov;AK-47 | Redline;M4A1-S | Fade;Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

## NiKo: all-in on Printstream

Black-and-white Printstream on the M4 and USP, a fiery **Desert Eagle | Blaze** (from [price name="Desert Eagle | Blaze"]), **Glock-18 | Fade** (from [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]) and the same Butterfly Doppler. **M4A1-S | Printstream** — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"], **USP-S | Printstream** — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"].

[skins names="Desert Eagle | Blaze;M4A1-S | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;Glock-18 | Fade;Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

**How to copy it cheaper:** keep the Printstreams and swap the Blaze for a **Desert Eagle | Printstream** ([price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]) for a full black-and-white set. Replace the Glock Fade with the pink **Glock-18 | Vogue** ([price name="Glock-18 | Vogue" wear="FT"]) and the knife with a Navaja Doppler.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;Desert Eagle | Printstream;Glock-18 | Vogue;Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

## ZywOo: Kill Confirmed

Vitality's star plays with the **USP-S | Kill Confirmed** ([price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FT"]) — the most popular USP among pros — plus **Dual Berettas | Melondrama** ([price name="Dual Berettas | Melondrama" wear="FT"]), **M4A1-S | Fade** and the Butterfly Doppler.

[skins names="USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Dual Berettas | Melondrama;M4A1-S | Fade;Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

**How to copy it cheaper:** everything except the knife is already affordable. Swap the Butterfly for a Navaja Doppler and the set costs six times less.

## donk: Printstream and Galil Eco

The most modest set on the list: **M4A1-S | Printstream** ([price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]) and **Galil AR | Eco** ([price name="Galil AR | Eco" wear="FT"]). Easy to copy with almost no compromise — just take both in Battle-Scarred.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Printstream;Galil AR | Eco"]

## m0NESY: Kill Confirmed and Glock Fade

**USP-S | Kill Confirmed** ([price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FT"]) and **Glock-18 | Fade** (from [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]). Almost all the cost is the Glock: Fade only comes in Factory New and Minimal Wear. A budget swap is the **Glock-18 | Vogue**.

[skins names="USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Glock-18 | Fade"]

## ropz: the red set

The most colorful loadout of the six — nearly all red: **AK-47 | Bloodsport** ([price name="AK-47 | Bloodsport" wear="FT"]), **USP-S | Kill Confirmed**, **Desert Eagle | Blaze**, **Glock-18 | Fade** and **Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono** (from [price name="Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono"]).

[skins names="AK-47 | Bloodsport;USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Desert Eagle | Blaze;Glock-18 | Fade;Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono"]

**How to copy it cheaper:** keep the Bloodsport and Kill Confirmed, swap the Blaze for a **Desert Eagle | Code Red** ([price name="Desert Eagle | Code Red" wear="FT"]), the Glock for a **Candy Apple** ([price name="Glock-18 | Candy Apple" wear="FT"]) and the gloves for **Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red** ([price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]). More in our [red and black CS2 loadout](/en/blog/krasno-chernyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/) guide.

[skins names="AK-47 | Bloodsport;USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Desert Eagle | Code Red;Glock-18 | Candy Apple;Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red"]

## How much pro sets and their copies cost

Totals use prices as of October 20, 2026, Field-Tested where available.

| Player | Pro set | Similar set |
|---|---|---|
| s1mple | ≈ $1,930 | ≈ $355 |
| NiKo | ≈ $3,640 | ≈ $290 |
| ZywOo | ≈ $1,880 | ≈ $330 |
| donk | ≈ $172 | ≈ $135 |
| m0NESY | ≈ $1,310 | ≈ $67 |
| ropz | ≈ $3,440 | ≈ $260 |

There's a pattern: almost every top player uses the **USP-S | Kill Confirmed**, a **Printstream** or an **Asiimov** — affordable skins you can start a "pro" loadout with. What makes the sets expensive is the knife, the gloves and the Glock Fade.

[cta color=0 budget=30000 text="Build a pro-style set for $330" btn="Open the builder"]

title: Какие перчатки подходят к ножу Doppler: пары для каждой фазы
desc: Перчатки к Karambit, Flip, Gut и Navaja Doppler: что брать к Phase 1–4, Ruby, Sapphire и Black Pearl. Пары под любой бюджет с живыми ценами.
lead: Doppler — самый популярный глянцевый нож в CS2, но у него не один цвет, а семь: четыре фазы и три «камня». Поэтому и перчатки к нему подбираются по фазе. Ниже — что надевать к каждой, от недорогих пар до топовых.
md:
## Сначала определи фазу

У Doppler один и тот же нож может быть почти чёрным, розовым, синим или зелёным — это зависит от фазы:

- **Phase 1** — чёрный с тёмно-фиолетовым и синим.
- **Phase 2** — самая яркая: розовый и фиолетовый.
- **Phase 3** — сине-зелёный, бирюзовый.
- **Phase 4** — насыщенный синий с фиолетовым.
- **Ruby, Sapphire, Black Pearl** — «камни»: сплошной красный, сплошной синий и тёмный перламутр. Стоят в разы дороже обычных фаз.

tr.title: Doppler bıçağa hangi eldiven yakışır: her faz için kombinler

tr.lead: Doppler, CS2'nin en popüler parlak bıçağı — ama tek bir rengi yok, yedi rengi var: dört faz ve üç taş. Bu yüzden eldivenler faza göre seçilir. Aşağıda her faza uygun eldivenler var, ucuzdan en üst seviyeye.
tr.md:
## Önce fazı belirle

Aynı Doppler bıçak faza göre neredeyse siyah, pembe, mavi ya da yeşil olabilir:

- **Phase 1** — koyu mor ve maviyle siyah.
- **Phase 2** — en canlısı: pembe ve mor.
- **Phase 3** — mavi-yeşil, turkuaz.
- **Phase 4** — morla koyu mavi.
- **Ruby, Sapphire, Black Pearl** — taşlar: düz kırmızı, düz mavi ve koyu inci. Normal fazlardan kat kat pahalı.

Ana kural: Doppler parlak ve canlı, bu yüzden eldivenleri de kirli kamuflaj değil, temiz renklerde seç. Doppler sadece Factory New ve Minimal Wear'da var; eldivenleri ise Field-Tested alabilirsin — oyunda fark neredeyse görünmez, fiyatta ise çok büyük.

[skins names="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

## Phase 2: pembe ve mor

pl.lead: Doppler to najpopularniejszy błyszczący nóż w CS2, ale nie ma jednego koloru — ma siedem: cztery fazy i trzy kamienie. Dlatego rękawice dobiera się do fazy. Poniżej — co pasuje do każdej, od tanich par po topowe.
pl.md:
## Najpierw ustal fazę

Ten sam nóż Doppler może być prawie czarny, różowy, niebieski albo zielony — zależy to od fazy:

- **Ruby, Sapphire, Black Pearl** — kamienie: czysta czerwień, czysty niebieski i ciemna perła. Kosztują wielokrotnie więcej niż zwykłe fazy.

Główna zasada: Doppler jest błyszczący i jaskrawy, więc rękawice też wybieraj w czystych kolorach, bez brudnego kamuflażu. Doppler występuje tylko w Factory New i Minimal Wear, a rękawice możesz brać w Field-Tested — w grze różnicy prawie nie widać, a w cenie jest ogromna.

en.desc: Which CS2 knife is the cheapest, which models you can get under $110 and where to find great-looking finishes for little money. Live prices for every knife.
en.lead: A CS2 knife doesn't have to cost hundreds of dollars. The cheapest ones cost about as much as a couple of rifle skins, and for $60–100 you can already get a Doppler, Fade or Lore. Here's where to start.
en.md:
## The cheapest knives right now

The cheapest are compact models in camo finishes. Prices are the lowest on marketplaces.

- **Shadow Daggers | Black Laminate** — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Black Laminate"]: twin push daggers, black with wood.
- **Navaja Knife | Forest DDPAT** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Forest DDPAT"]: a folding knife in forest camo.
- **Kukri Knife | Safari Mesh** — [price name="Kukri Knife | Safari Mesh"]: the newest knife in the game at the lowest price.
- **Paracord Knife | Safari Mesh** — [price name="Paracord Knife | Safari Mesh"].
- **Survival Knife | Boreal Forest** — [price name="Survival Knife | Boreal Forest"].
- **Gut Knife | Safari Mesh** — [price name="Gut Knife | Safari Mesh"]: the classic "first knife".

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Black Laminate;Navaja Knife | Forest DDPAT;Kukri Knife | Safari Mesh;Paracord Knife | Safari Mesh;Survival Knife | Boreal Forest;Gut Knife | Safari Mesh"]

There's also **Rust Coat** — rust that only exists in Battle-Scarred: for example, Shadow Daggers | Rust Coat from [price name="Shadow Daggers | Rust Coat"]. Slightly cheaper, but the knife really looks rusty — an acquired taste.

## Which models you can get under $110

If you want a proper model rather than "the cheapest", here are the minimum prices for each:

- **Ursus Knife** (Safari Mesh) — [price name="Ursus Knife | Safari Mesh"]
- **Huntsman Knife** (Boreal Forest) — [price name="Huntsman Knife | Boreal Forest"]
- **Falchion Knife** (Safari Mesh) — [price name="Falchion Knife | Safari Mesh"]
- **Classic Knife** (Safari Mesh) — [price name="Classic Knife | Safari Mesh"]
- **Flip Knife** (Boreal Forest) — [price name="Flip Knife | Boreal Forest"]
- **Bayonet** (Scorched) — [price name="Bayonet | Scorched"]

[skins names="Ursus Knife | Safari Mesh;Huntsman Knife | Boreal Forest;Falchion Knife | Safari Mesh;Classic Knife | Safari Mesh;Flip Knife | Boreal Forest;Bayonet | Scorched"]

The Flip Knife and Bayonet are the best finds in this range: popular models with great animations that cost many times more in top finishes.

## Great-looking knives for the price of camo

The most interesting part: cheap models in "expensive" finishes. For $45–100 you get a knife that looks like it cost much more:

- **Shadow Daggers | Lore** — gold, [price name="Shadow Daggers | Lore"].
- **Navaja Knife | Crimson Web** — red web, [price name="Navaja Knife | Crimson Web"].
- **Gut Knife | Lore** — [price name="Gut Knife | Lore"].
- **Navaja Knife | Marble Fade** — red-blue with yellow, [price name="Navaja Knife | Marble Fade"].
- **Gut Knife | Autotronic** — red and black metal, [price name="Gut Knife | Autotronic"].
- **Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — pink-purple Doppler, [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"].

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Lore;Navaja Knife | Crimson Web;Gut Knife | Lore;Navaja Knife | Marble Fade;Gut Knife | Autotronic;Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

It's easy to build a whole matching loadout around any of these — see the blog for [red and black](/en/blog/krasno-chernyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/), [gold](/en/blog/zolotoj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/) and [purple](/en/blog/fioletovyj-inventar-cs2-tri-seta/) sets.

## And how much do the "top" models cost

For comparison — minimum prices for the most wanted knives (in their cheapest finish):

- **Talon Knife** — from [price name="Talon Knife | Safari Mesh"]
- **M9 Bayonet** — from [price name="M9 Bayonet | Safari Mesh"]
- **Karambit** — from [price name="Karambit | Safari Mesh"]

## How to save on a knife

- **Go for Field-Tested or Well-Worn.** The knife is big on screen, but wear is barely visible on camo and dark finishes.
- **Pick the model, not the finish.** A Flip or Bayonet in a simple finish often feels better than a Gut in an "expensive" one.
