title: Качество скинов CS2: что значит FT, MW, FN, WW и BS и что лучше
desc: FT — Field-Tested, среднее качество (float 0,15–0,38). MW — немного поношенное, FN — с завода, WW — поношенное, BS — худшее. Что лучше: FT или BS, WW или FT.
lead: Один и тот же скин в разном качестве может отличаться в цене в 5–10 раз — а в игре разницу иногда не видно вообще. Разбираемся, что значат FN, MW, FT, WW и BS, и где на этом можно сэкономить.
md:
## FT, MW, FN, WW, BS — какое это качество

- **FT** — Field-Tested, «после полевых испытаний». Среднее качество, float 0,15–0,38: лёгкие потёртости, рисунок целый.
- **MW** — Minimal Wear, «немного поношенное». Второе по качеству, float 0,07–0,15: царапины видны только вблизи.
- **FN** — Factory New, «прямо с завода». Лучшее качество, float 0,00–0,07.
- **WW** — Well-Worn, «поношенное». Float 0,38–0,45: износ уже заметен.
- **BS** — Battle-Scarred, «закалённый в боях». Худшее и самое дешёвое качество, float 0,45–1,00.

Порядок от лучшего к худшему: **FN → MW → FT → WW → BS**.

## Таблица качеств скинов CS2

Подробнее: у каждого скина есть **float** — число от 0 до 1, которое показывает, насколько потёрт рисунок. По нему скин попадает в одно из пяти качеств. В КС 2 они устроены так же, как были в КС ГО:

| Качество | Сокращение | Float | Как выглядит |
|---|---|---|---|
| Factory New | FN | 0,00–0,07 | Как с завода, без потёртостей |
| Minimal Wear | MW | 0,07–0,15 | Мелкие царапины, заметны только вблизи |
| Field-Tested | FT | 0,15–0,38 | Потёртости по краям, рисунок целый |
| Well-Worn | WW | 0,38–0,45 | Заметный износ, краска начинает сходить |
| Battle-Scarred | BS | 0,45–1,00 | Сильно потёртый, части рисунка нет |

- **FT качество** — это Field-Tested, «после полевых испытаний». Самое популярное качество: износ виден, если присматриваться, но рисунок цел. Для большинства скинов лучший баланс цены и вида.
- **BS качество** — Battle-Scarred, «закалённый в боях». Самый дешёвый вариант. На светлых скинах выглядит грязно, на тёмных разница с FT бывает почти незаметна.
- **WW качество** — Well-Worn, «поношенное». Промежуточное между FT и BS, самый узкий диапазон float.
- **MW** — Minimal Wear, «немного поношенное», и **FN** — Factory New, «прямо с завода».

Чем выше float, тем больше потёртостей, царапин и «съеденной» краски. Но у разных скинов износ проявляется по-разному: на одних его почти не видно даже в BS, на других рисунок исчезает уже в FT.

Не у всех скинов есть все пять качеств. Doppler, Fade и Marble Fade бывают только FN и MW, а AWP | Asiimov — наоборот, только FT, WW и BS.

## Что лучше: FT, WW или BS — коротко

- **FT или BS?** Почти всегда **FT (Field-Tested)**: рисунок заметно целее, а разница в цене обычно 10–25%. BS берут, только если скин в нём выглядит нормально (тёмные и матовые раскраски) или нужен самый дешёвый вариант.
- **WW или FT?** **FT**. Well-Worn — узкий диапазон float 0,38–0,45, по виду он ближе к BS, а стоит почти как FT, а иногда даже дороже. Исключение — WW с float около 0,38: выглядит как FT, но дешевле.
- **MW или FT?** На основном оружии (AK, M4, AWP) — MW, разницу видно. На перчатках, пистолетах и тёмных скинах — FT, переплачивать за MW нет смысла.
- **FN или MW?** MW с низким float (до ~0,09) на глаз не отличить от FN, а стоит он заметно дешевле.

## Что лучше: FT или BS — на примерах

Разница в цене между FT и BS у популярных скинов меньше, чем кажется:

| Скин | FT | BS | Что выбрать |
|---|---|---|---|
| AK-47 \| Redline | [price name="AK-47 | Redline" wear="FT"] | [price name="AK-47 | Redline" wear="BS"] | FT — в BS красные полосы стираются |
| USP-S \| Kill Confirmed | [price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FT"] | [price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="BS"] | FT — главный рисунок на затворе |
| AWP \| Asiimov | [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"] | [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="BS"] | Дело вкуса: BS — это «Blackiimov» |
| Karambit \| Case Hardened | [price name="Karambit | Case Hardened" wear="FT"] | [price name="Karambit | Case Hardened" wear="BS"] | BS — износ почти не виден |

**AWP | Asiimov в BS** — известное исключение. Белая краска стирается до чёрного металла, и скин становится почти чёрным с оранжевыми вставками. Его даже называют отдельно — Blackiimov, и многим он нравится больше FT.

**Ножи Case Hardened, Blue Steel, Night и Damascus Steel** — металлические отделки, на которых износ почти не читается. Здесь BS — нормальный способ сэкономить на ноже.

А вот на ярких рисунках (Redline, Kill Confirmed, Asiimov на AK, Printstream) BS выглядит грязно. Переплата за FT небольшая и того стоит.

[skins names="AK-47 | Redline;USP-S | Kill Confirmed;AWP | Asiimov;Karambit | Case Hardened"]

## WW или FT: где подвох

Well-Worn кажется разумным компромиссом, но часто это худшая покупка из всех:

- **WW бывает дороже FT.** Например, Desert Eagle | Printstream в FT стоит [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"], а в WW — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="WW"]. WW-скинов на рынке меньше, и цена из-за этого скачет.
- **По виду WW ближе к BS.** Диапазон float 0,38–0,45 — это уже заметный износ.
- **Когда WW имеет смысл:** если float около 0,38–0,39 и цена ниже FT. Такой скин на глаз не отличить от «плохого» FT.

Перед покупкой всегда сравнивай цены во всех качествах. Иногда FT дешевле WW, а BS почти столько же, сколько WW.

## Сколько стоит разница

Несколько примеров, как меняется цена одного скина:

- **AK-47 | Asiimov** — FN [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FN"], MW [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="MW"], FT [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. Factory New стоит в разы дороже остальных, потому что встречается редко.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — FN [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FN"], MW [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="MW"], FT [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"].
- **Driver Gloves | King Snake** — FN [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FN"], FT [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FT"], BS [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="BS"].
- **AK-47 | Vulcan** — MW [price name="AK-47 | Vulcan" wear="MW"], FT [price name="AK-47 | Vulcan" wear="FT"], BS [price name="AK-47 | Vulcan" wear="BS"]. Белый скин: в BS он теряет почти половину цены, потому что выглядит заметно хуже.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Nightmare;Driver Gloves | King Snake;AK-47 | Vulcan"]

## Где можно смело брать FT и ниже

- **Тёмные и матовые скины.** На чёрном, камуфляже и тёмных узорах потёртости почти не видны. Field-Tested здесь — лучший баланс цены и вида.
- **Перчатки.** Их видно каждый раунд, но в динамике игры разница между FT и MW почти незаметна, а цена отличается в разы.
- **Пистолеты и второстепенное оружие.** Их держат в руках реже, поэтому FT или даже WW — нормальный выбор.
- **Металлические ножи.** Case Hardened, Blue Steel, Night, Damascus Steel — износ на них почти не читается.

## Где лучше не экономить

- **Яркие белые и светлые скины.** На белом износ виден сильнее всего — у Asiimov, Printstream, Vulcan и похожих рисунков в WW и BS появляются грязные пятна.
- **Основное оружие.** AK, M4 или AWP ты видишь на экране почти всё время — тут разница между FT и MW заметнее, чем на пистолете.
- **Скины, которые теряют главный элемент.** У некоторых рисунков в высоком износе стирается ключевая деталь — перед покупкой посмотри скриншоты именно этого качества.

## Вопросы и ответы

**Что значит FT в КС 2?** Field-Tested — третье из пяти качеств, float от 0,15 до 0,38. Потёртости есть, но рисунок цел. Самое популярное качество для покупки.

**MW — какое качество?** Minimal Wear, второе по качеству после FN. Float 0,07–0,15, царапины видны только вблизи.

**WW — какое качество?** Well-Worn, четвёртое из пяти, между FT и BS. Float 0,38–0,45.

**Какое качество лучше: WW или FT?** FT. Он выглядит заметно чище, а стоит почти столько же, иногда даже дешевле WW.

**Что значит BS у скина?** Battle-Scarred — самое изношенное качество, float от 0,45 до 1. Самое дешёвое, но на светлых скинах выглядит грязно.

**Можно ли улучшить качество скина?** Нет. Float задаётся при выпадении скина и больше не меняется. Скин не изнашивается, сколько бы ты с ним ни играл.

**Влияет ли качество на игру?** Нет. FN и BS стреляют одинаково — разница только во внешнем виде и цене.

**Какое качество брать на нож и перчатки?** На перчатки — FT: разница с MW почти не видна. На нож с ярким рисунком (Fade, Doppler, Slaughter) — FN или MW, а на металлические отделки можно брать FT и даже BS.

## Как выбрать качество в конструкторе

В Skinset есть переключатель **«Качество»**: «Любое», FN, MW, FT, WW, BS. Выбери FT — и весь сет пересчитается по ценам Field-Tested. А у каждого предмета можно выбрать своё качество отдельно — например, нож в MW, а пистолеты в FT.

[cta color=1 budget=15000 text="Собрать сет в Field-Tested за 15 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

en.title: CS2 Skin Wear Explained: FN, MW, FT, WW, BS — Where You Can Save
en.desc: FT beats BS almost every time: the pattern stays intact for a small extra cost. What FN, MW, FT, WW and BS mean, float ranges, and where you can save.
en.lead: The same skin in different wear can differ in price by 5–10x — and sometimes in game you can't see the difference at all. Here's what FN, MW, FT, WW and BS mean and where you can save.
en.md:
## Quick answer: FT, WW or BS?

- **FT or BS?** Almost always **FT (Field-Tested)**: the pattern is noticeably cleaner, and the price gap is usually 10–25%. Go BS only if the skin still looks fine in it (dark and matte finishes) or you need the cheapest option.
- **WW or FT?** **FT**. Well-Worn is a narrow float range of 0.38–0.45 that looks closer to BS, yet costs almost as much as FT — sometimes even more. The exception is a WW with a float around 0.38: it looks like FT but costs less.
- **MW or FT?** On your main weapon (AK, M4, AWP) — MW, the difference shows. On gloves, pistols and dark skins — FT, MW isn't worth the extra money.
- **FN or MW?** A low-float MW (under ~0.09) is impossible to tell from FN by eye, and it's much cheaper.

## What FN, MW, FT, WW and BS mean in CS2

Every skin has a **float** — a number from 0 to 1 that shows how worn the pattern is. It puts the skin into one of five wear levels, which work exactly the same as they did in CS:GO:

| Wear | Short | Float | How it looks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Factory New | FN | 0.00–0.07 | Fresh from the factory, no scuffs |
| Minimal Wear | MW | 0.07–0.15 | Tiny scratches, visible only up close |
| Field-Tested | FT | 0.15–0.38 | Scuffs on the edges, pattern intact |
| Well-Worn | WW | 0.38–0.45 | Visible wear, paint starts to come off |
| Battle-Scarred | BS | 0.45–1.00 | Heavily worn, parts of the pattern gone |

- **Field-Tested (FT)** is the most popular wear: the wear shows if you look closely, but the pattern is intact. For most skins it's the best balance of price and look.
- **Battle-Scarred (BS)** is the cheapest. It looks dirty on light skins, while on dark ones the difference from FT can be almost invisible.
- **Well-Worn (WW)** sits between FT and BS and has the narrowest float range.

Not every skin has all five wear levels. Doppler, Fade and Marble Fade only come in FN and MW, while the AWP | Asiimov is the opposite — only FT, WW and BS.

## FT or BS — real examples

The price gap between FT and BS on popular skins is smaller than you'd think:

| Skin | FT | BS | Pick |
|---|---|---|---|
| AK-47 \| Redline | [price name="AK-47 | Redline" wear="FT"] | [price name="AK-47 | Redline" wear="BS"] | FT — the red stripes wear off in BS |
| USP-S \| Kill Confirmed | [price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FT"] | [price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="BS"] | FT — the main art is on the slide |
| AWP \| Asiimov | [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"] | [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="BS"] | Taste: BS is the "Blackiimov" |
| Karambit \| Case Hardened | [price name="Karambit | Case Hardened" wear="FT"] | [price name="Karambit | Case Hardened" wear="BS"] | BS — wear barely shows |

**AWP | Asiimov in BS** is the famous exception: the white paint wears down to black metal, and the skin turns almost black with orange accents. It even has its own name — Blackiimov — and many players prefer it to FT.

**Case Hardened, Blue Steel, Night and Damascus Steel knives** are metal finishes where wear is hard to read. BS is a perfectly good way to save on a knife here.

On bright patterns (Redline, Kill Confirmed, AK Asiimov, Printstream), BS looks dirty — the extra cost of FT is small and worth it.

[skins names="AK-47 | Redline;USP-S | Kill Confirmed;AWP | Asiimov;Karambit | Case Hardened"]

## WW or FT: the catch

Well-Worn looks like a smart compromise, but it's often the worst buy of all:

- **WW can cost more than FT.** For example, Desert Eagle | Printstream is [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"] in FT and [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="WW"] in WW. There are fewer WW skins on the market, so prices jump around.
- **WW looks closer to BS.** A 0.38–0.45 float already means visible wear.
- **When WW makes sense:** a float around 0.38–0.39 at a price below FT — you can't tell it from a "bad" FT.

Always compare prices across all wear levels before buying: sometimes FT is cheaper than WW, and BS costs nearly the same as WW.

## How much the difference costs

- **AK-47 | Asiimov** — FN [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FN"], MW [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="MW"], FT [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. Factory New costs several times more because it's rare.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — FN [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FN"], MW [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="MW"], FT [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"].
- **Driver Gloves | King Snake** — FN [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FN"], FT [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FT"], BS [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="BS"].
- **AK-47 | Vulcan** — MW [price name="AK-47 | Vulcan" wear="MW"], FT [price name="AK-47 | Vulcan" wear="FT"], BS [price name="AK-47 | Vulcan" wear="BS"]. A white skin: in BS it loses almost half its price because it looks much worse.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Nightmare;Driver Gloves | King Snake;AK-47 | Vulcan"]

## Where FT and lower are totally fine

- **Dark and matte skins.** On black, camo and dark patterns scuffs are barely visible.
- **Gloves.** In fast gameplay the difference between FT and MW is barely noticeable, while the price differs a lot.
- **Pistols and secondary weapons.** You hold them less often, so FT or even WW is fine.
- **Metal knives.** Case Hardened, Blue Steel, Night, Damascus Steel — wear barely reads on them.

## Where not to save

- **Bright white and light skins.** Wear shows the most on white — Asiimov, Printstream, Vulcan and similar patterns get dirty patches in WW and BS.
- **Your main weapon.** You see your AK, M4 or AWP almost all the time.
- **Skins that lose their key element.** Check screenshots of that exact wear before buying.

## FAQ

**What does FT mean in CS2?** Field-Tested — the third of five wear levels, float 0.15–0.38. There are scuffs, but the pattern is intact. The most popular wear to buy.

**What does BS mean on a skin?** Battle-Scarred — the most worn level, float 0.45–1. The cheapest, but it looks dirty on light skins.

**Can you improve a skin's wear?** No. The float is set when the skin drops and never changes — skins don't wear out no matter how much you play.

**Does wear affect gameplay?** No. FN and BS shoot exactly the same — only the look and price differ.

**What wear for knives and gloves?** Gloves — FT, the difference from MW barely shows. Knives with bright patterns (Fade, Doppler, Slaughter) — FN or MW; metal finishes are fine in FT and even BS.

## How to pick wear in the builder

Skinset has a **Wear** switch: Any, FN, MW, FT, WW, BS. Pick FT and the whole set is recalculated with Field-Tested prices. You can also set the wear for each item separately — say, the knife in MW and pistols in FT.

[cta color=1 budget=15000 text="Build a Field-Tested set for $165" btn="Open the builder"]

de.title: Zustand von CS2-Skins: FN, MW, FT, WW, BS — wo du sparen kannst
de.desc: Was Factory New, Minimal Wear, Field-Tested, Well-Worn und Battle-Scarred bedeuten, was der Float ist und bei welchen Skins ein schlechterer Zustand nicht stört.
de.lead: Derselbe Skin kann je nach Zustand 5- bis 10-mal mehr kosten — und im Spiel sieht man den Unterschied manchmal gar nicht. Hier erfährst du, was FN, MW, FT, WW und BS bedeuten und wo du sparen kannst.
de.md:
## Was Zustand und Float sind

Jeder Skin hat einen **Float** — eine Zahl von 0 bis 1, die zeigt, wie abgenutzt das Muster ist. Danach landet er in einem von fünf Zuständen:

| Zustand | Kürzel | Float |
|---|---|---|
| Factory New | FN | 0,00–0,07 |
| Minimal Wear | MW | 0,07–0,15 |
| Field-Tested | FT | 0,15–0,38 |
| Well-Worn | WW | 0,38–0,45 |
| Battle-Scarred | BS | 0,45–1,00 |

Je höher der Float, desto mehr Kratzer und abgeriebene Farbe. Aber Abnutzung zeigt sich unterschiedlich: Bei manchen Skins sieht man sie selbst in BS kaum, bei anderen verschwindet das Muster schon in FT.

Nicht jeder Skin hat alle fünf Zustände. Doppler, Fade und Marble Fade gibt es nur in FN und MW, die AWP | Asiimov dagegen nur in FT, WW und BS.

## Was der Unterschied kostet

Ein paar Beispiele, wie sich der Preis eines Skins ändert:

- **AK-47 | Asiimov** — FN [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FN"], MW [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="MW"], FT [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. Factory New ist selten und kostet ein Vielfaches.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — FN [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FN"], MW [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="MW"], FT [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"].
- **Driver Gloves | King Snake** — FN [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FN"], FT [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FT"], BS [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="BS"].
- **AWP | Asiimov** — FT [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], WW [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="WW"], BS [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="BS"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Nightmare;Driver Gloves | King Snake;AWP | Asiimov"]

## Wo FT und schlechter völlig okay sind

- **Dunkle und matte Skins.** Auf Schwarz, Camo und dunklen Mustern sieht man Kratzer kaum. Field-Tested ist hier die beste Balance aus Preis und Optik.
- **Handschuhe.** Man sieht sie jede Runde, aber im schnellen Spiel ist der Unterschied zwischen FT und MW kaum zu erkennen, der Preis dagegen schon.
- **Pistolen und Zweitwaffen.** Du hältst sie seltener in der Hand, FT oder sogar WW reicht.
- **Skins, bei denen Abnutzung zum Stil gehört.** Manche Muster sehen abgenutzt sogar besser aus.

## Wo du nicht sparen solltest

- **Grelle weiße und helle Skins.** Auf Weiß sieht man Abnutzung am stärksten — Asiimov, Printstream und ähnliche Muster bekommen in WW und BS schmutzige Flecken.
- **Deine Hauptwaffe.** AK, M4 oder AWP siehst du fast die ganze Zeit — da fällt der Unterschied FT vs. MW mehr auf als bei einer Pistole.
- **Skins, die ihr Hauptelement verlieren.** Bei manchen Mustern verschwindet bei starker Abnutzung das wichtigste Detail — schau dir vor dem Kauf Screenshots genau dieses Zustands an.

## Zustand im Builder wählen

Skinset hat einen **Zustand**-Schalter: Beliebig, FN, MW, FT, WW, BS. Wähle FT und das ganze Set wird mit Field-Tested-Preisen berechnet. Für jedes Item kannst du den Zustand auch einzeln wählen — etwa Messer in MW und Pistolen in FT.

[cta color=1 budget=15000 text="Field-Tested-Set für 165 $ bauen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

pt.title: Desgaste das skins de CS2: FN, MW, FT, WW, BS — onde dá para economizar
pt.desc: O que significam Factory New, Minimal Wear, Field-Tested, Well-Worn e Battle-Scarred, o que é float e em quais skins dá para pegar desgaste maior sem perder o visual.
pt.lead: A mesma skin em desgastes diferentes pode custar 5–10 vezes mais — e às vezes no jogo a diferença nem aparece. Veja o que significam FN, MW, FT, WW e BS e onde dá para economizar.
pt.md:
## O que é desgaste e float

Toda skin tem um **float** — um número de 0 a 1 que mostra o quanto a pintura está gasta. Ele coloca a skin em um de cinco desgastes:

| Desgaste | Sigla | Float |
|---|---|---|
| Factory New | FN | 0,00–0,07 |
| Minimal Wear | MW | 0,07–0,15 |
| Field-Tested | FT | 0,15–0,38 |
| Well-Worn | WW | 0,38–0,45 |
| Battle-Scarred | BS | 0,45–1,00 |

Quanto maior o float, mais arranhões e tinta faltando. Mas o desgaste aparece de forma diferente: em algumas skins quase não se vê nem em BS, em outras o desenho some já em FT.

Nem toda skin tem os cinco desgastes. Doppler, Fade e Marble Fade só existem em FN e MW, já a AWP | Asiimov é o contrário — só FT, WW e BS.

## Quanto custa a diferença

Alguns exemplos de como muda o preço de uma skin:

- **AK-47 | Asiimov** — FN [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FN"], MW [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="MW"], FT [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. A Factory New custa várias vezes mais por ser rara.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — FN [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FN"], MW [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="MW"], FT [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"].
- **Driver Gloves | King Snake** — FN [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FN"], FT [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FT"], BS [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="BS"].
- **AWP | Asiimov** — FT [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], WW [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="WW"], BS [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="BS"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Nightmare;Driver Gloves | King Snake;AWP | Asiimov"]

## Onde FT e abaixo estão ótimos

- **Skins escuras e foscas.** Em preto, camuflagem e desenhos escuros os arranhões quase não aparecem. Field-Tested é o melhor equilíbrio entre preço e visual.
- **Luvas.** Aparecem em todo round, mas no jogo rápido a diferença entre FT e MW quase não se nota, já o preço muda muito.
- **Pistolas e armas secundárias.** Você as segura menos, então FT ou até WW resolve.
- **Skins em que o desgaste faz parte do estilo.** Alguns desenhos ficam até melhores gastos, com cara de "batalha".

## Onde não economizar

- **Skins brancas e claras.** No branco o desgaste aparece mais — Asiimov, Printstream e parecidas ganham manchas sujas em WW e BS.
- **Sua arma principal.** Você vê sua AK, M4 ou AWP quase o tempo todo — a diferença FT x MW aparece mais que numa pistola.
- **Skins que perdem o elemento principal.** Em alguns desenhos o desgaste alto apaga o detalhe principal — veja capturas desse desgaste antes de comprar.

## Como escolher o desgaste no montador

O Skinset tem o seletor **Desgaste**: Qualquer, FN, MW, FT, WW, BS. Escolha FT e o set todo é recalculado com preços Field-Tested. Também dá para escolher o desgaste de cada item — por exemplo, faca em MW e pistolas em FT.

[cta color=1 budget=15000 text="Montar um set Field-Tested por US$ 165" btn="Abrir o montador"]

tr.title: CS2 skin aşınması: FN, MW, FT, WW, BS — nerede tasarruf edilir
tr.desc: Factory New, Minimal Wear, Field-Tested, Well-Worn ve Battle-Scarred ne demek, float nedir ve hangi skinlerde görüntü bozulmadan daha aşınmışı alınır.
tr.lead: Aynı skin farklı aşınmalarda 5–10 kat farklı fiyatta olabilir — ve bazen oyunda fark hiç görünmez. FN, MW, FT, WW ve BS ne demek, nerede tasarruf edebileceğini anlatıyoruz.
tr.md:
## Aşınma ve float nedir

Her skinin bir **float** değeri var — desenin ne kadar aşındığını gösteren 0 ile 1 arası bir sayı. Buna göre skin beş aşınma seviyesinden birine girer:

| Aşınma | Kısaltma | Float |
|---|---|---|
| Factory New | FN | 0,00–0,07 |
| Minimal Wear | MW | 0,07–0,15 |
| Field-Tested | FT | 0,15–0,38 |
| Well-Worn | WW | 0,38–0,45 |
| Battle-Scarred | BS | 0,45–1,00 |

Float yükseldikçe çizik ve dökülen boya artar. Ama aşınma her skinde farklı görünür: bazılarında BS'de bile zor fark edilir, bazılarında desen FT'de kaybolmaya başlar.

Her skinde beş aşınma da yoktur. Doppler, Fade ve Marble Fade sadece FN ve MW'de; AWP | Asiimov ise tam tersi, sadece FT, WW ve BS'de var.

## Fark ne kadar tutuyor

Bir skinin fiyatının nasıl değiştiğine birkaç örnek:

- **AK-47 | Asiimov** — FN [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FN"], MW [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="MW"], FT [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. Factory New nadir olduğu için kat kat pahalı.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — FN [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FN"], MW [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="MW"], FT [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"].
- **Driver Gloves | King Snake** — FN [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FN"], FT [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FT"], BS [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="BS"].
- **AWP | Asiimov** — FT [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], WW [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="WW"], BS [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="BS"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Nightmare;Driver Gloves | King Snake;AWP | Asiimov"]

## FT ve altının rahatça alınabileceği yerler

- **Koyu ve mat skinler.** Siyah, kamuflaj ve koyu desenlerde çizikler neredeyse görünmez. Burada Field-Tested, fiyat ve görüntü arasında en iyi denge.
- **Eldivenler.** Her raunt görünürler ama hızlı oyunda FT ile MW arasındaki fark zor fark edilir, fiyat farkı ise büyük.
- **Tabancalar ve yan silahlar.** Daha az elde tutulurlar, FT hatta WW gayet yeterli.
- **Aşınmanın tarzın parçası olduğu skinler.** Bazı desenler aşınmış halde daha "savaşmış" ve güzel görünür.

## Tasarruf etmemen gereken yerler

- **Parlak beyaz ve açık renkli skinler.** Aşınma en çok beyazda görünür — Asiimov, Printstream ve benzerlerinde WW ve BS'de kirli lekeler çıkar.
- **Ana silahın.** AK, M4 ya da AWP neredeyse hep ekranda — FT ile MW farkı tabancaya göre daha belirgin.
- **Ana öğesini kaybeden skinler.** Bazı desenlerde yüksek aşınma en önemli detayı siler — almadan önce tam o aşınmanın ekran görüntülerine bak.

## Oluşturucuda aşınma nasıl seçilir

Skinset'te **Aşınma** seçici var: Herhangi, FN, MW, FT, WW, BS. FT'yi seç, tüm set Field-Tested fiyatlarıyla yeniden hesaplanır. Her eşya için aşınmayı ayrı da seçebilirsin — örneğin bıçak MW, tabancalar FT.

[cta color=1 budget=15000 text="165 $'a Field-Tested set kur" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

pl.title: Stan skinów CS2: FN, MW, FT, WW, BS — gdzie można zaoszczędzić
pl.desc: Co oznaczają Factory New, Minimal Wear, Field-Tested, Well-Worn i Battle-Scarred, czym jest float i na których skinach gorszy stan nie psuje wyglądu.
pl.lead: Ten sam skin w różnym stanie może kosztować 5–10 razy więcej — a w grze różnicy czasem w ogóle nie widać. Wyjaśniamy, co znaczą FN, MW, FT, WW i BS i gdzie można na tym zaoszczędzić.
pl.md:
## Czym jest stan i float

Każdy skin ma **float** — liczbę od 0 do 1, która pokazuje, jak bardzo wzór jest zużyty. Na jej podstawie skin trafia do jednego z pięciu stanów:

| Stan | Skrót | Float |
|---|---|---|
| Factory New | FN | 0,00–0,07 |
| Minimal Wear | MW | 0,07–0,15 |
| Field-Tested | FT | 0,15–0,38 |
| Well-Worn | WW | 0,38–0,45 |
| Battle-Scarred | BS | 0,45–1,00 |

Im wyższy float, tym więcej rys i startej farby. Ale zużycie wygląda różnie: na niektórych skinach prawie go nie widać nawet w BS, na innych wzór znika już w FT.

Nie każdy skin ma wszystkie pięć stanów. Doppler, Fade i Marble Fade występują tylko w FN i MW, a AWP | Asiimov odwrotnie — tylko w FT, WW i BS.

## Ile kosztuje różnica

Kilka przykładów, jak zmienia się cena jednego skina:

- **AK-47 | Asiimov** — FN [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FN"], MW [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="MW"], FT [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. Factory New kosztuje wielokrotnie więcej, bo jest rzadki.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — FN [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FN"], MW [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="MW"], FT [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"].
- **Driver Gloves | King Snake** — FN [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FN"], FT [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="FT"], BS [price name="Driver Gloves | King Snake" wear="BS"].
- **AWP | Asiimov** — FT [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], WW [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="WW"], BS [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="BS"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Nightmare;Driver Gloves | King Snake;AWP | Asiimov"]

## Gdzie FT i niżej są w porządku

- **Ciemne i matowe skiny.** Na czerni, kamuflażu i ciemnych wzorach rysy są prawie niewidoczne. Field-Tested to tu najlepszy balans ceny i wyglądu.
- **Rękawice.** Widać je w każdej rundzie, ale w szybkiej grze różnica między FT a MW jest prawie niezauważalna, a cena — bardzo.
- **Pistolety i broń poboczna.** Rzadziej trzymasz je w rękach, więc FT albo nawet WW wystarczy.
- **Skiny, w których zużycie to część stylu.** Niektóre wzory wyglądają lepiej zużyte, „bojowo”.

## Gdzie lepiej nie oszczędzać

- **Jasne i białe skiny.** Na bieli zużycie widać najmocniej — Asiimov, Printstream i podobne wzory w WW i BS łapią brudne plamy.
- **Główna broń.** AK, M4 albo AWP widzisz prawie cały czas — różnica FT i MW jest bardziej widoczna niż na pistolecie.
- **Skiny, które tracą główny element.** Na niektórych wzorach wysokie zużycie ściera kluczowy detal — przed zakupem obejrzyj zrzuty właśnie tego stanu.

## Jak wybrać stan w kreatorze

Skinset ma przełącznik **Stan**: Dowolny, FN, MW, FT, WW, BS. Wybierz FT, a cały zestaw przeliczy się po cenach Field-Tested. Stan możesz też ustawić osobno dla każdego przedmiotu — np. nóż w MW, a pistolety w FT.

[cta color=1 budget=15000 text="Zbuduj zestaw Field-Tested za 650 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

title: Бирюзовый инвентарь CS2: сеты с Gamma Doppler от 10 000 до 80 000 ₽
desc: Как собрать бирюзовый инвентарь в CS2: три сета от 10 000 до 80 000 ₽ вокруг Gamma Doppler, Aquamarine Revenge и Ocean Drive, плюс ловушки цвета.
lead: Бирюзы в CS2 мало, поэтому здесь цвет задаёт нож Gamma Doppler, а оружие подстраивается под него. Три сета под разные бюджеты и список скинов, которые только притворяются бирюзовыми.
md:
Бирюза — самая «дефицитная» гамма из популярных. Синих и зелёных скинов в CS2 сотни, а вот чистого цвета морской волны, ровно посередине между ними, — считанные единицы. Зато у бирюзы есть козырь, которого нет у большинства других цветов: ножи Gamma Doppler, которые сами по себе переливаются именно в этом диапазоне.

Поэтому логика сборки здесь обратная. В других гаммах начинают с оружия и потом подбирают нож; в бирюзовой нож задаёт цвет, а оружие подстраивается под него, местами с компромиссами. Ниже три сета, где эти компромиссы честно отмечены.

## Откуда в CS2 бирюза

Бирюзовые скины делятся на три группы:

- **Gamma Doppler** — главный источник цвета. Фазы 1–4 дают зелёно-голубой перелив, Emerald — насыщенный изумрудный. Бывают только Factory New и Minimal Wear, так что износ не важен, важна фаза. Самый дешёвый вход — Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) от [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]; Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) — от [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"].
- **Bright Water** — голубовато-бирюзовые волны на клинке, дешёвая альтернатива Доплерам: Shadow Daggers | Bright Water — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Bright Water" wear="FT"], Gut Knife | Bright Water — [price name="Gut Knife | Bright Water" wear="FT"].
- **Оружие «с бирюзовым акцентом»** — AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner. Это три лучших совпадения по цвету во всём оружейном пуле гаммы.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Bright Water;AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — отдельная находка: за [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"] получаешь самый точный бирюзовый пистолет в игре. На слотах M4, AWP и USP-S идеальных вариантов нет, и это надо принять сразу, чтобы не тратить часы на поиски.

## Сет до 10 000 ₽

Бюджетный сет держится на двух опорах: Aquamarine Revenge на AK и Ocean Drive на Deagle. Остальные слоты закрываются дешёвыми скинами, которые не спорят с бирюзой.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge — [price name="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Cyber Security — [price name="M4A4 | Cyber Security" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Atheris — [price name="AWP | Atheris" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive — [price name="Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Lead Conduit — [price name="USP-S | Lead Conduit" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"]

Итого ≈ 9 200 ₽. Cyber Security и Atheris — сознательный акцент, а не попадание в цвет: в них голубого и бирюзового ровно столько, чтобы не выбиваться, но основную работу делают AK и Deagle. Ocean Drive — самый дорогой пункт; если нужно срезать бюджет почти вдвое, замени его на Desert Eagle | Tilted ([price name="Desert Eagle | Tilted" wear="FT"]) — он бледнее, но в ту же сторону.

[skins names="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;M4A4 | Cyber Security;AWP | Atheris;Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive;USP-S | Lead Conduit;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

[cta color=7 budget=10000 text="Собрать бирюзовый сет за 10 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сет до 30 000 ₽

В среднем бюджете бирюзе выгоднее нож, а не перчатки. Перчатки, которые действительно совпадают с бирюзой, в Field-Tested стоят дороже, чем Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler, а на руке выглядят спокойнее. Нож же даёт настоящий доплеровский перелив, который видно в каждом раунде при осмотре.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge — [price name="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Hyper Beast — [price name="M4A1-S | Hyper Beast" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Hyper Beast — [price name="AWP | Hyper Beast" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive — [price name="Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Lead Conduit — [price name="USP-S | Lead Conduit" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"]
- Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]

Итого ≈ 26 900 ₽. Пара Hyper Beast на M4A1-S и AWP добавляет бирюзово-розовый оттенок, который рифмуется с Aquamarine Revenge и Ocean Drive: у всех трёх та же схема «морская волна плюс тёплый акцент». Phase 1 выбрана потому, что на Shadow Daggers это самая близкая к бирюзе фаза: у Phase 4 на этой модели слишком много синего, у Phase 2 и Phase 3 — зелёного. Цена у всех фаз Shadow Daggers почти одинаковая, так что переплачивать за правильный оттенок не придётся.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Hyper Beast;AWP | Hyper Beast;Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive"]

[cta color=7 budget=30000 text="Собрать бирюзовый сет с Gamma Doppler за 30 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сет с ножом и перчатками до 80 000 ₽

Полный сет — момент, когда можно взять нормальный по размеру нож с Gamma Doppler и добавить перчатки.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, M4A1-S | Hyper Beast, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, USP-S | Lead Conduit, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — как раньше
- AWP | Silk Tiger — [price name="AWP | Silk Tiger" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers — [price name="Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers" wear="FT"]
- Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) — от [price name="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]

Итого ≈ 75 800 ₽. AWP | Silk Tiger заменяет Hyper Beast, потому что под крупный Доплер нужна спокойная снайперка: тигровый узор в бирюзово-зелёных тонах не перетягивает внимание. Brocade Flowers — лучшее совпадение по цвету среди перчаток гаммы: узорчатые, с бирюзовой вышивкой. Если хочется дешевле, Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) (от [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]) даёт тот же перелив на ноже попроще — экономия около 19 000 ₽.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers;AWP | Silk Tiger;Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]

[cta color=7 budget=80000 text="Собрать бирюзовый сет с ножом и перчатками за 80 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сводка по сетам

| Бюджет | Что входит | Итого |
|---|---|---|
| до 10 000 ₽ | AK Aquamarine Revenge, M4A4 Cyber Security, AWP Atheris, Deagle Ocean Drive, USP-S Lead Conduit, Glock Bunsen Burner | ≈ 9 200 ₽ |
| до 30 000 ₽ | AK Aquamarine Revenge, M4A1-S и AWP Hyper Beast, Deagle Ocean Drive, USP-S Lead Conduit, Glock Bunsen Burner, Shadow Daggers Gamma Doppler | ≈ 26 900 ₽ |
| до 80 000 ₽ | То же оружие с AWP Silk Tiger, Driver Gloves Brocade Flowers, Bayonet Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) | ≈ 75 800 ₽ |

Итоговые суммы — по ценам на 15 октября 2026 года. Цены у каждого предмета в статье подтягиваются автоматически и обновляются ежедневно.

## Чего избегать

- **Фаза ножа, купленная «вслепую».** Фазы Gamma Doppler отличаются соотношением зелёного и синего, и на разных моделях ножей одна и та же фаза смотрится по-разному: на Bayonet лучше всего в бирюзу попадают Phase 2 и Phase 4, на Shadow Daggers — Phase 1 и Emerald. Перед покупкой смотри скриншот конкретного экземпляра, а не общую иконку.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** ([price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]). На иконке бирюза с розовым поровну, на руке доминирует розовый. Для бирюзового сета это перебор.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** и **Broken Fang Gloves | Jade** — зелёные, не бирюзовые. Рядом с Phase 2 разница бьёт в глаза.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint и Cool Mint в Battle-Scarred.** Минимальная цена Spearmint — [price name="Moto Gloves | Spearmint" wear="FT"], но это потёртый экземпляр, в котором мятный цвет почти исчез. Нормальный вид начинается с Field-Tested, а там цена уже в разы выше.
- **AK-47 | Wild Lotus и AWP | Medusa.** Оба зелёно-бирюзовые на превью, оба стоят на порядок дороже всего полного сета, и оба в игре заметно темнее и «болотнее», чем ожидаешь. Для цветового сета невыгодно.

## Если хочется дороже

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** — [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. Самое точное бирюзовое попадание на винтовке во всей игре, закрывает главную дыру гаммы.
- **Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)** — от [price name="Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Канонический бирюзовый нож.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint** в Field-Tested — светлые мятно-бирюзовые, одна из самых редких пар в гамме.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** — [price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]. Морская тема и сине-бирюзовый корпус; коллекционный скин, цена которого держится в первую очередь на редкости.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Moto Gloves | Spearmint;M4A4 | Poseidon"]

## Последний совет

Покупай нож первым и только потом подбирай оружие под его фазу: бирюза слишком узкий цвет, чтобы собирать её «снизу вверх». Полный подбор — на странице [бирюзовых скинов CS2](/biryuzovye-skiny-cs2/), отдельно — [бирюзовые ножи](/biryuzovye-nozhi-cs2/) и [бирюзовые перчатки](/biryuzovye-perchatki-cs2/). Остальные гаммы ждут в разделе [цветовых сетов скинов CS2](/cvetovye-sety-skinov-cs2/).

en.title: Teal CS2 Inventory: Gamma Doppler Skin Loadouts from $110 to $890
en.desc: How to build a teal CS2 inventory: three loadouts from $110 to $890 built around Gamma Doppler, Aquamarine Revenge and Ocean Drive, plus color traps.
en.lead: Teal is rare in CS2, so here the Gamma Doppler knife sets the color and the guns fall in line behind it. Three loadouts for different budgets, plus a list of skins that only pretend to be teal.
en.md:
Teal is the scarcest of the popular color schemes. CS2 has hundreds of blue and green skins, but a clean sea-green right between the two? You can count them on your fingers. What teal does have is a trump card most other colors lack: Gamma Doppler knives, which shimmer in exactly this range on their own.

That flips the usual build logic. With other colors you start with the guns and pick a knife later; with teal, the knife sets the color and the guns adapt to it, sometimes with compromises. Below are three loadouts where those compromises are flagged honestly.

## Where teal comes from in CS2

Teal skins fall into three groups:

- **Gamma Doppler** — the main source of the color. Phases 1–4 give a green-blue shimmer, Emerald is a deep, saturated green. It only comes in Factory New and Minimal Wear, so wear doesn't matter, the phase does. The cheapest entry is Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) from [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]; Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) starts at [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"].
- **Bright Water** — blue-teal waves on the blade, a budget alternative to Dopplers: Shadow Daggers | Bright Water — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Bright Water" wear="FT"], Gut Knife | Bright Water — [price name="Gut Knife | Bright Water" wear="FT"].
- **Guns with a teal accent** — AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner. These are the three best color matches in the entire weapon pool for this palette.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Bright Water;AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner is a real find: for [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"] you get the most accurate teal pistol in the game. There are no perfect options for the M4, AWP and USP-S slots, and it's best to accept that up front instead of wasting hours searching.

## Loadout under $110

The budget loadout rests on two pillars: Aquamarine Revenge on the AK and Ocean Drive on the Deagle. The remaining slots get cheap skins that don't fight the teal.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge — [price name="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Cyber Security — [price name="M4A4 | Cyber Security" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Atheris — [price name="AWP | Atheris" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive — [price name="Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Lead Conduit — [price name="USP-S | Lead Conduit" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $100. Cyber Security and Atheris are a deliberate accent rather than a color match: they have just enough blue and teal not to stand out, while the AK and Deagle do the heavy lifting. Ocean Drive is the priciest item; if you need to cut the budget almost in half, swap it for Desert Eagle | Tilted ([price name="Desert Eagle | Tilted" wear="FT"]) — it's paler, but leans the same way.

[skins names="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;M4A4 | Cyber Security;AWP | Atheris;Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive;USP-S | Lead Conduit;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

[cta color=7 budget=10000 text="Build a teal loadout for $110" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout under $330

At a mid-range budget, teal gets more out of a knife than gloves. Gloves that genuinely match teal cost more in Field-Tested than Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler, and they look more muted on your hands. A knife, on the other hand, gives you a real Doppler shimmer you see every round when you inspect.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge — [price name="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Hyper Beast — [price name="M4A1-S | Hyper Beast" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Hyper Beast — [price name="AWP | Hyper Beast" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive — [price name="Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Lead Conduit — [price name="USP-S | Lead Conduit" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"]
- Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]

Total ≈ $300. The Hyper Beast pair on the M4A1-S and AWP adds a teal-and-pink tone that rhymes with Aquamarine Revenge and Ocean Drive: all three follow the same "sea green plus a warm accent" formula. Phase 1 was picked because on Shadow Daggers it's the phase closest to teal: Phase 4 has too much blue on this model, Phase 2 and Phase 3 too much green. All Shadow Daggers phases cost about the same, so you won't overpay for the right shade.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Hyper Beast;AWP | Hyper Beast;Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive"]

[cta color=7 budget=30000 text="Build a teal Gamma Doppler loadout for $330" btn="Open the builder"]

## Knife and gloves loadout under $890

The full loadout is where you can grab a proper full-size Gamma Doppler knife and add gloves.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, M4A1-S | Hyper Beast, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, USP-S | Lead Conduit, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — same as before
- AWP | Silk Tiger — [price name="AWP | Silk Tiger" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers — [price name="Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers" wear="FT"]
- Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) — from [price name="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]

Total ≈ $840. AWP | Silk Tiger replaces the Hyper Beast because a big Doppler needs a calm sniper: the tiger pattern in teal-green tones doesn't steal the spotlight. Brocade Flowers are the best color match among gloves in this palette: patterned, with teal embroidery. If you want it cheaper, Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) (from [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]) gives you the same shimmer on a simpler knife — saving about $210.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers;AWP | Silk Tiger;Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]

[cta color=7 budget=80000 text="Build a teal loadout with knife and gloves for $890" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout summary

| Budget | What's included | Total |
|---|---|---|
| under $110 | AK Aquamarine Revenge, M4A4 Cyber Security, AWP Atheris, Deagle Ocean Drive, USP-S Lead Conduit, Glock Bunsen Burner | ≈ $100 |
| under $330 | AK Aquamarine Revenge, M4A1-S and AWP Hyper Beast, Deagle Ocean Drive, USP-S Lead Conduit, Glock Bunsen Burner, Shadow Daggers Gamma Doppler | ≈ $300 |
| under $890 | Same guns with AWP Silk Tiger, Driver Gloves Brocade Flowers, Bayonet Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) | ≈ $840 |

Totals are based on prices as of October 15, 2026. Individual item prices in the article are pulled in automatically and updated daily.

## What to avoid

- **Buying a knife phase blind.** Gamma Doppler phases differ in their green-to-blue ratio, and the same phase looks different on different knife models: on the Bayonet, Phase 2 and Phase 4 hit teal best; on Shadow Daggers, it's Phase 1 and Emerald. Before buying, check a screenshot of the specific item, not the generic icon.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** ([price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]). The icon shows an even split of teal and pink, but on your hands the pink dominates. Too much for a teal loadout.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** and **Broken Fang Gloves | Jade** — green, not teal. Next to Phase 2 the difference is glaring.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint and Cool Mint in Battle-Scarred.** The cheapest Spearmint goes for [price name="Moto Gloves | Spearmint" wear="FT"], but that's a beat-up copy where the mint has almost faded away. They start looking right in Field-Tested, and there the price is several times higher.
- **AK-47 | Wild Lotus and AWP | Medusa.** Both look green-teal in previews, both cost an order of magnitude more than the entire full loadout, and both are noticeably darker and swampier in-game than you'd expect. Not worth it for a color loadout.

## If you want to go bigger

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** — [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. The most accurate teal rifle in the whole game, plugging the palette's biggest gap.
- **Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)** — from [price name="Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]. The definitive teal knife.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint** in Field-Tested — light mint-teal and one of the rarest pairs in this palette.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** — [price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]. Ocean theme and a blue-teal body; a collector's skin whose price rests mostly on rarity.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Moto Gloves | Spearmint;M4A4 | Poseidon"]

## One last tip

Buy the knife first, then pick guns to match its phase: teal is too narrow a color to build from the bottom up. The full selection is on the [teal CS2 skins](/en/teal-cs2-skins/) page, with separate pages for [turquoise knives](/en/turquoise-knives-cs2/) and [turquoise gloves](/en/turquoise-gloves-cs2/). Other palettes are waiting in the [CS2 skin sets by color](/en/cs2-skin-sets-by-color/) section.

de.title: Türkise CS2 Skins: 3 Inventar-Sets mit Gamma Doppler (110–900 €)
de.desc: Türkises CS2-Inventar zusammenstellen: drei Sets von 110 bis 900 € rund um Gamma Doppler, Aquamarine Revenge und Ocean Drive – plus typische Farbfallen.
de.lead: Türkis ist in CS2 rar – deshalb gibt hier das Gamma-Doppler-Messer die Farbe vor, und die Waffen richten sich danach. Drei Sets für verschiedene Budgets und eine Liste von Skins, die nur so tun, als wären sie türkis.
de.md:
Türkis ist unter den beliebten Farbwelten die mit dem knappsten Angebot. Blaue und grüne Skins gibt es in CS2 zu Hunderten, aber echtes Meeresgrün, genau in der Mitte zwischen beiden, kannst du an zwei Händen abzählen. Dafür hat Türkis einen Trumpf, den die meisten anderen Farben nicht haben: die Gamma-Doppler-Messer, die von Haus aus genau in diesem Spektrum schimmern.

Deshalb läuft der Aufbau hier andersherum. Bei anderen Farben fängt man mit den Waffen an und sucht dann ein Messer dazu; beim türkisen Loadout gibt das Messer die Farbe vor, und die Waffen passen sich an – teils mit Kompromissen. Unten findest du drei Sets, in denen diese Kompromisse ehrlich benannt sind.

## Woher Türkis in CS2 kommt

Türkise Skins lassen sich in drei Gruppen einteilen:

- **Gamma Doppler** – die Hauptquelle der Farbe. Phase 1–4 liefern einen grün-blauen Schimmer, Emerald ein sattes Smaragdgrün. Es gibt sie nur in Factory New und Minimal Wear, der Zustand spielt also keine Rolle – entscheidend ist die Phase. Der günstigste Einstieg sind Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) ab [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]; Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) gibt es ab [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"].
- **Bright Water** – bläulich-türkise Wellen auf der Klinge, die günstige Alternative zu den Dopplern: Shadow Daggers | Bright Water – [price name="Shadow Daggers | Bright Water" wear="FT"], Gut Knife | Bright Water – [price name="Gut Knife | Bright Water" wear="FT"].
- **Waffen „mit türkisem Akzent“** – AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner. Das sind die drei besten Farbtreffer im gesamten Waffen-Pool dieser Farbwelt.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Bright Water;AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner ist ein echter Fund: Für [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"] bekommst du die farbtreueste türkise Pistole im ganzen Spiel. Für M4, AWP und USP-S gibt es dagegen keine perfekten Optionen – das solltest du gleich akzeptieren, statt stundenlang zu suchen.

## Set bis 110 €

Das Budget-Set steht auf zwei Säulen: Aquamarine Revenge auf der AK und Ocean Drive auf der Deagle. Die übrigen Slots füllen günstige Skins, die sich nicht mit dem Türkis beißen.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge – [price name="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Cyber Security – [price name="M4A4 | Cyber Security" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Atheris – [price name="AWP | Atheris" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive – [price name="Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Lead Conduit – [price name="USP-S | Lead Conduit" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner – [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"]

Gesamt ≈ 100 €. Cyber Security und Atheris sind ein bewusster Akzent, kein exakter Farbtreffer: Sie haben gerade so viel Blau und Türkis, dass sie nicht herausfallen – die Hauptarbeit machen AK und Deagle. Ocean Drive ist der teuerste Posten; wenn du das Budget fast halbieren willst, nimm stattdessen Desert Eagle | Tilted ([price name="Desert Eagle | Tilted" wear="FT"]) – blasser, aber in dieselbe Richtung.

[skins names="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;M4A4 | Cyber Security;AWP | Atheris;Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive;USP-S | Lead Conduit;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

[cta color=7 budget=10000 text="Türkises Set für 110 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set bis 330 €

Im mittleren Budget lohnt sich bei Türkis eher ein Messer als Handschuhe. Handschuhe, die wirklich zu Türkis passen, kosten in Field-Tested mehr als Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler und wirken an der Hand zurückhaltender. Das Messer dagegen bringt echten Doppler-Schimmer, den du jede Runde beim Inspecten siehst.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge – [price name="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Hyper Beast – [price name="M4A1-S | Hyper Beast" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Hyper Beast – [price name="AWP | Hyper Beast" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive – [price name="Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Lead Conduit – [price name="USP-S | Lead Conduit" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner – [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"]
- Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) – [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]

Gesamt ≈ 300 €. Das Hyper-Beast-Duo auf M4A1-S und AWP bringt einen türkis-pinken Ton, der mit Aquamarine Revenge und Ocean Drive harmoniert: Alle drei folgen dem Schema „Meeresgrün plus warmer Akzent“. Phase 1 ist gewählt, weil sie auf den Shadow Daggers am nächsten an Türkis liegt: Phase 4 hat auf diesem Modell zu viel Blau, Phase 2 und Phase 3 zu viel Grün. Alle Phasen der Shadow Daggers kosten fast gleich viel, für den richtigen Farbton zahlst du also keinen Aufpreis.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Hyper Beast;AWP | Hyper Beast;Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive"]

[cta color=7 budget=30000 text="Türkises Set mit Gamma Doppler für 330 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set mit Messer und Handschuhen bis 900 €

Beim kompletten Set kannst du endlich ein ordentlich großes Gamma-Doppler-Messer nehmen und Handschuhe dazupacken.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, M4A1-S | Hyper Beast, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, USP-S | Lead Conduit, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner – wie gehabt

- Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers – [price name="Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers" wear="FT"]
- Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) – ab [price name="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]

Gesamt ≈ 840 €. AWP | Silk Tiger ersetzt die Hyper Beast, weil ein großer Doppler eine ruhige AWP braucht: Das Tigermuster in Türkis- und Grüntönen zieht keine Aufmerksamkeit ab. Brocade Flowers sind farblich der beste Treffer unter den Handschuhen dieser Farbwelt: gemustert, mit türkiser Stickerei. Wenn es günstiger sein soll, liefert Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) (ab [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]) denselben Schimmer auf einem schlichteren Messer – rund 210 € gespart.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers;AWP | Silk Tiger;Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]

[cta color=7 budget=80000 text="Türkises Set mit Messer und Handschuhen für 900 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Die Sets im Überblick

| Budget | Inhalt | Gesamt |
|---|---|---|
| bis 110 € | AK Aquamarine Revenge, M4A4 Cyber Security, AWP Atheris, Deagle Ocean Drive, USP-S Lead Conduit, Glock Bunsen Burner | ≈ 100 € |
| bis 330 € | AK Aquamarine Revenge, M4A1-S und AWP Hyper Beast, Deagle Ocean Drive, USP-S Lead Conduit, Glock Bunsen Burner, Shadow Daggers Gamma Doppler | ≈ 300 € |
| bis 900 € | Dieselben Waffen mit AWP Silk Tiger, Driver Gloves Brocade Flowers, Bayonet Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) | ≈ 840 € |

Die Gesamtsummen basieren auf den Preisen vom 15. Oktober 2026. Die Preise der einzelnen Items im Artikel werden automatisch geladen und täglich aktualisiert.

## Was du vermeiden solltest

- **Messerphase „blind“ gekauft.** Die Gamma-Doppler-Phasen unterscheiden sich im Verhältnis von Grün zu Blau, und dieselbe Phase sieht auf verschiedenen Messermodellen unterschiedlich aus: Beim Bayonet treffen Phase 2 und Phase 4 Türkis am besten, bei den Shadow Daggers Phase 1 und Emerald. Schau dir vor dem Kauf den Screenshot des konkreten Exemplars an, nicht das allgemeine Icon.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** ([price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]). Auf dem Icon halb Türkis, halb Pink – an der Hand dominiert Pink. Für ein türkises Set ist das zu viel.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** und **Broken Fang Gloves | Jade** – grün, nicht türkis. Neben Phase 2 springt der Unterschied sofort ins Auge.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint und Cool Mint in Battle-Scarred.** Der Mindestpreis für Spearmint liegt bei [price name="Moto Gloves | Spearmint" wear="FT"], aber das ist ein abgenutztes Exemplar, bei dem das Mintgrün fast verschwunden ist. Ordentlich sieht er erst ab Field-Tested aus – und da kostet er schon ein Vielfaches.
- **AK-47 | Wild Lotus und AWP | Medusa.** Beide wirken in der Vorschau grün-türkis, beide kosten eine Größenordnung mehr als das komplette Set, und beide sind im Spiel deutlich dunkler und „sumpfiger“ als erwartet. Für ein Farb-Set lohnt sich das nicht.

## Wenn es teurer sein darf

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** – [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. Der präziseste Türkis-Treffer auf einem Gewehr im ganzen Spiel – schließt die größte Lücke dieser Farbwelt.
- **Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)** – ab [price name="Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Das Türkis-Messer schlechthin.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint** in Field-Tested – helles Mint-Türkis, eines der seltensten Paare dieser Farbwelt.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** – [price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]. Meeresthema und blau-türkiser Body; ein Sammler-Skin, dessen Preis vor allem von seiner Seltenheit lebt.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Moto Gloves | Spearmint;M4A4 | Poseidon"]

## Zum Schluss

Kauf zuerst das Messer und such erst danach die Waffen passend zu seiner Phase aus: Türkis ist eine zu schmale Farbe, um sie „von unten nach oben“ aufzubauen. Die komplette Auswahl inklusive Messern und Handschuhen findest du auf der Seite mit [türkisen CS2 Skins](/de/tuerkise-cs2-skins/). Die anderen Farbwelten warten im Bereich [Farb-Sets für CS2-Skins](/de/).

pt.title: Inventário turquesa no CS2: sets Gamma Doppler de R$ 610 a R$ 4.900
pt.desc: Como montar um inventário turquesa no CS2: três sets de R$ 610 a R$ 4.900 com Gamma Doppler, Aquamarine Revenge e Ocean Drive, e as armadilhas da cor.
pt.lead: Turquesa é raro no CS2, então aqui quem define a cor é a faca Gamma Doppler, e as armas se ajustam a ela. Três sets para orçamentos diferentes e uma lista de skins que só fingem ser turquesa.
pt.md:
Turquesa é a paleta mais "escassa" entre as populares. Skins azuis e verdes no CS2 existem às centenas, mas um verde-água puro, bem no meio entre os dois, dá pra contar nos dedos. Em compensação, o turquesa tem um trunfo que a maioria das outras cores não tem: as facas Gamma Doppler, que por si só cintilam exatamente nessa faixa.

Por isso, a lógica de montagem aqui é invertida. Nas outras paletas você começa pelas armas e depois escolhe a faca; no turquesa, a faca define a cor e as armas se adaptam a ela, às vezes com concessões. Abaixo estão três sets em que essas concessões estão apontadas com honestidade.

## De onde vem o turquesa no CS2

As skins turquesa se dividem em três grupos:

- **Gamma Doppler** — a principal fonte da cor. As fases 1–4 dão um brilho verde-azulado, a Emerald dá um esmeralda saturado. Só existem em Factory New e Minimal Wear, então o desgaste não importa; o que importa é a fase. A entrada mais barata é Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1), a partir de [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]; Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) sai a partir de [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"].
- **Bright Water** — ondas azul-turquesa na lâmina, uma alternativa barata às Doppler: Shadow Daggers | Bright Water — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Bright Water" wear="FT"], Gut Knife | Bright Water — [price name="Gut Knife | Bright Water" wear="FT"].
- **Armas "com detalhe turquesa"** — AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner. São os três melhores matches de cor em todo o arsenal da paleta.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Bright Water;AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

A Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner é um achado à parte: por [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"] você leva a pistola turquesa mais fiel do jogo. Nos slots de M4, AWP e USP-S não existem opções perfeitas, e é melhor aceitar isso logo de cara para não perder horas procurando.

## Set até R$ 610

O set econômico se apoia em dois pilares: Aquamarine Revenge na AK e Ocean Drive na Deagle. Os outros slots ficam com skins baratas que não brigam com o turquesa.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge — [price name="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Cyber Security — [price name="M4A4 | Cyber Security" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Atheris — [price name="AWP | Atheris" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive — [price name="Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Lead Conduit — [price name="USP-S | Lead Conduit" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ R$ 560. Cyber Security e Atheris são um detalhe proposital, não um acerto de cor: têm azul e turquesa na medida certa para não destoar, mas quem faz o trabalho pesado são a AK e a Deagle. A Ocean Drive é o item mais caro; se precisar cortar o orçamento quase pela metade, troque-a pela Desert Eagle | Tilted ([price name="Desert Eagle | Tilted" wear="FT"]) — é mais apagada, mas vai na mesma direção.

[skins names="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;M4A4 | Cyber Security;AWP | Atheris;Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive;USP-S | Lead Conduit;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

[cta color=7 budget=10000 text="Montar set turquesa por R$ 610" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set até R$ 1.800

No orçamento médio, para o turquesa compensa mais uma faca do que luvas. As luvas que realmente combinam com turquesa custam mais em Field-Tested do que as Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler e ficam mais discretas na mão. Já a faca entrega o brilho Doppler de verdade, que aparece em todo round na inspeção.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge — [price name="AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Hyper Beast — [price name="M4A1-S | Hyper Beast" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Hyper Beast — [price name="AWP | Hyper Beast" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive — [price name="Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Lead Conduit — [price name="USP-S | Lead Conduit" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"]
- Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]

Total ≈ R$ 1.600. A dupla Hyper Beast na M4A1-S e na AWP traz um tom turquesa com rosa que conversa com a Aquamarine Revenge e a Ocean Drive: as três seguem o mesmo esquema "verde-água mais um toque quente". A Phase 1 foi escolhida porque, nas Shadow Daggers, é a fase mais próxima do turquesa: a Phase 4 nesse modelo tem azul demais, e as Phase 2 e Phase 3 têm verde demais. O preço de todas as fases das Shadow Daggers é quase o mesmo, então você não paga a mais pelo tom certo.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Hyper Beast;AWP | Hyper Beast;Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive"]

[cta color=7 budget=30000 text="Montar set turquesa com Gamma Doppler por R$ 1.800" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set com faca e luvas até R$ 4.900

O set completo é a hora de pegar uma faca Gamma Doppler de tamanho decente e adicionar luvas.

- AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, M4A1-S | Hyper Beast, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, USP-S | Lead Conduit, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner — como antes
- AWP | Silk Tiger — [price name="AWP | Silk Tiger" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers — [price name="Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers" wear="FT"]
- Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) — a partir de [price name="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]

Total ≈ R$ 4.600. A AWP | Silk Tiger substitui a Hyper Beast porque uma Doppler grande pede uma AWP mais tranquila: o padrão de tigre em tons verde-azulados não rouba a atenção. As Brocade Flowers são o melhor match de cor entre as luvas da paleta: estampadas, com bordado turquesa. Se quiser algo mais barato, a Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) (a partir de [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]) entrega o mesmo brilho numa faca mais simples — economia de cerca de R$ 1.200.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers;AWP | Silk Tiger;Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]

[cta color=7 budget=80000 text="Montar set turquesa com faca e luvas por R$ 4.900" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Resumo dos sets

| Orçamento | O que entra | Total |
|---|---|---|
| até R$ 610 | AK Aquamarine Revenge, M4A4 Cyber Security, AWP Atheris, Deagle Ocean Drive, USP-S Lead Conduit, Glock Bunsen Burner | ≈ R$ 560 |
| até R$ 1.800 | AK Aquamarine Revenge, M4A1-S e AWP Hyper Beast, Deagle Ocean Drive, USP-S Lead Conduit, Glock Bunsen Burner, Shadow Daggers Gamma Doppler | ≈ R$ 1.600 |
| até R$ 4.900 | As mesmas armas com AWP Silk Tiger, Driver Gloves Brocade Flowers, Bayonet Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) | ≈ R$ 4.600 |

Os totais usam os preços de 15 de outubro de 2026. O preço de cada item no artigo é puxado automaticamente e atualizado todos os dias.

## O que evitar

- **Fase de faca comprada "às cegas".** As fases da Gamma Doppler variam na proporção de verde e azul, e a mesma fase fica diferente em cada modelo de faca: na Bayonet, as que mais acertam o turquesa são a Phase 2 e a Phase 4; nas Shadow Daggers, a Phase 1 e a Emerald. Antes de comprar, veja o screenshot do item específico, não o ícone genérico.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** ([price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]). No ícone, turquesa e rosa aparecem meio a meio; na mão, o rosa domina. Para um set turquesa, é demais.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** e **Broken Fang Gloves | Jade** — são verdes, não turquesa. Ao lado de uma Phase 2, a diferença salta aos olhos.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint e Cool Mint em Battle-Scarred.** O preço mínimo da Spearmint é [price name="Moto Gloves | Spearmint" wear="FT"], mas é um exemplar gasto, em que o verde-menta quase sumiu. A aparência decente começa no Field-Tested, e aí o preço já é várias vezes maior.
- **AK-47 | Wild Lotus e AWP | Medusa.** As duas parecem verde-turquesa na prévia, as duas custam uma ordem de grandeza a mais que o set completo inteiro, e as duas ficam bem mais escuras e "pantanosas" no jogo do que você espera. Para um set de cor, não compensa.

## Se quiser gastar mais

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** — [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. O acerto turquesa mais preciso em um rifle no jogo inteiro, fecha o maior buraco da paleta.
- **Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)** — a partir de [price name="Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]. A faca turquesa canônica.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint** em Field-Tested — verde-menta claro puxado para o turquesa, um dos pares mais raros da paleta.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** — [price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]. Tema marinho e corpo azul-turquesa; skin de colecionador, cujo preço se sustenta acima de tudo pela raridade.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Moto Gloves | Spearmint;M4A4 | Poseidon"]

## Dica final

Compre a faca primeiro e só depois escolha as armas de acordo com a fase dela: o turquesa é uma cor estreita demais para ser montada "de baixo para cima". A seleção completa de facas, luvas e armas está na página de [skins turquesa do CS2](/pt/skins-turquesa-cs2/). As outras paletas estão na seção de [sets de skins por cor do CS2](/pt/).

tr.title: Turkuaz CS2 envanteri: Gamma Doppler'lı skin setleri $110–$890
tr.desc: CS2'de turkuaz envanter nasıl kurulur: Gamma Doppler, Aquamarine Revenge ve Ocean Drive etrafında $110–$890 arası üç set ve renk tuzakları.
tr.lead: CS2'de turkuaz az, bu yüzden burada rengi Gamma Doppler bıçak belirliyor, silahlar ona uyuyor. Farklı bütçelere üç set ve turkuazmış gibi davranan skinlerin listesi.
tr.md:
Turkuaz, popüler renkler arasında en "kıt" olanı. CS2'de yüzlerce mavi ve yeşil skin var ama tam ikisinin ortasındaki saf deniz yeşili tonu bir elin parmaklarını geçmez. Buna karşılık turkuazın çoğu renkte olmayan bir kozu var: kendi başına tam bu aralıkta parıldayan Gamma Doppler bıçaklar.

Bu yüzden burada set kurma mantığı tersine işliyor. Diğer renklerde önce silahlarla başlayıp bıçağı sonra seçersin; turkuazda rengi bıçak belirler, silahlar ona uyum sağlar, yer yer tavizle. Aşağıda bu tavizlerin dürüstçe belirtildiği üç set var.

## CS2'de turkuaz nereden gelir

Turkuaz skinler üç gruba ayrılır:

- **Gamma Doppler** — rengin ana kaynağı. Phase 1–4 yeşil-mavi bir parıltı verir, Emerald ise doygun zümrüt yeşili. Yalnızca Factory New ve Minimal Wear olarak çıkar, yani aşınma değil faz önemli. En ucuz giriş Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1): [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]'dan başlıyor; Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) ise [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]'dan.
- **Bright Water** — bıçak ağzında mavimsi-turkuaz dalgalar, Doppler'lara ucuz bir alternatif: Shadow Daggers | Bright Water — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Bright Water" wear="FT"], Gut Knife | Bright Water — [price name="Gut Knife | Bright Water" wear="FT"].
- **"Turkuaz vurgulu" silahlar** — AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner. Bu renk grubunun tüm silah havuzunda tona en iyi oturan üç skin bunlar.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Bright Water;AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner ayrı bir keşif: [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"] karşılığında oyundaki en isabetli turkuaz tabancayı alıyorsun. M4, AWP ve USP-S slotlarında ideal seçenek yok; saatlerce arayıp vakit kaybetmemek için bunu baştan kabul etmek gerek.

## $110'a kadar set

Bütçe seti iki direğe dayanıyor: AK'de Aquamarine Revenge, Deagle'da Ocean Drive. Kalan slotları turkuazla çatışmayan ucuz skinler dolduruyor.

- USP-S | Lead Conduit — [price name="USP-S | Lead Conduit" wear="FT"]

Toplam ≈ $100. Cyber Security ve Atheris bilinçli birer vurgu, tam renk eşleşmesi değil: içlerinde göze batmayacak kadar mavi ve turkuaz var, asıl işi ise AK ve Deagle yapıyor. En pahalı kalem Ocean Drive; bütçeyi neredeyse yarıya indirmen gerekirse yerine Desert Eagle | Tilted ([price name="Desert Eagle | Tilted" wear="FT"]) al — daha soluk ama aynı yöne gidiyor.

Orta bütçede turkuaz için eldiven değil bıçak almak daha mantıklı. Turkuaza gerçekten uyan eldivenler Field-Tested'da Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler'dan pahalı, elde de daha sönük duruyor. Bıçak ise her raundda inspect ederken görünen gerçek bir Doppler parıltısı veriyor.

Phase 1'in seçilme sebebi, Shadow Daggers'ta turkuaza en yakın faz olması: bu modelde Phase 4'te mavi, Phase 2 ve Phase 3'te yeşil fazla. Shadow Daggers'ın tüm fazları hemen hemen aynı fiyatta, yani doğru ton için fazladan para ödemen gerekmiyor.

## Bıçak ve eldivenli set, $890'a kadar

Tam set, normal boyutlu bir Gamma Doppler bıçak alıp üstüne eldiven ekleyebileceğin an.

Toplam ≈ $840. AWP | Silk Tiger, Hyper Beast'in yerini alıyor çünkü büyük bir Doppler'ın yanına sakin bir keskin nişancı tüfeği lazım: turkuaz-yeşil tonlardaki kaplan deseni dikkati üstüne çekmiyor. Brocade Flowers, bu renk grubundaki eldivenler arasında tona en iyi oturanı: desenli, turkuaz işlemeli. Daha ucuzunu istersen Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) ([price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]'dan başlıyor) daha mütevazı bir bıçakta aynı parıltıyı veriyor — yaklaşık $210 tasarruf.

Toplamlar 15 Ekim 2026 fiyatlarına göre. Yazıdaki her eşyanın fiyatı otomatik çekiliyor ve her gün güncelleniyor.

## Nelerden kaçınmalı

- **"Körlemesine" alınmış bıçak fazı.** Gamma Doppler fazları yeşil-mavi oranında farklılaşır ve aynı faz farklı bıçak modellerinde farklı görünür: Bayonet'te turkuaza en iyi Phase 2 ve Phase 4 oturur, Shadow Daggers'ta Phase 1 ve Emerald. Satın almadan önce genel ikona değil, o belirli eşyanın ekran görüntüsüne bak.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** ([price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]). İkonda turkuaz ve pembe eşit görünür, elde ise pembe baskın çıkar. Turkuaz set için fazla.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** ve **Broken Fang Gloves | Jade** — yeşil, turkuaz değil. Phase 2'nin yanında fark hemen göze batıyor.
- **Battle-Scarred Moto Gloves | Spearmint ve Cool Mint.** Spearmint'in en düşük fiyatı [price name="Moto Gloves | Spearmint" wear="FT"], ama bu, nane renginin neredeyse kaybolduğu yıpranmış bir eşya. Düzgün görünüm Field-Tested'dan başlıyor, orada da fiyat katlanıyor.
- **AK-47 | Wild Lotus ve AWP | Medusa.** İkisi de önizlemede yeşil-turkuaz, ikisi de tam setin tamamından kat kat pahalı ve ikisi de oyunda beklediğinden belirgin şekilde daha koyu ve "bataklık" tonunda. Renk seti için kârlı değil.

## Bütçen daha yüksekse

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** — [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. Oyundaki tüfekler arasında en isabetli turkuaz; renk grubunun en büyük boşluğunu kapatıyor.

- **M4A4 | Poseidon** — [price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]. Deniz teması ve mavi-turkuaz gövde; fiyatı her şeyden önce nadirliğine dayanan bir koleksiyon skini.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Moto Gloves | Spearmint;M4A4 | Poseidon"]

## Son tavsiye

Önce bıçağı al, silahları ancak sonra onun fazına göre seç: turkuaz "aşağıdan yukarıya" kurulamayacak kadar dar bir renk. Bıçaklar ve eldivenler dahil tüm seçki [turkuaz CS2 skinleri](/tr/turkuaz-cs2-skinleri/) sayfasında. Diğer renkler [CS2 renk setleri](/tr/) bölümünde seni bekliyor.

pl.title: Turkusowy ekwipunek CS2: sety z Gamma Doppler od 440 do 3 600 zł
pl.desc: Jak złożyć turkusowy ekwipunek w CS2: trzy sety od 440 do 3 600 zł wokół Gamma Doppler, Aquamarine Revenge i Ocean Drive oraz kolorystyczne pułapki.
pl.lead: Turkusu w CS2 jest mało, dlatego kolor dyktuje tu nóż Gamma Doppler, a broń dopasowuje się do niego. Trzy sety na różne budżety i lista skinów, które tylko udają turkusowe.
pl.md:
Turkus to najbardziej „deficytowa” z popularnych palet. Niebieskich i zielonych skinów są w CS2 setki, ale czystego koloru morskiej fali, dokładnie pośrodku między nimi, jest jak na lekarstwo. Za to turkus ma asa w rękawie, którego nie ma większość innych kolorów: noże Gamma Doppler, które same z siebie mienią się właśnie w tym zakresie.

Dlatego logika składania jest tu odwrócona. W innych paletach zaczyna się od broni, a nóż dobiera na końcu; w turkusowej to nóż wyznacza kolor, a broń się do niego dopasowuje, miejscami z kompromisami. Poniżej trzy sety, w których te kompromisy są uczciwie zaznaczone.

## Skąd w CS2 bierze się turkus

Turkusowe skiny dzielą się na trzy grupy:

- **Gamma Doppler** — główne źródło koloru. Fazy 1–4 dają zielono-błękitny połysk, Emerald — nasycony szmaragd. Występuje tylko w Factory New i Minimal Wear, więc wear nie ma znaczenia, liczy się faza. Najtańsze wejście to Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) od [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]; Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) — od [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"].
- **Bright Water** — błękitno-turkusowe fale na ostrzu, tania alternatywa dla Dopplerów: Shadow Daggers | Bright Water — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Bright Water" wear="FT"], Gut Knife | Bright Water — [price name="Gut Knife | Bright Water" wear="FT"].
- **Broń „z turkusowym akcentem”** — AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge, Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive, Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner. To trzy najlepsze dopasowania kolorystyczne w całej puli broni tej palety.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Gut Knife | Bright Water;AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge;Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner"]

Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner to osobne znalezisko: za [price name="Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner" wear="FT"] dostajesz najbardziej turkusowy pistolet w grze. Na slotach M4, AWP i USP-S idealnych opcji nie ma i trzeba to od razu przyjąć do wiadomości, żeby nie tracić godzin na poszukiwania.

## Set do 440 zł

Budżetowy set stoi na dwóch filarach: Aquamarine Revenge na AK i Ocean Drive na Deagle. Pozostałe sloty zamykają tanie skiny, które nie gryzą się z turkusem.

Razem ≈ 410 zł. Cyber Security i Atheris to świadomy akcent, a nie trafienie w kolor: mają dokładnie tyle błękitu i turkusu, żeby nie odstawać, ale główną robotę robią AK i Deagle. Ocean Drive to najdroższa pozycja; jeśli chcesz ściąć budżet prawie o połowę, zamień go na Desert Eagle | Tilted ([price name="Desert Eagle | Tilted" wear="FT"]) — jest bledszy, ale idzie w tę samą stronę.

[cta color=7 budget=10000 text="Złóż turkusowy set za 440 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

Przy średnim budżecie w turkusie bardziej opłaca się nóż niż rękawice. Rękawice, które naprawdę pasują do turkusu, kosztują w Field-Tested więcej niż Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler, a na dłoni wyglądają spokojniej. Nóż daje za to prawdziwy dopplerowy połysk, widoczny w każdej rundzie przy inspekcie.

Para Hyper Beast na M4A1-S i AWP dodaje turkusowo-różowy odcień, który rymuje się z Aquamarine Revenge i Ocean Drive: wszystkie trzy mają ten sam schemat „morska fala plus ciepły akcent”. Phase 1 wybraliśmy, bo na Shadow Daggers to faza najbliższa turkusowi: Phase 4 ma na tym modelu za dużo niebieskiego, a Phase 2 i Phase 3 — zielonego. Razem ≈ 3 400 zł. AWP | Silk Tiger zastępuje Hyper Beast, bo do dużego Dopplera potrzebna jest spokojna snajperka: tygrysi wzór w turkusowo-zielonych tonach nie kradnie uwagi. Brocade Flowers to najlepsze dopasowanie kolorystyczne wśród rękawic tej palety: wzorzyste, z turkusowym haftem. Jeśli chcesz taniej, Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) (od [price name="Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]) daje ten sam połysk na prostszym nożu — oszczędność około 840 zł.
