Sumy według cen z 15 października 2026 roku. Ceny poszczególnych przedmiotów w artykule pobierają się automatycznie i aktualizują codziennie.

## Czego unikać

- **Faza noża kupiona „w ciemno”.** Fazy Gamma Doppler różnią się proporcją zieleni i niebieskiego, a na różnych modelach noży ta sama faza wygląda inaczej: na Bayonet najlepiej w turkus trafiają Phase 2 i Phase 4, na Shadow Daggers — Phase 1 i Emerald. Przed zakupem oglądaj screenshot konkretnego egzemplarza, a nie ogólną ikonkę.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** ([price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]). Na ikonce turkus i róż po równo, na dłoni dominuje róż. Do turkusowego setu to przesada.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** i **Broken Fang Gloves | Jade** — zielone, nie turkusowe. Obok Phase 2 różnica kłuje w oczy.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint i Cool Mint w Battle-Scarred.** Minimalna cena Spearmint to [price name="Moto Gloves | Spearmint" wear="FT"], ale to zjechany egzemplarz, w którym miętowy kolor prawie zniknął. Normalny wygląd zaczyna się od Field-Tested, a tam cena jest już kilka razy wyższa.
- **AK-47 | Wild Lotus i AWP | Medusa.** Oba na podglądzie są zielono-turkusowe, oba kosztują o rząd wielkości więcej niż cały pełny set i oba w grze są wyraźnie ciemniejsze i bardziej „bagienne”, niż się spodziewasz. Do setu kolorystycznego to się nie opłaca.

## Jeśli chcesz drożej

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** — [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. Najcelniejsze turkusowe trafienie na karabinie w całej grze, łata największą dziurę tej palety.
- **Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)** — od [price name="Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Kanoniczny turkusowy nóż.
- **Moto Gloves | Spearmint** w Field-Tested — jasne, miętowo-turkusowe, jedna z najrzadszych par w tej palecie.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** — [price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]. Morski motyw i niebiesko-turkusowy korpus; skin kolekcjonerski, którego cena trzyma się przede wszystkim na rzadkości.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2);Moto Gloves | Spearmint;M4A4 | Poseidon"]

## Ostatnia rada

Kupuj nóż jako pierwszy i dopiero potem dobieraj broń pod jego fazę: turkus to zbyt wąski kolor, żeby składać go „od dołu”. Pełny dobór noży, rękawic i broni znajdziesz na stronie [turkusowych skinów CS2](/pl/turkusowe-skiny-cs2/). Pozostałe palety czekają w dziale [kolorowych setów skinów CS2](/pl/).

title: Чёрно-белый инвентарь CS2: Printstream-сеты от 10 000 до 90 000 ₽
desc: Чёрно-белый инвентарь CS2 на трёх бюджетах: Printstream, Neo-Noir, перчатки Black Tie и Karambit Damascus Steel. Сеты от 10 000 до 90 000 ₽.
lead: Монохром — самая простая гамма в CS2: скинов на каждый слот десятки. Главное — собрать контраст, а не серость. Три готовых сета от бюджетного до полного с Karambit.
md:
Чёрно-белый — самый простой цвет для первого тематического инвентаря в CS2. Монохромных скинов в игре больше, чем любых других: на каждый слот находится два-три десятка вариантов, от копеечных камуфляжей до премиальных винтовок. Поэтому проблема тут не в том, чтобы что-то найти, а в том, чтобы не набрать случайный серый хлам, который вместе выглядит как стандартные скины без раскраски.

Разберём, какие серии дают настоящий контраст, и соберём три сета — от десяти тысяч рублей до полного инвентаря с Karambit.

## Что такое «чёрно-белый» в CS2

Хороший монохромный сет — это контраст, а не серость. Ориентируйся на три линейки, которые сделаны именно в этой логике:

- **Printstream** — перламутровый белый с чёрной графикой. Одна серия закрывает четыре слота: AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"], Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"], USP-S | Printstream — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]. По цвету это самые точные попадания во всей гамме.
- **Neo-Noir** — чёрно-белый комикс с красными штрихами: M4A4 | Neo-Noir — [price name="M4A4 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], AWP | Neo-Noir — [price name="AWP | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"].
- **Damascus Steel** — узорчатая сталь на ножах. Это самая дешёвая дорога к монохромному ножу: Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel стоит [price name="Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"], Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel — [price name="Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AWP | Printstream;Desert Eagle | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;M4A1-S | Printstream;M4A4 | Neo-Noir;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

С перчатками тоже просто: в гамме есть четыре пары, которые попадают в цвет почти идеально, — Driver Gloves | Black Tie, Moto Gloves | Smoke Out, Specialist Gloves | Mogul и Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged. Ни у одного другого цвета нет такого выбора в рабочем ценовом диапазоне.

Перед покупкой реши, что в сете будет доминировать. «Белый» инвентарь строится на Printstream и светлом оружии, и тогда нож лучше брать узорчатый, с бликами. «Чёрный» опирается на Neo-Noir, тёмные перчатки и воронёную сталь. Оба варианта рабочие, но смешивать их поровну не стоит: если белого и чёрного ровно пятьдесят на пятьдесят, взгляд не цепляется ни за что, и инвентарь кажется пёстрым. Сеты ниже собраны в «белую» сторону — она нагляднее на экране.

## Сет до 10 000 ₽

В бюджетном сете берём Printstream там, где он дешёвый (AWP и Deagle), а на остальные слоты ставим недорогие бело-чёрные скины.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]

- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]

Итого ≈ 9 800 ₽. AK-47 | Asiimov здесь работает как белое оружие с чёрными деталями; оранжевая полоса на нём небольшая и в общей картинке не мешает. Если хочется строже, возьми AK-47 | Head Shot ([price name="AK-47 | Head Shot" wear="FT"]) — он дешевле и без оранжевого. Clear Polymer на Glock — прозрачный пластик с чёрной начинкой, в руке смотрится заметно дороже своей цены.

## Сет до 32 000 ₽

Средний сет — полный Printstream на четырёх слотах плюс перчатки. Это, пожалуй, самый узнаваемый монохромный инвентарь в игре.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]

- USP-S | Printstream — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]
- Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged — [price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged" wear="FT"]

Итого ≈ 31 300 ₽. M4A1-S | Printstream — самая дорогая часть сета, и если ты играешь с M4A4, смело меняй её на M4A4 | Neo-Noir: экономия заметная, а стиль сохраняется. Unhinged выбраны как самые доступные перчатки из «идеальной четвёрки», чёрные с белыми надписями, и в Field-Tested они ещё сохраняют чистый контраст.

## Сет с ножом и перчатками до 90 000 ₽

Для полного сета оружие остаётся прежним, а перчатки и нож переходят в другую лигу.

- Оружие — как в среднем сете: Asiimov на AK, Printstream на M4A1-S, AWP, Deagle и USP-S, Neo-Noir на Glock
- Driver Gloves | Black Tie — [price name="Driver Gloves | Black Tie" wear="FT"]
- Karambit | Damascus Steel — [price name="Karambit | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]

Итого ≈ 85 400 ₽. Black Tie — чёрная кожа с белой отделкой, буквально смокинг для рук: самое точное попадание в гамму среди всех перчаток. Karambit | Damascus Steel — самый доступный Karambit, который при этом идеально вписывается в монохром. Если Karambit не принципиален, Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel даёт тот же узор и опускает итог полного сета почти вдвое; Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel ([price name="Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]) — промежуточный вариант с более редкой моделью.

[skins names="Karambit | Damascus Steel;Driver Gloves | Black Tie;Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel;Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel;Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged"]

[cta color=8 budget=90000 text="Собрать чёрно-белый сет с Karambit за 90 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сравнение сетов

| Бюджет | Что входит | Итого |
|---|---|---|
| до 10 000 ₽ | AK Asiimov, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP и Deagle Printstream, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Clear Polymer | ≈ 9 800 ₽ |
| до 32 000 ₽ | AK Asiimov, Printstream на M4A1-S, AWP, Deagle, USP-S, Glock Neo-Noir, Broken Fang Gloves Unhinged | ≈ 31 300 ₽ |
| до 90 000 ₽ | Оружие среднего сета, Driver Gloves Black Tie, Karambit Damascus Steel | ≈ 85 400 ₽ |

Все итоги — по ценам на 15 октября 2026 года; отдельные цены в тексте живые и пересчитываются каждый день.

## Чего избегать

- **Серые камуфляжи вместо контраста.** AK-47 | VariCamo Grey, M4A4 | Urban DDPAT, AWP | Safari Mesh формально подходят по цвету и стоят копейки, но это серая каша без белого. Один такой скин на запасном слоте не страшен, три — и инвентарь выглядит пустым.
- **Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1).** Алгоритмы подбора по цвету часто ставят его рядом с монохромом из-за тёмных участков, но в игре это зелёно-синий перелив. С Printstream он не работает.
- **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Black Pearl).** На иконке почти чёрный, при осмотре отливает фиолетовым и синим. Красиво, но в чёрно-белый сет его можно ставить только как осознанный акцент.
- **Printstream в Battle-Scarred.** Перламутр стирается пятнами, и белый превращается в грязно-серый. Field-Tested — минимальный износ, на котором серия выглядит так, как задумано.
- **M4A4 | Asiimov** ([price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]). Без Factory New и Minimal Wear, а в Field-Tested стоит заметно дороже M4A4 | Neo-Noir — при том что для монохрома оранжевый на нём лишний.
- **Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT** — подбор по яркости ставит его в чёрно-белую гамму, но он розовый.

## Если хочется дороже

- **AK-47 | Leet Museo** — [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"]. Белый с чёрным, ближе к гамме, чем любой другой AK.
- **AK-47 | Jet Set** — [price name="AK-47 | Jet Set" wear="FT"]. Классика с чёрно-белым узором, для тех, кому Asiimov кажется слишком «оранжевым».
- **Karambit | Blue Steel** — [price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]. Тёмная воронёная сталь вместо узора Damascus; строже и дороже.
- **Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers** — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers" wear="FT"]. Светлая пара с чёрными деталями — редкий случай, когда в монохромном сете перчатки не тёмные.

[skins names="AK-47 | Leet Museo;AK-47 | Jet Set;Karambit | Blue Steel;Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers"]

## Коротко на прощание

Монохром прощает почти всё, кроме серости: держи в каждом предмете и чистый белый, и глубокий чёрный. Весь подбор — на странице [чёрно-белых скинов CS2](/cherno-belye-skiny-cs2/), отдельно собраны [чёрно-белые ножи](/cherno-belye-nozhi-cs2/) и [чёрно-белые перчатки](/cherno-belye-perchatki-cs2/). Другие гаммы — в разделе [цветовые сеты скинов CS2](/cvetovye-sety-skinov-cs2/).

en.title: Black and White CS2 Loadout: Printstream Sets from $110 to $1,000
en.desc: A black and white CS2 inventory on three budgets: Printstream, Neo-Noir, Black Tie gloves and a Karambit Damascus Steel. Loadouts from $110 to $1,000.
en.lead: Monochrome is the easiest palette in CS2: there are dozens of skins for every slot. The trick is building contrast, not a wall of grey. Three ready-made loadouts, from budget to a full set with a Karambit.
en.md:
Black and white is the easiest color for your first themed inventory in CS2. The game has more monochrome skins than any other kind: every slot has twenty or thirty options, from dirt-cheap camos to premium rifles. So the problem isn't finding something, it's avoiding a pile of random grey junk that ends up looking like default skins with no paint job.

Let's look at which series deliver real contrast and put together three loadouts — from $110 up to a full inventory with a Karambit.

## What "black and white" means in CS2

A good monochrome loadout is about contrast, not grey. Focus on three lines built around exactly that idea:

- **Printstream** — pearlescent white with black graphics. One series covers four slots: AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"], Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"], USP-S | Printstream — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]. Color-wise, these are the most accurate matches in the whole palette.
- **Neo-Noir** — black-and-white comic art with red strokes: M4A4 | Neo-Noir — [price name="M4A4 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], AWP | Neo-Noir — [price name="AWP | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"].
- **Damascus Steel** — patterned steel on knives. It's the cheapest route to a monochrome knife: Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel costs [price name="Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"], Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel — [price name="Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AWP | Printstream;Desert Eagle | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;M4A1-S | Printstream;M4A4 | Neo-Noir;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

Gloves are easy too: the palette has four pairs that hit the color almost perfectly — Driver Gloves | Black Tie, Moto Gloves | Smoke Out, Specialist Gloves | Mogul and Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged. No other color offers that much choice in a realistic price range.

Before buying, decide what will dominate the loadout. A "white" inventory is built on Printstream and light-colored guns, and then a patterned, shiny knife works best. A "black" one leans on Neo-Noir, dark gloves and blued steel. Both work, but don't mix them evenly: if white and black are split exactly fifty-fifty, the eye has nothing to latch onto and the inventory looks busy. The loadouts below lean "white" — it reads better on screen.

## Loadout under $110

In the budget loadout we take Printstream where it's cheap (AWP and Deagle) and fill the other slots with inexpensive white-and-black skins.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Clear Polymer — [price name="Glock-18 | Clear Polymer" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $110. AK-47 | Asiimov works here as a white gun with black details; the orange stripe is small and doesn't hurt the overall look. If you want it stricter, take AK-47 | Head Shot ([price name="AK-47 | Head Shot" wear="FT"]) — it's cheaper and has no orange. Clear Polymer on the Glock is transparent plastic with black internals and looks far more expensive in hand than it is.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Clear Polymer;AK-47 | Head Shot"]

[cta color=8 budget=10000 text="Build a black and white loadout for $110" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout under $360

The mid-range loadout is full Printstream on four slots plus gloves. It's probably the most recognizable monochrome inventory in the game.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Printstream — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]
- Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged — [price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $350. M4A1-S | Printstream is the most expensive part of the loadout, so if you play the M4A4, feel free to swap it for M4A4 | Neo-Noir: you save a good chunk and keep the style. Unhinged were chosen as the most affordable gloves from the "perfect four" — black with white lettering, and in Field-Tested they still hold clean contrast.

[cta color=8 budget=32000 text="Build a Printstream loadout with gloves for $360" btn="Open the builder"]

## Knife and gloves loadout under $1,000

For the full loadout the guns stay the same, while the gloves and knife move up a league.

- Guns — same as the mid-range loadout: Asiimov on the AK, Printstream on the M4A1-S, AWP, Deagle and USP-S, Neo-Noir on the Glock
- Driver Gloves | Black Tie — [price name="Driver Gloves | Black Tie" wear="FT"]
- Karambit | Damascus Steel — [price name="Karambit | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $950. Black Tie is black leather with white trim, literally a tuxedo for your hands: the most accurate fit for the palette among all gloves. Karambit | Damascus Steel is the most affordable Karambit and still slots perfectly into monochrome. If the Karambit isn't a must, Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel gives you the same pattern and cuts the full loadout's total almost in half; Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel ([price name="Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]) is a middle option with a rarer model.

[skins names="Karambit | Damascus Steel;Driver Gloves | Black Tie;Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel;Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel;Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged"]

[cta color=8 budget=90000 text="Build a black and white Karambit loadout for $1,000" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout comparison

| Budget | What's included | Total |
|---|---|---|
| under $110 | AK Asiimov, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP and Deagle Printstream, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Clear Polymer | ≈ $110 |
| under $360 | AK Asiimov, Printstream on M4A1-S, AWP, Deagle, USP-S, Glock Neo-Noir, Broken Fang Gloves Unhinged | ≈ $350 |
| under $1,000 | Mid-range guns, Driver Gloves Black Tie, Karambit Damascus Steel | ≈ $950 |

All totals are based on prices as of October 15, 2026; individual prices in the text are live and recalculated every day.

## What to avoid

- **Grey camos instead of contrast.** AK-47 | VariCamo Grey, M4A4 | Urban DDPAT and AWP | Safari Mesh technically fit the color and cost pennies, but they're grey mush with no white. One on a backup slot is fine; three, and your inventory looks empty.
- **Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1).** Color-matching algorithms often put it next to monochrome because of its dark areas, but in-game it's a green-blue shimmer. It doesn't work with Printstream.
- **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Black Pearl).** Almost black on the icon, but on inspect it flashes purple and blue. Gorgeous, but in a black and white loadout it only works as a deliberate accent.
- **Printstream in Battle-Scarred.** The pearl coating wears off in patches and the white turns dirty grey. Field-Tested is the lowest wear where the series looks the way it was meant to.
- **M4A4 | Asiimov** ([price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]). No Factory New or Minimal Wear, and in Field-Tested it costs noticeably more than M4A4 | Neo-Noir — while the orange on it is out of place in monochrome anyway.
- **Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT** — brightness-based matching puts it in the black and white palette, but it's pink.

## If you want to go bigger

- **AK-47 | Leet Museo** — [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"]. White with black, closer to the palette than any other AK.
- **AK-47 | Jet Set** — [price name="AK-47 | Jet Set" wear="FT"]. A classic with a black-and-white pattern, for anyone who finds the Asiimov too orange.
- **Karambit | Blue Steel** — [price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]. Dark blued steel instead of the Damascus pattern; stricter and pricier.
- **Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers** — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers" wear="FT"]. A light pair with black details — a rare case of non-dark gloves in a monochrome loadout.

[skins names="AK-47 | Leet Museo;AK-47 | Jet Set;Karambit | Blue Steel;Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers"]

## Parting words

Monochrome forgives almost everything except grey: keep both a clean white and a deep black in every item. The full selection is on the [black and white CS2 skins](/en/black-white-cs2-skins/) page, with separate collections of [black and white knives](/en/black-and-white-knives-cs2/) and [black and white gloves](/en/black-and-white-gloves-cs2/). Other palettes are in the [CS2 skin sets by color](/en/cs2-skin-sets-by-color/) section.

de.title: Schwarz-weiße CS2 Skins: Printstream-Inventar von 110 bis 1.000 €
de.desc: Schwarz-weißes CS2-Inventar in drei Budgets: Printstream, Neo-Noir, Black-Tie-Handschuhe und Karambit Damascus Steel. Sets von 110 bis 1.000 €.
de.lead: Monochrom ist die einfachste Farbwelt in CS2: Für jeden Slot gibt es Dutzende Skins. Entscheidend ist Kontrast statt Grau. Drei fertige Sets – vom Budget-Loadout bis zum kompletten Inventar mit Karambit.
de.md:
Schwarz-Weiß ist die einfachste Farbe für dein erstes Themen-Inventar in CS2. Es gibt mehr monochrome Skins im Spiel als in jeder anderen Farbe: Für jeden Slot findest du zwei, drei Dutzend Optionen, von Billig-Camos bis zu Premium-Gewehren. Das Problem ist hier also nicht, überhaupt etwas zu finden, sondern keinen zufälligen grauen Kram zusammenzukaufen, der am Ende wie Standardwaffen ohne Skin aussieht.

Wir schauen uns an, welche Serien echten Kontrast liefern, und stellen drei Sets zusammen – von 110 € bis zum kompletten Inventar mit Karambit.

## Was „Schwarz-Weiß“ in CS2 bedeutet

Ein gutes monochromes Set lebt von Kontrast, nicht von Grau. Orientiere dich an drei Linien, die genau nach dieser Logik gestaltet sind:

- **Printstream** – perlmuttweiß mit schwarzer Grafik. Eine Serie deckt vier Slots ab: AWP | Printstream – [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"], Desert Eagle | Printstream – [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"], USP-S | Printstream – [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Printstream – [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]. Farblich die präzisesten Treffer der ganzen Farbwelt.
- **Neo-Noir** – Schwarz-Weiß-Comic mit roten Strichen: M4A4 | Neo-Noir – [price name="M4A4 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], Glock-18 | Neo-Noir – [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], AWP | Neo-Noir – [price name="AWP | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"].
- **Damascus Steel** – gemusterter Stahl auf Messern. Der günstigste Weg zu einem monochromen Messer: Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel kostet [price name="Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"], Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel – [price name="Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AWP | Printstream;Desert Eagle | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;M4A1-S | Printstream;M4A4 | Neo-Noir;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

Auch bei den Handschuhen ist es einfach: Vier Paare treffen die Farbe fast perfekt – Driver Gloves | Black Tie, Moto Gloves | Smoke Out, Specialist Gloves | Mogul und Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged. Keine andere Farbe bietet so viel Auswahl in einer realistischen Preisklasse.

Entscheide vor dem Kauf, was im Set dominieren soll. Ein „weißes“ Inventar baut auf Printstream und hellen Waffen auf – dann nimmst du am besten ein gemustertes Messer mit Glanzeffekten. Ein „schwarzes“ setzt auf Neo-Noir, dunkle Handschuhe und brünierten Stahl. Beides funktioniert, aber halb-halb mischen solltest du nicht: Bei exakt fünfzig zu fünfzig bleibt der Blick nirgends hängen, und das Inventar wirkt unruhig. Die Sets unten gehen in die „weiße“ Richtung – sie kommt auf dem Bildschirm besser rüber.

## Set bis 110 €

Im Budget-Set nehmen wir Printstream dort, wo er günstig ist (AWP und Deagle), und füllen die restlichen Slots mit preiswerten weiß-schwarzen Skins.

- AK-47 | Asiimov – [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator – [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Printstream – [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream – [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex – [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Clear Polymer – [price name="Glock-18 | Clear Polymer" wear="FT"]

Wenn es strenger sein soll, nimm AK-47 | Head Shot ([price name="AK-47 | Head Shot" wear="FT"]) – günstiger und ohne Orange. Clear Polymer auf der Glock ist transparenter Kunststoff mit schwarzem Innenleben und sieht in der Hand deutlich teurer aus, als er ist.

Gesamt ≈ 350 €. M4A1-S | Printstream ist der teuerste Teil des Sets – wenn du mit der M4A4 spielst, tausch sie ruhig gegen M4A4 | Neo-Noir: spürbar günstiger, und der Stil bleibt. Die Unhinged sind die günstigsten Handschuhe aus den „perfekten Vier“, schwarz mit weißen Schriftzügen, und behalten auch in Field-Tested einen sauberen Kontrast.

[cta color=8 budget=32000 text="Printstream-Set mit Handschuhen für 360 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set mit Messer und Handschuhen bis 1.000 €

Im kompletten Set bleiben die Waffen gleich, Handschuhe und Messer spielen aber in einer anderen Liga.

Gesamt ≈ 950 €. Black Tie ist schwarzes Leder mit weißem Besatz, quasi ein Smoking für die Hände: der präziseste Farbtreffer unter allen Handschuhen. Karambit | Damascus Steel ist das günstigste Karambit, das trotzdem perfekt ins Monochrom passt. Wenn es nicht unbedingt ein Karambit sein muss, liefert Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel dasselbe Muster und drückt die Gesamtsumme fast auf die Hälfte; Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel ([price name="Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]) ist die Zwischenlösung mit einem selteneren Modell.

[skins names="Karambit | Damascus Steel;Driver Gloves | Black Tie;Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel;Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel;Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged"]

[cta color=8 budget=90000 text="Schwarz-weißes Set mit Karambit für 1.000 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Die Sets im Vergleich

| Budget | Inhalt | Gesamt |
|---|---|---|
| bis 110 € | AK Asiimov, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP und Deagle Printstream, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Clear Polymer | ≈ 110 € |

| bis 1.000 € | Waffen aus dem mittleren Set, Driver Gloves Black Tie, Karambit Damascus Steel | ≈ 950 € |

Alle Summen basieren auf den Preisen vom 15. Oktober 2026; die einzelnen Preise im Text sind live und werden täglich neu berechnet.

## Was du vermeiden solltest

- **Graue Camos statt Kontrast.** AK-47 | VariCamo Grey, M4A4 | Urban DDPAT, AWP | Safari Mesh passen formal zur Farbe und kosten fast nichts, sind aber grauer Brei ohne Weiß. Ein solcher Skin auf einem Nebenslot ist kein Drama – bei drei wirkt das Inventar leer.
- **Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1).** Farbbasierte Matching-Algorithmen stellen es wegen der dunklen Stellen gern neben Monochrom, im Spiel ist es aber ein grün-blauer Schimmer. Zu Printstream passt es nicht.
- **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Black Pearl).** Auf dem Icon fast schwarz, beim Inspecten schimmert es lila und blau. Schön, aber in einem Schwarz-Weiß-Set nur als bewusster Akzent.
- **Printstream in Battle-Scarred.** Das Perlmutt reibt sich fleckig ab, und aus Weiß wird schmutziges Grau. Field-Tested ist der Mindestzustand, in dem die Serie so aussieht, wie sie gedacht ist.
- **M4A4 | Asiimov** ([price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]). Kein Factory New und kein Minimal Wear, und in Field-Tested deutlich teurer als M4A4 | Neo-Noir – obwohl das Orange darauf für Monochrom zu viel ist.
- **Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT** – das Matching nach Helligkeit sortiert ihn in Schwarz-Weiß ein, aber er ist pink.

## Wenn es teurer sein darf

- **AK-47 | Leet Museo** – [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"]. Weiß mit Schwarz, näher an der Farbwelt als jede andere AK.
- **AK-47 | Jet Set** – [price name="AK-47 | Jet Set" wear="FT"]. Ein Klassiker mit schwarz-weißem Muster für alle, denen die Asiimov zu „orange“ ist.
- **Karambit | Blue Steel** – [price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]. Dunkler brünierter Stahl statt Damascus-Muster; strenger und teurer.
- **Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers** – [price name="Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers" wear="FT"]. Ein helles Paar mit schwarzen Details – einer der seltenen Fälle, in denen die Handschuhe in einem monochromen Set nicht dunkel sind.

[skins names="AK-47 | Leet Museo;AK-47 | Jet Set;Karambit | Blue Steel;Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers"]

## Kurz zum Abschied

Monochrom verzeiht fast alles, außer Grau: Achte darauf, dass jedes Item sowohl sauberes Weiß als auch tiefes Schwarz hat. Die komplette Auswahl inklusive Messern und Handschuhen findest du auf der Seite mit [schwarz-weißen CS2 Skins](/de/schwarz-weisse-cs2-skins/). Weitere Farbwelten gibt es im Bereich [Farb-Sets für CS2-Skins](/de/).

pt.title: Inventário preto e branco CS2: sets Printstream de R$ 610 a R$ 5.500
pt.desc: Inventário preto e branco no CS2 em três orçamentos: Printstream, Neo-Noir, luvas Black Tie e Karambit Damascus Steel. Sets de R$ 610 a R$ 5.500.
pt.lead: Monocromático é a paleta mais fácil do CS2: tem dezenas de skins para cada slot. O segredo é montar contraste, não um monte de cinza. Três sets prontos, do econômico ao completo com Karambit.
pt.md:
Preto e branco é a cor mais fácil para o primeiro inventário temático no CS2. Há mais skins monocromáticas no jogo do que de qualquer outra cor: para cada slot existem duas ou três dezenas de opções, de camuflagens baratíssimas a rifles premium. Então o problema aqui não é encontrar alguma coisa, e sim não juntar um monte de lixo cinza aleatório que, no conjunto, parece arma padrão sem pintura.

Vamos ver quais coleções entregam contraste de verdade e montar três sets — de R$ 610 até um inventário completo com Karambit.

## O que é "preto e branco" no CS2

Um bom set monocromático é contraste, não cinza. Foque em três linhas feitas exatamente com essa lógica:

- **Printstream** — branco perolado com grafismos pretos. Uma única coleção cobre quatro slots: AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"], Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"], USP-S | Printstream — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]. Em cor, são os acertos mais precisos de toda a paleta.
- **Neo-Noir** — HQ em preto e branco com traços vermelhos: M4A4 | Neo-Noir — [price name="M4A4 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], AWP | Neo-Noir — [price name="AWP | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"].
- **Damascus Steel** — aço com padrão nas facas. É o caminho mais barato para uma faca monocromática: a Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel custa [price name="Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"], a Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel — [price name="Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AWP | Printstream;Desert Eagle | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;M4A1-S | Printstream;M4A4 | Neo-Noir;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

Com luvas também é fácil: a paleta tem quatro pares que acertam a cor quase perfeitamente — Driver Gloves | Black Tie, Moto Gloves | Smoke Out, Specialist Gloves | Mogul e Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged. Nenhuma outra cor tem tanta escolha numa faixa de preço acessível.

Antes de comprar, decida o que vai dominar o set. Um inventário "branco" se apoia em Printstream e armas claras, e aí é melhor pegar uma faca com padrão e reflexos. Um "preto" se apoia em Neo-Noir, luvas escuras e aço oxidado. As duas opções funcionam, mas não vale misturar meio a meio: se branco e preto ficam exatamente cinquenta por cento cada, o olho não se prende a nada e o inventário parece bagunçado. Os sets abaixo puxam para o "branco" — fica mais bonito na tela.

## Set até R$ 610

No set econômico, usamos Printstream onde ela é barata (AWP e Deagle) e colocamos skins branco e preto baratas nos outros slots.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Clear Polymer — [price name="Glock-18 | Clear Polymer" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ R$ 600. A AK-47 | Asiimov funciona aqui como uma arma branca com detalhes pretos; a faixa laranja é pequena e não atrapalha o visual geral. Se quiser algo mais sóbrio, pegue a AK-47 | Head Shot ([price name="AK-47 | Head Shot" wear="FT"]) — é mais barata e não tem laranja. A Clear Polymer na Glock é plástico transparente com miolo preto e, na mão, parece bem mais cara do que é.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Clear Polymer;AK-47 | Head Shot"]

[cta color=8 budget=10000 text="Montar set preto e branco por R$ 610" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set até R$ 2.000

O set médio é Printstream completa em quatro slots mais luvas. Provavelmente é o inventário monocromático mais reconhecível do jogo.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Printstream — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]
- Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged — [price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ R$ 1.900. A M4A1-S | Printstream é a parte mais cara do set, e se você joga de M4A4, pode trocar sem medo pela M4A4 | Neo-Noir: a economia é grande e o estilo se mantém. As Unhinged foram escolhidas por serem as luvas mais acessíveis do "quarteto perfeito" — pretas com escritos brancos — e em Field-Tested ainda mantêm um contraste limpo.

[cta color=8 budget=32000 text="Montar set Printstream com luvas por R$ 2.000" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set com faca e luvas até R$ 5.500

No set completo, as armas continuam as mesmas, mas as luvas e a faca sobem de nível.

- Armas — como no set médio: Asiimov na AK, Printstream na M4A1-S, AWP, Deagle e USP-S, Neo-Noir na Glock
- Driver Gloves | Black Tie — [price name="Driver Gloves | Black Tie" wear="FT"]
- Karambit | Damascus Steel — [price name="Karambit | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ R$ 5.200. As Black Tie são de couro preto com acabamento branco, literalmente um smoking para as mãos: o acerto mais preciso da paleta entre todas as luvas. A Karambit | Damascus Steel é a Karambit mais acessível e, ao mesmo tempo, encaixa perfeitamente no monocromático. Se Karambit não for questão de honra, a Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel dá o mesmo padrão e corta o total do set completo quase pela metade; a Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel ([price name="Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]) é um meio-termo com um modelo mais raro.

[skins names="Karambit | Damascus Steel;Driver Gloves | Black Tie;Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel;Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel;Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged"]

[cta color=8 budget=90000 text="Montar set preto e branco com Karambit por R$ 5.500" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Comparação dos sets

| Orçamento | O que entra | Total |
|---|---|---|
| até R$ 610 | AK Asiimov, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP e Deagle Printstream, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Clear Polymer | ≈ R$ 600 |
| até R$ 2.000 | AK Asiimov, Printstream na M4A1-S, AWP, Deagle, USP-S, Glock Neo-Noir, Broken Fang Gloves Unhinged | ≈ R$ 1.900 |
| até R$ 5.500 | Armas do set médio, Driver Gloves Black Tie, Karambit Damascus Steel | ≈ R$ 5.200 |

Todos os totais usam os preços de 15 de outubro de 2026; os preços individuais no texto são ao vivo e recalculados todos os dias.

## O que evitar

- **Camuflagens cinza em vez de contraste.** AK-47 | VariCamo Grey, M4A4 | Urban DDPAT e AWP | Safari Mesh até combinam na cor e custam quase nada, mas são uma papa cinza sem branco. Uma skin dessas num slot reserva não faz mal; três, e o inventário parece vazio.
- **Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1).** Os algoritmos de busca por cor costumam colocá-la junto do monocromático por causa das partes escuras, mas no jogo ela é um brilho verde-azulado. Com Printstream não funciona.
- **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Black Pearl).** No ícone parece quase preta, mas na inspeção reflete roxo e azul. É bonita, mas num set preto e branco só entra como destaque proposital.
- **Printstream em Battle-Scarred.** O perolado se desgasta em manchas e o branco vira um cinza sujo. Field-Tested é o desgaste mínimo em que a coleção fica como deveria.
- **M4A4 | Asiimov** ([price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]). Não existe em Factory New nem Minimal Wear, e em Field-Tested custa bem mais que a M4A4 | Neo-Noir — sendo que, para um set monocromático, o laranja dela sobra.
- **Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT** — a busca por brilho a joga na paleta preto e branco, mas ela é rosa.

## Se quiser gastar mais

- **AK-47 | Leet Museo** — [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"]. Branca com preto, mais próxima da paleta do que qualquer outra AK.
- **AK-47 | Jet Set** — [price name="AK-47 | Jet Set" wear="FT"]. Um clássico com padrão preto e branco, para quem acha a Asiimov "laranja" demais.
- **Karambit | Blue Steel** — [price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]. Aço oxidado escuro no lugar do padrão Damascus; mais sóbria e mais cara.
- **Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers** — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers" wear="FT"]. Um par claro com detalhes pretos — caso raro em que as luvas de um set monocromático não são escuras.

[skins names="AK-47 | Leet Museo;AK-47 | Jet Set;Karambit | Blue Steel;Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers"]

## Resumindo

O monocromático perdoa quase tudo, menos o cinza: mantenha em cada item tanto um branco limpo quanto um preto profundo. A seleção completa de armas, facas e luvas está na página de [skins preto e branco do CS2](/pt/skins-preto-branco-cs2/). As outras paletas ficam na seção de [sets de skins por cor do CS2](/pt/).

tr.title: Siyah-beyaz CS2 envanteri: $110–$1.000 Printstream skin setleri
tr.desc: Üç bütçede siyah-beyaz CS2 envanteri: Printstream, Neo-Noir, Black Tie eldiven ve Karambit Damascus Steel. $110'dan $1.000'e setler.
tr.lead: Monokrom, CS2'deki en kolay renk: her slot için onlarca skin var. Önemli olan gri değil kontrast kurmak. Bütçe setinden Karambit'li tam envantere üç hazır set.
tr.md:
Siyah-beyaz, CS2'de ilk temalı envanter için en kolay renk. Oyunda monokrom skinler diğer tüm renklerden fazla: her slot için kuruşluk kamuflajlardan premium tüfeklere kadar iki üç düzine seçenek çıkıyor. Yani buradaki sorun bir şey bulmak değil, bir araya gelince boyasız varsayılan skinler gibi duran rastgele gri çöplerle envanteri doldurmamak.

Hangi serilerin gerçek kontrast verdiğine bakalım ve üç set kuralım — $110'dan Karambit'li tam envantere kadar.

## CS2'de "siyah-beyaz" ne demek

İyi bir monokrom set gri değil, kontrastlı olur. Tam da bu mantıkla tasarlanmış üç seriye odaklan:

- **Printstream** — siyah grafikli sedef beyazı. Tek seri dört slotu kapatıyor: AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"], Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"], USP-S | Printstream — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]. Renk olarak tüm grubun en isabetli parçaları.
- **Neo-Noir** — kırmızı vuruşlu siyah-beyaz çizgi roman: M4A4 | Neo-Noir — [price name="M4A4 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], AWP | Neo-Noir — [price name="AWP | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"].
- **Damascus Steel** — bıçaklarda desenli çelik. Monokrom bıçağa giden en ucuz yol: Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel [price name="Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"], Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel — [price name="Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AWP | Printstream;Desert Eagle | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;M4A1-S | Printstream;M4A4 | Neo-Noir;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

Eldivenlerde de iş kolay: bu grupta renge neredeyse kusursuz oturan dört çift var — Driver Gloves | Black Tie, Moto Gloves | Smoke Out, Specialist Gloves | Mogul ve Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged. Makul fiyat aralığında başka hiçbir renkte bu kadar seçenek yok.

Almadan önce sette neyin baskın olacağına karar ver. "Beyaz" envanter Printstream ve açık renkli silahlar üzerine kurulur; o zaman bıçağın desenli, parlak yansımalı olması daha iyi. "Siyah" envanter ise Neo-Noir, koyu eldivenler ve karartılmış çeliğe dayanır. İkisi de işe yarar, ama eşit karıştırmamak lazım: beyaz ve siyah tam yarı yarıya olursa göz hiçbir şeye takılmaz ve envanter alacalı görünür. Aşağıdaki setler "beyaz" tarafa kurulu — ekranda daha net duruyor.

## $110'a kadar set

Bütçe setinde Printstream'i ucuz olduğu yerde (AWP ve Deagle) alıyoruz, diğer slotlara uygun fiyatlı beyaz-siyah skinler koyuyoruz.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Clear Polymer — [price name="Glock-18 | Clear Polymer" wear="FT"]

Toplam ≈ $110. AK-47 | Asiimov burada siyah detaylı beyaz bir silah işlevi görüyor; üzerindeki turuncu şerit küçük ve genel görüntüyü bozmuyor. Daha sade istersen AK-47 | Head Shot ([price name="AK-47 | Head Shot" wear="FT"]) al — hem daha ucuz hem turuncusuz. Glock'taki Clear Polymer, siyah iç aksamlı şeffaf plastik; elde fiyatından belirgin şekilde pahalı duruyor.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Clear Polymer;AK-47 | Head Shot"]

[cta color=8 budget=10000 text="Siyah-beyaz seti $110'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## $360'a kadar set

Orta set — dört slotta tam Printstream artı eldiven. Muhtemelen oyundaki en tanınan monokrom envanter.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]

Toplam ≈ $350. Setin en pahalı parçası M4A1-S | Printstream; M4A4 ile oynuyorsan gönül rahatlığıyla M4A4 | Neo-Noir'a geç: tasarruf ciddi, stil korunuyor. Unhinged, "ideal dörtlünün" en uygun fiyatlı eldiveni olduğu için seçildi: beyaz yazılı siyah, ve Field-Tested'da hâlâ temiz kontrastını koruyor.

[cta color=8 budget=32000 text="Eldivenli Printstream setini $360'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Bıçak ve eldivenli set, $1.000'e kadar

Tam sette silahlar aynı kalıyor, eldiven ve bıçak ise lig atlıyor.

- Silahlar — orta setteki gibi: AK'de Asiimov, M4A1-S, AWP, Deagle ve USP-S'te Printstream, Glock'ta Neo-Noir

Toplam ≈ $950. Black Tie, beyaz detaylı siyah deri; resmen eller için smokin: tüm eldivenler arasında renge en isabetli olanı. Karambit | Damascus Steel, monokroma kusursuz oturan en uygun fiyatlı Karambit. Karambit şart değilse Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel aynı deseni veriyor ve tam setin toplamını neredeyse yarıya indiriyor; Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel ([price name="Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]) ise daha nadir modelle arada bir seçenek.

## Setlerin karşılaştırması

pl.title: Czarno-biały ekwipunek CS2: sety z Printstream od 440 do 4 000 zł
pl.desc: Czarno-biały ekwipunek CS2 w trzech budżetach: Printstream, Neo-Noir, rękawice Black Tie i Karambit Damascus Steel. Sety od 440 do 4 000 zł.
pl.lead: Monochrom to najprostsza paleta w CS2: na każdy slot są dziesiątki skinów. Klucz to kontrast, a nie szarość. Trzy gotowe sety, od budżetowego po pełny z Karambitem.
pl.md:
Czerń i biel to najprostszy kolor na pierwszy tematyczny ekwipunek w CS2. Monochromatycznych skinów jest w grze więcej niż jakichkolwiek innych: na każdy slot znajdziesz dwadzieścia–trzydzieści opcji, od groszowych kamuflaży po topowe karabiny. Problemem nie jest więc znalezienie czegokolwiek, tylko to, żeby nie nazbierać przypadkowego szarego śmiecia, który razem wygląda jak domyślne skiny bez malowania.

Sprawdzimy, które serie dają prawdziwy kontrast, i złożymy trzy sety — od ok. 440 zł po pełny ekwipunek z Karambitem.

## Czym jest „czarno-biały” w CS2

Dobry monochromatyczny set to kontrast, a nie szarość. Trzymaj się trzech linii, które są zaprojektowane właśnie w tej logice:

- **Printstream** — perłowa biel z czarną grafiką. Jedna seria zamyka cztery sloty: AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"], Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"], USP-S | Printstream — [price name="USP-S | Printstream" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Printstream — [price name="M4A1-S | Printstream" wear="FT"]. Kolorystycznie to najcelniejsze trafienia w całej palecie.
- **Neo-Noir** — czarno-biały komiks z czerwonymi kreskami: M4A4 | Neo-Noir — [price name="M4A4 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"], AWP | Neo-Noir — [price name="AWP | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"].
- **Damascus Steel** — wzorzysta stal na nożach. To najtańsza droga do monochromatycznego noża: Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel kosztuje [price name="Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"], Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel — [price name="Bowie Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AWP | Printstream;Desert Eagle | Printstream;USP-S | Printstream;M4A1-S | Printstream;M4A4 | Neo-Noir;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

Z rękawicami też jest prosto: w palecie są cztery pary, które trafiają w kolor niemal idealnie — Driver Gloves | Black Tie, Moto Gloves | Smoke Out, Specialist Gloves | Mogul i Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged. Żaden inny kolor nie ma takiego wyboru w rozsądnym przedziale cenowym.

Przed zakupem zdecyduj, co ma dominować w secie. „Biały” ekwipunek opiera się na Printstream i jasnej broni, a wtedy lepiej wziąć wzorzysty nóż z refleksami. „Czarny” stoi na Neo-Noir, ciemnych rękawicach i oksydowanej stali. Obie opcje działają, ale nie warto mieszać ich po równo: jeśli bieli i czerni jest dokładnie pół na pół, wzrok nie ma się czego uchwycić, a ekwipunek wydaje się pstrokaty. Sety poniżej idą w „białą” stronę — na ekranie wygląda ona wyraźniej.

## Set do 440 zł

W budżetowym secie bierzemy Printstream tam, gdzie jest tani (AWP i Deagle), a na pozostałe sloty dajemy niedrogie biało-czarne skiny.

- AWP | Printstream — [price name="AWP | Printstream" wear="FT"]

Razem ≈ 440 zł. AK-47 | Asiimov działa tu jako biała broń z czarnymi detalami; pomarańczowy pasek jest na nim niewielki i w ogólnym obrazie nie przeszkadza. Jeśli chcesz surowiej, weź AK-47 | Head Shot ([price name="AK-47 | Head Shot" wear="FT"]) — jest tańszy i bez pomarańczu. Clear Polymer na Glocku to przezroczysty plastik z czarnym wnętrzem, w dłoni wygląda wyraźnie drożej, niż kosztuje.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Clear Polymer;AK-47 | Head Shot"]

[cta color=8 budget=10000 text="Złóż czarno-biały set za 440 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Set do 1 400 zł

Średni set to pełny Printstream na czterech slotach plus rękawice. To chyba najbardziej rozpoznawalny monochromatyczny ekwipunek w grze.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]

Razem ≈ 1 400 zł. M4A1-S | Printstream to najdroższa część setu, więc jeśli grasz M4A4, śmiało zamień go na M4A4 | Neo-Noir: oszczędność jest odczuwalna, a styl zostaje. Unhinged wybraliśmy jako najtańsze rękawice z „idealnej czwórki” — czarne z białymi napisami, a w Field-Tested wciąż trzymają czysty kontrast.

W pełnym secie broń zostaje ta sama, a rękawice i nóż wchodzą do innej ligi.

Karambit | Damascus Steel to najtańszy Karambit, który przy tym idealnie wpisuje się w monochrom. Jeśli Karambit nie jest dla ciebie must-have, Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel daje ten sam wzór i obniża koszt pełnego setu prawie o połowę; Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel ([price name="Skeleton Knife | Damascus Steel" wear="FT"]) to opcja pośrednia z rzadszym modelem.
