Wenn du unbedingt die Redline auf der AK willst – die passt hier auch, aber dazu haben wir eine [eigene Analyse der Kombinationen](/de/blog/s-chem-sochetat-ak-47-redline/).

[cta color=0 budget=8000 text="Rot-schwarzes Set für 90 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set bis 360 €

Rund 350 €. Wir rüsten auf zweifarbige Waffen auf und nehmen Handschuhe dazu:

- **AK-47 | Bloodsport** – [price name="AK-47 | Bloodsport" wear="FT"]. Die beste rot-schwarze AK im Spiel: rote Details, schwarzer Body, die weißen Einsätze fallen aus der Ego-Perspektive kaum auf.
- **M4A4 | Spider Lily** – [price name="M4A4 | Spider Lily" wear="FT"]. Rote Lilien auf dunklem Grund.
- **AWP | Redline** – bleibt aus dem vorherigen Set.
- **Desert Eagle | Code Red** – [price name="Desert Eagle | Code Red" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Kill Confirmed** – [price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FT"].
- **Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo** – ab [price name="Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo"]. Gibt es nur in Factory New und Minimal Wear, sieht also bei allen gleich knallig aus.
- **Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red** – [price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]. Rotes Leder mit dunklen Nähten, einer der präzisesten Farbtreffer unter den Handschuhen.

[skins names="AK-47 | Bloodsport;USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo;Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red"]

Variante ohne Handschuhe: Statt Rezan the Red nimmst du das **Navaja Knife | Crimson Web** – [price name="Navaja Knife | Crimson Web" wear="FT"]. Fast dasselbe Budget, aber das Messer siehst du öfter in der Hand als die Handschuhe beim Inspecten.

[cta color=0 budget=32000 text="Rot-schwarzes Set für 360 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set mit Messer und Handschuhen bis 1.200 €

Rund 1.200 €. Die Waffen kommen aus dem mittleren Set, dazu ein Paar, das beide Farben trägt:

- **Karambit | Autotronic** – [price name="Karambit | Autotronic" wear="FT"]. Carbonklinge mit roten Linien – Rot-Schwarz in Reinform.
- **Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure** – [price name="Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure" wear="FT"]. Schwarz mit Rot, greifen das Muster der Autotronic perfekt auf.

Wenn das Karambit nicht drin ist, liefert das **Bayonet | Autotronic** dasselbe Finish für etwa ein Drittel des Preises, und das Set sinkt auf rund 600 €. Ein anderes Handschuhpaar in derselben Preisklasse: **Sport Gloves | Omega**, [price name="Sport Gloves | Omega" wear="FT"].

[skins names="Karambit | Autotronic;Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure;Sport Gloves | Omega;Bayonet | Autotronic"]

[cta color=0 budget=105000 text="Rot-schwarzes Set für 1.200 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Drei Sets in einer Tabelle

| Budget | Inhalt | Gesamt |
|---|---|---|
| Bis 90 € | Red Laminate, Evil Daimyo, AWP Redline, Deagle Crimson Web, USP Cyrex, Glock Royal Legion | ≈ 80 € |
| Bis 360 € | Bloodsport, Spider Lily, AWP Redline, Code Red, Kill Confirmed, Dragon Tattoo + Rezan the Red | ≈ 350 € |
| Bis 1.200 € | Waffen aus dem mittleren Set + Karambit Autotronic + Moto Gloves Blood Pressure | ≈ 1.200 € |

Die Summen basieren auf den Preisen vom 15. Oktober 2026; die Preise im Text sind live und werden täglich aktualisiert.

## Was du vermeiden solltest

- **Crimson Web in Factory New.** M9 Bayonet | Crimson Web kostet in Factory New mehr als das Zehnfache von Field-Tested ([price name="M9 Bayonet | Crimson Web" wear="FT"]). Der Unterschied liegt in der Sauberkeit des Netzes und seltenen Patterns – nur für die Farbe dafür zu zahlen, ist sinnlos.
- **Crimson Web in schlechtem Zustand bei Handschuhen.** Specialist Gloves | Crimson Web verlieren in Battle-Scarred ihr Muster und sehen nur noch weinrot aus.
- **Driver Gloves | Crimson Weave.** Der niedrigste Marktpreis ist ein abgewetztes Battle-Scarred, ein ordentliches Field-Tested kostet [price name="Driver Gloves | Crimson Weave" wear="FT"]. Eine Falle für alle, die nur auf „ab“ schauen.
- **AK-47 | Asiimov, AK-47 | Fuel Injector, AWP | Asiimov.** In der Vorschau wirken sie rot, im Spiel sind sie orange. Neben der Bloodsport sehen sie aus wie aus einem anderen Set.
- **Glock-18 | Candy Apple.** Günstig und knallrot, aber ohne Schwarz – im rot-schwarzen Inventar wirkt sie wie ein aufgeklebter Sticker.
- **Hand Wraps | Badlands und Bloodhound Gloves | Snakebite.** Eher braunrot, und bei Badlands kostet FT zudem [price name="Hand Wraps | Badlands" wear="FT"] – Aufpreis für eine ungenaue Farbe.

## Wenn es teurer sein darf

- **Karambit | Doppler (Ruby)** – [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Ruby)"]. Ruby ist das Ende der Fahnenstange für ein rotes Messer; das Schwarz übernehmen dann Handschuhe und Waffen.
- **Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono** – [price name="Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono" wear="FT"]. Die bekanntesten rot-schwarzen Handschuhe im Spiel.
- **M4A1-S | Hot Rod** – ab [price name="M4A1-S | Hot Rod"]. Durchgehend rotes Metallic, passt gut zu Ruby.
- **Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 弐** – [price name="Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 弐" wear="FT"]. Eine Sammler-Pistole für alle, die die übrigen Slots schon abgehakt haben.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Ruby);Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono;M4A1-S | Hot Rod;Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 弐"]

Praxistipp: Wähle im rot-schwarzen Set zuerst die Handschuhe, dann das Messer. Rote Handschuhe gibt es wenige, und genau sie entscheiden, ob das Inventar dunkel oder knallig wirkt. Den Rest erledigt der Builder – schau dir alle [rot-schwarzen Skins und Handschuhe](/de/rot-schwarze-cs2-skins/) sowie die anderen [Farb-Sets für CS2-Skins](/de/) an.

pt.title: Inventário vermelho e preto CS2: sets por R$ 490, R$ 2.000 e R$ 6.400
pt.desc: Três sets vermelho e preto prontos para o CS2: de armas baratas a Karambit Autotronic com luvas. O que pegar, quais desgastes matam a cor e o que evitar.
pt.lead: Vermelho e preto vive do equilíbrio entre as duas cores: base escura e detalhes vermelhos. Montamos três sets para orçamentos diferentes e destrinchamos as armadilhas dessa paleta.
pt.md:
Vermelho e preto é a única paleta popular do CS2 com duas cores, e a segunda importa tanto quanto a primeira. Vermelho puro sem fundo preto vira rapidinho um "caminhão de bombeiro": faca rubi, luvas vermelho vivo e AK escarlate no mesmo frame cansam a vista. Um bom inventário vermelho e preto é base escura com detalhes vermelhos, como no capô de um carro esportivo.

Abaixo, três sets prontos: só armas, armas com luvas e o kit completo com faca. Todos os itens foram escolhidos pela correspondência de cor da nossa base, e não pelas miniaturas do mercado.

## O que deixa uma skin vermelha e preta

No CS2, essa paleta se apoia em três famílias de acabamento:

- **Crimson Web** — teia vermelha sobre preto. Clássico desde 2013, existe em quase todas as facas, na Desert Eagle e nas Specialist Gloves. O detalhe principal: a teia só aparece com desgaste bom; em Battle-Scarred a faca fica simplesmente escura.
- **Autotronic** — carbono preto com detalhes vermelhos. É o acabamento de faca vermelho e preto mais "certinho": mesmo em Field-Tested as cores não desandam. Bayonet — [price name="Bayonet | Autotronic" wear="FT"], Gut Knife — [price name="Gut Knife | Autotronic" wear="FT"], Karambit — [price name="Karambit | Autotronic" wear="FT"].
- **Armas bicolores** — AK-47 | Bloodsport, M4A4 | Spider Lily, Desert Eagle | Code Red, USP-S | Kill Confirmed. Têm mais ou menos tanto preto quanto vermelho e fazem a ponte entre a faca e as luvas.

[skins names="Bayonet | Autotronic;Navaja Knife | Crimson Web;AK-47 | Bloodsport;M4A4 | Spider Lily;Desert Eagle | Code Red"]

A Doppler (Ruby) também é vermelha, mas é um rubi polido sólido, sem preto. Vale pegá-la como peça central de um set caro, e não como "mais uma faca vermelha". Mais opções na página de [skins vermelhas](/pt/skins-vermelhas-cs2/).

## Set até R$ 490

Seis armas sem faca e sem luvas — cerca de R$ 460. Aqui trabalhamos com acertos baratos e precisos:

- **AK-47 | Red Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Red Laminate" wear="FT"]. Madeira vermelha sobre metal preto, mais discreta que a Redline e sem repetir metade dos inventários por aí.
- **M4A4 | Evil Daimyo** — [price name="M4A4 | Evil Daimyo" wear="FT"]. Match de cor quase perfeito por uma mixaria.
- **AWP | Redline** — [price name="AWP | Redline" wear="FT"]. Diferente da versão da AK, na AWP as faixas vermelhas se seguram melhor em Field-Tested.
- **Desert Eagle | Crimson Web** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Crimson Web" wear="FT"]. A mesma teia das facas — já prepara o terreno para uma faca Crimson Web.
- **USP-S | Cyrex** — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"].
- **Glock-18 | Royal Legion** — [price name="Glock-18 | Royal Legion" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Red Laminate;M4A4 | Evil Daimyo;AWP | Redline;Desert Eagle | Crimson Web;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Royal Legion"]

Se você quer mesmo a Redline na AK — ela também cabe aqui, mas temos uma [análise separada de combinações](/pt/blog/s-chem-sochetat-ak-47-redline/) sobre ela.

[cta color=0 budget=8000 text="Montar set vermelho e preto por R$ 490" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set até R$ 2.000

Cerca de R$ 1.900. Fazemos upgrade para armas bicolores e adicionamos luvas:

- **AK-47 | Bloodsport** — [price name="AK-47 | Bloodsport" wear="FT"]. A melhor AK vermelha e preta do jogo: detalhes vermelhos, corpo preto, e os detalhes brancos quase não aparecem em primeira pessoa.
- **M4A4 | Spider Lily** — [price name="M4A4 | Spider Lily" wear="FT"]. Lírios vermelhos sobre fundo escuro.
- **AWP | Redline** — continua do set anterior.
- **Desert Eagle | Code Red** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Code Red" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Kill Confirmed** — [price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FT"].
- **Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo** — a partir de [price name="Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo"]. Só sai em Factory New e Minimal Wear, então fica igualmente vibrante para todo mundo.
- **Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red** — [price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]. Couro vermelho com costuras escuras, um dos acertos mais precisos da paleta entre as luvas.

[skins names="AK-47 | Bloodsport;USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo;Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red"]

Opção sem luvas: no lugar das Rezan the Red, coloque a **Navaja Knife | Crimson Web** — [price name="Navaja Knife | Crimson Web" wear="FT"]. O orçamento é quase o mesmo, mas a faca aparece na mão mais vezes do que as luvas na inspeção.

[cta color=0 budget=32000 text="Montar set vermelho e preto por R$ 2.000" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set com faca e luvas até R$ 6.400

Cerca de R$ 6.400. As armas vêm do set médio, e adicionamos um par que segura as duas cores:

- **Karambit | Autotronic** — [price name="Karambit | Autotronic" wear="FT"]. Lâmina de carbono com linhas vermelhas — vermelho e preto em estado puro.
- **Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure** — [price name="Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure" wear="FT"]. Pretas com vermelho, repetem muito bem o desenho da Autotronic.

Se a Karambit não couber, a **Bayonet | Autotronic** entrega o mesmo acabamento por mais ou menos um terço do preço, e o set cai para cerca de R$ 3.300. Outro par de luvas na mesma faixa — **Sport Gloves | Omega**, [price name="Sport Gloves | Omega" wear="FT"].

[skins names="Karambit | Autotronic;Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure;Sport Gloves | Omega;Bayonet | Autotronic"]

[cta color=0 budget=105000 text="Montar set vermelho e preto por R$ 6.400" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Os três sets numa tabela

| Orçamento | O que entra | Total |
|---|---|---|
| Até R$ 490 | Red Laminate, Evil Daimyo, AWP Redline, Deagle Crimson Web, USP Cyrex, Glock Royal Legion | ≈ R$ 460 |
| Até R$ 2.000 | Bloodsport, Spider Lily, AWP Redline, Code Red, Kill Confirmed, Dragon Tattoo + Rezan the Red | ≈ R$ 1.900 |
| Até R$ 6.400 | Armas do set médio + Karambit Autotronic + Moto Gloves Blood Pressure | ≈ R$ 6.400 |

Os totais foram calculados com os preços de 15 de outubro de 2026; os preços no texto são ao vivo e atualizados todos os dias.

## O que evitar

- **Crimson Web em Factory New.** A M9 Bayonet | Crimson Web em Factory New custa mais de dez vezes o preço da Field-Tested ([price name="M9 Bayonet | Crimson Web" wear="FT"]). A diferença está na nitidez da teia e em patterns raros, e pagar por isso só pela cor não faz sentido.
- **Crimson Web com desgaste ruim em luvas.** As Specialist Gloves | Crimson Web em Battle-Scarred perdem o desenho e ficam só cor de vinho.
- **Driver Gloves | Crimson Weave.** O menor preço do mercado é uma Battle-Scarred toda gasta, enquanto uma Field-Tested decente custa [price name="Driver Gloves | Crimson Weave" wear="FT"]. Armadilha para quem só olha o "a partir de".
- **AK-47 | Asiimov, AK-47 | Fuel Injector, AWP | Asiimov.** Na prévia parecem vermelhas; no jogo, são laranja. Ao lado da Bloodsport parecem de outro set.
- **Glock-18 | Candy Apple.** Barata e vermelho vivo, mas sem preto — num inventário vermelho e preto ela fica sobrando como um adesivo.
- **Hand Wraps | Badlands e Bloodhound Gloves | Snakebite.** Puxam mais para o marrom-avermelhado, e a Badlands ainda custa [price name="Hand Wraps | Badlands" wear="FT"] em FT — pagar a mais por uma cor imprecisa.

## Se quiser gastar mais

- **Karambit | Doppler (Ruby)** — [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Ruby)"]. O Ruby é o fim da linha para uma faca vermelha; aí o preto fica por conta das luvas e das armas.
- **Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono** — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono" wear="FT"]. As luvas vermelhas e pretas mais icônicas do jogo.
- **M4A1-S | Hot Rod** — a partir de [price name="M4A1-S | Hot Rod"]. Vermelho metálico sólido, combina bem com a Ruby.
- **Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 弐** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 弐" wear="FT"]. Pistola de colecionador para quem já fechou os outros slots.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Ruby);Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono;M4A1-S | Hot Rod;Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 弐"]

Dica prática: num set vermelho e preto, escolha primeiro as luvas e depois a faca. Luvas vermelhas são poucas, e são elas que definem se o inventário vai ficar escuro ou vibrante. O resto o montador resolve — veja todas as [skins, facas e luvas vermelhas](/pt/skins-vermelhas-cs2/) e os outros [sets de skins por cor do CS2](/pt/).

tr.title: Kırmızı-siyah CS2 envanteri: $90, $360 ve $1.200'e skin setleri
tr.desc: CS2 için üç hazır kırmızı-siyah set: ucuz silahlardan eldivenli Karambit Autotronic'e. Ne alınmalı, hangi aşınmalar rengi öldürür, nelerden kaçınmalı.
tr.lead: Kırmızı-siyah iki rengin dengesine dayanır: koyu taban ve kırmızı vurgular. Farklı bütçelere üç set kurduk ve bu renk grubunun tuzaklarını inceledik.
tr.md:
Kırmızı-siyah, CS2'de iki renkli tek popüler renk grubu ve ikinci renk de birincisi kadar önemli. Siyah zemini olmayan saf kırmızı çabucak "itfaiye aracına" dönüşür: aynı karede yakut bıçak, parlak kırmızı eldiven ve al bir AK göz yorar. İyi bir kırmızı-siyah envanter, spor araba kaputundaki gibi koyu bir taban ve kırmızı vurgulardan oluşur.

Aşağıda üç hazır set var: sadece silahlar, silahlar artı eldiven ve bıçaklı tam takım. Tüm eşyalar markettaki küçük resimlere göre değil, veritabanımızdaki renk eşleşmesine göre seçildi.

## Bir skini kırmızı-siyah yapan ne

CS2'de bu renk grubunu üç kaplama ailesi taşır:

- **Crimson Web** — siyah üstüne kırmızı örümcek ağı. 2013'ten beri klasik; neredeyse tüm bıçaklarda, Desert Eagle'da ve Specialist Gloves'ta var. Asıl özelliği: ağ yalnızca iyi aşınmada görünür, Battle-Scarred'da bıçak düz koyu bir şeye dönüşür.
- **Autotronic** — kırmızı ekli siyah karbon. En "doğru" kırmızı-siyah bıçak kaplaması: Field-Tested'da bile renkler kaymıyor. Bayonet — [price name="Bayonet | Autotronic" wear="FT"], Gut Knife — [price name="Gut Knife | Autotronic" wear="FT"], Karambit — [price name="Karambit | Autotronic" wear="FT"].
- **İki renkli silahlar** — AK-47 | Bloodsport, M4A4 | Spider Lily, Desert Eagle | Code Red, USP-S | Kill Confirmed. Bunlarda siyah aşağı yukarı kırmızı kadar; bıçakla eldiveni birbirine bağlıyorlar.

[skins names="Bayonet | Autotronic;Navaja Knife | Crimson Web;AK-47 | Bloodsport;M4A4 | Spider Lily;Desert Eagle | Code Red"]

Doppler (Ruby) da kırmızı, ama siyahsız, baştan sona parlak bir yakut. Onu "bir kırmızı bıçak daha" olarak değil, pahalı bir setin merkez parçası olarak almak gerek. Seçeneklerin ayrıntısı [kırmızı bıçaklar](/tr/kirmizi-cs2-skinleri/) sayfasında.

## $90'a kadar set

Bıçaksız ve eldivensiz altı silah — yaklaşık $80. Burada ucuz ama isabetli parçalarla çalışıyoruz:

- **AK-47 | Red Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Red Laminate" wear="FT"]. Siyah metal üzerinde kırmızı ahşap; Redline'dan daha sakin duruyor ve her ikinci envanterde görmüyorsun.
- **M4A4 | Evil Daimyo** — [price name="M4A4 | Evil Daimyo" wear="FT"]. Kuruşa neredeyse kusursuz renk eşleşmesi.
- **AWP | Redline** — [price name="AWP | Redline" wear="FT"]. AK versiyonunun aksine AWP'deki kırmızı şeritler Field-Tested'da daha iyi dayanıyor.
- **Desert Eagle | Crimson Web** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Crimson Web" wear="FT"]. Bıçaklardaki ağın aynısı — Crimson Web bıçağa şimdiden zemin hazırlıyor.
- **USP-S | Cyrex** — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"].
- **Glock-18 | Royal Legion** — [price name="Glock-18 | Royal Legion" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Red Laminate;M4A4 | Evil Daimyo;AWP | Redline;Desert Eagle | Crimson Web;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Royal Legion"]

AK'de illa Redline istiyorsan burada o da yerinde durur; onun için [ayrı bir kombinasyon rehberimiz](/tr/blog/s-chem-sochetat-ak-47-redline/) var.

[cta color=0 budget=8000 text="Kırmızı-siyah seti $90'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## $360'a kadar set

Yaklaşık $350. Silahları iki renkliye yükseltip eldiven ekliyoruz:

- **AK-47 | Bloodsport** — [price name="AK-47 | Bloodsport" wear="FT"]. Oyundaki en iyi kırmızı-siyah AK: kırmızı detaylar, siyah gövde, beyaz ekler birinci şahıs görünümünde neredeyse fark edilmiyor.
- **M4A4 | Spider Lily** — [price name="M4A4 | Spider Lily" wear="FT"]. Koyu zemin üzerinde kırmızı zambaklar.
- **AWP | Redline** — önceki setten kalıyor.
- **Desert Eagle | Code Red** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Code Red" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Kill Confirmed** — [price name="USP-S | Kill Confirmed" wear="FT"].
- **Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo** — [price name="Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo"]'dan başlıyor. Yalnızca Factory New ve Minimal Wear olarak çıkıyor, bu yüzden herkeste aynı parlaklıkta görünüyor.
- **Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red** — [price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]. Koyu dikişli kırmızı deri; eldivenler arasında renk grubuna en isabetli oturanlardan biri.

[skins names="AK-47 | Bloodsport;USP-S | Kill Confirmed;Glock-18 | Dragon Tattoo;Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red"]

Eldivensiz seçenek: Rezan the Red yerine **Navaja Knife | Crimson Web** koy — [price name="Navaja Knife | Crimson Web" wear="FT"]. Bütçe hemen hemen aynı, ama bıçak elde, eldivenlerin inspect'te göründüğünden daha sık görünür.

[cta color=0 budget=32000 text="Kırmızı-siyah seti $360'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Bıçak ve eldivenli set, $1.200'e kadar

Yaklaşık $1.200. Silahları orta setten alıp iki rengi de taşıyan bir ikili ekliyoruz:

- **Karambit | Autotronic** — [price name="Karambit | Autotronic" wear="FT"]. Kırmızı çizgili karbon bıçak ağzı — saf haliyle kırmızı-siyah.
- **Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure** — [price name="Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure" wear="FT"]. Kırmızılı siyah; Autotronic'in desenini çok iyi tekrar ediyor.

Karambit bütçeye sığmıyorsa **Bayonet | Autotronic** aynı kaplamayı yaklaşık üçte bir fiyatına veriyor ve set yaklaşık $600'e iniyor. Aynı fiyattaki bir başka eldiven çifti — **Sport Gloves | Omega**, [price name="Sport Gloves | Omega" wear="FT"].

[skins names="Karambit | Autotronic;Moto Gloves | Blood Pressure;Sport Gloves | Omega;Bayonet | Autotronic"]

[cta color=0 budget=105000 text="Kırmızı-siyah seti $1.200'e topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Üç set tek tabloda

| Bütçe | İçerik | Toplam |
|---|---|---|
| $90'a kadar | Red Laminate, Evil Daimyo, AWP Redline, Deagle Crimson Web, USP Cyrex, Glock Royal Legion | ≈ $80 |
| $360'a kadar | Bloodsport, Spider Lily, AWP Redline, Code Red, Kill Confirmed, Dragon Tattoo + Rezan the Red | ≈ $350 |
| $1.200'e kadar | Orta setin silahları + Karambit Autotronic + Moto Gloves Blood Pressure | ≈ $1.200 |

Toplamlar 15 Ekim 2026 fiyatlarıyla hesaplandı; metindeki fiyatlar canlı ve her gün güncelleniyor.

## Nelerden kaçınmalı

pl.title: Czerwono-czarny ekwipunek CS2: sety za 360, 1 400 i 4 700 zł
pl.desc: Trzy gotowe czerwono-czarne sety do CS2: od tanich spluw po Karambit Autotronic z rękawicami. Co brać, jaki wear zabija kolor i czego unikać.
pl.lead: Czerwono-czarny stoi na równowadze dwóch kolorów: ciemna baza i czerwone akcenty. Złożyliśmy trzy sety na różne budżety i rozebraliśmy pułapki tej palety.
pl.md:
Czerwono-czarny to jedyna popularna paleta w CS2, w której kolory są dwa, a drugi jest równie ważny jak pierwszy. Czysta czerwień bez czarnego podkładu szybko zamienia się w „wóz strażacki”: rubinowy nóż, jaskrawoczerwone rękawice i szkarłatny AK w jednym kadrze kłują w oczy. Dobry czerwono-czarny ekwipunek to ciemna baza i czerwone akcenty, jak na masce sportowego auta.

Poniżej trzy gotowe sety: sama broń, broń z rękawicami i pełny komplet z nożem. Wszystkie przedmioty dobraliśmy według dopasowania kolorystycznego z naszej bazy, a nie według miniaturek na markecie.

## Co sprawia, że skin jest czerwono-czarny

W CS2 tę paletę trzymają trzy rodziny wykończeń:

- **Autotronic** — czarny karbon z czerwonymi wstawkami. To najbardziej „prawidłowe” czerwono-czarne wykończenie noża: nawet w Field-Tested kolory się nie rozjeżdżają. Bayonet — [price name="Bayonet | Autotronic" wear="FT"], Gut Knife — [price name="Gut Knife | Autotronic" wear="FT"], Karambit — [price name="Karambit | Autotronic" wear="FT"].
- **Dwukolorowe spluwy** — AK-47 | Bloodsport, M4A4 | Spider Lily, Desert Eagle | Code Red, USP-S | Kill Confirmed. Czerni jest na nich mniej więcej tyle samo co czerwieni i to one spinają nóż z rękawicami.

[skins names="Bayonet | Autotronic;Navaja Knife | Crimson Web;AK-47 | Bloodsport;M4A4 | Spider Lily;Desert Eagle | Code Red"]

Doppler (Ruby) też jest czerwony, ale to jednolity błyszczący rubin bez czerni. Warto go brać jako centralny przedmiot drogiego setu, a nie jako „kolejny czerwony nóż”. Więcej o opcjach — na stronie [czerwonych noży](/pl/czerwone-skiny-cs2/).

title: Оранжево-белый инвентарь CS2: три сета Asiimov от 8 000 до 75 000 ₽
desc: Оранжево-белый инвентарь в CS2 вокруг семейства Asiimov: три готовых сета от 8 000 до 75 000 ₽, нож Slaughter, перчатки Overtake и ловушки гаммы.
lead: Оранжево-белая гамма в CS2 почти целиком держится на семействе Asiimov. Собрали три сета — от бюджетного до полного с ножом и перчатками — и разобрали, что ломает цвет.
md:
Оранжевый с белым — одна из немногих гамм в CS2, у которой есть «родоначальник». Почти любой оранжево-белый инвентарь строится вокруг семейства Asiimov: белый корпус, оранжевые вставки, чёрные технические детали. Хорошая новость в том, что вокруг Asiimov уже выросла целая экосистема похожих скинов от других художников, поэтому сет можно собрать хоть за несколько тысяч рублей, хоть за сотню тысяч.

Ниже — три готовых сета под разные бюджеты, разбор того, какие предметы действительно держат цвет, а какие только кажутся оранжевыми на превью маркета.

## Что делает инвентарь оранжево-белым

Главное правило этой гаммы: **белого должно быть больше, чем оранжевого**. Оранжевый работает как акцент — полоса на ствольной коробке, маркировка, край прицела. Если перевернуть пропорцию, инвентарь уезжает в «огненную» тему с Howl и Blaze, а это уже совсем другой сет.

Опорные скины гаммы:

- **Asiimov** — эталон. AK-47 | Asiimov стоит [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"], AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. У AWP и M4A4 нет ни Factory New, ни Minimal Wear: самый чистый вариант — Field-Tested, и это нормально, белый там ещё ровный.
- **Mecha Industries** — та же логика «белый пластик + оранжевая разметка», только дешевле: Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries за [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Mecha Industries — [price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"].
- **Cyrex и Decimator** — бело-оранжевые с красным оттенком, закрывают слоты USP-S и M4A1-S за копейки: USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Serum** — по цвету самое точное попадание из всех пистолетов в гамме, почти идеальный оранжевый: [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;M4A4 | Asiimov;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Serum"]

С ножами и перчатками сложнее. Чисто оранжево-белых ножей в игре нет вообще, поэтому ближайший вариант — **Slaughter**: светлый металл с красно-оранжевыми разводами. С перчатками выручают Driver Gloves | Overtake и Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh.

## Сет до 8 000 ₽

Задача бюджетного сета — получить узнаваемый «Asiimov-look» на основном оружии и не переплачивать за пистолеты. AK-47 | Asiimov здесь обязателен: это самый дешёвый скин семейства и при этом тот, который ты видишь в руках чаще всего.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Mortis — [price name="AWP | Mortis" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]

Итого ≈ 7 400 ₽. AWP | Mortis — компромисс: он больше рыже-коричневый, чем белый, зато стоит как пачка жвачки и не выбивается из тона. Если готов добавить пару тысяч, поменяй Glock на Glock-18 | Bullet Queen ([price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]) — у него оранжевый ярче.

## Сет до 35 000 ₽

Средний бюджет — это полная «тройка Asiimov»: AK, M4A4 и AWP в одном стиле, плюс перчатки. Именно в этой точке инвентарь начинает выглядеть собранным, а не случайным.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen — [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Overtake — [price name="Driver Gloves | Overtake" wear="FT"]

Итого ≈ 34 100 ₽. Overtake — лучшая по совпадению цвета пара перчаток в гамме и при этом одна из самых дешёвых: белая кожа с оранжевыми гоночными полосами. В Field-Tested они ещё светлые, а вот за Minimal Wear просят больше вдвое без заметной разницы на экране.

Почему M4A4, а не M4A1-S? Если ты играешь с глушителем, логичная замена — M4A1-S | Mecha Industries ([price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]): он дешевле и по цвету почти не уступает. Но тогда теряется главный эффект сета — три основные винтовки одной серии, которые узнаются с первого взгляда. Для тех, кто часто переключается между M4, разумный вариант держать обе: Asiimov на M4A4 и Mecha Industries на M4A1-S, сет от этого не развалится.

Ещё один момент — флоат. У Asiimov в Field-Tested разброс внешнего вида огромный: экземпляр с флоатом около 0.18 почти чистый, а ближе к 0.37 на белом корпусе уже заметны потёртости. Разница в цене между ними небольшая, поэтому при покупке стоит смотреть на конкретный флоат, а не только на категорию износа.

[skins names="M4A4 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;Glock-18 | Bullet Queen;Driver Gloves | Overtake"]

## Сет с ножом и перчатками до 75 000 ₽

Для полного сета берём ту же тройку Asiimov, меняем USP-S на Serum и добавляем нож с перчатками посолиднее.

- AK-47 | Asiimov, M4A4 | Asiimov, AWP | Asiimov — как в среднем сете

Итого ≈ 73 100 ₽. Bayonet выбран за длинный клинок: Slaughter на нём читается крупными пятнами, а на маленьких ножах узор дробится. Если хочется сэкономить, Navaja Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) или Gut Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Gut Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) дают тот же рисунок в разы дешевле. Scarlet Shamagh красноватее Overtake, но вместе со Slaughter они образуют одну тёплую пару.

Суммы посчитаны по ценам на 15 октября 2026 года; цены у отдельных предметов в тексте живые и обновляются каждый день.

## Чего избегать

- **Asiimov в Battle-Scarred.** Белое покрытие стирается до чёрного металла, и AWP превращается в чёрный «Blackiimov». Вещь культовая, но это уже не оранжево-белый скин. M4A4 | Asiimov в BS стоит заметно дешевле Field-Tested — именно из-за этого.
- **M4A4 | Howl** ([price name="M4A4 | Howl" wear="FT"]). На превью оранжевый, в игре — красно-рыжий волк на тёмном фоне. Это коллекционный предмет, а не элемент цветового сета, и стоит он как весь полный сет несколько раз.
- **Desert Eagle | Blaze** и **AWP | Wildfire** — огонь на чёрном. Оранжевого много, белого нет совсем, гамма ломается.
- **Printstream** (например, Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]). Чёрно-белый перламутр без капли оранжевого; рядом с Asiimov выглядит как вещь из чужого инвентаря.
- **Hand Wraps | Slaughter** — Field-Tested стоит [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"], в разы дороже Overtake, а на руке это просто розово-рыжие бинты без белого.

## Если хочется дороже

- **Butterfly Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. Тот же рисунок, но анимации бабочки делают его главным предметом инвентаря.
- **M4A1-S | Icarus Fell** — [price name="M4A1-S | Icarus Fell"]. Белый с золотисто-оранжевым небом, самый «светлый» скин на M4A1-S.
- **Moto Gloves | Boom!** — [price name="Moto Gloves | Boom!" wear="FT"]. Комиксовые бело-оранжевые перчатки; в Field-Tested стоят дорого, но ничего ярче в этой гамме нет.
- **Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱" wear="FT"]. Версия с иероглифом 壱 и оранжевым закатом — для тех, кто собирает не только цвет, но и историю.

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter;M4A1-S | Icarus Fell;Moto Gloves | Boom!;Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱"]

## Совет напоследок

Начинай с AK-47 | Asiimov — он задаёт тон всему остальному, и под него легко добирать пистолеты по одному. Все оранжевые скины собраны на странице [оранжевых скинов CS2](/oranzhevye-skiny-cs2/), отдельно — [оранжевые ножи](/oranzhevye-nozhi-cs2/) и [оранжевые перчатки](/oranzhevye-perchatki-cs2/). Другие гаммы — в разделе [цветовые сеты скинов CS2](/cvetovye-sety-skinov-cs2/).

en.title: Orange and White CS2 Inventory: 3 Asiimov Loadouts from $90 to $830
en.desc: An orange and white CS2 inventory built on the Asiimov family: three loadouts from $90 to $830, a Slaughter knife, Overtake gloves and palette traps.
en.lead: The orange and white palette in CS2 rests almost entirely on the Asiimov family. We put together three loadouts — from budget to a full set with knife and gloves — and broke down what ruins the color.
en.md:
Orange and white is one of the few CS2 palettes with a founding father. Almost any orange and white inventory is built around the Asiimov family: white body, orange inserts, black technical details. The good news is that a whole ecosystem of similar skins from other artists has grown up around the Asiimov, so you can build a loadout for under a hundred dollars or for over a thousand.

Below are three ready-made loadouts for different budgets, plus a breakdown of which items actually hold the color and which only look orange in market previews.

## What makes an inventory orange and white

The main rule of this palette: **there should be more white than orange**. Orange works as an accent — a stripe on the receiver, markings, the edge of a scope. Flip the ratio and your inventory drifts into a "fire" theme with the Howl and Blaze, which is a different loadout entirely.

The palette's core skins:

- **Asiimov** — the benchmark. AK-47 | Asiimov costs [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"], AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. The AWP and M4A4 have neither Factory New nor Minimal Wear: the cleanest option is Field-Tested, and that's fine, the white is still even there.
- **Mecha Industries** — the same "white plastic + orange markings" idea, only cheaper: Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries for [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Mecha Industries — [price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"].
- **Cyrex and Decimator** — white-orange with a reddish tint, covering the USP-S and M4A1-S slots for pennies: USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Serum** — the most accurate color match among all pistols in the palette, an almost perfect orange: [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;M4A4 | Asiimov;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Serum"]

Knives and gloves are trickier. The game has no purely orange and white knives at all, so the closest option is **Slaughter**: light metal with red-orange swirls. For gloves, Driver Gloves | Overtake and Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh come to the rescue.

## Loadout under $90

The budget loadout's job is to get the recognizable "Asiimov look" on your main guns without overpaying for pistols. AK-47 | Asiimov is mandatory here: it's the cheapest skin in the family and also the one you see in your hands most often.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Mortis — [price name="AWP | Mortis" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $80. AWP | Mortis is a compromise: it's more rusty brown than white, but it costs as much as a pack of gum and doesn't break the tone. If you're willing to add around $20, swap the Glock for Glock-18 | Bullet Queen ([price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]) — its orange is brighter.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;AWP | Mortis;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

[cta color=6 budget=8000 text="Build an orange and white loadout for $90" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout under $390

A mid-range budget gets you the full "Asiimov trio": AK, M4A4 and AWP in one style, plus gloves. This is the point where the inventory starts looking put together rather than random.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen — [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Overtake — [price name="Driver Gloves | Overtake" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $380. Overtake is the best color-matched pair of gloves in the palette and also one of the cheapest: white leather with orange racing stripes. In Field-Tested they're still light, while Minimal Wear costs twice as much with no visible difference on screen.

Why the M4A4 and not the M4A1-S? If you play with the silencer, the logical swap is M4A1-S | Mecha Industries ([price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]): it's cheaper and almost as good color-wise. But then you lose the loadout's main effect — three main rifles from one series, recognizable at a glance. If you switch between M4s a lot, it's reasonable to keep both: Asiimov on the M4A4 and Mecha Industries on the M4A1-S — the loadout won't fall apart.

One more thing — float. Field-Tested Asiimovs vary hugely in appearance: a copy with a float around 0.18 is almost clean, while closer to 0.37 the scratches on the white body are already visible. The price gap between them is small, so when buying, check the specific float, not just the wear category.

[skins names="M4A4 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;Glock-18 | Bullet Queen;Driver Gloves | Overtake"]

[cta color=6 budget=35000 text="Build an Asiimov loadout with gloves for $390" btn="Open the builder"]

## Knife and gloves loadout under $830

For the full loadout we keep the same Asiimov trio, swap the USP-S for the Serum and add a knife plus a more serious pair of gloves.

- AK-47 | Asiimov, M4A4 | Asiimov, AWP | Asiimov — same as the mid-range loadout
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Serum — [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen — [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh — [price name="Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh" wear="FT"]
- Bayonet | Slaughter — [price name="Bayonet | Slaughter" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ $810. The Bayonet was chosen for its long blade: Slaughter reads as large patches on it, while on small knives the pattern gets broken up. If you want to save, Navaja Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) or Gut Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Gut Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) give you the same pattern for a fraction of the price. Scarlet Shamagh is redder than Overtake, but together with the Slaughter it makes one warm pairing.

[skins names="Bayonet | Slaughter;Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh;USP-S | Serum;Navaja Knife | Slaughter;Gut Knife | Slaughter"]

[cta color=6 budget=75000 text="Build an orange and white loadout with a knife for $830" btn="Open the builder"]

## The three loadouts side by side

| Budget | What's included | Total |
|---|---|---|
| under $90 | AK Asiimov, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP Mortis, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Neo-Noir | ≈ $80 |
| under $390 | Asiimov trio, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Bullet Queen, Driver Gloves Overtake | ≈ $380 |
| under $830 | Asiimov trio, USP-S Serum, Glock Bullet Queen, Sport Gloves Scarlet Shamagh, Bayonet Slaughter | ≈ $810 |

Totals are calculated from prices as of October 15, 2026; individual item prices in the text are live and updated every day.

## What to avoid

- **Asiimov in Battle-Scarred.** The white coating wears down to black metal and the AWP turns into the black "Blackiimov." It's a cult item, but it's no longer an orange and white skin. That's exactly why M4A4 | Asiimov in BS costs noticeably less than Field-Tested.
- **M4A4 | Howl** ([price name="M4A4 | Howl" wear="FT"]). Orange in the preview, but in-game it's a red-orange wolf on a dark background. It's a collector's item, not part of a color loadout, and it costs several times as much as the entire full loadout.
- **Desert Eagle | Blaze** and **AWP | Wildfire** — fire on black. Lots of orange, no white at all, and the palette breaks.
- **Printstream** (e.g. Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]). Black and white pearl without a drop of orange; next to the Asiimov it looks like something from someone else's inventory.
- **Hand Wraps | Slaughter** — Field-Tested costs [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"], many times more than Overtake, and on your hands it's just pinkish-orange wraps with no white.

## If you want to go bigger

- **Butterfly Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. The same pattern, but the butterfly animations make it the star of the inventory.
- **M4A1-S | Icarus Fell** — [price name="M4A1-S | Icarus Fell"]. White with a golden-orange sky, the "lightest" skin on the M4A1-S.
- **Moto Gloves | Boom!** — [price name="Moto Gloves | Boom!" wear="FT"]. Comic-style white and orange gloves; expensive in Field-Tested, but nothing in this palette is brighter.
- **Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱" wear="FT"]. The version with the 壱 character and an orange sunset — for those who collect not just color but history.

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter;M4A1-S | Icarus Fell;Moto Gloves | Boom!;Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱"]

## A parting tip

Start with the AK-47 | Asiimov — it sets the tone for everything else, and it's easy to add matching pistols one at a time. All orange skins are collected on the [orange CS2 skins](/en/orange-cs2-skins/) page, with separate pages for [orange knives](/en/orange-knives-cs2/) and [orange gloves](/en/orange-gloves-cs2/). Other palettes are in the [CS2 skin sets by color](/en/cs2-skin-sets-by-color/) section.

de.title: Orange CS2 Skins: 3 Asiimov-Inventar-Sets von 90 bis 830 €
de.desc: Orange-weißes CS2-Inventar rund um die Asiimov-Familie: drei Sets von 90 bis 830 €, Slaughter-Messer, Overtake-Handschuhe und die Fallen dieser Farbwelt.
de.lead: Die orange-weiße Farbwelt in CS2 hängt fast komplett an der Asiimov-Familie. Wir haben drei Sets zusammengestellt – vom Budget-Loadout bis zum kompletten Set mit Messer und Handschuhen – und zeigen, was die Farbe kaputt macht.
de.md:
Orange mit Weiß ist eine der wenigen Farbwelten in CS2 mit einem echten „Stammvater“. Fast jedes orange-weiße Inventar baut auf der Asiimov-Familie auf: weißer Body, orange Einsätze, schwarze Technikdetails. Die gute Nachricht: Rund um den Asiimov ist längst ein ganzes Ökosystem ähnlicher Skins anderer Künstler entstanden – das Set lässt sich also für ein paar Dutzend Euro genauso zusammenstellen wie für über 1.000 €.

Unten findest du drei fertige Sets für verschiedene Budgets und eine Analyse, welche Items die Farbe wirklich halten und welche nur in der Marktvorschau orange wirken.

## Was ein Inventar orange-weiß macht

Die wichtigste Regel dieser Farbwelt: **Weiß muss überwiegen, nicht Orange.** Orange ist der Akzent – ein Streifen am Gehäuse, eine Markierung, der Rand des Visiers. Drehst du das Verhältnis um, rutscht das Inventar ins „Feuer“-Thema mit Howl und Blaze, und das ist ein ganz anderes Set.

Die tragenden Skins der Farbwelt:

- **Asiimov** – die Referenz. AK-47 | Asiimov kostet [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"], AWP | Asiimov – [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], M4A4 | Asiimov – [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. AWP und M4A4 gibt es weder in Factory New noch in Minimal Wear: Die sauberste Variante ist Field-Tested, und das passt – das Weiß ist dort noch gleichmäßig.
- **Mecha Industries** – dieselbe Logik „weißes Plastik + orange Markierungen“, nur günstiger: Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries für [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Mecha Industries – [price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"].
- **Cyrex und Decimator** – weiß-orange mit Rotstich, decken die Slots für USP-S und M4A1-S für kleines Geld ab: USP-S | Cyrex – [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Decimator – [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Serum** – farblich der präziseste Treffer aller Pistolen in dieser Farbwelt, ein fast perfektes Orange: [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;M4A4 | Asiimov;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Serum"]

Bei Messern und Handschuhen wird es schwieriger. Rein orange-weiße Messer gibt es im Spiel überhaupt nicht, die nächstbeste Option ist **Slaughter**: helles Metall mit rot-orangen Schlieren. Bei den Handschuhen retten Driver Gloves | Overtake und Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh die Lage.

## Set bis 90 €

Ziel des Budget-Sets: den unverkennbaren „Asiimov-Look“ auf den Hauptwaffen zu bekommen, ohne für Pistolen zu viel zu zahlen. AK-47 | Asiimov ist hier Pflicht – der günstigste Skin der Familie und gleichzeitig der, den du am häufigsten in der Hand hast.

- AK-47 | Asiimov – [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator – [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Mortis – [price name="AWP | Mortis" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries – [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex – [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Neo-Noir – [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]

Gesamt ≈ 80 €. AWP | Mortis ist ein Kompromiss: eher rotbraun als weiß, kostet aber so viel wie eine Packung Kaugummi und fällt farblich nicht raus. Wenn du gut 20 € drauflegen kannst, tausch die Glock gegen Glock-18 | Bullet Queen ([price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]) – deren Orange ist kräftiger.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;AWP | Mortis;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

[cta color=6 budget=8000 text="Orange-weißes Set für 90 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set bis 390 €

Mittleres Budget heißt: das komplette „Asiimov-Trio“ – AK, M4A4 und AWP im selben Stil – plus Handschuhe. Genau ab diesem Punkt wirkt das Inventar durchdacht statt zufällig.

- AK-47 | Asiimov – [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Asiimov – [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Asiimov – [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries – [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex – [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen – [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Overtake – [price name="Driver Gloves | Overtake" wear="FT"]

Gesamt ≈ 380 €. Overtake sind farblich das beste Handschuhpaar dieser Farbwelt und gleichzeitig eines der günstigsten: weißes Leder mit orangen Rennstreifen. In Field-Tested sind sie noch hell, für Minimal Wear wird dagegen mehr als das Doppelte verlangt – ohne sichtbaren Unterschied auf dem Bildschirm.

Warum M4A4 und nicht M4A1-S? Wenn du mit Schalldämpfer spielst, ist M4A1-S | Mecha Industries ([price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]) der logische Ersatz: günstiger und farblich kaum schlechter. Dann geht aber der Haupteffekt des Sets verloren – drei Hauptgewehre aus einer Serie, die man auf den ersten Blick erkennt. Wer oft zwischen den M4 wechselt, kann vernünftigerweise beide behalten: Asiimov auf der M4A4 und Mecha Industries auf der M4A1-S – das Set fällt dadurch nicht auseinander.

Noch ein Punkt: der Float. Beim Asiimov in Field-Tested ist die optische Spanne riesig: Ein Exemplar mit Float um 0.18 ist fast sauber, Richtung 0.37 sieht man auf dem weißen Body schon deutliche Abnutzung. Der Preisunterschied ist gering – schau beim Kauf also auf den konkreten Float, nicht nur auf die Wear-Kategorie.

[skins names="M4A4 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;Glock-18 | Bullet Queen;Driver Gloves | Overtake"]

[cta color=6 budget=35000 text="Asiimov-Set mit Handschuhen für 390 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set mit Messer und Handschuhen bis 830 €

Für das komplette Set nehmen wir dasselbe Asiimov-Trio, tauschen die USP-S gegen Serum und packen ein Messer und hochwertigere Handschuhe dazu.

- AK-47 | Asiimov, M4A4 | Asiimov, AWP | Asiimov – wie im mittleren Set
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries – [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Serum – [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen – [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh – [price name="Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh" wear="FT"]
- Bayonet | Slaughter – [price name="Bayonet | Slaughter" wear="FT"]

Gesamt ≈ 810 €. Das Bayonet ist wegen der langen Klinge gewählt: Slaughter zeigt sich darauf in großen Flecken, auf kleinen Messern zerfällt das Muster. Zum Sparen liefern Navaja Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) oder Gut Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Gut Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) dasselbe Muster zu einem Bruchteil des Preises. Scarlet Shamagh ist rötlicher als Overtake, bildet mit Slaughter aber ein stimmiges warmes Duo.

[skins names="Bayonet | Slaughter;Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh;USP-S | Serum;Navaja Knife | Slaughter;Gut Knife | Slaughter"]

[cta color=6 budget=75000 text="Orange-weißes Set mit Messer für 830 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Die drei Sets nebeneinander

| Budget | Inhalt | Gesamt |
|---|---|---|
| bis 90 € | AK Asiimov, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP Mortis, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Neo-Noir | ≈ 80 € |
| bis 390 € | Asiimov-Trio, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Bullet Queen, Driver Gloves Overtake | ≈ 380 € |
| bis 830 € | Asiimov-Trio, USP-S Serum, Glock Bullet Queen, Sport Gloves Scarlet Shamagh, Bayonet Slaughter | ≈ 810 € |

Die Summen basieren auf den Preisen vom 15. Oktober 2026; die Preise der einzelnen Items im Text sind live und werden täglich aktualisiert.

## Was du vermeiden solltest

- **Asiimov in Battle-Scarred.** Die weiße Beschichtung reibt sich bis aufs schwarze Metall ab, und die AWP wird zum schwarzen „Blackiimov“. Kult, aber eben kein orange-weißer Skin mehr. Genau deshalb kostet M4A4 | Asiimov in BS deutlich weniger als in Field-Tested.
- **M4A4 | Howl** ([price name="M4A4 | Howl" wear="FT"]). In der Vorschau orange, im Spiel ein rot-oranger Wolf auf dunklem Grund. Ein Sammlerstück, kein Baustein für ein Farb-Set – und er kostet ein Mehrfaches des kompletten Sets.
- **Desert Eagle | Blaze** und **AWP | Wildfire** – Feuer auf Schwarz. Viel Orange, aber null Weiß – die Farbwelt bricht.
- **Printstream** (zum Beispiel Desert Eagle | Printstream – [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]). Schwarz-weißes Perlmutt ohne einen Hauch Orange; neben Asiimov wirkt er wie aus einem fremden Inventar.
- **Hand Wraps | Slaughter** – Field-Tested kostet [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"], ein Vielfaches von Overtake, und an der Hand sind es einfach rosa-orange Bandagen ohne Weiß.

## Wenn es teurer sein darf

- **Butterfly Knife | Slaughter** – [price name="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. Dasselbe Muster, aber die Butterfly-Animationen machen es zum Highlight des Inventars.
- **M4A1-S | Icarus Fell** – [price name="M4A1-S | Icarus Fell"]. Weiß mit gold-orangem Himmel, der „hellste“ Skin für die M4A1-S.
- **Moto Gloves | Boom!** – [price name="Moto Gloves | Boom!" wear="FT"]. Comic-Handschuhe in Weiß-Orange; in Field-Tested teuer, aber knalliger wird es in dieser Farbwelt nicht.
- **Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱** – [price name="Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱" wear="FT"]. Die Version mit dem Schriftzeichen 壱 und orangem Sonnenuntergang – für alle, die nicht nur Farbe, sondern auch Geschichte sammeln.

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter;M4A1-S | Icarus Fell;Moto Gloves | Boom!;Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱"]

## Ein letzter Tipp

Fang mit AK-47 | Asiimov an – sie gibt den Ton für alles andere vor, und die Pistolen kannst du danach einzeln ergänzen. Alle orangen Skins inklusive Messern und Handschuhen findest du auf der Seite mit [orangen CS2 Skins](/de/orange-cs2-skins/). Andere Farbwelten gibt es im Bereich [Farb-Sets für CS2-Skins](/de/).

pt.title: Inventário laranja e branco CS2: 3 sets Asiimov de R$ 490 a R$ 4.600
pt.desc: Inventário laranja e branco no CS2 em torno da família Asiimov: três sets prontos de R$ 490 a R$ 4.600, faca Slaughter, luvas Overtake e armadilhas.
pt.lead: A paleta laranja e branca do CS2 se apoia quase toda na família Asiimov. Montamos três sets — do econômico ao completo com faca e luvas — e mostramos o que estraga a cor.
pt.md:
Laranja com branco é uma das poucas paletas do CS2 que tem um "patriarca". Quase todo inventário laranja e branco é montado em volta da família Asiimov: corpo branco, detalhes laranja, peças técnicas pretas. A boa notícia é que em torno da Asiimov já cresceu todo um ecossistema de skins parecidas de outros artistas, então dá para montar o set tanto com umas poucas centenas de reais quanto com mais de R$ 6.000.

Abaixo, três sets prontos para orçamentos diferentes e uma análise de quais itens realmente seguram a cor e quais só parecem laranja na prévia do mercado.

## O que deixa um inventário laranja e branco

A regra principal dessa paleta: **tem que ter mais branco do que laranja**. O laranja funciona como detalhe — uma faixa no receptor, uma marcação, a borda da mira. Se você inverter a proporção, o inventário descamba para o tema "fogo", com Howl e Blaze, e aí já é outro set.

As skins-base da paleta:

- **Asiimov** — a referência. A AK-47 | Asiimov custa [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"], a AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], a M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. AWP e M4A4 não existem em Factory New nem Minimal Wear: a versão mais limpa é a Field-Tested, e tudo bem, o branco ainda fica uniforme.
- **Mecha Industries** — a mesma lógica "plástico branco + marcação laranja", só que mais barata: Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries por [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Mecha Industries — [price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"].
- **Cyrex e Decimator** — branco e laranja puxando para o vermelho, fecham os slots de USP-S e M4A1-S por uma mixaria: USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Serum** — o acerto de cor mais preciso entre todas as pistolas da paleta, um laranja quase perfeito: [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;M4A4 | Asiimov;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Serum"]

Com facas e luvas é mais complicado. Facas puramente laranja e brancas simplesmente não existem no jogo, então a opção mais próxima é a **Slaughter**: metal claro com manchas vermelho-alaranjadas. Nas luvas, quem salva são as Driver Gloves | Overtake e as Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh.

## Set até R$ 490

O objetivo do set econômico é ter o "visual Asiimov" reconhecível nas armas principais sem pagar caro nas pistolas. A AK-47 | Asiimov é obrigatória aqui: é a skin mais barata da família e, ao mesmo tempo, a que você mais vê na mão.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Mortis — [price name="AWP | Mortis" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ R$ 450. A AWP | Mortis é uma concessão: puxa mais para o ruivo-marrom do que para o branco, mas custa o preço de um chiclete e não destoa do tom. Se topar gastar uns R$ 120 a mais, troque a Glock pela Glock-18 | Bullet Queen ([price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]) — o laranja dela é mais vivo.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;AWP | Mortis;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

[cta color=6 budget=8000 text="Montar set laranja e branco por R$ 490" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set até R$ 2.100

O orçamento médio é o "trio Asiimov" completo: AK, M4A4 e AWP no mesmo estilo, mais luvas. É nesse ponto que o inventário começa a parecer montado de propósito, e não aleatório.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen — [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Overtake — [price name="Driver Gloves | Overtake" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ R$ 2.100. As Overtake são o par de luvas com melhor match de cor da paleta e, ao mesmo tempo, um dos mais baratos: couro branco com faixas de corrida laranja. Em Field-Tested ainda são claras, enquanto em Minimal Wear pedem mais que o dobro sem diferença visível na tela.

Por que M4A4 e não M4A1-S? Se você joga de silenciada, a troca lógica é a M4A1-S | Mecha Industries ([price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]): é mais barata e quase não perde na cor. Mas aí se perde o principal efeito do set — os três rifles principais da mesma coleção, reconhecíveis à primeira vista. Para quem alterna muito entre as M4, uma boa saída é ter as duas: Asiimov na M4A4 e Mecha Industries na M4A1-S, o set não desmorona por isso.

Mais um detalhe — o float. Na Asiimov Field-Tested a variação de aparência é enorme: um exemplar com float perto de 0.18 é quase limpo, enquanto perto de 0.37 já aparecem marcas de desgaste no corpo branco. A diferença de preço entre eles é pequena, então na hora de comprar vale olhar o float específico, não só a categoria de desgaste.

[skins names="M4A4 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;Glock-18 | Bullet Queen;Driver Gloves | Overtake"]

[cta color=6 budget=35000 text="Montar set Asiimov com luvas por R$ 2.100" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set com faca e luvas até R$ 4.600

No set completo, mantemos o mesmo trio Asiimov, trocamos a USP-S pela Serum e adicionamos faca e luvas mais parrudas.

- AK-47 | Asiimov, M4A4 | Asiimov, AWP | Asiimov — como no set médio
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Serum — [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen — [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh — [price name="Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh" wear="FT"]
- Bayonet | Slaughter — [price name="Bayonet | Slaughter" wear="FT"]

Total ≈ R$ 4.500. A Bayonet foi escolhida pela lâmina longa: nela a Slaughter aparece em manchas grandes, enquanto nas facas pequenas o padrão se fragmenta. Se quiser economizar, a Navaja Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) ou a Gut Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Gut Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) dão o mesmo desenho por várias vezes menos. As Scarlet Shamagh são mais avermelhadas que as Overtake, mas junto com a Slaughter formam uma dupla quente coerente.

[skins names="Bayonet | Slaughter;Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh;USP-S | Serum;Navaja Knife | Slaughter;Gut Knife | Slaughter"]

[cta color=6 budget=75000 text="Montar set laranja e branco com faca por R$ 4.600" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Os três sets lado a lado

| Orçamento | O que entra | Total |
|---|---|---|
| até R$ 490 | AK Asiimov, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP Mortis, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Neo-Noir | ≈ R$ 450 |
| até R$ 2.100 | Trio Asiimov, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Bullet Queen, Driver Gloves Overtake | ≈ R$ 2.100 |
| até R$ 4.600 | Trio Asiimov, USP-S Serum, Glock Bullet Queen, Sport Gloves Scarlet Shamagh, Bayonet Slaughter | ≈ R$ 4.500 |

Os valores foram calculados com os preços de 15 de outubro de 2026; os preços de cada item no texto são ao vivo e atualizados todos os dias.

## O que evitar

- **Asiimov em Battle-Scarred.** A pintura branca se desgasta até o metal preto, e a AWP vira a "Blackiimov" preta. É um item cult, mas já não é uma skin laranja e branca. A M4A4 | Asiimov em BS é bem mais barata que a Field-Tested justamente por isso.
- **M4A4 | Howl** ([price name="M4A4 | Howl" wear="FT"]). Na prévia é laranja; no jogo, é um lobo vermelho-alaranjado sobre fundo escuro. É item de colecionador, não peça de set de cor, e custa várias vezes o set completo inteiro.
- **Desert Eagle | Blaze** e **AWP | Wildfire** — fogo sobre preto. Muito laranja, nada de branco, a paleta quebra.
- **Printstream** (por exemplo, Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]). Perolado preto e branco sem uma gota de laranja; ao lado da Asiimov parece item de outro inventário.
- **Hand Wraps | Slaughter** — a Field-Tested custa [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"], várias vezes mais que as Overtake, e na mão são só faixas rosa-alaranjadas sem branco.

## Se quiser gastar mais

- **Butterfly Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. O mesmo desenho, mas as animações da butterfly fazem dela o item principal do inventário.
- **M4A1-S | Icarus Fell** — [price name="M4A1-S | Icarus Fell"]. Branca com céu dourado-alaranjado, a skin mais "clara" da M4A1-S.
- **Moto Gloves | Boom!** — [price name="Moto Gloves | Boom!" wear="FT"]. Luvas branco e laranja estilo HQ; em Field-Tested são caras, mas não há nada mais vibrante nessa paleta.
- **Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱" wear="FT"]. A versão com o ideograma 壱 e o pôr do sol laranja — para quem coleciona não só cor, mas também história.

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter;M4A1-S | Icarus Fell;Moto Gloves | Boom!;Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱"]

## Dica final

Comece pela AK-47 | Asiimov — ela dá o tom de todo o resto, e fica fácil completar as pistolas uma por uma em volta dela. Todas as skins, facas e luvas laranjas estão reunidas na página de [skins laranjas do CS2](/pt/skins-laranjas-cs2/). Outras paletas ficam na seção de [sets de skins por cor do CS2](/pt/).

tr.title: Turuncu-beyaz CS2 envanteri: $90–$830 arası üç Asiimov skin seti
tr.desc: CS2'de Asiimov ailesi etrafında turuncu-beyaz envanter: $90–$830 arası üç hazır set, Slaughter bıçak, Overtake eldiven ve renk tuzakları.
tr.lead: CS2'de turuncu-beyaz neredeyse tamamen Asiimov ailesine dayanıyor. Bütçe setinden bıçak ve eldivenli tam takıma üç set kurduk ve rengi neyin bozduğunu inceledik.
tr.md:
Turuncu-beyaz, CS2'de bir "kurucu atası" olan az sayıdaki renk grubundan biri. Neredeyse her turuncu-beyaz envanter Asiimov ailesi etrafında kurulur: beyaz gövde, turuncu ekler, siyah teknik detaylar. İyi haber şu ki Asiimov'un çevresinde başka sanatçıların benzer skinlerinden koca bir ekosistem oluştu; yani seti birkaç on dolara da, bin dolardan fazlasına da kurabilirsin.

Aşağıda farklı bütçelere üç hazır set ve hangi eşyaların rengi gerçekten taşıdığını, hangilerinin yalnızca market önizlemesinde turuncu göründüğünü anlatan bir inceleme var.

## Envanteri turuncu-beyaz yapan ne

Bu renk grubunun ana kuralı: **beyaz, turuncudan fazla olmalı**. Turuncu bir vurgu olarak çalışır — gövdedeki şerit, işaretler, dürbünün kenarı. Oranı tersine çevirirsen envanter Howl ve Blaze'li "ateş" temasına kayar, o da bambaşka bir set.

Renk grubunun temel skinleri:

- **Asiimov** — referans. AK-47 | Asiimov [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"], AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. AWP ve M4A4'ün ne Factory New'u ne Minimal Wear'ı var: en temiz seçenek Field-Tested ve bu sorun değil, beyaz orada hâlâ düzgün.
- **Mecha Industries** — aynı "beyaz plastik + turuncu işaretler" mantığı, sadece daha ucuz: Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Mecha Industries — [price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"].
- **Cyrex ve Decimator** — kırmızı tonlu beyaz-turuncu; USP-S ve M4A1-S slotlarını kuruşa kapatıyor: USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Serum** — renk grubundaki tüm tabancalar arasında en isabetlisi, neredeyse kusursuz turuncu: [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;M4A4 | Asiimov;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Serum"]

Bıçak ve eldivende iş daha zor. Oyunda saf turuncu-beyaz bıçak hiç yok, bu yüzden en yakın seçenek **Slaughter**: kırmızı-turuncu lekeli açık renkli metal. Eldivende ise Driver Gloves | Overtake ve Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh kurtarıyor.

## $90'a kadar set

Bütçe setinin amacı ana silahlarda tanınır bir "Asiimov görünümü" yakalamak ve tabancalara fazla para vermemek. AK-47 | Asiimov burada şart: ailenin en ucuz skini ve elinde en sık gördüğün silah.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Mortis — [price name="AWP | Mortis" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]

Toplam ≈ $80. AWP | Mortis bir taviz: beyazdan çok kızıl-kahverengi, ama bir paket sakız fiyatına ve tondan kopmuyor. Yaklaşık $20 eklemeye hazırsan Glock'u Glock-18 | Bullet Queen ([price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]) ile değiştir — turuncusu daha parlak.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;AWP | Mortis;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

[cta color=6 budget=8000 text="Turuncu-beyaz seti $90'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## $390'a kadar set

Orta bütçe tam "Asiimov üçlüsü" demek: aynı stilde AK, M4A4 ve AWP, artı eldiven. Envanter tam bu noktada rastgele değil, derli toplu görünmeye başlıyor.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen — [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Overtake — [price name="Driver Gloves | Overtake" wear="FT"]

Toplam ≈ $380. Overtake, renk grubunda renk eşleşmesi en iyi eldiven ve aynı zamanda en ucuzlarından: turuncu yarış şeritli beyaz deri. Field-Tested'da hâlâ açık renkli; Minimal Wear için ise ekranda belirgin bir fark olmadan iki katından fazlası isteniyor.

Neden M4A1-S değil de M4A4? Susturucuyla oynuyorsan mantıklı alternatif M4A1-S | Mecha Industries ([price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]): daha ucuz ve renkte neredeyse geri kalmıyor. Ama o zaman setin asıl etkisi kayboluyor — ilk bakışta tanınan, aynı seriden üç ana tüfek. M4'ler arasında sık geçiş yapanlar için makul seçenek ikisini de tutmak: M4A4'te Asiimov, M4A1-S'te Mecha Industries; set bundan dağılmaz.

Bir nokta daha — float. Field-Tested Asiimov'da görünüm aralığı çok geniş: 0.18 civarı float'lı bir eşya neredeyse temiz, 0.37'ye yaklaştıkça beyaz gövdede aşınmalar belirginleşiyor. Aralarındaki fiyat farkı küçük, bu yüzden alırken sadece aşınma kategorisine değil, somut float'a da bakmaya değer.

[skins names="M4A4 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;Glock-18 | Bullet Queen;Driver Gloves | Overtake"]

[cta color=6 budget=35000 text="Eldivenli Asiimov setini $390'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Bıçak ve eldivenli set, $830'a kadar

Tam set için aynı Asiimov üçlüsünü alıyoruz, USP-S'i Serum ile değiştiriyor ve daha iddialı bir bıçak ile eldiven ekliyoruz.

- AK-47 | Asiimov, M4A4 | Asiimov, AWP | Asiimov — orta setteki gibi
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Serum — [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen — [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh — [price name="Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh" wear="FT"]
- Bayonet | Slaughter — [price name="Bayonet | Slaughter" wear="FT"]

Toplam ≈ $810. Bayonet uzun bıçak ağzı için seçildi: Slaughter onda iri lekeler halinde okunuyor, küçük bıçaklarda ise desen parçalanıyor. Tasarruf istersen Navaja Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) ya da Gut Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Gut Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) aynı deseni kat kat ucuza veriyor. Scarlet Shamagh, Overtake'ten daha kırmızımsı, ama Slaughter ile birlikte sıcak bir ikili oluşturuyorlar.

[skins names="Bayonet | Slaughter;Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh;USP-S | Serum;Navaja Knife | Slaughter;Gut Knife | Slaughter"]

[cta color=6 budget=75000 text="Bıçaklı turuncu-beyaz seti $830'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Üç set yan yana

| Bütçe | İçerik | Toplam |

| $90'a kadar | AK Asiimov, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP Mortis, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Neo-Noir | ≈ $80 |
| $390'a kadar | Asiimov üçlüsü, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Bullet Queen, Driver Gloves Overtake | ≈ $380 |

Tutarlar 15 Ekim 2026 fiyatlarıyla hesaplandı; metindeki tek tek eşyaların fiyatları canlı ve her gün güncelleniyor.

## Nelerden kaçınmalı

- **Battle-Scarred Asiimov.** Beyaz kaplama siyah metale kadar silinir ve AWP siyah bir "Blackiimov"a dönüşür. Kült bir eşya, ama artık turuncu-beyaz bir skin değil. M4A4 | Asiimov'un BS'si Field-Tested'dan belirgin şekilde ucuz — tam da bu yüzden.
- **M4A4 | Howl** ([price name="M4A4 | Howl" wear="FT"]). Önizlemede turuncu, oyunda koyu zemin üzerinde kızıl-kırmızı bir kurt. Bu bir renk setinin parçası değil koleksiyon eşyası ve fiyatı tam setin birkaç katı.
- **Desert Eagle | Blaze** ve **AWP | Wildfire** — siyah üstünde ateş. Turuncu bol, beyaz hiç yok; renk grubu bozuluyor.
- **Printstream** (örneğin Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]). Bir damla turuncusu olmayan siyah-beyaz sedef; Asiimov'un yanında başkasının envanterinden gelmiş gibi duruyor.
- **Hand Wraps | Slaughter** — Field-Tested [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"], Overtake'ten kat kat pahalı, elde ise beyazsız pembe-kızıl sargılardan ibaret.

## Bütçen daha yüksekse

- **Butterfly Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. Aynı desen, ama kelebek animasyonları onu envanterin baş eşyası yapıyor.
- **M4A1-S | Icarus Fell** — [price name="M4A1-S | Icarus Fell"]. Altın-turuncu gökyüzüyle beyaz; M4A1-S'teki en "açık" skin.
- **Moto Gloves | Boom!** — [price name="Moto Gloves | Boom!" wear="FT"]. Çizgi roman tarzı beyaz-turuncu eldiven; Field-Tested'da pahalı ama bu renk grubunda daha parlağı yok.
- **Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱" wear="FT"]. 壱 karakterli, turuncu gün batımlı versiyon — sadece renk değil hikâye de toplayanlar için.

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter;M4A1-S | Icarus Fell;Moto Gloves | Boom!;Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱"]

## Son bir tavsiye

AK-47 | Asiimov ile başla — geri kalan her şeyin tonunu o belirliyor ve tabancaları ona göre teker teker eklemek kolay. Bıçaklar ve eldivenler dahil tüm turuncu skinler [turuncu CS2 skinleri](/tr/turuncu-cs2-skinleri/) sayfasında. Diğer renkler [CS2 renk setleri](/tr/) bölümünde.

pl.title: Pomarańczowo-biały ekwipunek CS2: 3 sety Asiimov od 360 do 3 300 zł
pl.desc: Pomarańczowo-biały ekwipunek w CS2 wokół rodziny Asiimov: trzy gotowe sety od 360 do 3 300 zł, nóż Slaughter, rękawice Overtake i pułapki palety.
pl.lead: Pomarańczowo-biała paleta w CS2 niemal w całości stoi na rodzinie Asiimov. Złożyliśmy trzy sety — od budżetowego po pełny z nożem i rękawicami — i sprawdziliśmy, co psuje kolor.
pl.md:
Pomarańcz z bielą to jedna z niewielu palet w CS2, które mają swojego „protoplastę”. Prawie każdy pomarańczowo-biały ekwipunek buduje się wokół rodziny Asiimov: biały korpus, pomarańczowe wstawki, czarne techniczne detale. Dobra wiadomość jest taka, że wokół Asiimova wyrósł już cały ekosystem podobnych skinów od innych artystów, więc set złożysz zarówno za kilkaset złotych, jak i za kilka tysięcy.

Poniżej trzy gotowe sety na różne budżety oraz rozbiórka tego, które przedmioty naprawdę trzymają kolor, a które tylko wydają się pomarańczowe na podglądzie z marketu.

## Co sprawia, że ekwipunek jest pomarańczowo-biały

Główna zasada tej palety: **bieli musi być więcej niż pomarańczu**. Pomarańcz działa jako akcent — pasek na komorze zamkowej, oznaczenia, krawędź celownika. Jeśli odwrócisz proporcje, ekwipunek odjeżdża w „ognisty” motyw z Howl i Blaze, a to już zupełnie inny set.

Skiny-filary tej palety:

- **Asiimov** — wzorzec. AK-47 | Asiimov kosztuje [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"], AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"], M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]. AWP i M4A4 nie mają ani Factory New, ani Minimal Wear: najczystsza wersja to Field-Tested, i to w porządku, biel jest tam jeszcze równa.
- **Mecha Industries** — ta sama logika „biały plastik + pomarańczowe oznaczenia”, tylko taniej: Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries za [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Mecha Industries — [price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"].
- **Cyrex i Decimator** — biało-pomarańczowe z czerwonym odcieniem, za grosze zamykają sloty USP-S i M4A1-S: USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"], M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Serum** — kolorystycznie najcelniejsze trafienie spośród wszystkich pistoletów w palecie, niemal idealny pomarańcz: [price name="USP-S | Serum" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;M4A4 | Asiimov;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Serum"]

Z nożami i rękawicami jest trudniej. Czysto pomarańczowo-białych noży w grze nie ma wcale, więc najbliższa opcja to **Slaughter**: jasny metal z czerwono-pomarańczowymi smugami. W rękawicach ratują Driver Gloves | Overtake i Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh.

## Set do 360 zł

Zadanie budżetowego setu to uzyskać rozpoznawalny „Asiimov-look” na głównej broni i nie przepłacać za pistolety. AK-47 | Asiimov jest tu obowiązkowy: to najtańszy skin z rodziny, a zarazem ten, który najczęściej widzisz w dłoniach.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A1-S | Decimator — [price name="M4A1-S | Decimator" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Mortis — [price name="AWP | Mortis" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Neo-Noir — [price name="Glock-18 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"]

Razem ≈ 330 zł. AWP | Mortis to kompromis: jest bardziej rudo-brązowy niż biały, ale kosztuje tyle co paczka gumy i nie wybija się z tonu. Jeśli możesz dorzucić jakieś 90 zł, zamień Glocka na Glock-18 | Bullet Queen ([price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]) — ma jaśniejszy pomarańcz.

[skins names="AK-47 | Asiimov;M4A1-S | Decimator;AWP | Mortis;Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries;USP-S | Cyrex;Glock-18 | Neo-Noir"]

[cta color=6 budget=8000 text="Złóż pomarańczowo-biały set za 360 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Set do 1 600 zł

Średni budżet to pełna „trójka Asiimov”: AK, M4A4 i AWP w jednym stylu, plus rękawice. Właśnie w tym punkcie ekwipunek zaczyna wyglądać na przemyślany, a nie przypadkowy.

- AK-47 | Asiimov — [price name="AK-47 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- M4A4 | Asiimov — [price name="M4A4 | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- AWP | Asiimov — [price name="AWP | Asiimov" wear="FT"]
- Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries — [price name="Desert Eagle | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]
- USP-S | Cyrex — [price name="USP-S | Cyrex" wear="FT"]
- Glock-18 | Bullet Queen — [price name="Glock-18 | Bullet Queen" wear="FT"]
- Driver Gloves | Overtake — [price name="Driver Gloves | Overtake" wear="FT"]

Razem ≈ 1 500 zł. Overtake to najlepiej dopasowana kolorystycznie para rękawic w palecie, a przy tym jedna z najtańszych: biała skóra z pomarańczowymi wyścigowymi pasami. W Field-Tested są jeszcze jasne, a za Minimal Wear chcą ponad dwa razy więcej bez widocznej różnicy na ekranie.

Dlaczego M4A4, a nie M4A1-S? Jeśli grasz z tłumikiem, logiczna zamiana to M4A1-S | Mecha Industries ([price name="M4A1-S | Mecha Industries" wear="FT"]): jest tańszy i kolorystycznie prawie nie ustępuje. Ale wtedy traci się główny efekt setu — trzy podstawowe karabiny z jednej serii, rozpoznawalne od pierwszego rzutu oka. Dla tych, którzy często przełączają się między M4, rozsądnie jest trzymać obie: Asiimov na M4A4 i Mecha Industries na M4A1-S, set się od tego nie rozsypie.

Jeszcze jedna sprawa — float. Asiimov w Field-Tested ma ogromny rozrzut wyglądu: egzemplarz z floatem około 0.18 jest prawie czysty, a bliżej 0.37 na białym korpusie widać już przetarcia. Różnica w cenie między nimi jest niewielka, więc przy zakupie warto patrzeć na konkretny float, a nie tylko na kategorię wearu.

[skins names="M4A4 | Asiimov;AWP | Asiimov;Glock-18 | Bullet Queen;Driver Gloves | Overtake"]

[cta color=6 budget=35000 text="Złóż set Asiimov z rękawicami za 1 600 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Set z nożem i rękawicami do 3 300 zł

Do pełnego setu bierzemy tę samą trójkę Asiimov, zamieniamy USP-S na Serum i dokładamy nóż oraz poważniejsze rękawice.

- AK-47 | Asiimov, M4A4 | Asiimov, AWP | Asiimov — jak w średnim secie
