Razem ≈ 3 200 zł. Bayonet wybraliśmy za długie ostrze: Slaughter jest na nim czytelny w dużych plamach, a na małych nożach wzór się rozdrabnia. Jeśli chcesz zaoszczędzić, Navaja Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Navaja Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) lub Gut Knife | Slaughter ([price name="Gut Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]) dają ten sam wzór kilka razy taniej. Scarlet Shamagh jest bardziej czerwonawy niż Overtake, ale razem ze Slaughter tworzy jedną ciepłą parę.

[skins names="Bayonet | Slaughter;Sport Gloves | Scarlet Shamagh;USP-S | Serum;Navaja Knife | Slaughter;Gut Knife | Slaughter"]

[cta color=6 budget=75000 text="Złóż pomarańczowo-biały set z nożem za 3 300 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Trzy sety obok siebie

| Budżet | Co wchodzi | Razem |
|---|---|---|
| do 360 zł | AK Asiimov, M4A1-S Decimator, AWP Mortis, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Neo-Noir | ≈ 330 zł |
| do 1 600 zł | Trójka Asiimov, Deagle Mecha Industries, USP-S Cyrex, Glock Bullet Queen, Driver Gloves Overtake | ≈ 1 500 zł |
| do 3 300 zł | Trójka Asiimov, USP-S Serum, Glock Bullet Queen, Sport Gloves Scarlet Shamagh, Bayonet Slaughter | ≈ 3 200 zł |

Sumy policzone według cen z 15 października 2026 roku; ceny poszczególnych przedmiotów w tekście są aktualne i odświeżają się codziennie.

## Czego unikać

- **Asiimov w Battle-Scarred.** Biała powłoka ściera się do czarnego metalu, a AWP zamienia się w czarnego „Blackiimova”. Rzecz kultowa, ale to już nie jest pomarańczowo-biały skin. M4A4 | Asiimov w BS kosztuje wyraźnie mniej niż Field-Tested — właśnie z tego powodu.
- **M4A4 | Howl** ([price name="M4A4 | Howl" wear="FT"]). Na podglądzie pomarańczowy, w grze — czerwono-rudy wilk na ciemnym tle. To przedmiot kolekcjonerski, a nie element setu kolorystycznego, i kosztuje tyle co kilka pełnych setów.
- **Desert Eagle | Blaze** i **AWP | Wildfire** — ogień na czarnym. Pomarańczu dużo, bieli wcale, paleta się sypie.
- **Printstream** (np. Desert Eagle | Printstream — [price name="Desert Eagle | Printstream" wear="FT"]). Czarno-biała perła bez grama pomarańczu; obok Asiimova wygląda jak rzecz z cudzego ekwipunku.
- **Hand Wraps | Slaughter** — Field-Tested kosztuje [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"], kilka razy drożej niż Overtake, a na dłoni to po prostu różowo-rude bandaże bez bieli.

## Jeśli chcesz drożej

- **Butterfly Knife | Slaughter** — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter" wear="FT"]. Ten sam wzór, ale animacje motylka robią z niego główny przedmiot ekwipunku.
- **M4A1-S | Icarus Fell** — [price name="M4A1-S | Icarus Fell"]. Biały ze złocisto-pomarańczowym niebem, najbardziej „jasny” skin na M4A1-S.
- **Moto Gloves | Boom!** — [price name="Moto Gloves | Boom!" wear="FT"]. Komiksowe biało-pomarańczowe rękawice; w Field-Tested są drogie, ale nic jaskrawszego w tej palecie nie ma.
- **Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱" wear="FT"]. Wersja ze znakiem 壱 i pomarańczowym zachodem słońca — dla tych, którzy kolekcjonują nie tylko kolor, ale i historię.

[skins names="Butterfly Knife | Slaughter;M4A1-S | Icarus Fell;Moto Gloves | Boom!;Desert Eagle | Sunset Storm 壱"]

## Rada na koniec

Zacznij od AK-47 | Asiimov — nadaje ton całej reszcie, a pistolety łatwo dobierać pod niego po jednym. Wszystkie pomarańczowe skiny, noże i rękawice zebraliśmy na stronie [pomarańczowych skinów CS2](/pl/pomaranczowe-skiny-cs2/). Inne palety — w dziale [kolorowe sety skinów CS2](/pl/).

title: Розовый инвентарь CS2: готовые сеты за 7 000, 18 000 и 65 000 ₽
desc: Розовый инвентарь CS2 на три бюджета: неоновые пушки, сет с Overprint и Flip Doppler Phase 2 с Vice. Какие перчатки реально розовые и чего избегать.
lead: Розовых пушек в CS2 много и они дешёвые, а вот перчаток всего три пары. Собрали три сета от реальных вариантов и разобрали ловушки гаммы.
md:
Розовый инвентарь в CS2 собирают ради одного эффекта: когда весь экран в одной кислотно-розовой гамме, это запоминается сильнее любого дорогого ножа. Сложность в другом — розовых перчаток почти нет, а среди ножей есть только две подходящие отделки. Зато пушки в этой гамме дешёвые и яркие.

Ниже три сета, собранные от того, что реально существует в игре, а не от того, что хочется.

## Чем держится розовый в CS2

- **Doppler Phase 2** — розово-фиолетовый глянец. Именно Phase 2, а не любая фаза: Phase 1 тёмная, Phase 3 зелёно-синяя, Phase 4 синяя. Бывает только в Factory New и Minimal Wear.
- **Fade** — градиент от розового через фиолетовый к жёлтому. На лезвии розовой обычно оказывается большая часть, поэтому Fade в розовом сете работает даже лучше, чем в «золотом».
- **Неоновые поп-арт скины** — M4A4 | Tooth Fairy, Desert Eagle | Starcade, AWP | POP AWP, Glock-18 | Shinobu. Это главный источник розового в оружии: много цвета, мало денег.

И короткий список перчаток, который стоит запомнить: **Hand Wraps | Overprint**, **Specialist Gloves | Fade** и **Sport Gloves | Vice**. Всё остальное с розовым в названии или на превью либо красное, либо фиолетовое. Подробнее — на странице [розовых перчаток](/rozovye-perchatki-cs2/).

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Navaja Knife | Fade;Hand Wraps | Overprint;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Sport Gloves | Vice"]

## Сет до 7 000 ₽

Около 6 600 ₽ за шесть стволов:

- **AK-47 | Neon Rider** — [price name="AK-47 | Neon Rider" wear="FT"]. Розово-фиолетовый неон, выглядит дороже своей цены.
- **M4A4 | Tooth Fairy** — [price name="M4A4 | Tooth Fairy" wear="FT"]. Самая точная розовая M4 в игре и одна из самых дешёвых.
- **AWP | POP AWP** — [price name="AWP | POP AWP" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Night Heist** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Night Heist" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Cortex** — [price name="USP-S | Cortex" wear="FT"]. Розовый мозг на белом — спорно, но по цвету точное попадание.
- **Glock-18 | Shinobu** — [price name="Glock-18 | Shinobu" wear="FT"]. Розовый Glock с аниме-рисунком, почти идеальный цвет.

[skins names="AK-47 | Neon Rider;M4A4 | Tooth Fairy;AWP | POP AWP;Desert Eagle | Night Heist;USP-S | Cortex;Glock-18 | Shinobu"]

Если USP с мозгом не нравится, замени на **USP-S | Jawbreaker** ([price name="USP-S | Jawbreaker" wear="FT"]) — цена и цвет почти те же.

Важная деталь: розовый в этом сете неоновый, а не пастельный. Поэтому не смешивай его с бледно-розовыми камуфляжами — рядом с Tooth Fairy и Shinobu они выглядят грязными. Если сомневаешься в скине, открой его инспект в игре на светлой карте вроде Mirage: неон остаётся ярким даже на солнце, пастель там почти белеет.

[cta color=2 budget=7000 text="Собрать розовый сет за 7 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сет до 18 000 ₽

Около 17 600 ₽. Меняем четыре ствола и добавляем самые дешёвые розовые перчатки:

- **AK-47 | Nightwish** — [price name="AK-47 | Nightwish" wear="FT"]. Ночное небо в розово-фиолетовых тонах; лучшее совпадение среди AK.
- **M4A4 | Temukau** — [price name="M4A4 | Temukau" wear="FT"].
- **AWP | Fever Dream** — [price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="FT"]. Почти не дешевеет с износом, так что Field-Tested здесь — разумный выбор.
- **Desert Eagle | Starcade** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Starcade" wear="FT"]. Розовый ретро-аркадный дизайн, лучший розовый Deagle по цвету.
- **Hand Wraps | Overprint** — [price name="Hand Wraps | Overprint" wear="FT"]. Розовые обмотки с принтом — самый точный по цвету вариант среди перчаток.
- USP Cortex и Glock Shinobu остаются.

[skins names="AK-47 | Nightwish;M4A4 | Temukau;AWP | Fever Dream;Desert Eagle | Starcade;Hand Wraps | Overprint"]

Вместо перчаток можно взять **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — от [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Это самый дешёвый способ получить Doppler Phase 2; сет тогда выйдет примерно на 2 000 ₽ дороже. Ещё дешевле по цене модели — **Navaja Knife | Fade** (от [price name="Navaja Knife | Fade"]).

[cta color=2 budget=18000 text="Собрать розовый сет за 18 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сет с ножом и перчатками до 65 000 ₽

Около 65 000 ₽. Пушки из среднего сета, а пару подбираем так, чтобы они не спорили:

- **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — от [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Flip хорошо показывает лезвие на инспекте, а Phase 2 даёт тот самый розово-фиолетовый глянец.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** — [price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]. Розовый с бирюзой в стиле Майами, самые известные «розовые» перчатки CS2. Бирюзовые вставки не мешают: они перекликаются с голубыми бликами Doppler.

Более спокойная альтернатива — **Specialist Gloves | Fade** ([price name="Specialist Gloves | Fade" wear="FT"]): сет станет дешевле примерно на 17 000 ₽ и будет выглядеть мягче.

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Sport Gloves | Vice;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Desert Eagle | Starcade"]

[cta color=2 budget=65000 text="Собрать розовый сет за 65 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Итоги по сетам

| Бюджет | Что входит | Итого |
|---|---|---|
| До 7 000 ₽ | Neon Rider, Tooth Fairy, POP AWP, Night Heist, Cortex, Shinobu | ≈ 6 600 ₽ |
| До 18 000 ₽ | Nightwish, Temukau, Fever Dream, Starcade, Cortex, Shinobu + Hand Wraps Overprint | ≈ 17 600 ₽ |
| До 65 000 ₽ | Пушки среднего сета + Flip Knife Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves Vice | ≈ 65 000 ₽ |

Суммы приведены по ценам на 15 октября 2026 года; цены у предметов в тексте подтягиваются автоматически каждый день.

## Чего избегать

- **Slaughter.** Ножи и Hand Wraps | Slaughter на превью кажутся розовыми, но в игре это красно-коралловый узор. К тому же самые дешёвые лоты перчаток — это потёртые экземпляры, а Field-Tested стоит [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"].
- **Pink DDPAT.** AWP и Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT — бледный камуфляж, который рядом с неоновым Tooth Fairy выглядит выцветшим. Glock Pink DDPAT при этом дороже Shinobu: [price name="Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** — фиолетово-голубые и очень дорогие ([price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"]). Для розового сета не подходят.
- **AK-47 | Leet Museo в Field-Tested.** Разница между минимальной ценой и FT большая: [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"] за скин, который в розовом сете всё равно уступает Nightwish.
- **M4A1-S | Hyper Beast и AWP | Hyper Beast.** Розовые акценты есть, но бирюзы, жёлтого и чёрного на них больше. Если брать, то только как осознанный акцент.
- **Doppler не той фазы.** Phase 1 и Phase 3 продаются под тем же названием «Doppler» — всегда проверяй «(Phase 2)» в названии лота.

## Если хочется дороже

- **Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)** — от [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Классика розово-фиолетовых инвентарей.
- **Butterfly Knife | Fade** — от [price name="Butterfly Knife | Fade"]. Самый яркий розовый градиент в игре.
- **AWP | Fade** — от [price name="AWP | Fade"]. Розово-золотой AWP, который поддержит Fade на ноже.
- **Glock-18 | Fade** — от [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]. Дорогой пистолет-коллекционка, логичное завершение Fade-сета.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Butterfly Knife | Fade;AWP | Fade;Glock-18 | Fade"]

Совет напоследок: в розовом сете решай сразу, Doppler или Fade. Оба розовые, но Doppler уводит гамму в фиолетовый, а Fade — в жёлтый, и пушки под них подбираются по-разному. Все варианты — на страницах [розовых скинов](/rozovye-skiny-cs2/) и [розовых ножей](/rozovye-nozhi-cs2/), другие гаммы — в разделе [цветовые сеты скинов CS2](/cvetovye-sety-skinov-cs2/).

en.title: Pink CS2 Inventory: Ready-Made Skin Loadouts for $80, $200 and $720
en.desc: A pink CS2 inventory on three budgets: neon guns, an Overprint loadout and a Flip Doppler Phase 2 with Vice. Which gloves are truly pink and what to avoid.
en.lead: CS2 has plenty of cheap pink guns, but only three pairs of pink gloves. We built three loadouts from what's actually available and broke down the palette's traps.
en.md:
People build a pink inventory in CS2 for one effect: when the whole screen is in one acid-pink palette, it sticks in your memory more than any expensive knife. The catch is elsewhere — there are almost no pink gloves, and only two finishes work among knives. On the plus side, the guns in this palette are cheap and bright.

Below are three loadouts built from what actually exists in the game, not from wishful thinking.

## What carries pink in CS2

- **Doppler Phase 2** — a pink-purple gloss. Specifically Phase 2, not just any phase: Phase 1 is dark, Phase 3 is green-blue, Phase 4 is blue. It only comes in Factory New and Minimal Wear.
- **Fade** — a gradient from pink through purple to yellow. Most of the blade usually ends up pink, so a Fade works even better in a pink loadout than in a "gold" one.
- **Neon pop-art skins** — M4A4 | Tooth Fairy, Desert Eagle | Starcade, AWP | POP AWP, Glock-18 | Shinobu. These are the main source of pink on guns: lots of color, little money.

And a short list of gloves worth memorizing: **Hand Wraps | Overprint**, **Specialist Gloves | Fade** and **Sport Gloves | Vice**. Everything else with pink in the name or the preview is either red or purple. More on the [pink gloves](/en/pink-gloves-cs2/) page.

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Navaja Knife | Fade;Hand Wraps | Overprint;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Sport Gloves | Vice"]

## Loadout under $80

About $70 for six guns:

- **AK-47 | Neon Rider** — [price name="AK-47 | Neon Rider" wear="FT"]. Pink-purple neon that looks pricier than it is.
- **M4A4 | Tooth Fairy** — [price name="M4A4 | Tooth Fairy" wear="FT"]. The most accurate pink M4 in the game and one of the cheapest.
- **AWP | POP AWP** — [price name="AWP | POP AWP" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Night Heist** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Night Heist" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Cortex** — [price name="USP-S | Cortex" wear="FT"]. A pink brain on white — debatable, but a spot-on color match.
- **Glock-18 | Shinobu** — [price name="Glock-18 | Shinobu" wear="FT"]. A pink Glock with anime art, almost perfect color.

[skins names="AK-47 | Neon Rider;M4A4 | Tooth Fairy;AWP | POP AWP;Desert Eagle | Night Heist;USP-S | Cortex;Glock-18 | Shinobu"]

If the brain USP isn't your thing, swap it for **USP-S | Jawbreaker** ([price name="USP-S | Jawbreaker" wear="FT"]) — nearly the same price and color.

An important detail: the pink in this loadout is neon, not pastel. So don't mix it with pale pink camos — next to Tooth Fairy and Shinobu they look dirty. If you're unsure about a skin, inspect it in-game on a bright map like Mirage: neon stays vivid even in the sun, while pastel almost turns white there.

[cta color=2 budget=7000 text="Build a pink loadout for $80" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout under $200

About $195. We swap four guns and add the cheapest pink gloves:

- **AK-47 | Nightwish** — [price name="AK-47 | Nightwish" wear="FT"]. A night sky in pink and purple tones; the best match among AKs.
- **M4A4 | Temukau** — [price name="M4A4 | Temukau" wear="FT"].
- **AWP | Fever Dream** — [price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="FT"]. It barely gets cheaper with wear, so Field-Tested is a sensible choice here.
- **Desert Eagle | Starcade** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Starcade" wear="FT"]. A pink retro-arcade design, the best pink Deagle color-wise.
- **Hand Wraps | Overprint** — [price name="Hand Wraps | Overprint" wear="FT"]. Pink printed wraps — the most color-accurate option among gloves.
- The USP Cortex and Glock Shinobu stay.

[skins names="AK-47 | Nightwish;M4A4 | Temukau;AWP | Fever Dream;Desert Eagle | Starcade;Hand Wraps | Overprint"]

Instead of gloves, you can grab a **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — from [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. It's the cheapest way to get a Doppler Phase 2; the loadout then comes out about $20 more expensive. Even cheaper by model price is the **Navaja Knife | Fade** (from [price name="Navaja Knife | Fade"]).

[cta color=2 budget=18000 text="Build a pink loadout for $200" btn="Open the builder"]

## Knife and gloves loadout under $720

About $720. The guns come from the mid-range loadout, and we pick a pair that doesn't clash:

- **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — from [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. The Flip shows off the blade well on inspect, and Phase 2 gives exactly that pink-purple gloss.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** — [price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]. Pink and teal Miami style, the most famous "pink" gloves in CS2. The teal inserts don't get in the way: they echo the Doppler's blue highlights.

A calmer alternative is **Specialist Gloves | Fade** ([price name="Specialist Gloves | Fade" wear="FT"]): the loadout gets about $190 cheaper and looks softer.

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Sport Gloves | Vice;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Desert Eagle | Starcade"]

[cta color=2 budget=65000 text="Build a pink loadout for $720" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout totals

| Budget | What's included | Total |
|---|---|---|
| Under $80 | Neon Rider, Tooth Fairy, POP AWP, Night Heist, Cortex, Shinobu | ≈ $70 |
| Under $200 | Nightwish, Temukau, Fever Dream, Starcade, Cortex, Shinobu + Hand Wraps Overprint | ≈ $195 |
| Under $720 | Mid-range guns + Flip Knife Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves Vice | ≈ $720 |

Totals are based on prices as of October 15, 2026; item prices in the text are pulled in automatically every day.

## What to avoid

- **Slaughter.** Slaughter knives and Hand Wraps | Slaughter look pink in previews, but in-game it's a red-coral pattern. On top of that, the cheapest glove listings are worn-out copies, while Field-Tested costs [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"].
- **Pink DDPAT.** AWP and Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT are a pale camo that looks washed out next to the neon Tooth Fairy. And the Glock Pink DDPAT costs more than the Shinobu: [price name="Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** — purple-blue and very expensive ([price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"]). They don't fit a pink loadout.
- **AK-47 | Leet Museo in Field-Tested.** The gap between the lowest price and FT is big: [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"] for a skin that still loses to the Nightwish in a pink loadout.
- **M4A1-S | Hyper Beast and AWP | Hyper Beast.** They have pink accents, but more teal, yellow and black. If you take them, only as a deliberate accent.
- **The wrong Doppler phase.** Phase 1 and Phase 3 are sold under the same "Doppler" name — always check for "(Phase 2)" in the listing title.

## If you want to go bigger

- **Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)** — from [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. A classic of pink-purple inventories.
- **Butterfly Knife | Fade** — from [price name="Butterfly Knife | Fade"]. The brightest pink gradient in the game.
- **AWP | Fade** — from [price name="AWP | Fade"]. A pink-gold AWP to back up a Fade knife.
- **Glock-18 | Fade** — from [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]. A pricey collector's pistol, the natural finishing touch for a Fade loadout.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Butterfly Knife | Fade;AWP | Fade;Glock-18 | Fade"]

A parting tip: in a pink loadout, decide right away between Doppler and Fade. Both are pink, but Doppler pulls the palette toward purple and Fade toward yellow, and the guns are matched differently for each. All options are on the [pink CS2 skins](/en/pink-cs2-skins/) and [pink knives](/en/pink-knives-cs2/) pages, and other palettes are in the [CS2 skin sets by color](/en/cs2-skin-sets-by-color/) section.

de.title: Pinke CS2 Skins: fertige Inventar-Sets für 80, 200 und 720 €
de.desc: Pinkes CS2-Inventar in drei Budgets: Neon-Waffen, Set mit Overprint, Flip Doppler Phase 2 mit Vice. Welche Handschuhe wirklich pink sind und was nicht.
de.lead: Pinke Waffen gibt es in CS2 viele und günstig, Handschuhe dagegen nur drei Paar. Wir haben drei Sets aus real verfügbaren Optionen gebaut und die Fallen dieser Farbwelt durchleuchtet.
de.md:
Ein pinkes Inventar in CS2 baut man für genau einen Effekt: Wenn der ganze Bildschirm in knalligem Neonpink leuchtet, bleibt das stärker hängen als jedes teure Messer. Die Schwierigkeit liegt woanders – pinke Handschuhe gibt es kaum, und bei den Messern passen nur zwei Finishes. Dafür sind die Waffen in dieser Farbwelt günstig und knallig.

Unten findest du drei Sets, gebaut aus dem, was es im Spiel wirklich gibt – nicht aus Wunschdenken.

## Was Pink in CS2 trägt

- **Doppler Phase 2** – rosa-violetter Glanz. Wirklich Phase 2, nicht irgendeine Phase: Phase 1 ist dunkel, Phase 3 grün-blau, Phase 4 blau. Gibt es nur in Factory New und Minimal Wear.
- **Fade** – Verlauf von Pink über Lila bis Gelb. Auf der Klinge ist meist der größte Teil pink, deshalb funktioniert Fade im pinken Set sogar besser als im „goldenen“.
- **Neon-Pop-Art-Skins** – M4A4 | Tooth Fairy, Desert Eagle | Starcade, AWP | POP AWP, Glock-18 | Shinobu. Die Hauptquelle für Pink bei den Waffen: viel Farbe für wenig Geld.

Und eine kurze Liste Handschuhe, die du dir merken solltest: **Hand Wraps | Overprint**, **Specialist Gloves | Fade** und **Sport Gloves | Vice**. Alles andere mit Pink im Namen oder in der Vorschau ist entweder rot oder lila. Mehr dazu auf der Seite mit [pinken CS2 Skins und Handschuhen](/de/pinke-cs2-skins/).

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Navaja Knife | Fade;Hand Wraps | Overprint;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Sport Gloves | Vice"]

## Set bis 80 €

Rund 70 € für sechs Waffen:

- **AK-47 | Neon Rider** – [price name="AK-47 | Neon Rider" wear="FT"]. Pink-violettes Neon, sieht teurer aus, als es ist.
- **M4A4 | Tooth Fairy** – [price name="M4A4 | Tooth Fairy" wear="FT"]. Die farbgenaueste pinke M4 im Spiel und eine der günstigsten.
- **AWP | POP AWP** – [price name="AWP | POP AWP" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Night Heist** – [price name="Desert Eagle | Night Heist" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Cortex** – [price name="USP-S | Cortex" wear="FT"]. Ein pinkes Gehirn auf Weiß – Geschmackssache, farblich aber ein Volltreffer.
- **Glock-18 | Shinobu** – [price name="Glock-18 | Shinobu" wear="FT"]. Pinke Glock mit Anime-Motiv, fast perfekte Farbe.

[skins names="AK-47 | Neon Rider;M4A4 | Tooth Fairy;AWP | POP AWP;Desert Eagle | Night Heist;USP-S | Cortex;Glock-18 | Shinobu"]

Wenn dir die USP mit Gehirn nicht gefällt, nimm stattdessen **USP-S | Jawbreaker** ([price name="USP-S | Jawbreaker" wear="FT"]) – Preis und Farbe sind fast gleich.

Wichtiges Detail: Das Pink in diesem Set ist Neon, nicht Pastell. Misch es deshalb nicht mit blassrosa Camos – neben Tooth Fairy und Shinobu wirken die schmutzig. Wenn du dir bei einem Skin unsicher bist, inspecte ihn im Spiel auf einer hellen Map wie Mirage: Neon bleibt auch in der Sonne knallig, Pastell wird dort fast weiß.

[cta color=2 budget=7000 text="Pinkes Set für 80 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set bis 200 €

Rund 200 €. Wir tauschen vier Waffen und nehmen die günstigsten pinken Handschuhe dazu:

- **AK-47 | Nightwish** – [price name="AK-47 | Nightwish" wear="FT"]. Nachthimmel in Rosa- und Lilatönen; der beste Farbtreffer unter den AKs.
- **M4A4 | Temukau** – [price name="M4A4 | Temukau" wear="FT"].
- **AWP | Fever Dream** – [price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="FT"]. Wird mit schlechterem Zustand kaum günstiger, Field-Tested ist hier also eine vernünftige Wahl.
- **Desert Eagle | Starcade** – [price name="Desert Eagle | Starcade" wear="FT"]. Pinkes Retro-Arcade-Design, farblich die beste pinke Deagle.
- **Hand Wraps | Overprint** – [price name="Hand Wraps | Overprint" wear="FT"]. Pinke Bandagen mit Print – farblich die präziseste Option unter den Handschuhen.
- USP Cortex und Glock Shinobu bleiben.

[skins names="AK-47 | Nightwish;M4A4 | Temukau;AWP | Fever Dream;Desert Eagle | Starcade;Hand Wraps | Overprint"]

Statt Handschuhen kannst du das **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** nehmen – ab [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Das ist der günstigste Weg zu Doppler Phase 2; das Set wird dann etwa 20 € teurer. Vom Modellpreis her noch günstiger: **Navaja Knife | Fade** (ab [price name="Navaja Knife | Fade"]).

[cta color=2 budget=18000 text="Pinkes Set für 200 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set mit Messer und Handschuhen bis 720 €

Rund 720 €. Die Waffen aus dem mittleren Set, und das Paar wählen wir so, dass sich nichts beißt:

- **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** – ab [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Das Flip zeigt die Klinge beim Inspecten gut, und Phase 2 liefert genau den rosa-violetten Glanz.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** – [price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]. Pink mit Türkis im Miami-Stil, die bekanntesten „pinken“ Handschuhe in CS2. Die türkisen Einsätze stören nicht: Sie greifen die bläulichen Reflexe des Doppler auf.

Eine ruhigere Alternative sind **Specialist Gloves | Fade** ([price name="Specialist Gloves | Fade" wear="FT"]): Das Set wird rund 190 € günstiger und wirkt weicher.

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Sport Gloves | Vice;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Desert Eagle | Starcade"]

[cta color=2 budget=65000 text="Pinkes Set für 720 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Die Sets im Überblick

| Budget | Inhalt | Gesamt |
|---|---|---|
| Bis 80 € | Neon Rider, Tooth Fairy, POP AWP, Night Heist, Cortex, Shinobu | ≈ 70 € |
| Bis 200 € | Nightwish, Temukau, Fever Dream, Starcade, Cortex, Shinobu + Hand Wraps Overprint | ≈ 200 € |
| Bis 720 € | Waffen aus dem mittleren Set + Flip Knife Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves Vice | ≈ 720 € |

Die Summen basieren auf den Preisen vom 15. Oktober 2026; die Preise der Items im Text werden täglich automatisch aktualisiert.

## Was du vermeiden solltest

- **Slaughter.** Messer und Hand Wraps | Slaughter wirken in der Vorschau pink, im Spiel ist das Muster aber rot-korallenfarben. Dazu sind die billigsten Handschuh-Angebote abgenutzte Exemplare, Field-Tested kostet [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"].
- **Pink DDPAT.** AWP und Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT sind blasse Camos, die neben der neonfarbenen Tooth Fairy verwaschen aussehen. Die Glock Pink DDPAT ist dabei sogar teurer als Shinobu: [price name="Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** – lila-hellblau und sehr teuer ([price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"]). Passen nicht ins pinke Set.
- **AK-47 | Leet Museo in Field-Tested.** Der Abstand zwischen Mindestpreis und FT ist groß: [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"] für einen Skin, der im pinken Set ohnehin hinter der Nightwish zurückbleibt.
- **M4A1-S | Hyper Beast und AWP | Hyper Beast.** Pinke Akzente sind da, aber Türkis, Gelb und Schwarz überwiegen. Wenn überhaupt, dann nur als bewusster Akzent.
- **Doppler in der falschen Phase.** Phase 1 und Phase 3 werden unter demselben Namen „Doppler“ verkauft – prüf im Angebotstitel immer auf „(Phase 2)“.

## Wenn es teurer sein darf

- **Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)** – ab [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Der Klassiker rosa-violetter Inventare.
- **Butterfly Knife | Fade** – ab [price name="Butterfly Knife | Fade"]. Der knalligste pinke Verlauf im Spiel.
- **AWP | Fade** – ab [price name="AWP | Fade"]. Rosa-goldene AWP, die ein Fade-Messer unterstützt.
- **Glock-18 | Fade** – ab [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]. Eine teure Sammler-Pistole, der logische Abschluss eines Fade-Sets.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Butterfly Knife | Fade;AWP | Fade;Glock-18 | Fade"]

Ein letzter Tipp: Entscheide dich im pinken Set gleich zwischen Doppler und Fade. Beide sind pink, aber Doppler zieht die Farbwelt ins Lila, Fade ins Gelbe – und die Waffen wählst du jeweils anders dazu. Alle Optionen inklusive Messern findest du auf der Seite mit [pinken CS2 Skins](/de/pinke-cs2-skins/), andere Farbwelten im Bereich [Farb-Sets für CS2-Skins](/de/).

pt.title: Inventário rosa no CS2: sets prontos por R$ 430, R$ 1.100 e R$ 4.000
pt.desc: Inventário rosa no CS2 em três orçamentos: armas neon, set com Overprint e Flip Doppler Phase 2 com Vice. Quais luvas são rosa de verdade e o que evitar.
pt.lead: Armas rosa no CS2 são muitas e baratas, mas luvas são só três pares. Montamos três sets com o que existe de verdade e destrinchamos as armadilhas da paleta.
pt.md:
Um inventário rosa no CS2 é montado por um efeito só: quando a tela inteira está numa mesma paleta rosa-choque, isso marca mais do que qualquer faca cara. A dificuldade é outra — luvas rosa quase não existem, e entre as facas só há dois acabamentos que servem. Em compensação, as armas nessa paleta são baratas e vibrantes.

Abaixo, três sets montados com o que realmente existe no jogo, e não com o que a gente gostaria que existisse.

## O que segura o rosa no CS2

- **Doppler Phase 2** — brilho polido rosa-roxo. Tem que ser a Phase 2, não qualquer fase: a Phase 1 é escura, a Phase 3 é verde-azulada, a Phase 4 é azul. Só existe em Factory New e Minimal Wear.
- **Fade** — degradê do rosa, passando pelo roxo, até o amarelo. Na lâmina, a maior parte costuma ficar rosa, então a Fade funciona até melhor num set rosa do que num "dourado".
- **Skins neon pop art** — M4A4 | Tooth Fairy, Desert Eagle | Starcade, AWP | POP AWP, Glock-18 | Shinobu. São a principal fonte de rosa nas armas: muita cor, pouco dinheiro.

E uma lista curta de luvas que vale decorar: **Hand Wraps | Overprint**, **Specialist Gloves | Fade** e **Sport Gloves | Vice**. Todo o resto com rosa no nome ou na prévia é vermelho ou roxo. Mais detalhes na página de [skins rosas](/pt/skins-rosas-cs2/).

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Navaja Knife | Fade;Hand Wraps | Overprint;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Sport Gloves | Vice"]

## Set até R$ 430

Cerca de R$ 400 por seis armas:

- **AK-47 | Neon Rider** — [price name="AK-47 | Neon Rider" wear="FT"]. Neon rosa-roxo, parece mais cara do que é.
- **M4A4 | Tooth Fairy** — [price name="M4A4 | Tooth Fairy" wear="FT"]. A M4 rosa mais fiel do jogo e uma das mais baratas.
- **AWP | POP AWP** — [price name="AWP | POP AWP" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Night Heist** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Night Heist" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Cortex** — [price name="USP-S | Cortex" wear="FT"]. Um cérebro rosa sobre branco — discutível, mas na cor é acerto em cheio.
- **Glock-18 | Shinobu** — [price name="Glock-18 | Shinobu" wear="FT"]. Glock rosa com desenho de anime, cor quase perfeita.

[skins names="AK-47 | Neon Rider;M4A4 | Tooth Fairy;AWP | POP AWP;Desert Eagle | Night Heist;USP-S | Cortex;Glock-18 | Shinobu"]

Se não curtir a USP com cérebro, troque pela **USP-S | Jawbreaker** ([price name="USP-S | Jawbreaker" wear="FT"]) — preço e cor quase iguais.

Detalhe importante: o rosa deste set é neon, não pastel. Então não misture com camuflagens rosa-claro — ao lado da Tooth Fairy e da Shinobu elas parecem sujas. Se estiver em dúvida sobre uma skin, inspecione no jogo num mapa claro como a Mirage: o neon continua vivo até no sol, o pastel ali quase fica branco.

[cta color=2 budget=7000 text="Montar set rosa por R$ 430" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set até R$ 1.100

Cerca de R$ 1.100. Trocamos quatro armas e adicionamos as luvas rosa mais baratas:

- **AK-47 | Nightwish** — [price name="AK-47 | Nightwish" wear="FT"]. Céu noturno em tons rosa-roxo; o melhor match entre as AKs.
- **M4A4 | Temukau** — [price name="M4A4 | Temukau" wear="FT"].
- **AWP | Fever Dream** — [price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="FT"]. Quase não barateia com o desgaste, então Field-Tested aqui é uma escolha sensata.
- **Desert Eagle | Starcade** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Starcade" wear="FT"]. Design rosa de fliperama retrô, a melhor Deagle rosa em cor.
- **Hand Wraps | Overprint** — [price name="Hand Wraps | Overprint" wear="FT"]. Faixas rosa estampadas — a opção mais precisa em cor entre as luvas.
- USP Cortex e Glock Shinobu continuam.

[skins names="AK-47 | Nightwish;M4A4 | Temukau;AWP | Fever Dream;Desert Eagle | Starcade;Hand Wraps | Overprint"]

No lugar das luvas, dá para pegar a **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — a partir de [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. É o jeito mais barato de ter uma Doppler Phase 2; o set fica cerca de R$ 120 mais caro. Ainda mais barata pelo preço do modelo é a **Navaja Knife | Fade** (a partir de [price name="Navaja Knife | Fade"]).

[cta color=2 budget=18000 text="Montar set rosa por R$ 1.100" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set com faca e luvas até R$ 4.000

Cerca de R$ 4.000. As armas vêm do set médio, e escolhemos o par para que um não brigue com o outro:

- **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — a partir de [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. A Flip mostra bem a lâmina na inspeção, e a Phase 2 dá exatamente aquele brilho rosa-roxo.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** — [price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]. Rosa com turquesa no estilo Miami, as luvas "rosa" mais famosas do CS2. Os detalhes turquesa não atrapalham: conversam com os reflexos azulados da Doppler.

Uma alternativa mais tranquila são as **Specialist Gloves | Fade** ([price name="Specialist Gloves | Fade" wear="FT"]): o set fica cerca de R$ 1.000 mais barato e com visual mais suave.

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Sport Gloves | Vice;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Desert Eagle | Starcade"]

[cta color=2 budget=65000 text="Montar set rosa por R$ 4.000" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Resumo dos sets

| Orçamento | O que entra | Total |
|---|---|---|
| Até R$ 430 | Neon Rider, Tooth Fairy, POP AWP, Night Heist, Cortex, Shinobu | ≈ R$ 400 |
| Até R$ 1.100 | Nightwish, Temukau, Fever Dream, Starcade, Cortex, Shinobu + Hand Wraps Overprint | ≈ R$ 1.100 |
| Até R$ 4.000 | Armas do set médio + Flip Knife Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves Vice | ≈ R$ 4.000 |

Os valores usam os preços de 15 de outubro de 2026; os preços dos itens no texto são puxados automaticamente todos os dias.

## O que evitar

- **Slaughter.** Facas e Hand Wraps | Slaughter parecem rosa na prévia, mas no jogo o padrão é vermelho-coral. Além disso, os anúncios mais baratos das luvas são exemplares gastos, e a Field-Tested custa [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"].
- **Pink DDPAT.** AWP e Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT são uma camuflagem pálida que, ao lado da Tooth Fairy neon, parece desbotada. E a Glock Pink DDPAT ainda é mais cara que a Shinobu: [price name="Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** — roxo-azuladas e bem caras ([price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"]). Não servem para um set rosa.
- **AK-47 | Leet Museo em Field-Tested.** A diferença entre o preço mínimo e a FT é grande: [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"] por uma skin que, num set rosa, ainda perde para a Nightwish.
- **M4A1-S | Hyper Beast e AWP | Hyper Beast.** Têm detalhes rosa, mas turquesa, amarelo e preto aparecem mais. Se for pegar, só como destaque proposital.
- **Doppler da fase errada.** Phase 1 e Phase 3 são vendidas com o mesmo nome "Doppler" — sempre confira o "(Phase 2)" no nome do anúncio.

## Se quiser gastar mais

- **Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)** — a partir de [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Um clássico dos inventários rosa e roxo.
- **Butterfly Knife | Fade** — a partir de [price name="Butterfly Knife | Fade"]. O degradê rosa mais vibrante do jogo.
- **AWP | Fade** — a partir de [price name="AWP | Fade"]. Uma AWP rosa e dourada que acompanha a Fade na faca.
- **Glock-18 | Fade** — a partir de [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]. Pistola cara de colecionador, o fechamento lógico de um set Fade.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Butterfly Knife | Fade;AWP | Fade;Glock-18 | Fade"]

Dica final: num set rosa, decida logo de cara entre Doppler e Fade. As duas são rosa, mas a Doppler puxa a paleta para o roxo, e a Fade para o amarelo, e as armas combinam de forma diferente com cada uma. Todas as opções de skins e facas estão na página de [skins rosas do CS2](/pt/skins-rosas-cs2/), e as outras paletas na seção de [sets de skins por cor do CS2](/pt/).

tr.title: Pembe CS2 envanteri: $80, $200 ve $720'ye hazır skin setleri
tr.desc: Üç bütçede pembe CS2 envanteri: neon silahlar, Overprint'li set ve Vice ile Flip Doppler Phase 2. Hangi eldivenler gerçekten pembe, nelerden kaçınmalı.
tr.lead: CS2'de pembe silah çok ve ucuz, ama eldiven sadece üç çift. Gerçek seçeneklerden üç set kurduk ve bu renk grubunun tuzaklarını inceledik.
tr.md:
CS2'de pembe envanter tek bir etki için kurulur: bütün ekran tek bir asit pembesi tonda olduğunda, bu her pahalı bıçaktan daha akılda kalıcıdır. Zorluk başka yerde — pembe eldiven neredeyse yok, bıçaklarda da uygun yalnızca iki kaplama var. Buna karşılık bu renkteki silahlar ucuz ve parlak.

Aşağıda istediklerimize göre değil, oyunda gerçekten var olana göre kurulmuş üç set var.

## CS2'de pembeyi ne taşıyor

- **Doppler Phase 2** — pembe-mor parlaklık. Herhangi bir faz değil, özellikle Phase 2: Phase 1 koyu, Phase 3 yeşil-mavi, Phase 4 mavi. Yalnızca Factory New ve Minimal Wear olarak çıkar.
- **Fade** — pembeden mora, oradan sarıya geçen bir gradyan. Bıçak ağzında genelde büyük kısım pembe kalır, bu yüzden Fade pembe sette "altın" settekinden bile daha iyi çalışır.
- **Neon pop-art skinler** — M4A4 | Tooth Fairy, Desert Eagle | Starcade, AWP | POP AWP, Glock-18 | Shinobu. Silahlarda pembenin ana kaynağı bunlar: bol renk, az para.

Bir de akılda tutmaya değer kısa bir eldiven listesi: **Hand Wraps | Overprint**, **Specialist Gloves | Fade** ve **Sport Gloves | Vice**. İsminde ya da önizlemesinde pembe olan diğer her şey ya kırmızı ya mor. Ayrıntılar [pembe eldivenler](/tr/pembe-cs2-skinleri/) sayfasında.

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Navaja Knife | Fade;Hand Wraps | Overprint;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Sport Gloves | Vice"]

## $80'e kadar set

Altı silah için yaklaşık $70:

- **AK-47 | Neon Rider** — [price name="AK-47 | Neon Rider" wear="FT"]. Pembe-mor neon, fiyatından pahalı görünüyor.
- **M4A4 | Tooth Fairy** — [price name="M4A4 | Tooth Fairy" wear="FT"]. Oyundaki en isabetli pembe M4 ve en ucuzlarından biri.
- **AWP | POP AWP** — [price name="AWP | POP AWP" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Night Heist** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Night Heist" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Cortex** — [price name="USP-S | Cortex" wear="FT"]. Beyaz üstünde pembe beyin — tartışmalı, ama renkte tam isabet.
- **Glock-18 | Shinobu** — [price name="Glock-18 | Shinobu" wear="FT"]. Anime çizimli pembe Glock, neredeyse kusursuz renk.

[skins names="AK-47 | Neon Rider;M4A4 | Tooth Fairy;AWP | POP AWP;Desert Eagle | Night Heist;USP-S | Cortex;Glock-18 | Shinobu"]

Beyinli USP hoşuna gitmediyse **USP-S | Jawbreaker** ([price name="USP-S | Jawbreaker" wear="FT"]) ile değiştir — fiyat ve renk hemen hemen aynı.

Önemli bir detay: bu setteki pembe pastel değil, neon. Bu yüzden onu soluk pembe kamuflajlarla karıştırma — Tooth Fairy ve Shinobu'nun yanında kirli görünürler. Bir skinden emin değilsen oyunda Mirage gibi aydınlık bir haritada inspect et: neon güneşte bile parlak kalır, pastel ise orada neredeyse beyazlaşır.

[cta color=2 budget=7000 text="Pembe seti $80'e topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## $200'e kadar set

Yaklaşık $200. Dört silahı değiştirip en ucuz pembe eldivenleri ekliyoruz:

- **AK-47 | Nightwish** — [price name="AK-47 | Nightwish" wear="FT"]. Pembe-mor tonlarda gece göğü; AK'ler arasında en iyi eşleşme.
- **M4A4 | Temukau** — [price name="M4A4 | Temukau" wear="FT"].
- **AWP | Fever Dream** — [price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="FT"]. Aşınmayla neredeyse ucuzlamıyor, yani burada Field-Tested mantıklı bir seçim.
- **Desert Eagle | Starcade** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Starcade" wear="FT"]. Pembe retro atari tasarımı, renk olarak en iyi pembe Deagle.
- **Hand Wraps | Overprint** — [price name="Hand Wraps | Overprint" wear="FT"]. Baskılı pembe sargılar — eldivenler arasında renge en isabetli seçenek.
- USP Cortex ve Glock Shinobu kalıyor.

[skins names="AK-47 | Nightwish;M4A4 | Temukau;AWP | Fever Dream;Desert Eagle | Starcade;Hand Wraps | Overprint"]

Eldiven yerine **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** alabilirsin — [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]'dan başlıyor. Doppler Phase 2'ye sahip olmanın en ucuz yolu bu; set o zaman yaklaşık $20 daha pahalıya gelir. Model fiyatı olarak daha da ucuzu **Navaja Knife | Fade** ([price name="Navaja Knife | Fade"]'dan başlıyor).

[cta color=2 budget=18000 text="Pembe seti $200'e topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Bıçak ve eldivenli set, $720'ye kadar

Yaklaşık $720. Silahlar orta setten, ikiliyi ise birbiriyle çatışmayacak şekilde seçiyoruz:

- **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]'dan başlıyor. Flip, inspect'te bıçak ağzını iyi gösteriyor, Phase 2 de tam o pembe-mor parlaklığı veriyor.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** — [price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]. Miami tarzı turkuazlı pembe, CS2'nin en ünlü "pembe" eldivenleri. Turkuaz ekler sorun yaratmıyor: Doppler'ın mavi yansımalarıyla kafiyeleniyorlar.

Daha sakin bir alternatif **Specialist Gloves | Fade** ([price name="Specialist Gloves | Fade" wear="FT"]): set yaklaşık $190 ucuzlar ve daha yumuşak görünür.

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Sport Gloves | Vice;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Desert Eagle | Starcade"]

[cta color=2 budget=65000 text="Pembe seti $720'ye topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Setlerin özeti

| Bütçe | İçerik | Toplam |
|---|---|---|
| $80'e kadar | Neon Rider, Tooth Fairy, POP AWP, Night Heist, Cortex, Shinobu | ≈ $70 |
| $200'e kadar | Nightwish, Temukau, Fever Dream, Starcade, Cortex, Shinobu + Hand Wraps Overprint | ≈ $200 |
| $720'ye kadar | Orta setin silahları + Flip Knife Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves Vice | ≈ $720 |

Tutarlar 15 Ekim 2026 fiyatlarına göre; metindeki eşyaların fiyatları her gün otomatik olarak çekiliyor.

## Nelerden kaçınmalı

- **Slaughter.** Bıçaklar ve Hand Wraps | Slaughter önizlemede pembe görünür, ama oyunda kırmızı-mercan bir desen. Üstelik eldivenlerin en ucuz ilanları yıpranmış eşyalar, Field-Tested ise [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"].
- **Pink DDPAT.** AWP ve Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT, neon Tooth Fairy'nin yanında solmuş görünen soluk bir kamuflaj. Üstelik Glock Pink DDPAT, Shinobu'dan pahalı: [price name="Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** — mor-mavi ve çok pahalı ([price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"]). Pembe sete uymuyor.
- **Field-Tested AK-47 | Leet Museo.** En düşük fiyat ile FT arasındaki fark büyük: pembe sette zaten Nightwish'in gerisinde kalan bir skin için [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"].
- **M4A1-S | Hyper Beast ve AWP | Hyper Beast.** Pembe vurguları var, ama üzerlerinde turkuaz, sarı ve siyah daha fazla. Alacaksan ancak bilinçli bir vurgu olarak.
- **Yanlış fazda Doppler.** Phase 1 ve Phase 3 de aynı "Doppler" adıyla satılıyor — ilan adında her zaman "(Phase 2)" yazıp yazmadığını kontrol et.

## Bütçen daha yüksekse

- **Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)** — [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]'dan başlıyor. Pembe-mor envanterlerin klasiği.
- **Butterfly Knife | Fade** — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Fade"]'dan başlıyor. Oyundaki en parlak pembe gradyan.
- **AWP | Fade** — [price name="AWP | Fade"]'dan başlıyor. Bıçaktaki Fade'i destekleyecek pembe-altın AWP.
- **Glock-18 | Fade** — [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]'dan başlıyor. Pahalı bir koleksiyon tabancası, Fade setinin mantıklı finali.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Butterfly Knife | Fade;AWP | Fade;Glock-18 | Fade"]

Son bir tavsiye: pembe sette Doppler mı Fade mi, baştan karar ver. İkisi de pembe, ama Doppler renk grubunu mora, Fade ise sarıya çekiyor ve silahlar ikisine farklı seçiliyor. Bıçaklar dahil tüm seçenekler [pembe CS2 skinleri](/tr/pembe-cs2-skinleri/) sayfasında, diğer renkler [CS2 renk setleri](/tr/) bölümünde.

pl.title: Różowy ekwipunek CS2: gotowe sety za 310, 800 i 2 900 zł
pl.desc: Różowy ekwipunek CS2 w trzech budżetach: neonowe spluwy, set z Overprint i Flip Doppler Phase 2 z Vice. Które rękawice są naprawdę różowe i czego unikać.
pl.lead: Różowych spluw w CS2 jest dużo i są tanie, ale rękawic tylko trzy pary. Złożyliśmy trzy sety z realnych opcji i rozebraliśmy pułapki tej palety.
pl.md:
Różowy ekwipunek w CS2 składa się dla jednego efektu: kiedy cały ekran jest w jednej kwasoworóżowej palecie, zapada w pamięć mocniej niż jakikolwiek drogi nóż. Trudność leży gdzie indziej — różowych rękawic prawie nie ma, a wśród noży pasują tylko dwa wykończenia. Za to spluwy w tej palecie są tanie i jaskrawe.

Poniżej trzy sety złożone z tego, co naprawdę istnieje w grze, a nie z tego, co by się chciało.

## Na czym stoi róż w CS2

- **Doppler Phase 2** — różowo-fioletowy połysk. Właśnie Phase 2, a nie dowolna faza: Phase 1 jest ciemna, Phase 3 zielono-niebieska, Phase 4 niebieska. Występuje tylko w Factory New i Minimal Wear.
- **Fade** — gradient od różu przez fiolet do żółtego. Na ostrzu różowa zwykle jest większa część, dlatego Fade w różowym secie działa nawet lepiej niż w „złotym”.
- **Neonowe skiny pop-art** — M4A4 | Tooth Fairy, Desert Eagle | Starcade, AWP | POP AWP, Glock-18 | Shinobu. To główne źródło różu w broni: dużo koloru, mało pieniędzy.

I krótka lista rękawic, którą warto zapamiętać: **Hand Wraps | Overprint**, **Specialist Gloves | Fade** i **Sport Gloves | Vice**. Wszystko inne z różem w nazwie albo na podglądzie jest albo czerwone, albo fioletowe. Więcej — na stronie [różowych rękawic](/pl/rozowe-skiny-cs2/).

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Navaja Knife | Fade;Hand Wraps | Overprint;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Sport Gloves | Vice"]

## Set do 310 zł

Około 290 zł za sześć spluw:

- **AK-47 | Neon Rider** — [price name="AK-47 | Neon Rider" wear="FT"]. Różowo-fioletowy neon, wygląda drożej, niż kosztuje.
- **M4A4 | Tooth Fairy** — [price name="M4A4 | Tooth Fairy" wear="FT"]. Najcelniejsza różowa M4 w grze i jedna z najtańszych.
- **AWP | POP AWP** — [price name="AWP | POP AWP" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Night Heist** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Night Heist" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Cortex** — [price name="USP-S | Cortex" wear="FT"]. Różowy mózg na białym — kontrowersyjny, ale kolorystycznie to celne trafienie.
- **Glock-18 | Shinobu** — [price name="Glock-18 | Shinobu" wear="FT"]. Różowy Glock z rysunkiem w stylu anime, prawie idealny kolor.

[skins names="AK-47 | Neon Rider;M4A4 | Tooth Fairy;AWP | POP AWP;Desert Eagle | Night Heist;USP-S | Cortex;Glock-18 | Shinobu"]

Jeśli USP z mózgiem ci nie leży, zamień go na **USP-S | Jawbreaker** ([price name="USP-S | Jawbreaker" wear="FT"]) — cena i kolor prawie te same.

Ważny szczegół: róż w tym secie jest neonowy, a nie pastelowy. Dlatego nie mieszaj go z bladoróżowymi kamuflażami — obok Tooth Fairy i Shinobu wyglądają na brudne. Jeśli masz wątpliwości co do skina, odpal jego inspekt w grze na jasnej mapie typu Mirage: neon zostaje jaskrawy nawet w słońcu, pastel prawie tam bieleje.

[cta color=2 budget=7000 text="Złóż różowy set za 310 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Set do 800 zł

Około 780 zł. Wymieniamy cztery spluwy i dokładamy najtańsze różowe rękawice:

- **AK-47 | Nightwish** — [price name="AK-47 | Nightwish" wear="FT"]. Nocne niebo w różowo-fioletowych tonach; najlepsze dopasowanie wśród AK.
- **M4A4 | Temukau** — [price name="M4A4 | Temukau" wear="FT"].
- **AWP | Fever Dream** — [price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="FT"]. Prawie nie tanieje wraz z wearem, więc Field-Tested to tutaj rozsądny wybór.
- **Desert Eagle | Starcade** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Starcade" wear="FT"]. Różowy retro-arcade'owy design, najlepszy różowy Deagle pod względem koloru.
- **Hand Wraps | Overprint** — [price name="Hand Wraps | Overprint" wear="FT"]. Różowe owijki z nadrukiem — najcelniejsza kolorystycznie opcja wśród rękawic.
- USP Cortex i Glock Shinobu zostają.

[skins names="AK-47 | Nightwish;M4A4 | Temukau;AWP | Fever Dream;Desert Eagle | Starcade;Hand Wraps | Overprint"]

Zamiast rękawic możesz wziąć **Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — od [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. To najtańszy sposób na Doppler Phase 2; set wyjdzie wtedy o około 90 zł drożej. Jeszcze taniej, jeśli chodzi o cenę modelu, wychodzi **Navaja Knife | Fade** (od [price name="Navaja Knife | Fade"]).

[cta color=2 budget=18000 text="Złóż różowy set za 800 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Set z nożem i rękawicami do 2 900 zł

Około 2 900 zł. Spluwy ze średniego setu, a parę dobieramy tak, żeby się nie gryzła:

- **Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)** — od [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Flip dobrze pokazuje ostrze przy inspekcie, a Phase 2 daje ten właśnie różowo-fioletowy połysk.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** — [price name="Sport Gloves | Vice" wear="FT"]. Róż z turkusem w klimacie Miami, najbardziej znane „różowe” rękawice w CS2. Turkusowe wstawki nie przeszkadzają: korespondują z błękitnymi refleksami Dopplera.

Spokojniejsza alternatywa to **Specialist Gloves | Fade** ([price name="Specialist Gloves | Fade" wear="FT"]): set stanieje o około 760 zł i będzie wyglądał łagodniej.

[skins names="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Sport Gloves | Vice;Specialist Gloves | Fade;Desert Eagle | Starcade"]

[cta color=2 budget=65000 text="Złóż różowy set za 2 900 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Podsumowanie setów

| Budżet | Co wchodzi | Razem |
|---|---|---|
| Do 310 zł | Neon Rider, Tooth Fairy, POP AWP, Night Heist, Cortex, Shinobu | ≈ 290 zł |
| Do 800 zł | Nightwish, Temukau, Fever Dream, Starcade, Cortex, Shinobu + Hand Wraps Overprint | ≈ 780 zł |
| Do 2 900 zł | Spluwy ze średniego setu + Flip Knife Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves Vice | ≈ 2 900 zł |

Sumy podane według cen z 15 października 2026 roku; ceny przedmiotów w tekście pobierają się automatycznie codziennie.

## Czego unikać

- **Slaughter.** Noże i Hand Wraps | Slaughter na podglądzie wydają się różowe, ale w grze to czerwono-koralowy wzór. Do tego najtańsze oferty rękawic to zjechane egzemplarze, a Field-Tested kosztuje [price name="Hand Wraps | Slaughter" wear="FT"].
- **Pink DDPAT.** AWP i Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT to blady kamuflaż, który obok neonowego Tooth Fairy wygląda na wyblakły. Glock Pink DDPAT jest przy tym droższy niż Shinobu: [price name="Glock-18 | Pink DDPAT" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** — fioletowo-błękitne i bardzo drogie ([price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"]). Do różowego setu nie pasują.
- **AK-47 | Leet Museo w Field-Tested.** Różnica między minimalną ceną a FT jest duża: [price name="AK-47 | Leet Museo" wear="FT"] za skin, który w różowym secie i tak przegrywa z Nightwish.
- **M4A1-S | Hyper Beast i AWP | Hyper Beast.** Różowe akcenty są, ale turkusu, żółtego i czerni jest na nich więcej. Jeśli już, to tylko jako świadomy akcent.
- **Doppler w złej fazie.** Phase 1 i Phase 3 sprzedają się pod tą samą nazwą „Doppler” — zawsze sprawdzaj „(Phase 2)” w nazwie oferty.

## Jeśli chcesz drożej

- **Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)** — od [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]. Klasyka różowo-fioletowych ekwipunków.
- **Butterfly Knife | Fade** — od [price name="Butterfly Knife | Fade"]. Najjaskrawszy różowy gradient w grze.
- **AWP | Fade** — od [price name="AWP | Fade"]. Różowo-złote AWP, które podbije Fade na nożu.
- **Glock-18 | Fade** — od [price name="Glock-18 | Fade"]. Drogi kolekcjonerski pistolet, logiczne zwieńczenie setu Fade.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2);Butterfly Knife | Fade;AWP | Fade;Glock-18 | Fade"]

Rada na koniec: w różowym secie od razu zdecyduj — Doppler czy Fade. Oba są różowe, ale Doppler ciągnie paletę w fiolet, a Fade w żółć, i spluwy dobiera się pod nie inaczej. Wszystkie opcje, w tym noże, znajdziesz na stronie [różowych skinów](/pl/rozowe-skiny-cs2/), inne palety — w dziale [kolorowe sety skinów CS2](/pl/).

title: Синий инвентарь CS2: три готовых сета от 3 000 до 76 000 ₽
desc: Синий инвентарь CS2 на три бюджета: пушки за 3 000 ₽, сет с Cobalt Skulls и полный комплект с Doppler Phase 4. Почему Blue Steel — не синий.
lead: Синий — самая дешёвая гамма на входе: шесть точных по цвету стволов стоят меньше 3 000 ₽. Дальше всё решают нож и перчатки — разбираем три сета.
md:
Синий — самый дешёвый на входе цвет в CS2. Шесть синих стволов можно собрать дешевле одного ножа в любой другой гамме, а точных совпадений по цвету среди пушек больше, чем кажется. Дорогим синий становится только на ноже и перчатках, и там есть своя ловушка — названия, в которых «синее» только слово.

Разбираем три готовых сета и объясняем, почему Doppler Sapphire и Phase 4 — это синий, а Blue Steel — нет.

## Откуда в CS2 берётся синий

У синей гаммы три опоры:

- **Doppler Sapphire и Doppler Phase 4.** Sapphire — один из «камней» Doppler: однотонный насыщенный синий без примесей. Phase 4 — обычная фаза, синяя с голубыми и фиолетовыми переливами. Обе бывают только в Factory New и Minimal Wear, так что износ на вид не влияет. Цена у Doppler сильно зависит от фазы: обычные фазы стоят примерно одинаково, а Sapphire — в разы дороже. Проверяй фазу в названии лота.
- **Анодированный синий** — Royal Blue, Blue Laminate, Blue Ply, Cobalt Disruption. Это ровная заливка без рисунка: в игре такие скины выглядят ярче, чем на превью.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — по сути единственные по-настоящему синие перчатки. Остальные «синие» варианты либо фиолетовые, либо бирюзовые.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Sapphire);Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption"]

Все синие ножи по фазам собраны на странице [синих ножей](/sinie-nozhi-cs2/).

## Сет до 3 000 ₽

Около 2 400 ₽ за шесть стволов — и почти все с очень точным попаданием в цвет:

- **AK-47 | Blue Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Blue Laminate" wear="FT"]. Синее ламинированное дерево; самый синий AK в игре и при этом недорогой.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"]. Тёмно-синий с чёрным, хорошо гасит яркость остальных пушек.
- **AWP | Capillary** — [price name="AWP | Capillary" wear="FT"]. Синие «капилляры» на тёмном — совпадение по цвету лучше, чем у многих дорогих AWP.
- **Desert Eagle | Blue Ply** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Blue Ply" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Royal Blue** — [price name="USP-S | Royal Blue" wear="FT"]. Чистый королевский синий, эталон для всего сета.
- **Glock-18 | Sacrifice** — [price name="Glock-18 | Sacrifice" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Blue Laminate;M4A1-S | Nightmare;AWP | Capillary;Desert Eagle | Blue Ply;USP-S | Royal Blue;Glock-18 | Sacrifice"]

Почему такой сет работает: у пяти из шести стволов синий — основной цвет, а не деталь. От первого лица ты видишь именно заливку корпуса, поэтому даже дешёвые Blue Ply и Royal Blue дают больше синего на экране, чем многие скины за десятки долларов с синими вставками. Износ здесь тоже почти не важен: анодированная краска в Field-Tested стирается в основном по краям.

[cta color=1 budget=3000 text="Собрать синий сет за 3 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сет до 30 000 ₽

Около 28 100 ₽. Меняем две пушки и добавляем перчатки:

- **M4A4 | X-Ray** — [price name="M4A4 | X-Ray" wear="FT"]. Синий «рентген» с видимой механикой — заметный апгрейд над Nightmare.

Хочешь нож вместо перчаток — дешевле Cobalt Skulls есть **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)**: от [price name="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. Самый доступный синий Doppler, хоть и на непопулярной модели. Sapphire на тех же ножах — «камень» и стоит в разы дороже обычной фазы. Из перчаток дешевле Cobalt Skulls только **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** ([price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"]), но они скорее фиолетовые и подойдут, если в сете есть Glock Sacrifice или AK Baroque Purple.

## Сет с ножом и перчатками до 76 000 ₽

- **Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)** — от [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. Phase 4 — синий с переливами; на Bayonet лезвие крупное, и цвет читается отлично.

Альтернатива той же цены — **Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)**, от [price name="Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)"].

[cta color=1 budget=76000 text="Собрать синий сет за 76 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сравнение сетов

## Чего избегать

- **Blue Steel.** Несмотря на название, это серая воронёная сталь: Karambit | Blue Steel ([price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]) и Bowie Knife | Blue Steel в игре смотрятся металлом, а не синим. Им место в чёрно-белом сете.
- **Gut Knife | Doppler (Sapphire).** Да, Sapphire, но на Gut лезвие маленькое, а модель тёмная — в нашей базе он заметно хуже по совпадению, чем Shadow Daggers или Bayonet с той же отделкой.
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box.** Очень дорогие ([price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"]) и при этом фиолетово-синие: в синем сете они тянут гамму в фиолетовый.
- **Specialist Gloves | Fade, Sport Gloves | Superconductor, Specialist Gloves | Lt. Commander.** Есть синие элементы, но основной цвет другой — для синего сета это слабое совпадение.

## Если хочется дороже

- **AWP | Lightning Strike** — от [price name="AWP | Lightning Strike"]. Старая классика: фиолетово-синие молнии.

Главный совет для синего: экономь на пушках и вкладывай в нож. Синие стволы почти бесплатные и точные, а разница между инвентарями видна только по ножу. Все варианты — на страницах [синих скинов](/sinie-skiny-cs2/) и [синих перчаток](/sinie-perchatki-cs2/), а сеты в других цветах — в разделе [цветовые сеты скинов CS2](/cvetovye-sety-skinov-cs2/).

en.title: Blue CS2 Inventory: Three Ready-Made Skin Loadouts from $35 to $850
en.desc: A blue CS2 inventory on three budgets: guns for $35, a Cobalt Skulls loadout and a full set with Doppler Phase 4. Why Blue Steel isn't actually blue.
en.lead: Blue is the cheapest palette to get into: six color-accurate guns cost under $35. After that it all comes down to the knife and gloves — we break down three loadouts.
en.md:
Blue is the cheapest color to get into in CS2. You can put together six blue guns for less than a single knife in any other palette, and there are more accurate color matches among guns than you'd think. Blue only gets expensive on the knife and gloves, and there's a trap there too — names where "blue" is just a word.

We break down three ready-made loadouts and explain why Doppler Sapphire and Phase 4 are blue, while Blue Steel isn't.

## Where blue comes from in CS2

The blue palette has three pillars:

- **Doppler Sapphire and Doppler Phase 4.** Sapphire is one of the Doppler "gems": a solid, saturated blue with nothing mixed in. Phase 4 is a regular phase, blue with cyan and purple shimmers. Both only come in Factory New and Minimal Wear, so wear doesn't affect the look. Doppler prices depend heavily on the phase: regular phases cost about the same, while Sapphire is many times more expensive. Check the phase in the listing title.
- **Anodized blue** — Royal Blue, Blue Laminate, Blue Ply, Cobalt Disruption. These are a flat fill with no pattern: in-game they look brighter than in previews.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — essentially the only truly blue gloves. The other "blue" options are either purple or teal.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Sapphire);Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption"]

All blue knives by phase are collected on the [blue knives](/en/blue-knives-cs2/) page.

## Loadout under $35

About $30 for six guns — and almost all of them are very accurate color matches:

- **AK-47 | Blue Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Blue Laminate" wear="FT"]. Blue laminated wood; the bluest AK in the game, and cheap too.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"]. Dark blue with black, nicely tones down the brightness of the other guns.
- **AWP | Capillary** — [price name="AWP | Capillary" wear="FT"]. Blue "capillaries" on a dark base — a better color match than many expensive AWPs.
- **Desert Eagle | Blue Ply** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Blue Ply" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Royal Blue** — [price name="USP-S | Royal Blue" wear="FT"]. Pure royal blue, the reference point for the whole loadout.
- **Glock-18 | Sacrifice** — [price name="Glock-18 | Sacrifice" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Blue Laminate;M4A1-S | Nightmare;AWP | Capillary;Desert Eagle | Blue Ply;USP-S | Royal Blue;Glock-18 | Sacrifice"]

Why this loadout works: on five of the six guns, blue is the main color, not a detail. In first person you see the body's fill, so even the cheap Blue Ply and Royal Blue put more blue on screen than plenty of skins costing tens of dollars with blue inserts. Wear barely matters here either: in Field-Tested, anodized paint mostly wears off at the edges.

[cta color=1 budget=3000 text="Build a blue loadout for $35" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout under $330

About $310. We swap two guns and add gloves:

- **M4A4 | X-Ray** — [price name="M4A4 | X-Ray" wear="FT"]. A blue "X-ray" with visible internals — a noticeable upgrade over the Nightmare.
- **Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption" wear="FT"]. Deep blue metallic, one of the most accurate skins in the palette.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — [price name="Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls" wear="FT"]. Blue wraps with skulls that show up in every animation.
- The AK Blue Laminate, AWP Capillary, USP Royal Blue and Glock Sacrifice stay.

[skins names="M4A4 | X-Ray;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption;Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;USP-S | Royal Blue"]

Want a knife instead of gloves? Cheaper than Cobalt Skulls is the **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)**: from [price name="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. The most affordable blue Doppler, even if it's on an unpopular model. Sapphire on the same daggers is a "gem" and costs many times more than a regular phase. Among gloves, only **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** ([price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"]) are cheaper than Cobalt Skulls, but they lean purple and only fit if your loadout has the Glock Sacrifice or AK Baroque Purple.

[cta color=1 budget=30000 text="Build a blue loadout for $330" btn="Open the builder"]

## Knife and gloves loadout under $850

About $840. We add a knife to the mid-range guns and swap the Glock for the most "cosmic" blue pistol:

- **Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)** — from [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. Phase 4 is blue with shimmers; the Bayonet's blade is large, so the color reads perfectly.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — they stay.
- **Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy** — [price name="Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy" wear="FT"]. A sparkly blue galaxy that rhymes nicely with the Doppler's shimmer.

An alternative at the same price is the **Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)**, from [price name="Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)"].

[skins names="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy;Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls"]

[cta color=1 budget=76000 text="Build a blue loadout for $850" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout comparison

| Budget | What's included | Total |
|---|---|---|
| Under $35 | Blue Laminate, M4A1-S Nightmare, Capillary, Blue Ply, Royal Blue, Sacrifice | ≈ $30 |
| Under $330 | Blue Laminate, M4A4 X-Ray, Capillary, Cobalt Disruption, Royal Blue, Sacrifice + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ $310 |
| Under $850 | Mid-range guns, Glock Twilight Galaxy + Bayonet Doppler Phase 4 + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ $840 |

Totals are based on prices as of October 15, 2026; every item in the text above has a live price.

## What to avoid

- **Blue Steel.** Despite the name, it's grey blued steel: Karambit | Blue Steel ([price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]) and Bowie Knife | Blue Steel look like metal in-game, not blue. They belong in a black and white loadout.
- **Gut Knife | Doppler (Sapphire).** Yes, it's Sapphire, but the Gut's blade is small and the model is dark — in our database it's a noticeably worse match than Shadow Daggers or a Bayonet with the same finish.
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box.** Very expensive ([price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"]) and purple-blue on top of that: in a blue loadout they pull the palette toward purple.
- **Specialist Gloves | Fade, Sport Gloves | Superconductor, Specialist Gloves | Lt. Commander.** They have blue elements, but the main color is something else — a weak match for a blue loadout.
- **AK-47 | Vulcan and AK-47 | Point Disarray.** Blue in previews, but in hand they're light blue with white and a lot of black. They clash with Royal Blue.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** — iconic, but its Field-Tested price ([price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]) is way out of proportion to how "blue" it actually is.

## If you want to go bigger

- **Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)** — [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)"]. The game's ultimate blue knife.
- **M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)** — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)"].
- **M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor** — from [price name="M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor"]. Glowing blue for the M4A1-S, only available in good wear.
- **AWP | Lightning Strike** — from [price name="AWP | Lightning Strike"]. An old classic: purple-blue lightning.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire);M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire);M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor;AWP | Lightning Strike"]

The key tip for blue: save on the guns and invest in the knife. Blue guns are nearly free and accurate, and the difference between inventories only shows in the knife. All options are on the [blue CS2 skins](/en/blue-cs2-skins/) and [blue gloves](/en/blue-gloves-cs2/) pages, and loadouts in other colors are in the [CS2 skin sets by color](/en/cs2-skin-sets-by-color/) section.

de.title: Blaue CS2 Skins: drei fertige Inventar-Sets von 35 bis 840 €
de.desc: Blaues CS2-Inventar in drei Budgets: Waffen für 35 €, Set mit Cobalt Skulls und Komplett-Loadout mit Doppler Phase 4. Warum Blue Steel nicht blau ist.
de.lead: Blau ist die günstigste Farbwelt zum Einstieg: Sechs farbgenaue Waffen kosten unter 35 €. Danach entscheiden Messer und Handschuhe – wir gehen drei Sets durch.
de.md:
Blau ist in CS2 die Farbe mit dem günstigsten Einstieg. Sechs blaue Waffen bekommst du billiger als ein einziges Messer in jeder anderen Farbwelt, und präzise Farbtreffer gibt es bei den Waffen mehr, als man denkt. Teuer wird Blau erst bei Messer und Handschuhen – und dort lauert eine eigene Falle: Namen, in denen „blau“ nur ein Wort ist.

Wir gehen drei fertige Sets durch und erklären, warum Doppler Sapphire und Phase 4 blau sind, Blue Steel aber nicht.

## Woher in CS2 das Blau kommt

Die blaue Farbwelt steht auf drei Säulen:

- **Doppler Sapphire und Doppler Phase 4.** Sapphire ist einer der „Edelsteine“ des Doppler: einfarbiges, sattes Blau ohne Beimischungen. Phase 4 ist eine normale Phase, blau mit hellblauen und lila Reflexen. Beide gibt es nur in Factory New und Minimal Wear, der Zustand spielt optisch also keine Rolle. Der Doppler-Preis hängt stark von der Phase ab: Normale Phasen kosten ungefähr gleich viel, Sapphire ein Vielfaches. Prüf die Phase im Angebotstitel.
- **Eloxiertes Blau** – Royal Blue, Blue Laminate, Blue Ply, Cobalt Disruption. Gleichmäßige Lackierung ohne Muster: Im Spiel wirken diese Skins kräftiger als in der Vorschau.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** – im Grunde die einzigen wirklich blauen Handschuhe. Die übrigen „blauen“ Optionen sind entweder lila oder türkis.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Sapphire);Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption"]

Alle blauen Messer nach Phasen findest du auf der Seite mit [blauen CS2 Skins](/de/blaue-cs2-skins/).

## Set bis 35 €

Rund 25 € für sechs Waffen – und fast alle mit sehr präzisem Farbtreffer:

- **AK-47 | Blue Laminate** – [price name="AK-47 | Blue Laminate" wear="FT"]. Blau laminiertes Holz; die blaueste AK im Spiel und trotzdem günstig.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** – [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"]. Dunkelblau mit Schwarz, dämpft die Helligkeit der übrigen Waffen angenehm.
- **AWP | Capillary** – [price name="AWP | Capillary" wear="FT"]. Blaue „Kapillaren“ auf dunklem Grund – farblich besser als viele teure AWPs.
- **Desert Eagle | Blue Ply** – [price name="Desert Eagle | Blue Ply" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Royal Blue** – [price name="USP-S | Royal Blue" wear="FT"]. Reines Königsblau, die Referenz für das ganze Set.
- **Glock-18 | Sacrifice** – [price name="Glock-18 | Sacrifice" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Blue Laminate;M4A1-S | Nightmare;AWP | Capillary;Desert Eagle | Blue Ply;USP-S | Royal Blue;Glock-18 | Sacrifice"]

Warum das Set funktioniert: Bei fünf von sechs Waffen ist Blau die Hauptfarbe, nicht nur ein Detail. Aus der Ego-Perspektive siehst du vor allem die Lackierung des Gehäuses – deshalb bringen selbst die günstigen Blue Ply und Royal Blue mehr Blau auf den Bildschirm als viele Skins für mehrere Dutzend Euro mit blauen Einsätzen. Auch der Zustand ist hier fast egal: Eloxierte Farbe reibt sich in Field-Tested vor allem an den Kanten ab.

[cta color=1 budget=3000 text="Blaues Set für 35 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set bis 330 €

Rund 310 €. Wir tauschen zwei Waffen und nehmen Handschuhe dazu:

- **M4A4 | X-Ray** – [price name="M4A4 | X-Ray" wear="FT"]. Blaues „Röntgenbild“ mit sichtbarer Mechanik – ein deutliches Upgrade gegenüber der Nightmare.
- **Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption** – [price name="Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption" wear="FT"]. Tiefes Blau-Metallic, einer der präzisesten Skins der Farbwelt.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** – [price name="Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls" wear="FT"]. Blaue Bandagen mit Totenköpfen, die in jeder Animation zu sehen sind.
- AK Blue Laminate, AWP Capillary, USP Royal Blue und Glock Sacrifice bleiben.

[skins names="M4A4 | X-Ray;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption;Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;USP-S | Royal Blue"]

Lieber ein Messer statt Handschuhen? Günstiger als Cobalt Skulls sind die **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)**: ab [price name="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. Der günstigste blaue Doppler, wenn auch auf einem wenig beliebten Modell. Sapphire auf denselben Messern ist ein „Edelstein“ und kostet ein Vielfaches der normalen Phase. Bei den Handschuhen sind nur die **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** ([price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"]) günstiger als Cobalt Skulls, aber die sind eher lila und passen, wenn im Set eine Glock Sacrifice oder AK Baroque Purple steckt.

[cta color=1 budget=30000 text="Blaues Set für 330 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set mit Messer und Handschuhen bis 840 €

Rund 840 €. Zu den Waffen aus dem mittleren Set kommt ein Messer, und die Glock tauschen wir gegen die „kosmischste“ blaue Pistole:

- **Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)** – ab [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. Phase 4 ist Blau mit Schimmer; beim Bayonet ist die Klinge groß, die Farbe kommt hervorragend zur Geltung.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** – bleiben.
- **Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy** – [price name="Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy" wear="FT"]. Blaue Galaxie mit Glitzer, harmoniert gut mit dem Doppler-Schimmer.

Eine Alternative zum selben Preis: **Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)**, ab [price name="Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)"].

[skins names="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy;Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls"]

[cta color=1 budget=76000 text="Blaues Set für 840 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Die Sets im Vergleich

| Budget | Inhalt | Gesamt |
|---|---|---|
| Bis 35 € | Blue Laminate, M4A1-S Nightmare, Capillary, Blue Ply, Royal Blue, Sacrifice | ≈ 25 € |
| Bis 330 € | Blue Laminate, M4A4 X-Ray, Capillary, Cobalt Disruption, Royal Blue, Sacrifice + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ 310 € |
| Bis 840 € | Waffen aus dem mittleren Set, Glock Twilight Galaxy + Bayonet Doppler Phase 4 + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ 840 € |

Die Summen basieren auf den Preisen vom 15. Oktober 2026; die Preise der einzelnen Items oben im Text sind live.

## Was du vermeiden solltest

- **Blue Steel.** Trotz des Namens ist das grauer, brünierter Stahl: Karambit | Blue Steel ([price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]) und Bowie Knife | Blue Steel wirken im Spiel metallisch, nicht blau. Die gehören ins schwarz-weiße Set.
- **Gut Knife | Doppler (Sapphire).** Ja, Sapphire – aber beim Gut ist die Klinge klein und das Modell dunkel; in unserer Datenbank ist der Farbtreffer deutlich schlechter als bei Shadow Daggers oder Bayonet mit demselben Finish.
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box.** Sehr teuer ([price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"]) und dabei lila-blau: Im blauen Set ziehen sie die Farbwelt ins Lila.
- **Specialist Gloves | Fade, Sport Gloves | Superconductor, Specialist Gloves | Lt. Commander.** Blaue Elemente sind da, die Hauptfarbe ist aber eine andere – für ein blaues Set ein schwacher Treffer.
- **AK-47 | Vulcan und AK-47 | Point Disarray.** In der Vorschau blau, in der Hand hellblau mit Weiß und viel Schwarz. Beißen sich mit Royal Blue.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** – Kult, aber der Preis in Field-Tested ([price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]) steht in keinem Verhältnis dazu, wie „blau“ er ist.

## Wenn es teurer sein darf

- **Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)** – [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)"]. Das blaue Messer des Spiels schlechthin.
- **M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)** – [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)"].
- **M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor** – ab [price name="M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor"]. Leuchtendes Blau für die M4A1-S, nur in gutem Zustand erhältlich.
- **AWP | Lightning Strike** – ab [price name="AWP | Lightning Strike"]. Ein alter Klassiker: lila-blaue Blitze.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire);M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire);M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor;AWP | Lightning Strike"]

Der wichtigste Tipp für Blau: Spar bei den Waffen und investier ins Messer. Blaue Waffen sind fast umsonst und farbgenau, den Unterschied zwischen Inventaren sieht man nur am Messer. Alle Optionen inklusive Handschuhen findest du auf der Seite mit [blauen CS2 Skins](/de/blaue-cs2-skins/), Sets in anderen Farben im Bereich [Farb-Sets für CS2-Skins](/de/).

pt.title: Inventário azul no CS2: três sets de skins de R$ 180 a R$ 4.600
pt.desc: Inventário azul no CS2 em três orçamentos: armas por R$ 180, set com Cobalt Skulls e kit completo com Doppler Phase 4. Por que a Blue Steel não é azul.
pt.lead: Azul é a paleta mais barata para começar: seis armas com cor exata custam menos de R$ 180. Daí em diante, tudo depende da faca e das luvas — vamos aos três sets.
pt.md:
Azul é a cor mais barata para começar no CS2. Dá para montar seis armas azuis por menos do que uma faca em qualquer outra paleta, e há mais matches de cor precisos entre as armas do que parece. O azul só fica caro na faca e nas luvas, e ali existe uma armadilha própria — nomes em que o "azul" é só a palavra.

Vamos destrinchar três sets prontos e explicar por que Doppler Sapphire e Phase 4 são azuis, e a Blue Steel não.

## De onde vem o azul no CS2

A paleta azul tem três pilares:

- **Doppler Sapphire e Doppler Phase 4.** A Sapphire é uma das "gemas" da Doppler: azul saturado e uniforme, sem mistura. A Phase 4 é uma fase comum, azul com reflexos celestes e roxos. As duas só existem em Factory New e Minimal Wear, então o desgaste não muda a aparência. O preço da Doppler depende muito da fase: as fases comuns custam mais ou menos o mesmo, já a Sapphire custa várias vezes mais. Confira a fase no nome do anúncio.
- **Azul anodizado** — Royal Blue, Blue Laminate, Blue Ply, Cobalt Disruption. É cor chapada, sem desenho: no jogo, essas skins parecem mais vivas do que na prévia.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — na prática, as únicas luvas realmente azuis. As outras opções "azuis" são roxas ou turquesa.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Sapphire);Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption"]

Todas as facas azuis por fase estão reunidas na página de [skins azuis](/pt/skins-azuis-cs2/).

## Set até R$ 180

Cerca de R$ 150 por seis armas — e quase todas com acerto de cor muito preciso:

- **AK-47 | Blue Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Blue Laminate" wear="FT"]. Madeira laminada azul; a AK mais azul do jogo e, ainda assim, barata.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"]. Azul-escuro com preto, equilibra bem o brilho das outras armas.
- **AWP | Capillary** — [price name="AWP | Capillary" wear="FT"]. "Capilares" azuis sobre fundo escuro — match de cor melhor do que o de muitas AWPs caras.
- **Desert Eagle | Blue Ply** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Blue Ply" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Royal Blue** — [price name="USP-S | Royal Blue" wear="FT"]. Azul royal puro, a referência de todo o set.
- **Glock-18 | Sacrifice** — [price name="Glock-18 | Sacrifice" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Blue Laminate;M4A1-S | Nightmare;AWP | Capillary;Desert Eagle | Blue Ply;USP-S | Royal Blue;Glock-18 | Sacrifice"]

Por que esse set funciona: em cinco das seis armas, o azul é a cor principal, não um detalhe. Em primeira pessoa você vê justamente a pintura do corpo, então até as baratas Blue Ply e Royal Blue colocam mais azul na tela do que muitas skins de centenas de reais com detalhes azuis. O desgaste aqui também quase não importa: a tinta anodizada em Field-Tested se gasta principalmente nas bordas.

[cta color=1 budget=3000 text="Montar set azul por R$ 180" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set até R$ 1.800

Cerca de R$ 1.700. Trocamos duas armas e adicionamos luvas:

- **M4A4 | X-Ray** — [price name="M4A4 | X-Ray" wear="FT"]. "Raio-X" azul com o mecanismo à mostra — um upgrade visível sobre a Nightmare.
- **Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption" wear="FT"]. Azul metálico profundo, uma das skins mais precisas da paleta.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — [price name="Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls" wear="FT"]. Faixas azuis com caveiras, que aparecem em toda animação.
- AK Blue Laminate, AWP Capillary, USP Royal Blue e Glock Sacrifice continuam.

[skins names="M4A4 | X-Ray;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption;Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;USP-S | Royal Blue"]

Quer faca em vez de luvas? Mais barata que as Cobalt Skulls é a **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)**: a partir de [price name="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. É a Doppler azul mais acessível, ainda que num modelo pouco popular. A Sapphire nessas mesmas facas é "gema" e custa várias vezes mais que uma fase comum. Entre as luvas, mais baratas que as Cobalt Skulls só as **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** ([price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"]), mas elas puxam mais para o roxo e servem se o set tiver a Glock Sacrifice ou a AK Baroque Purple.

[cta color=1 budget=30000 text="Montar set azul por R$ 1.800" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set com faca e luvas até R$ 4.600

Cerca de R$ 4.600. Às armas do set médio adicionamos uma faca e trocamos a Glock pela pistola azul mais "cósmica":

- **Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)** — a partir de [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. A Phase 4 é azul com reflexos; na Bayonet a lâmina é grande e a cor aparece muito bem.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — continuam.
- **Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy** — [price name="Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy" wear="FT"]. Galáxia azul com brilhos, conversa bem com os reflexos da Doppler.

Alternativa no mesmo preço — **Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)**, a partir de [price name="Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)"].

[skins names="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy;Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls"]

[cta color=1 budget=76000 text="Montar set azul por R$ 4.600" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Comparação dos sets

| Orçamento | O que entra | Total |
|---|---|---|
| Até R$ 180 | Blue Laminate, M4A1-S Nightmare, Capillary, Blue Ply, Royal Blue, Sacrifice | ≈ R$ 150 |
| Até R$ 1.800 | Blue Laminate, M4A4 X-Ray, Capillary, Cobalt Disruption, Royal Blue, Sacrifice + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ R$ 1.700 |
| Até R$ 4.600 | Armas do set médio, Glock Twilight Galaxy + Bayonet Doppler Phase 4 + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ R$ 4.600 |

Valores com os preços de 15 de outubro de 2026; cada item no texto acima tem preço ao vivo.

## O que evitar
