- **Blue Steel.** Apesar do nome, é aço oxidado cinza: a Karambit | Blue Steel ([price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]) e a Bowie Knife | Blue Steel parecem metal no jogo, não azul. O lugar delas é num set preto e branco.
- **Gut Knife | Doppler (Sapphire).** Sim, é Sapphire, mas a lâmina da Gut é pequena e o modelo é escuro — na nossa base, o match dela é bem pior que o das Shadow Daggers ou da Bayonet com o mesmo acabamento.
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box.** Caríssimas ([price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"]) e, ainda por cima, roxo-azuladas: num set azul, puxam a paleta para o roxo.
- **Specialist Gloves | Fade, Sport Gloves | Superconductor, Specialist Gloves | Lt. Commander.** Têm elementos azuis, mas a cor principal é outra — para um set azul, o match é fraco.
- **AK-47 | Vulcan e AK-47 | Point Disarray.** Na prévia são azuis; na mão, são azul-claro com branco e muito preto. Brigam com a Royal Blue.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** — cult, mas o preço em Field-Tested ([price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]) não tem nada a ver com o quanto ela é "azul".

## Se quiser gastar mais

- **Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)** — [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)"]. A principal faca azul do jogo.
- **M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)** — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)"].
- **M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor** — a partir de [price name="M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor"]. Azul brilhante para a M4A1-S, só existe com desgaste bom.
- **AWP | Lightning Strike** — a partir de [price name="AWP | Lightning Strike"]. Um clássico antigo: raios roxo-azulados.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire);M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire);M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor;AWP | Lightning Strike"]

A principal dica para o azul: economize nas armas e invista na faca. As armas azuis são quase de graça e precisas, e a diferença entre inventários só aparece na faca. Todas as opções de skins e luvas estão na página de [skins azuis do CS2](/pt/skins-azuis-cs2/), e os sets de outras cores na seção de [sets de skins por cor do CS2](/pt/).

tr.title: Mavi CS2 envanteri: $35'ten $840'a üç hazır skin seti
tr.desc: Üç bütçede mavi CS2 envanteri: $35'e silahlar, Cobalt Skulls'lu set ve Doppler Phase 4'lü tam takım. Blue Steel neden mavi değil.
tr.lead: Mavi, girişi en ucuz renk: renge tam oturan altı silah $35'ten az. Sonrasını bıçak ve eldiven belirliyor — üç seti inceliyoruz.
tr.md:
Mavi, CS2'de girişi en ucuz renk. Altı mavi silahı başka herhangi bir renkteki tek bir bıçaktan daha ucuza toplayabilirsin, silahlarda tona tam oturan seçenek de sandığından fazla. Mavi ancak bıçak ve eldivende pahalılaşıyor, orada da kendi tuzağı var — "mavisi" sadece isminde olan kaplamalar.

Üç hazır seti inceliyor ve Doppler Sapphire ile Phase 4'ün neden mavi olduğunu, Blue Steel'in ise neden olmadığını açıklıyoruz.

## CS2'de mavi nereden gelir

Mavi renk grubunun üç direği var:

- **Doppler Sapphire ve Doppler Phase 4.** Sapphire, Doppler'ın "taşlarından" biri: katışıksız, tek tonlu doygun mavi. Phase 4 sıradan bir faz; açık mavi ve mor yansımalı mavi. İkisi de yalnızca Factory New ve Minimal Wear olarak çıkar, yani aşınma görünümü etkilemez. Doppler'da fiyat büyük ölçüde faza bağlı: sıradan fazlar aşağı yukarı aynı fiyatta, Sapphire ise kat kat pahalı. İlan adındaki fazı kontrol et.
- **Anodize mavi** — Royal Blue, Blue Laminate, Blue Ply, Cobalt Disruption. Desensiz düz bir boya: oyunda bu skinler önizlemeden daha parlak görünür.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — aslında gerçekten mavi olan tek eldiven. Diğer "mavi" seçenekler ya mor ya turkuaz.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Sapphire);Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption"]

Fazlarına göre tüm mavi bıçaklar [mavi bıçaklar](/tr/mavi-cs2-skinleri/) sayfasında toplandı.

## $35'e kadar set

Altı silah için yaklaşık $27 — ve neredeyse hepsi renge çok isabetli oturuyor:

- **AK-47 | Blue Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Blue Laminate" wear="FT"]. Mavi lamine ahşap; oyundaki en mavi AK ve üstelik ucuz.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"]. Siyahlı lacivert, diğer silahların parlaklığını iyi dengeliyor.
- **AWP | Capillary** — [price name="AWP | Capillary" wear="FT"]. Koyu zemin üzerinde mavi "kılcal damarlar" — renk eşleşmesi birçok pahalı AWP'den iyi.
- **Desert Eagle | Blue Ply** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Blue Ply" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Royal Blue** — [price name="USP-S | Royal Blue" wear="FT"]. Saf kraliyet mavisi, bütün setin referansı.
- **Glock-18 | Sacrifice** — [price name="Glock-18 | Sacrifice" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Blue Laminate;M4A1-S | Nightmare;AWP | Capillary;Desert Eagle | Blue Ply;USP-S | Royal Blue;Glock-18 | Sacrifice"]

Bu set neden işe yarıyor: altı silahın beşinde mavi bir detay değil ana renk. Birinci şahıs görünümünde gördüğün tam olarak gövdenin boyası, bu yüzden ucuz Blue Ply ve Royal Blue bile ekranda, mavi ekleri olan onlarca dolarlık birçok skinden daha fazla mavi veriyor. Aşınma da burada pek önemli değil: anodize boya Field-Tested'da çoğunlukla kenarlardan siliniyor.

[cta color=1 budget=3000 text="Mavi seti $35'e topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## $330'a kadar set

Yaklaşık $310. İki silahı değiştirip eldiven ekliyoruz:

- **M4A4 | X-Ray** — [price name="M4A4 | X-Ray" wear="FT"]. Mekanizması görünen mavi bir "röntgen" — Nightmare'e göre belirgin bir yükseltme.
- **Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption" wear="FT"]. Derin mavi metalik, renk grubunun en isabetli skinlerinden biri.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — [price name="Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls" wear="FT"]. Her animasyonda görünen kurukafalı mavi sargılar.
- AK Blue Laminate, AWP Capillary, USP Royal Blue ve Glock Sacrifice kalıyor.

[skins names="M4A4 | X-Ray;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption;Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;USP-S | Royal Blue"]

Eldiven yerine bıçak istiyorsan, Cobalt Skulls'tan ucuz bir seçenek var: **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)** — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)"]'dan başlıyor. Popüler olmayan bir modelde olsa da en uygun fiyatlı mavi Doppler. Aynı bıçaklarda Sapphire bir "taş" ve sıradan fazdan kat kat pahalı. Eldivenlerde Cobalt Skulls'tan ucuz olan tek seçenek **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** ([price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"]), ama onlar daha çok mor; sette Glock Sacrifice ya da AK Baroque Purple varsa uyar.

[cta color=1 budget=30000 text="Mavi seti $330'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Bıçak ve eldivenli set, $840'a kadar

Yaklaşık $840. Orta setin silahlarına bir bıçak ekliyor, Glock'u da en "kozmik" mavi tabancayla değiştiriyoruz:

- **Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)** — [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)"]'dan başlıyor. Phase 4, yansımalı mavi; Bayonet'te bıçak ağzı büyük ve renk çok iyi okunuyor.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — kalıyor.
- **Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy** — [price name="Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy" wear="FT"]. Simli mavi galaksi, Doppler'ın yansımalarıyla güzel kafiyeleniyor.

Aynı fiyatta alternatif — **Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)**, [price name="Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)"]'dan başlıyor.

[skins names="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy;Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls"]

[cta color=1 budget=76000 text="Mavi seti $840'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Setlerin karşılaştırması

| Bütçe | İçerik | Toplam |
|---|---|---|
| $35'e kadar | Blue Laminate, M4A1-S Nightmare, Capillary, Blue Ply, Royal Blue, Sacrifice | ≈ $27 |
| $330'a kadar | Blue Laminate, M4A4 X-Ray, Capillary, Cobalt Disruption, Royal Blue, Sacrifice + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ $310 |
| $840'a kadar | Orta setin silahları, Glock Twilight Galaxy + Bayonet Doppler Phase 4 + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ $840 |

Tutarlar 15 Ekim 2026 fiyatlarına göre; yukarıdaki metinde her eşyanın fiyatı canlı.

## Nelerden kaçınmalı

- **Blue Steel.** İsmine rağmen gri, karartılmış çelik: Karambit | Blue Steel ([price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]) ve Bowie Knife | Blue Steel oyunda mavi değil metal gibi görünür. Onların yeri siyah-beyaz set.
- **Gut Knife | Doppler (Sapphire).** Evet, Sapphire, ama Gut'ta bıçak ağzı küçük, model de koyu — veritabanımızda aynı kaplamalı Shadow Daggers ya da Bayonet'ten belirgin şekilde daha zayıf eşleşiyor.
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box.** Çok pahalı ([price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"]) ve üstelik mor-mavi: mavi sette renk grubunu mora çekiyor.
- **Specialist Gloves | Fade, Sport Gloves | Superconductor, Specialist Gloves | Lt. Commander.** Mavi öğeleri var ama ana renkleri başka — mavi set için zayıf eşleşme.
- **AK-47 | Vulcan ve AK-47 | Point Disarray.** Önizlemede mavi, elde ise bolca siyahla açık mavi-beyaz. Royal Blue ile çatışıyorlar.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** — kült bir skin, ama Field-Tested fiyatı ([price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]) ne kadar "mavi" olduğuyla orantısız.

## Bütçen daha yüksekse

- **Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)** — [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)"]. Oyunun baş mavi bıçağı.
- **M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)** — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)"].
- **M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor** — [price name="M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor"]'dan başlıyor. M4A1-S için parlayan mavi, yalnızca iyi aşınmada çıkıyor.
- **AWP | Lightning Strike** — [price name="AWP | Lightning Strike"]'dan başlıyor. Eski bir klasik: mor-mavi şimşekler.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire);M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire);M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor;AWP | Lightning Strike"]

Mavi için ana tavsiye: silahlarda tasarruf et, bıçağa yatır. Mavi silahlar neredeyse bedava ve isabetli; envanterler arasındaki fark yalnızca bıçakta görünüyor. Eldivenler dahil tüm seçenekler [mavi CS2 skinleri](/tr/mavi-cs2-skinleri/) sayfasında, diğer renklerdeki setler ise [CS2 renk setleri](/tr/) bölümünde.

pl.title: Niebieski ekwipunek CS2: trzy gotowe sety od 130 do 3 400 zł
pl.desc: Niebieski ekwipunek CS2 w trzech budżetach: spluwy za 130 zł, set z Cobalt Skulls i pełny komplet z Doppler Phase 4. Czemu Blue Steel nie jest niebieski.
pl.lead: Niebieski to najtańsza paleta na start: sześć celnych kolorystycznie spluw kosztuje mniej niż 130 zł. Dalej o wszystkim decydują nóż i rękawice — rozbieramy trzy sety.
pl.md:
Niebieski to najtańszy na start kolor w CS2. Sześć niebieskich spluw złożysz taniej niż jeden nóż w dowolnej innej palecie, a celnych trafień kolorystycznych wśród broni jest więcej, niż się wydaje. Drogi niebieski robi się dopiero na nożu i rękawicach, i tam czeka własna pułapka — nazwy, w których „niebieskie” jest tylko słowo.

Rozbieramy trzy gotowe sety i wyjaśniamy, czemu Doppler Sapphire i Phase 4 to niebieski, a Blue Steel — nie.

## Skąd w CS2 bierze się niebieski

Niebieska paleta ma trzy filary:

- **Doppler Sapphire i Doppler Phase 4.** Sapphire to jeden z „kamieni” Dopplera: jednolity, nasycony niebieski bez domieszek. Phase 4 to zwykła faza, niebieska z błękitnymi i fioletowymi przebłyskami. Obie występują tylko w Factory New i Minimal Wear, więc wear nie wpływa na wygląd. Cena Dopplera mocno zależy od fazy: zwykłe fazy kosztują mniej więcej tyle samo, a Sapphire — kilka razy więcej. Sprawdzaj fazę w nazwie oferty.
- **Anodowany niebieski** — Royal Blue, Blue Laminate, Blue Ply, Cobalt Disruption. To równe wypełnienie bez wzoru: w grze takie skiny wyglądają jaskrawiej niż na podglądzie.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — w zasadzie jedyne naprawdę niebieskie rękawice. Pozostałe „niebieskie” opcje są albo fioletowe, albo turkusowe.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Sapphire);Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption"]

Wszystkie niebieskie noże według faz zebraliśmy na stronie [niebieskich noży](/pl/niebieskie-skiny-cs2/).

## Set do 130 zł

Około 110 zł za sześć spluw — i prawie wszystkie z bardzo celnym trafieniem w kolor:

- **AK-47 | Blue Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Blue Laminate" wear="FT"]. Niebieskie laminowane drewno; najbardziej niebieski AK w grze, a przy tym niedrogi.
- **M4A1-S | Nightmare** — [price name="M4A1-S | Nightmare" wear="FT"]. Granat z czernią, dobrze tłumi jaskrawość pozostałych spluw.
- **AWP | Capillary** — [price name="AWP | Capillary" wear="FT"]. Niebieskie „naczynka” na ciemnym tle — dopasowanie kolorystyczne lepsze niż u wielu drogich AWP.
- **Desert Eagle | Blue Ply** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Blue Ply" wear="FT"].
- **USP-S | Royal Blue** — [price name="USP-S | Royal Blue" wear="FT"]. Czysty królewski niebieski, wzorzec dla całego setu.
- **Glock-18 | Sacrifice** — [price name="Glock-18 | Sacrifice" wear="FT"].

[skins names="AK-47 | Blue Laminate;M4A1-S | Nightmare;AWP | Capillary;Desert Eagle | Blue Ply;USP-S | Royal Blue;Glock-18 | Sacrifice"]

Dlaczego taki set działa: w pięciu z sześciu spluw niebieski to główny kolor, a nie detal. Z perspektywy pierwszej osoby widzisz właśnie wypełnienie korpusu, dlatego nawet tanie Blue Ply i Royal Blue dają więcej niebieskiego na ekranie niż wiele skinów za kilkadziesiąt dolarów z niebieskimi wstawkami. Wear też prawie nie ma tu znaczenia: anodowana farba w Field-Tested ściera się głównie na krawędziach.

[cta color=1 budget=3000 text="Złóż niebieski set za 130 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Set do 1 300 zł

Około 1 200 zł. Wymieniamy dwie spluwy i dokładamy rękawice:

- **M4A4 | X-Ray** — [price name="M4A4 | X-Ray" wear="FT"]. Niebieski „rentgen” z widoczną mechaniką — wyraźny upgrade względem Nightmare.
- **Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption" wear="FT"]. Głęboki niebieski metalik, jeden z najcelniejszych skinów w palecie.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — [price name="Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls" wear="FT"]. Niebieskie owijki z czaszkami, widoczne w każdej animacji.
- AK Blue Laminate, AWP Capillary, USP Royal Blue i Glock Sacrifice zostają.

[skins names="M4A4 | X-Ray;Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption;Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls;USP-S | Royal Blue"]

Wolisz nóż zamiast rękawic — taniej niż Cobalt Skulls wychodzi **Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)**: od [price name="Shadow Daggers | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. Najtańszy niebieski Doppler, choć na mało popularnym modelu. Sapphire na tych samych nożach to „kamień” i kosztuje kilka razy więcej niż zwykła faza. Z rękawic tańsze od Cobalt Skulls są tylko **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** ([price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"]), ale są raczej fioletowe i pasują, jeśli w secie jest Glock Sacrifice albo AK Baroque Purple.

[cta color=1 budget=30000 text="Złóż niebieski set za 1 300 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Set z nożem i rękawicami do 3 400 zł

Około 3 400 zł. Do spluw ze średniego setu dokładamy nóż, a Glocka zamieniamy na najbardziej „kosmiczny” niebieski pistolet:

- **Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)** — od [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4)"]. Phase 4 to niebieski z przebłyskami; na Bayonecie ostrze jest duże i kolor czyta się świetnie.
- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** — zostają.
- **Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy** — [price name="Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy" wear="FT"]. Niebieska galaktyka z brokatem, dobrze rymuje się z przebłyskami Dopplera.

Alternatywa w tej samej cenie — **Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)**, od [price name="Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4)"].

[skins names="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 4);Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy;Falchion Knife | Doppler (Phase 4);Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls"]

[cta color=1 budget=76000 text="Złóż niebieski set za 3 400 zł" btn="Otwórz kreator"]

## Porównanie setów

| Budżet | Co wchodzi | Razem |
|---|---|---|
| Do 130 zł | Blue Laminate, M4A1-S Nightmare, Capillary, Blue Ply, Royal Blue, Sacrifice | ≈ 110 zł |
| Do 1 300 zł | Blue Laminate, M4A4 X-Ray, Capillary, Cobalt Disruption, Royal Blue, Sacrifice + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ 1 200 zł |
| Do 3 400 zł | Spluwy ze średniego setu, Glock Twilight Galaxy + Bayonet Doppler Phase 4 + Cobalt Skulls | ≈ 3 400 zł |

Sumy według cen z 15 października 2026 roku, a przy każdym przedmiocie w tekście powyżej cena jest aktualna.

## Czego unikać

- **Blue Steel.** Wbrew nazwie to szara oksydowana stal: Karambit | Blue Steel ([price name="Karambit | Blue Steel" wear="FT"]) i Bowie Knife | Blue Steel wyglądają w grze jak metal, a nie niebieski. Ich miejsce jest w czarno-białym secie.
- **Gut Knife | Doppler (Sapphire).** Tak, Sapphire, ale na Gut ostrze jest małe, a model ciemny — w naszej bazie ma wyraźnie gorsze dopasowanie niż Shadow Daggers czy Bayonet z tym samym wykończeniem.
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box.** Bardzo drogie ([price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"]), a przy tym fioletowo-niebieskie: w niebieskim secie ciągną paletę w fiolet.
- **Specialist Gloves | Fade, Sport Gloves | Superconductor, Specialist Gloves | Lt. Commander.** Mają niebieskie elementy, ale główny kolor jest inny — do niebieskiego setu to słabe dopasowanie.
- **AK-47 | Vulcan i AK-47 | Point Disarray.** Na podglądzie niebieskie, w dłoni — błękit z bielą i dużą ilością czerni. Gryzą się z Royal Blue.
- **M4A4 | Poseidon** — kultowy, ale cena w Field-Tested ([price name="M4A4 | Poseidon" wear="FT"]) jest nieporównywalna z tym, jak bardzo jest „niebieski”.

## Jeśli chcesz drożej

- **Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)** — [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire)"]. Główny niebieski nóż w grze.
- **M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)** — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire)"].
- **M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor** — od [price name="M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor"]. Świecący niebieski na M4A1-S, występuje tylko w dobrym wearze.
- **AWP | Lightning Strike** — od [price name="AWP | Lightning Strike"]. Stara klasyka: fioletowo-niebieskie błyskawice.

[skins names="Karambit | Doppler (Sapphire);M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Sapphire);M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor;AWP | Lightning Strike"]

Najważniejsza rada w niebieskim: oszczędzaj na spluwach i inwestuj w nóż. Niebieskie spluwy są prawie darmowe i celne, a różnicę między ekwipunkami widać tylko po nożu. Wszystkie opcje, w tym rękawice, znajdziesz na stronie [niebieskich skinów](/pl/niebieskie-skiny-cs2/), a sety w innych kolorach — w dziale [kolorowe sety skinów CS2](/pl/).

title: Зелёный инвентарь CS2: от Hydra Emerald до Gamma Doppler, три сета
desc: Как собрать зелёный инвентарь в CS2: Hydra Gloves Emerald, ножи Gamma Doppler, змеиные Deagle. Три сета от 3 500 до 80 000 ₽.
lead: В зелёном сете дешевле всего закрываются перчатки, а сложнее всего — AK и Glock. Разбираем три сета вокруг изумрудных перчаток и Gamma Doppler.
md:
С зелёным в CS2 всё устроено наоборот по сравнению с большинством цветов. Обычно перчатки — самая дорогая и самая дефицитная часть сета, а здесь именно они закрываются дешевле всего: Hydra Gloves | Emerald попадают в оттенок почти идеально и стоят как пара средних скинов на оружие. Проблемные слоты другие — AK-47 и Glock, где точного зелёного за разумные деньги почти нет.

Разберём три сета: стартовый из одних стволов, средний с ножом Gamma Doppler и полный, где в цвет попадает каждый предмет.

## На чём держится зелёный в CS2

**Gamma Doppler.** Главная зелёная отделка ножей. У неё пять вариантов — четыре фазы и Emerald. Emerald даёт ровный изумруд по всему клинку, но это редкий «камень», который стоит в несколько раз дороже обычных фаз того же ножа, поэтому в сетах ниже мы берём обычные фазы. Самая зелёная из них — Phase 1; остальные на разных моделях могут уходить в холодную бирюзу. Отделка бывает только в Factory New и Minimal Wear, поэтому выбирать придётся не износ, а фазу.

**Emerald-перчатки.** Hydra Gloves | Emerald, Broken Fang Gloves | Jade и Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web — три пары, у которых совпадение с зелёным близко к идеальному. Первые две доступны почти любому, третья — коллекционный уровень.

**Змеиная тема на оружии.** Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike, AWP | Atheris, Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr — много зелёных скинов в CS2 нарисованы вокруг змей и чешуи, и они хорошо сочетаются между собой по фактуре.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Broken Fang Gloves | Jade;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr"]

## Сет до 3 500 ₽

Только оружие, всё в Field-Tested:

- **AK-47 | Green Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Green Laminate" wear="FT"]. Честно: это компромисс. Цвет скорее болотный, чем изумрудный, но других зелёных AK дешевле тысячи рублей нет.
- **M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S** — [price name="M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S" wear="FT"]. Динозавр в зелёной гамме, выглядит дороже своей цены.
- **AWP | Atheris** — [price name="AWP | Atheris" wear="FT"]. Змея на корпусе, яркая и читаемая в прицеле. Альтернатива — AWP | Green Energy за [price name="AWP | Green Energy" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike" wear="FT"]. Почти идеальное попадание в цвет за копейки — лучшая находка этого сета.
- **USP-S | Overgrowth** — [price name="USP-S | Overgrowth" wear="FT"]. Самая дорогая позиция, но и самая «зелёная» из USP.
- **Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden** — [price name="Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden" wear="FT"]. Кислотно-зелёный акцент. Точного зелёного Glock за такие деньги нет, поэтому здесь сознательно берём яркий акцент, а не попытку попасть в оттенок.

[skins names="AK-47 | Green Laminate;M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S;AWP | Atheris;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth;Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden"]

Итого около 3 100 ₽. Если хочется сразу добавить перчатки, Hydra Gloves | Emerald в Field-Tested стоят [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"] — с ними сет уже выглядит как полноценный зелёный инвентарь.

[cta color=4 budget=3500 text="Собрать зелёный сет за 3 500 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сет до 15 000 ₽

Средний сет строим вокруг самого доступного ножа с Gamma Doppler — **Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)**, от [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]. Да, тычковые ножи не всем по душе, но это самый дешёвый способ получить зелёный доплеровский клинок. Перед покупкой посмотри скриншот лота: у Phase 1 доля зелёного от экземпляра к экземпляру немного разная.

И сразу меняем Glock: вместо Nuclear Garden ставим **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** — [price name="Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler" wear="FT"]. Пистолет повторяет отделку ножа, и на T-стороне это самая заметная связка в инвентаре. Остальные стволы — из первого сета.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth"]

Итого около 14 800 ₽. Если тычковые ножи не нравятся, тот же бюджет можно отдать под перчатки: Broken Fang Gloves | Jade ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Jade" wear="FT"]) вместо ножа, а на остаток заменить USP на USP-S | Caiman ([price name="USP-S | Caiman" wear="FT"]). Выйдет около 13 400 ₽.

[cta color=4 budget=15000 text="Собрать зелёный сет с ножом за 15 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сет с ножом и перчатками до 80 000 ₽

- **Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)** — от [price name="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]. Крупный клинок, на котором зелень Phase 1 читается лучше всего, и классическая форма, которую видно в каждой анимации.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** — [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"]. Тут нет смысла переплачивать: эти перчатки попадают в цвет точнее, чем пары в десятки раз дороже.
- **Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr" wear="FT"]. Изумрудный змей на корпусе, почти точное совпадение по цвету с ножом. Именно сюда идут сэкономленные на перчатках деньги.
- **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** — как в среднем сете.
- AK, M4, AWP и USP — из первого сета.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr;Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;AWP | Atheris"]

Итого около 78 100 ₽. Нож и Deagle делят бюджет почти поровну и вместе дают около 90% суммы. Если Jörmungandr не нужен, верни Serpent Strike, и полный сет обойдётся примерно в 43 700 ₽ без потери цвета.

[cta color=4 budget=80000 text="Собрать зелёный сет с ножом и перчатками за 80 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Сравнение сетов

| Бюджет | Что входит | Итого |
|---|---|---|
| до 3 500 ₽ | Green Laminate, Emphorosaur-S, Atheris, Serpent Strike, Overgrowth, Nuclear Garden | ≈ 3 100 ₽ |
| до 15 000 ₽ | стволы + Glock Gamma Doppler + Shadow Daggers Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) | ≈ 14 800 ₽ |
| до 80 000 ₽ | Bayonet Gamma Doppler (Phase 1), Hydra Gloves Emerald, Deagle Emerald Jörmungandr + стволы | ≈ 78 100 ₽ |

Итоговые суммы — по ценам на 15 октября 2026 года. Цены у отдельных предметов в статье подтягиваются автоматически и обновляются каждый день.

## Чего избегать

- **Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) вместо Phase 1.** На маленьких превью Flip Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) и M9 Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) выглядят зелёными, но на этих моделях фаза ложится холодным сине-зелёным. Рядом с Hydra Gloves | Emerald разница бьёт в глаза.
- **Ножи Lore.** Bayonet | Lore и Karambit | Lore часто попадают в зелёные подборки из-за оливковых теней, но основной цвет у них золотой. Для зелёного сета это чужой нож.
- **Ножи Boreal Forest и Forest DDPAT.** Paracord Knife | Boreal Forest дешёвый, но это камуфляж, а не зелёный цвет: на фоне изумрудных перчаток он выглядит серо-болотным.
- **Мятные перчатки с «ловушкой износа».** У Moto Gloves | Cool Mint и Moto Gloves | Spearmint огромный разрыв между самым убитым экземпляром и Field-Tested: Cool Mint в FT стоит [price name="Moto Gloves | Cool Mint" wear="FT"]. Дешёвые Battle-Scarred почти теряют мятный цвет, а приличный износ стоит как нож. К тому же мята — не изумруд.
- **AK-47 | Fire Serpent и AK-47 | Wild Lotus «ради зелёного».** Оба коллекционные, оба стоят огромных денег, а совпадение с цветом у них только среднее. Покупать их стоит за историю, не за оттенок.
- **Hand Wraps | Spruce DDPAT и Specialist Gloves | Forest DDPAT.** Военный камуфляж с низким совпадением; превращает сет в хаки.

## Если хочется дороже

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** — [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. Самая точная зелёная винтовка в игре; закрывает слабое место M4 раз и навсегда.
- **AK-47 | Hydroponic** — [price name="AK-47 | Hydroponic" wear="FT"]. Единственный AK, который по-настоящему попадает в зелёный, — поэтому он и стоит так дорого.
- **Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web** — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web" wear="FT"]. Изумрудная паутина: тот же цвет, что у Hydra, но совсем другой статус.
- **Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)** — [price name="Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)"]. Финальная точка любого зелёного инвентаря. Цену у «камней» маркетплейсы не отделяют от обычных фаз, так что смотри конкретные лоты — обычно это в разы дороже Phase 1.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;AK-47 | Hydroponic;Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)"]

## Совет напоследок

В зелёном сете экономь на перчатках и вкладывайся в нож и Deagle: Hydra Gloves | Emerald всё равно попадают в цвет лучше большинства дорогих пар. Все подходящие скины собраны на странице [зелёные скины CS2](/zelenye-skiny-cs2/), отдельно — [зелёные ножи](/zelenye-nozhi-cs2/) и [зелёные перчатки](/zelenye-perchatki-cs2/). Остальные цвета — в разделе [цветовые сеты скинов CS2](/cvetovye-sety-skinov-cs2/).

en.title: Green CS2 Inventory: From Hydra Emerald to Gamma Doppler, 3 Loadouts
en.desc: How to build a green CS2 inventory: Hydra Gloves Emerald, Gamma Doppler knives, snake-themed Deagles. Three skin loadouts from $40 to $890.
en.lead: In a green loadout the gloves are the cheapest slot to fill, while the AK and Glock are the hardest. We break down three loadouts built around emerald gloves and Gamma Doppler.
en.md:
Green in CS2 works the opposite way from most colors. Usually the gloves are the most expensive and hardest-to-find part of a loadout, but here they're the cheapest slot to fill: Hydra Gloves | Emerald hit the shade almost perfectly and cost about as much as a couple of mid-range gun skins. The problem slots are different — the AK-47 and Glock, where there's almost no accurate green for reasonable money.

Let's go through three loadouts: a starter with guns only, a mid-range one with a Gamma Doppler knife, and a full one where every item matches the color.

## What carries green in CS2

**Gamma Doppler.** The main green knife finish. It has five variants — four phases and Emerald. Emerald gives an even emerald across the whole blade, but it's a rare "gem" that costs several times more than the regular phases of the same knife, so the loadouts below use regular phases. The greenest of them is Phase 1; the others can drift into cool teal on some models. The finish only comes in Factory New and Minimal Wear, so you'll be choosing a phase, not a wear.

**Emerald gloves.** Hydra Gloves | Emerald, Broken Fang Gloves | Jade and Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web — three pairs with a near-perfect green match. The first two are within almost anyone's reach, the third is collector tier.

**Snake theme on guns.** Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike, AWP | Atheris, Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr — a lot of green skins in CS2 are drawn around snakes and scales, and their textures go well together.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Broken Fang Gloves | Jade;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr"]

## Loadout under $40

Guns only, everything in Field-Tested:

- **AK-47 | Green Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Green Laminate" wear="FT"]. Honestly, it's a compromise. The color is more swampy than emerald, but there are no other green AKs under about $10.
- **M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S** — [price name="M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S" wear="FT"]. A dinosaur in green tones that looks pricier than it is.
- **AWP | Atheris** — [price name="AWP | Atheris" wear="FT"]. A snake on the body, bright and easy to read through the scope. The alternative is AWP | Green Energy for [price name="AWP | Green Energy" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike" wear="FT"]. A near-perfect color match for pocket change — the best find in this loadout.
- **USP-S | Overgrowth** — [price name="USP-S | Overgrowth" wear="FT"]. The priciest item, but also the "greenest" USP.
- **Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden** — [price name="Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden" wear="FT"]. An acid-green accent. There's no accurately green Glock at this price, so here we deliberately go for a bright accent instead of trying to hit the shade.

[skins names="AK-47 | Green Laminate;M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S;AWP | Atheris;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth;Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden"]

Total around $35. If you want to add gloves right away, Hydra Gloves | Emerald in Field-Tested cost [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"] — with them, the loadout already looks like a proper green inventory.

[cta color=4 budget=3500 text="Build a green loadout for $40" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout under $170

We build the mid-range loadout around the most affordable Gamma Doppler knife — **Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)**, from [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]. Yes, push daggers aren't for everyone, but they're the cheapest way to get a green Doppler blade. Check the listing's screenshot before buying: the amount of green in Phase 1 varies a bit from copy to copy.

And we swap the Glock right away: instead of the Nuclear Garden, take the **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** — [price name="Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler" wear="FT"]. The pistol mirrors the knife's finish, and on the T side it's the most eye-catching combo in the inventory. The rest of the guns come from the first loadout.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth"]

Total around $165. If you don't like push daggers, you can put the same budget into gloves: Broken Fang Gloves | Jade ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Jade" wear="FT"]) instead of the knife, and use the rest to swap the USP for USP-S | Caiman ([price name="USP-S | Caiman" wear="FT"]). That comes to about $150.

[cta color=4 budget=15000 text="Build a green loadout with a knife for $170" btn="Open the builder"]

## Knife and gloves loadout under $890

- **Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)** — from [price name="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]. A big blade where Phase 1's green reads best, and a classic shape you see in every animation.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** — [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"]. No point overpaying here: these gloves match the color more accurately than pairs costing dozens of times more.
- **Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr" wear="FT"]. An emerald serpent on the body, an almost exact color match with the knife. This is where the money saved on gloves goes.
- **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** — same as the mid-range loadout.
- AK, M4, AWP and USP — from the first loadout.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr;Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;AWP | Atheris"]

Total around $870. The knife and Deagle split the budget almost evenly and together make up about 90% of the total. If you don't need the Jörmungandr, bring back the Serpent Strike and the full loadout comes to roughly $490 with no loss of color.

[cta color=4 budget=80000 text="Build a green loadout with knife and gloves for $890" btn="Open the builder"]

## Loadout comparison

| Budget | What's included | Total |
|---|---|---|
| under $40 | Green Laminate, Emphorosaur-S, Atheris, Serpent Strike, Overgrowth, Nuclear Garden | ≈ $35 |
| under $170 | guns + Glock Gamma Doppler + Shadow Daggers Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) | ≈ $165 |
| under $890 | Bayonet Gamma Doppler (Phase 1), Hydra Gloves Emerald, Deagle Emerald Jörmungandr + guns | ≈ $870 |

Totals are based on prices as of October 15, 2026. Individual item prices in the article are pulled in automatically and updated every day.

## What to avoid

- **Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) instead of Phase 1.** In small previews, Flip Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) and M9 Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) look green, but on these models the phase comes out as a cool blue-green. Next to Hydra Gloves | Emerald the difference is glaring.
- **Lore knives.** Bayonet | Lore and Karambit | Lore often end up in green lists because of their olive shadows, but their main color is gold. For a green loadout, it's the wrong knife.
- **Boreal Forest and Forest DDPAT knives.** Paracord Knife | Boreal Forest is cheap, but it's camo, not green: next to emerald gloves it looks grey and swampy.
- **Mint gloves with a "wear trap".** Moto Gloves | Cool Mint and Moto Gloves | Spearmint have a huge gap between the most battered copy and Field-Tested: Cool Mint in FT costs [price name="Moto Gloves | Cool Mint" wear="FT"]. Cheap Battle-Scarred pairs have almost lost their mint color, while decent wear costs as much as a knife. And mint isn't emerald anyway.
- **AK-47 | Fire Serpent and AK-47 | Wild Lotus "for the green."** Both are collector's items, both cost a fortune, and their color match is only average. Buy them for the history, not the shade.
- **Hand Wraps | Spruce DDPAT and Specialist Gloves | Forest DDPAT.** Military camo with a low match; turns the loadout khaki.

## If you want to go bigger

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** — [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. The most accurate green rifle in the game; fixes the M4's weak spot once and for all.
- **AK-47 | Hydroponic** — [price name="AK-47 | Hydroponic" wear="FT"]. The only AK that truly nails green — which is why it costs so much.
- **Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web** — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web" wear="FT"]. An emerald web: the same color as the Hydra, but a completely different status.
- **Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)** — [price name="Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)"]. The finishing touch for any green inventory. Marketplaces don't separate "gem" prices from regular phases, so check specific listings — it's usually many times more than Phase 1.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;AK-47 | Hydroponic;Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)"]

## A parting tip

In a green loadout, save on the gloves and invest in the knife and Deagle: Hydra Gloves | Emerald match the color better than most expensive pairs anyway. All matching skins are collected on the [green CS2 skins](/en/green-cs2-skins/) page, with separate pages for [green knives](/en/green-knives-cs2/) and [green gloves](/en/green-gloves-cs2/). Other colors are in the [CS2 skin sets by color](/en/cs2-skin-sets-by-color/) section.

de.title: Grüne CS2 Skins: 3 Inventar-Sets von Hydra Emerald bis Gamma Doppler
de.desc: Grünes Inventar in CS2 zusammenstellen: Hydra Gloves Emerald, Gamma-Doppler-Messer, Schlangen-Deagles. Drei Sets von 40 bis 900 €.
de.lead: Im grünen Set sind ausgerechnet die Handschuhe am günstigsten, am schwierigsten dagegen AK und Glock. Wir gehen drei Sets rund um smaragdgrüne Handschuhe und Gamma Doppler durch.
de.md:
Bei Grün läuft in CS2 alles andersherum als bei den meisten Farben. Normalerweise sind Handschuhe der teuerste und knappste Teil eines Sets – hier sind sie am günstigsten abgedeckt: Hydra Gloves | Emerald treffen den Farbton fast perfekt und kosten so viel wie zwei mittelpreisige Waffen-Skins. Die Problemslots sind andere – AK-47 und Glock, wo es für vernünftiges Geld kaum präzises Grün gibt.

Wir gehen drei Sets durch: ein Starter-Set nur aus Waffen, ein mittleres mit Gamma-Doppler-Messer und ein komplettes, in dem jedes Item die Farbe trifft.

## Worauf Grün in CS2 aufbaut

**Gamma Doppler.** Das wichtigste grüne Messer-Finish. Es gibt fünf Varianten – vier Phasen und Emerald. Emerald liefert gleichmäßiges Smaragdgrün über die ganze Klinge, ist aber ein seltener „Edelstein“, der ein Mehrfaches der normalen Phasen desselben Messers kostet – deshalb nehmen wir in den Sets unten normale Phasen. Am grünsten ist Phase 1; die anderen können je nach Modell ins kühle Türkis kippen. Das Finish gibt es nur in Factory New und Minimal Wear – du wählst also nicht den Zustand, sondern die Phase.

**Emerald-Handschuhe.** Hydra Gloves | Emerald, Broken Fang Gloves | Jade und Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web – drei Paare mit fast perfektem Grün-Treffer. Die ersten beiden sind für fast jeden erschwinglich, das dritte ist Sammler-Niveau.

**Schlangenthema auf Waffen.** Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike, AWP | Atheris, Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr – viele grüne Skins in CS2 drehen sich um Schlangen und Schuppen, und sie passen von der Textur her gut zusammen.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Broken Fang Gloves | Jade;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr"]

## Set bis 40 €

Nur Waffen, alles in Field-Tested:

- **AK-47 | Green Laminate** – [price name="AK-47 | Green Laminate" wear="FT"]. Ehrlich gesagt: ein Kompromiss. Die Farbe ist eher sumpfig als smaragdgrün, aber andere grüne AKs unter rund 10 € gibt es nicht.
- **M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S** – [price name="M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S" wear="FT"]. Ein Dino in Grüntönen, sieht teurer aus, als er ist.
- **AWP | Atheris** – [price name="AWP | Atheris" wear="FT"]. Schlange auf dem Body, knallig und im Scope gut erkennbar. Alternative: AWP | Green Energy für [price name="AWP | Green Energy" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike** – [price name="Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike" wear="FT"]. Fast perfekter Farbtreffer für kleines Geld – der beste Fund dieses Sets.
- **USP-S | Overgrowth** – [price name="USP-S | Overgrowth" wear="FT"]. Der teuerste Posten, aber auch die „grünste“ USP.
- **Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden** – [price name="Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden" wear="FT"]. Giftgrüner Akzent. Eine farbgenaue grüne Glock gibt es für dieses Geld nicht, deshalb setzen wir hier bewusst auf einen knalligen Akzent statt auf den exakten Farbton.

[skins names="AK-47 | Green Laminate;M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S;AWP | Atheris;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth;Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden"]

Gesamt etwa 35 €. Wenn du gleich Handschuhe dazunehmen willst: Hydra Gloves | Emerald kosten in Field-Tested [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"] – damit wirkt das Set schon wie ein vollwertiges grünes Inventar.

[cta color=4 budget=3500 text="Grünes Set für 40 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set bis 170 €

Das mittlere Set bauen wir um das günstigste Gamma-Doppler-Messer – **Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)**, ab [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]. Ja, Push-Daggers sind nicht jedermanns Sache, aber es ist der günstigste Weg zu einer grünen Doppler-Klinge. Schau dir vor dem Kauf den Screenshot des Angebots an: Bei Phase 1 schwankt der Grünanteil von Exemplar zu Exemplar etwas.

Und gleich tauschen wir die Glock: Statt Nuclear Garden kommt **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** – [price name="Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler" wear="FT"]. Die Pistole greift das Finish des Messers auf, und auf der T-Seite ist das die auffälligste Kombi im Inventar. Die übrigen Waffen kommen aus dem ersten Set.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth"]

Gesamt etwa 160 €. Wenn dir Push-Daggers nicht gefallen, steck dasselbe Budget in Handschuhe: Broken Fang Gloves | Jade ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Jade" wear="FT"]) statt Messer, und vom Rest tauschst du die USP gegen USP-S | Caiman ([price name="USP-S | Caiman" wear="FT"]). Macht etwa 150 €.

[cta color=4 budget=15000 text="Grünes Set mit Messer für 170 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Set mit Messer und Handschuhen bis 900 €

- **Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)** – ab [price name="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]. Große Klinge, auf der das Grün von Phase 1 am besten zur Geltung kommt, und eine klassische Form, die du in jeder Animation siehst.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** – [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"]. Mehr auszugeben lohnt sich hier nicht: Diese Handschuhe treffen die Farbe genauer als Paare, die zigmal mehr kosten.
- **Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr** – [price name="Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr" wear="FT"]. Smaragdgrüne Schlange auf dem Body, farblich fast identisch mit dem Messer. Genau hier fließt das bei den Handschuhen gesparte Geld hin.
- **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** – wie im mittleren Set.
- AK, M4, AWP und USP – aus dem ersten Set.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr;Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;AWP | Atheris"]

Gesamt etwa 870 €. Messer und Deagle teilen sich das Budget fast zu gleichen Teilen und machen zusammen rund 90 % der Summe aus. Wenn du die Jörmungandr nicht brauchst, nimm wieder die Serpent Strike – dann kostet das komplette Set etwa 490 €, ohne an Farbe zu verlieren.

[cta color=4 budget=80000 text="Grünes Set mit Messer und Handschuhen für 900 € zusammenstellen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Die Sets im Vergleich

| Budget | Inhalt | Gesamt |
|---|---|---|
| bis 40 € | Green Laminate, Emphorosaur-S, Atheris, Serpent Strike, Overgrowth, Nuclear Garden | ≈ 35 € |
| bis 170 € | Waffen + Glock Gamma Doppler + Shadow Daggers Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) | ≈ 160 € |
| bis 900 € | Bayonet Gamma Doppler (Phase 1), Hydra Gloves Emerald, Deagle Emerald Jörmungandr + Waffen | ≈ 870 € |

Die Gesamtsummen basieren auf den Preisen vom 15. Oktober 2026. Die Preise der einzelnen Items im Artikel werden automatisch geladen und täglich aktualisiert.

## Was du vermeiden solltest

- **Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) statt Phase 1.** Auf kleinen Vorschaubildern wirken Flip Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) und M9 Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) grün, auf diesen Modellen fällt die Phase aber kühl blaugrün aus. Neben Hydra Gloves | Emerald springt der Unterschied sofort ins Auge.
- **Lore-Messer.** Bayonet | Lore und Karambit | Lore landen wegen ihrer olivfarbenen Schatten oft in grünen Listen, die Hauptfarbe ist aber Gold. Für ein grünes Set das falsche Messer.
- **Boreal-Forest- und Forest-DDPAT-Messer.** Das Paracord Knife | Boreal Forest ist günstig, aber ein Camo und kein Grün: Vor smaragdgrünen Handschuhen wirkt es grau-sumpfig.
- **Mintgrüne Handschuhe mit „Wear-Falle“.** Bei Moto Gloves | Cool Mint und Moto Gloves | Spearmint klafft eine riesige Lücke zwischen dem kaputtesten Exemplar und Field-Tested: Cool Mint kostet in FT [price name="Moto Gloves | Cool Mint" wear="FT"]. Billige Battle-Scarred verlieren das Mintgrün fast komplett, und ein ordentlicher Zustand kostet so viel wie ein Messer. Außerdem ist Mint kein Smaragd.
- **AK-47 | Fire Serpent und AK-47 | Wild Lotus „wegen des Grüns“.** Beides Sammlerstücke, beide kosten ein Vermögen, und der Farbtreffer ist nur mittelmäßig. Die kauft man wegen der Geschichte, nicht wegen des Farbtons.
- **Hand Wraps | Spruce DDPAT und Specialist Gloves | Forest DDPAT.** Militär-Camo mit schwachem Farbtreffer; macht aus dem Set Khaki.

## Wenn es teurer sein darf

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** – [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. Das farbgenaueste grüne Gewehr im Spiel; schließt die M4-Schwachstelle ein für alle Mal.
- **AK-47 | Hydroponic** – [price name="AK-47 | Hydroponic" wear="FT"]. Die einzige AK, die Grün wirklich trifft – deshalb ist sie auch so teuer.
- **Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web** – [price name="Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web" wear="FT"]. Smaragdgrünes Netz: dieselbe Farbe wie Hydra, aber ein völlig anderer Status.
- **Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)** – [price name="Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)"]. Der krönende Abschluss jedes grünen Inventars. Marktplätze trennen den Preis der „Edelsteine“ nicht von den normalen Phasen, schau dir also konkrete Angebote an – meist ist es ein Vielfaches von Phase 1.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;AK-47 | Hydroponic;Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)"]

## Ein letzter Tipp

Spar im grünen Set bei den Handschuhen und investier in Messer und Deagle: Hydra Gloves | Emerald treffen die Farbe ohnehin besser als die meisten teuren Paare. Alle passenden Skins inklusive Messern und Handschuhen findest du auf der Seite mit [grünen CS2 Skins](/de/gruene-cs2-skins/). Die übrigen Farben gibt es im Bereich [Farb-Sets für CS2-Skins](/de/).

pt.title: Inventário verde no CS2: de Hydra Emerald a Gamma Doppler, três sets
pt.desc: Como montar um inventário verde no CS2: Hydra Gloves Emerald, facas Gamma Doppler, Deagles de cobra. Três sets de skins de R$ 210 a R$ 4.900.
pt.lead: No set verde, as luvas são o slot mais barato de fechar, e os mais difíceis são AK e Glock. Destrinchamos três sets em volta das luvas esmeralda e da Gamma Doppler.
pt.md:
Com o verde no CS2, tudo funciona ao contrário da maioria das cores. Normalmente as luvas são a parte mais cara e mais escassa do set, mas aqui são justamente elas que saem mais barato: as Hydra Gloves | Emerald acertam o tom quase perfeitamente e custam o mesmo que um par de skins médias de arma. Os slots problemáticos são outros — AK-47 e Glock, em que verde de verdade a preço razoável quase não existe.

Vamos ver três sets: o inicial só com armas, o médio com faca Gamma Doppler e o completo, em que cada item acerta a cor.

## O que segura o verde no CS2

**Gamma Doppler.** O principal acabamento verde de facas. São cinco variantes — quatro fases e a Emerald. A Emerald dá um esmeralda uniforme na lâmina inteira, mas é uma "gema" rara que custa várias vezes mais que as fases comuns da mesma faca, então nos sets abaixo usamos fases comuns. A mais verde delas é a Phase 1; as outras, dependendo do modelo, podem puxar para um turquesa frio. O acabamento só existe em Factory New e Minimal Wear, então você vai escolher a fase, não o desgaste.

**Luvas esmeralda.** Hydra Gloves | Emerald, Broken Fang Gloves | Jade e Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web — três pares com match de verde quase perfeito. Os dois primeiros cabem no bolso de quase todo mundo; o terceiro é nível colecionador.

**Tema de cobra nas armas.** Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike, AWP | Atheris, Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr — muitas skins verdes do CS2 são desenhadas em volta de cobras e escamas, e combinam bem entre si pela textura.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Broken Fang Gloves | Jade;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr"]

## Set até R$ 210

Só armas, tudo em Field-Tested:

- **AK-47 | Green Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Green Laminate" wear="FT"]. Sendo honesto: é uma concessão. A cor é mais verde-pântano do que esmeralda, mas não existe outra AK verde abaixo de R$ 60.
- **M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S** — [price name="M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S" wear="FT"]. Um dinossauro na paleta verde, parece mais cara do que é.
- **AWP | Atheris** — [price name="AWP | Atheris" wear="FT"]. Uma cobra no corpo, vibrante e legível na mira. Alternativa — AWP | Green Energy por [price name="AWP | Green Energy" wear="FT"].
- **Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike" wear="FT"]. Acerto de cor quase perfeito por uma mixaria — o melhor achado deste set.
- **USP-S | Overgrowth** — [price name="USP-S | Overgrowth" wear="FT"]. O item mais caro, mas também a USP mais "verde".
- **Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden** — [price name="Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden" wear="FT"]. Um destaque verde-ácido. Não existe Glock verde fiel por esse preço, então aqui escolhemos de propósito um destaque vibrante, em vez de tentar acertar o tom.

[skins names="AK-47 | Green Laminate;M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S;AWP | Atheris;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth;Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden"]

Total de cerca de R$ 190. Se quiser já adicionar luvas, as Hydra Gloves | Emerald em Field-Tested custam [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"] — com elas o set já parece um inventário verde de verdade.

[cta color=4 budget=3500 text="Montar set verde por R$ 210" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set até R$ 920

O set médio é construído em volta da faca Gamma Doppler mais acessível — **Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)**, a partir de [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]. Sim, as push daggers não agradam todo mundo, mas é o jeito mais barato de ter uma lâmina Doppler verde. Antes de comprar, veja o screenshot do anúncio: na Phase 1, a proporção de verde varia um pouco de exemplar para exemplar.

E já trocamos a Glock: no lugar da Nuclear Garden entra a **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** — [price name="Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler" wear="FT"]. A pistola repete o acabamento da faca, e no lado TR é a combinação mais visível do inventário. As outras armas vêm do primeiro set.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth"]

Total de cerca de R$ 900. Se você não curte push daggers, o mesmo orçamento pode ir para luvas: Broken Fang Gloves | Jade ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Jade" wear="FT"]) no lugar da faca, e com o que sobrar troque a USP pela USP-S | Caiman ([price name="USP-S | Caiman" wear="FT"]). Fica em torno de R$ 820.

[cta color=4 budget=15000 text="Montar set verde com faca por R$ 920" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Set com faca e luvas até R$ 4.900

- **Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)** — a partir de [price name="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]. Lâmina grande, em que o verde da Phase 1 aparece melhor, e um formato clássico que se vê em toda animação.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** — [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"]. Aqui não faz sentido pagar mais: essas luvas acertam a cor melhor do que pares dezenas de vezes mais caros.
- **Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr" wear="FT"]. Uma serpente esmeralda no corpo, match quase exato com a faca. É para cá que vai o dinheiro economizado nas luvas.
- **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** — como no set médio.
- AK, M4, AWP e USP — do primeiro set.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr;Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;AWP | Atheris"]

Total de cerca de R$ 4.800. A faca e a Deagle dividem o orçamento quase meio a meio e, juntas, somam cerca de 90% do valor. Se não precisar da Jörmungandr, volte para a Serpent Strike, e o set completo sai por cerca de R$ 2.700 sem perder cor.

[cta color=4 budget=80000 text="Montar set verde com faca e luvas por R$ 4.900" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Comparação dos sets

| Orçamento | O que entra | Total |
|---|---|---|
| até R$ 210 | Green Laminate, Emphorosaur-S, Atheris, Serpent Strike, Overgrowth, Nuclear Garden | ≈ R$ 190 |
| até R$ 920 | armas + Glock Gamma Doppler + Shadow Daggers Gamma Doppler (Phase 1) | ≈ R$ 900 |
| até R$ 4.900 | Bayonet Gamma Doppler (Phase 1), Hydra Gloves Emerald, Deagle Emerald Jörmungandr + armas | ≈ R$ 4.800 |

Os totais usam os preços de 15 de outubro de 2026. O preço de cada item no artigo é puxado automaticamente e atualizado todos os dias.

## O que evitar

- **Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) no lugar da Phase 1.** Nas prévias pequenas, a Flip Knife | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) e a M9 Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 2) parecem verdes, mas nesses modelos a fase fica num verde-azulado frio. Ao lado das Hydra Gloves | Emerald, a diferença salta aos olhos.
- **Facas Lore.** A Bayonet | Lore e a Karambit | Lore aparecem muito em listas de verde por causa das sombras oliva, mas a cor principal delas é dourada. Para um set verde, é faca de outro inventário.
- **Facas Boreal Forest e Forest DDPAT.** A Paracord Knife | Boreal Forest é barata, mas é camuflagem, não cor verde: ao lado das luvas esmeralda ela parece cinza-pântano.
- **Luvas menta com "armadilha de desgaste".** As Moto Gloves | Cool Mint e as Moto Gloves | Spearmint têm uma diferença enorme entre o exemplar mais detonado e a Field-Tested: a Cool Mint em FT custa [price name="Moto Gloves | Cool Mint" wear="FT"]. As Battle-Scarred baratas quase perdem o verde-menta, e um desgaste decente custa o preço de uma faca. Além disso, menta não é esmeralda.
- **AK-47 | Fire Serpent e AK-47 | Wild Lotus "pelo verde".** As duas são de colecionador, as duas custam uma fortuna, e o match de cor delas é só mediano. Vale comprá-las pela história, não pelo tom.
- **Hand Wraps | Spruce DDPAT e Specialist Gloves | Forest DDPAT.** Camuflagem militar com match baixo; transforma o set em cáqui.

## Se quiser gastar mais

- **M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle** — [price name="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle" wear="FT"]. O rifle verde mais fiel do jogo; resolve o ponto fraco da M4 de uma vez por todas.
- **AK-47 | Hydroponic** — [price name="AK-47 | Hydroponic" wear="FT"]. A única AK que acerta o verde de verdade — e por isso custa tão caro.
- **Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web** — [price name="Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web" wear="FT"]. Teia esmeralda: a mesma cor das Hydra, mas um status completamente diferente.
- **Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)** — [price name="Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)"]. O ponto final de qualquer inventário verde. Os marketplaces não separam o preço das "gemas" do das fases comuns, então olhe os anúncios específicos — normalmente custa várias vezes mais que a Phase 1.

[skins names="M4A1-S | Welcome to the Jungle;AK-47 | Hydroponic;Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web;Karambit | Gamma Doppler (Emerald)"]

## Dica final

No set verde, economize nas luvas e invista na faca e na Deagle: as Hydra Gloves | Emerald acertam a cor melhor que a maioria dos pares caros de qualquer jeito. Todas as skins, facas e luvas que combinam estão na página de [skins verdes do CS2](/pt/skins-verdes-cs2/). As outras cores ficam na seção de [sets de skins por cor do CS2](/pt/).

tr.title: Yeşil CS2 envanteri: Hydra Emerald'dan Gamma Doppler'a üç skin seti
tr.desc: CS2'de yeşil envanter nasıl kurulur: Hydra Gloves Emerald, Gamma Doppler bıçaklar, yılanlı Deagle'lar. $40'tan $890'a üç set.
tr.lead: Yeşil sette en ucuza eldiven kapanıyor, en zoru ise AK ve Glock. Zümrüt eldivenler ve Gamma Doppler etrafında üç seti inceliyoruz.
tr.md:
CS2'de yeşil, çoğu renge kıyasla tam tersine işliyor. Normalde eldiven setin en pahalı ve en kıt parçasıdır; burada ise en ucuza kapanan slot tam olarak o: Hydra Gloves | Emerald tona neredeyse kusursuz oturuyor ve iki orta halli silah skini fiyatında. Sorunlu slotlar başka — makul paraya tam yeşilin neredeyse bulunmadığı AK-47 ve Glock.

Üç seti inceleyelim: sadece silahlardan oluşan başlangıç seti, Gamma Doppler bıçaklı orta set ve her eşyanın renge oturduğu tam set.

## CS2'de yeşili ne taşıyor

**Gamma Doppler.** Bıçakların ana yeşil kaplaması. Beş varyantı var — dört faz ve Emerald. Emerald tüm bıçak ağzında düz bir zümrüt veriyor, ama aynı bıçağın sıradan fazlarından birkaç kat pahalı, nadir bir "taş"; bu yüzden aşağıdaki setlerde sıradan fazları alıyoruz. En yeşili Phase 1; diğerleri bazı modellerde soğuk turkuaza kayabiliyor. Kaplama yalnızca Factory New ve Minimal Wear olarak çıktığı için aşınmayı değil fazı seçeceksin.

**Emerald eldivenler.** Hydra Gloves | Emerald, Broken Fang Gloves | Jade ve Specialist Gloves | Emerald Web — yeşille eşleşmesi kusursuza yakın üç çift. İlk ikisine neredeyse herkes ulaşabilir, üçüncüsü koleksiyon seviyesinde.

**Silahlarda yılan teması.** Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike, AWP | Atheris, Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr — CS2'deki birçok yeşil skin yılanlar ve pullar etrafında çizilmiş, doku olarak da birbirleriyle iyi uyuşuyorlar.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Broken Fang Gloves | Jade;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr"]

## $40'a kadar set

Sadece silahlar, hepsi Field-Tested:

- **AK-47 | Green Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Green Laminate" wear="FT"]. Dürüst olalım: bu bir taviz. Renk zümrütten çok bataklık yeşili, ama $10'un altında başka yeşil AK yok.
- **M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S** — [price name="M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S" wear="FT"]. Yeşil tonlarda dinozor, fiyatından pahalı görünüyor.
- **AWP | Atheris** — [price name="AWP | Atheris" wear="FT"]. Gövdede yılan, dürbünde parlak ve okunaklı. Alternatif — [price name="AWP | Green Energy" wear="FT"] fiyatındaki AWP | Green Energy.
- **Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike" wear="FT"]. Kuruşa neredeyse kusursuz renk eşleşmesi — bu setin en iyi keşfi.
- **USP-S | Overgrowth** — [price name="USP-S | Overgrowth" wear="FT"]. En pahalı kalem, ama USP'lerin de en "yeşili".
- **Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden** — [price name="Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden" wear="FT"]. Asit yeşili bir vurgu. Bu paraya tam yeşil bir Glock yok, bu yüzden burada tonu tutturmaya çalışmak yerine bilinçli olarak parlak bir vurgu alıyoruz.

[skins names="AK-47 | Green Laminate;M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S;AWP | Atheris;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth;Glock-18 | Nuclear Garden"]

Toplam yaklaşık $35. Hemen eldiven de eklemek istersen, Field-Tested Hydra Gloves | Emerald [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"] — onlarla set şimdiden tam bir yeşil envanter gibi görünüyor.

[cta color=4 budget=3500 text="Yeşil seti $40'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## $170'e kadar set

Orta seti Gamma Doppler'lı en uygun fiyatlı bıçak etrafında kuruyoruz — **Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)**, [price name="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]'dan başlıyor. Evet, Shadow Daggers herkesin harcı değil, ama yeşil Doppler bıçağa sahip olmanın en ucuz yolu bu. Almadan önce ilanın ekran görüntüsüne bak: Phase 1'de yeşilin oranı eşyadan eşyaya biraz değişiyor.

Ve Glock'u hemen değiştiriyoruz: Nuclear Garden yerine **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** — [price name="Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler" wear="FT"]. Tabanca bıçağın kaplamasını tekrarlıyor ve T tarafında envanterdeki en göze çarpan ikili bu. Diğer silahlar ilk setten.

[skins names="Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Overgrowth"]

Toplam yaklaşık $165. Shadow Daggers'ı sevmiyorsan aynı bütçeyi eldivene verebilirsin: bıçak yerine Broken Fang Gloves | Jade ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Jade" wear="FT"]), kalan parayla da USP'yi USP-S | Caiman ([price name="USP-S | Caiman" wear="FT"]) ile değiştir. Yaklaşık $150 tutar.

[cta color=4 budget=15000 text="Bıçaklı yeşil seti $170'e topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Bıçak ve eldivenli set, $890'a kadar

- **Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)** — [price name="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1)"]'dan başlıyor. Phase 1'in yeşilinin en iyi okunduğu büyük bir bıçak ağzı ve her animasyonda görünen klasik bir form.
- **Hydra Gloves | Emerald** — [price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"]. Burada fazla para vermenin anlamı yok: bu eldivenler renge, onlarca kat pahalı çiftlerden daha isabetli oturuyor.
- **Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr" wear="FT"]. Gövdede zümrüt bir yılan, bıçakla neredeyse birebir renk eşleşmesi. Eldivenden artan para tam olarak buraya gidiyor.
- **Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler** — orta setteki gibi.
- AK, M4, AWP ve USP — ilk setten.

[skins names="Bayonet | Gamma Doppler (Phase 1);Hydra Gloves | Emerald;Desert Eagle | Emerald Jörmungandr;Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler;AWP | Atheris"]

Toplam yaklaşık $870. Bıçak ve Deagle bütçeyi neredeyse yarı yarıya paylaşıyor ve birlikte tutarın yaklaşık %90'ını oluşturuyor. Jörmungandr'a ihtiyacın yoksa Serpent Strike'a geri dön; tam set renkten hiçbir şey kaybetmeden yaklaşık $490'a mal olur.

[cta color=4 budget=80000 text="Bıçak ve eldivenli yeşil seti $890'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## Setlerin karşılaştırması

| Bütçe | İçerik | Toplam |
|---|---|---|
| $40'a kadar | Green Laminate, Emphorosaur-S, Atheris, Serpent Strike, Overgrowth, Nuclear Garden | ≈ $35 |
