## Co sprawdzić przed zakupem

Redline w Battle-Scarred mocno traci czerwień — pasy robią się szaroróżowe, więc akurat na zużyciu kałacha nie warto oszczędzać. Za to przy nożach Crimson Web i rękawicach Rezan the Red różnica między Field-Tested a Well-Worn jest w grze prawie niewidoczna, a w cenie potrafi być spora.

Pod każdym przedmiotem w kreatorze są dwa przyciski — DMarket i Lis-Skins. Porównaj oba: ten sam skin na różnych marketach może różnić się ceną o 10–20%.

title: Какие перчатки подходят к фиолетовому ножу: пары под четыре бюджета
desc: Фиолетовый нож в CS2 — Ultraviolet или Doppler Phase 2. Какие перчатки к нему взять — Mogul, Finish Line, Needle Point, новые Violet Beadwork — с живыми ценами.
lead: Фиолетовый — самый заметный цвет на стриме. Но перчаток в этой гамме мало, и цены на них различаются в сотни раз. Поэтому разбираем пары «нож + перчатки» по четырём бюджетам — по реальным ценам площадок, а не по ощущениям.
md:
## Какие ножи считаются фиолетовыми

Фиолетовых ножей в CS2 две семьи, и они очень разные по цене:

- **Ultraviolet** — матовый тёмно-фиолетовый, почти чёрный. Самый дешёвый способ получить фиолетовый нож: Navaja — [price name="Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Shadow Daggers — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Gut — [price name="Gut Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"] в Field-Tested. Falchion — [price name="Falchion Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Flip — [price name="Flip Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], M9 Bayonet — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Karambit — [price name="Karambit | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"].
- **Doppler Phase 2** — фиолетово-розовый глянец. Бывает только Factory New и Minimal Wear, поэтому износ почти не влияет на вид: Navaja — от [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Gut — от [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Flip — от [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Bayonet — от [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 2)"], M9 Bayonet — от [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Karambit — от [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Butterfly — от [price name="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"].

Gamma Doppler сюда не относится: его фазы зелёно-синие, и рядом с фиолетовыми перчатками он смотрится чужим.

[skins names="Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet;Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

Ключевое: **Ultraviolet — мат, Doppler — глянец.** Под матовый нож лучше тёмные матовые перчатки, под глянцевый — яркие.

## Фиолетовые перчатки: что есть и сколько стоит

- **Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point** — фиолетово-розовые с узором, самый дешёвый вход: [price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point" wear="FT"] в Field-Tested.
- **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** — фиолетово-чёрные с белым: [price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"] в Field-Tested. Выглядят дороже, чем стоят, — лучшее соотношение цены и вида.
- **Specialist Gloves | Mogul** — тёмно-фиолетовые, матовые: [price name="Specialist Gloves | Mogul" wear="FT"]. Лучшая пара под Ultraviolet.
- **Driver Gloves | Plum Quill** — новинка из Sealed Dead Hand Terminal, сливово-фиолетовые: [price name="Driver Gloves | Plum Quill" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** — тоже из Dead Hand Terminal, фиолетовый бисер: [price name="Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** — яркие фиолетово-голубые из того же кейса: [price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box** — эталон под Doppler Phase 2: [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"] в Field-Tested, даже Battle-Scarred — от [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="BS"].

[skins names="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point;Moto Gloves | Finish Line;Specialist Gloves | Mogul;Driver Gloves | Plum Quill;Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork;Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent"]

## Пара до 12 000 ₽

**Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet + Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point** — около 7 000 ₽ за пару. Или **Gut Knife | Ultraviolet + Specialist Gloves | Mogul** — около 11 000 ₽: оба матовые, оба тёмно-фиолетовые, читаются как один комплект.

[cta color=3 budget=12000 text="Собрать фиолетовый сет под эту пару за 12 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Пара до 35 000 ₽

**Flip Knife | Doppler Phase 2 + Specialist Gloves | Mogul** — около 30 000 ₽: глянцевый нож на фоне матовых перчаток. Альтернатива — **Flip Knife | Ultraviolet + Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork**: те же деньги, но акцент смещается на перчатки, которые на экране крупнее ножа.

[cta color=3 budget=35000 text="Собрать фиолетовый сет под эту пару за 35 000 ₽" btn="Открыть конструктор"]

## Пара до 110 000 ₽

**Karambit | Doppler Phase 2 + Moto Gloves | Finish Line** — около 100 000 ₽, классика стримерских инвентарей. Или **M9 Bayonet | Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** — около 90 000 ₽.

## Пара от 350 000 ₽

**Pandora's Box** имеет смысл только с ножом того же класса — Karambit или Butterfly Doppler Phase 2. Вместе это 350–450 тысяч рублей. С более дешёвым ножом перчатки будут стоить дороже всего остального инвентаря, а это редко выглядит гармонично.

## Чего избегать

- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** и **Moto Gloves | Eclipse** — синие и чёрные, они не делают сет фиолетовым, а размывают его. К тому же Eclipse в Field-Tested стоит [price name="Moto Gloves | Eclipse" wear="FT"] — дороже Mogul.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** — бирюзово-розовые, под Doppler Phase 2 не подходят.
- **Mogul и Finish Line в Battle-Scarred** сильно темнеют и теряют фиолетовый — экономия того не стоит.

## Оружие, которое закроет сет

Фиолетового оружия достаточно на все слоты, и оно дешёвое по сравнению с ножом и перчатками:

- AK-47 | Baroque Purple ([price name="AK-47 | Baroque Purple" wear="FT"]) или AK-47 | Neon Rider ([price name="AK-47 | Neon Rider" wear="FT"])
- M4A4 | Neo-Noir ([price name="M4A4 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"])
- AWP | POP AWP ([price name="AWP | POP AWP" wear="FT"]) или AWP | Fever Dream ([price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="FT"])
- Desert Eagle | Night Heist ([price name="Desert Eagle | Night Heist" wear="FT"]), USP-S | Purple DDPAT ([price name="USP-S | Purple DDPAT" wear="FT"]), Glock-18 | Sacrifice ([price name="Glock-18 | Sacrifice" wear="FT"])

[skins names="AK-47 | Baroque Purple;M4A4 | Neo-Noir;AWP | POP AWP;Desert Eagle | Night Heist;USP-S | Purple DDPAT;Glock-18 | Sacrifice"]

Суммы пар посчитаны по ценам на 15 октября 2026 года, цены у предметов — живые и обновляются каждый день. В конструкторе закрепи нож через «Выбрать», и остаток бюджета распределится на перчатки и оружие в той же гамме.

en.title: Which Gloves Go With a Purple Knife: Pairings for Four Budgets
en.desc: A purple CS2 knife means Ultraviolet or Doppler Phase 2. Gloves that match: Mogul, Finish Line, Needle Point, the new Violet Beadwork, with live prices.
en.lead: Purple is the color that pops most on stream. But there aren't many gloves in this palette, and their prices vary a hundredfold. So we're breaking down knife + glove pairings across four budgets, based on real marketplace prices rather than gut feeling.
en.md:
## Which knives count as purple

There are two families of purple knives in CS2, and they're worlds apart in price:

- **Ultraviolet** — a matte dark purple that's almost black. The cheapest way to get a purple knife: Navaja — [price name="Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Shadow Daggers — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Gut — [price name="Gut Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"] in Field-Tested. de.title: Welche Handschuhe passen zum lila Messer? Kombis für vier Budgets
de.desc: Lila Messer in CS2: Ultraviolet oder Doppler Phase 2. Welche Handschuhe dazu passen – Mogul, Finish Line, Needle Point, Violet Beadwork – mit Live-Preisen.
de.lead: Lila fällt im Stream mehr auf als jede andere Farbe. Das Problem: Handschuhe in diesem Farbton gibt es kaum, und ihre Preise liegen um das Hundertfache auseinander. Deshalb schauen wir uns Kombis aus Messer und Handschuhen für vier Budgets an – nach echten Marktplatzpreisen, nicht nach Bauchgefühl.
de.md:
## Welche Messer als lila gelten

Lila Messer gibt es in CS2 in zwei Familien, und preislich trennen sie Welten:

- **Ultraviolet** – mattes Dunkellila, fast schon Schwarz. Der günstigste Weg zum lila Messer: Navaja – [price name="Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Shadow Daggers – [price name="Shadow Daggers | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Gut – [price name="Gut Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"] in Field-Tested. Falchion – [price name="Falchion Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Flip – [price name="Flip Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], M9 Bayonet – [price name="M9 Bayonet | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Karambit – [price name="Karambit | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"].
- **Doppler Phase 2** – lila-pinker Hochglanz. Gibt es nur in Factory New und Minimal Wear, der Zustand ändert am Look also kaum etwas: Navaja – ab [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Gut – ab [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Flip – ab [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Bayonet – ab [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 2)"], M9 Bayonet – ab [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Karambit – ab [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Butterfly – ab [price name="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"].

Gamma Doppler gehört nicht dazu: Seine Phasen sind grün-blau, und neben lila Handschuhen wirkt er wie ein Fremdkörper.

[skins names="Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet;Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

Das Wichtigste: **Ultraviolet ist matt, Doppler glänzt.** Zum matten Messer passen dunkle, matte Handschuhe, zum glänzenden eher knallige.

## Lila Handschuhe: was es gibt und was sie kosten

- **Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point** – lila-pink mit Muster, der günstigste Einstieg: [price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point" wear="FT"] in Field-Tested.
- **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** – lila-schwarz mit Weiß: [price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"] in Field-Tested. Sehen teurer aus, als sie sind – das beste Verhältnis von Preis zu Optik.
- **Specialist Gloves | Mogul** – dunkellila und matt: [price name="Specialist Gloves | Mogul" wear="FT"]. Die beste Wahl zu Ultraviolet.
- **Driver Gloves | Plum Quill** – neu aus dem Sealed Dead Hand Terminal, pflaumenlila: [price name="Driver Gloves | Plum Quill" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** – ebenfalls aus dem Dead Hand Terminal, mit lila Perlenmuster: [price name="Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** – knallig lila-hellblau, aus derselben Case: [price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box** – die Referenz für Doppler Phase 2: [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"] in Field-Tested, selbst Battle-Scarred kostet ab [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="BS"].

[skins names="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point;Moto Gloves | Finish Line;Specialist Gloves | Mogul;Driver Gloves | Plum Quill;Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork;Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent"]

## Kombi bis 130 €

**Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet + Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point** – rund 80 € für beides. Oder **Gut Knife | Ultraviolet + Specialist Gloves | Mogul** – rund 120 €: beide matt, beide dunkellila, wirken wie aus einem Guss.

[cta color=3 budget=12000 text="Lila Set rund um diese Kombi für 130 € bauen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Kombi bis 390 €

**Flip Knife | Doppler Phase 2 + Specialist Gloves | Mogul** – rund 330 €: glänzendes Messer vor matten Handschuhen. Die Alternative: **Flip Knife | Ultraviolet + Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** – gleiches Geld, aber der Fokus liegt auf den Handschuhen, und die sind auf dem Bildschirm größer als das Messer.

[cta color=3 budget=35000 text="Lila Set rund um diese Kombi für 390 € bauen" btn="Builder öffnen"]

## Kombi bis 1.200 €

**Karambit | Doppler Phase 2 + Moto Gloves | Finish Line** – rund 1.100 €, der Klassiker in Streamer-Inventaren. Oder **M9 Bayonet | Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** – rund 1.000 €.

## Kombi ab 3.900 €

**Pandora's Box** lohnt sich nur mit einem Messer derselben Liga – Karambit oder Butterfly Doppler Phase 2. Zusammen bist du bei 3.900–5.000 €. Mit einem billigeren Messer kosten die Handschuhe mehr als der ganze Rest des Inventars, und das wirkt selten stimmig.

## Was du vermeiden solltest

- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** und **Moto Gloves | Eclipse** – blau und schwarz, sie machen das Set nicht lila, sondern verwässern es. Dazu kostet Eclipse in Field-Tested [price name="Moto Gloves | Eclipse" wear="FT"] – mehr als Mogul.

- **Mogul und Finish Line in Battle-Scarred** werden deutlich dunkler und verlieren ihr Lila – die Ersparnis lohnt sich nicht.

## Waffen, die das Set abrunden

Lila Waffen gibt es für jeden Slot, und im Vergleich zu Messer und Handschuhen sind sie günstig:

- AK-47 | Baroque Purple ([price name="AK-47 | Baroque Purple" wear="FT"]) oder AK-47 | Neon Rider ([price name="AK-47 | Neon Rider" wear="FT"])

[skins names="AK-47 | Baroque Purple;M4A4 | Neo-Noir;AWP | POP AWP;Desert Eagle | Night Heist;USP-S | Purple DDPAT;Glock-18 | Sacrifice"]

Die Summen der Kombis basieren auf den Preisen mit Stand 15. Oktober 2026, die Preise bei den Items sind live und werden täglich aktualisiert. Fixiere im Builder dein Messer über „Auswählen“, dann wird das restliche Budget auf Handschuhe und Waffen im selben Farbton verteilt.

pt.title: Quais luvas combinam com uma faca roxa: duplas para quatro orçamentos
pt.desc: Faca roxa no CS2: Ultraviolet ou Doppler Phase 2. Quais luvas usar — Mogul, Finish Line, Needle Point, as novas Violet Beadwork — com preços ao vivo.
pt.lead: Roxo é a cor que mais chama atenção na stream. Mas existem poucas luvas nessa paleta, e os preços entre elas variam centenas de vezes. Por isso, montamos duplas “faca + luvas” para quatro orçamentos — com preços reais dos marketplaces, não no chute.
pt.md:
## Quais facas contam como roxas

No CS2 existem duas famílias de facas roxas, e o preço delas é bem diferente:

- **Ultraviolet** — roxo-escuro fosco, quase preto. É o jeito mais barato de ter uma faca roxa: Navaja — [price name="Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Shadow Daggers — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Gut — [price name="Gut Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"] em Field-Tested. Falchion — [price name="Falchion Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Flip — [price name="Flip Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], M9 Bayonet — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Karambit — [price name="Karambit | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"].
- **Doppler Phase 2** — brilho roxo-rosado. Só existe em Factory New e Minimal Wear, então o desgaste quase não muda o visual: Navaja — a partir de [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Gut — a partir de [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Flip — a partir de [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Bayonet — a partir de [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 2)"], M9 Bayonet — a partir de [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Karambit — a partir de [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"], Butterfly — a partir de [price name="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"].

A Gamma Doppler fica de fora: as fases dela são verde-azuladas, e ao lado de luvas roxas ela fica deslocada.

[skins names="Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet;Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

O ponto-chave: **Ultraviolet é fosca, Doppler é brilhante.** Com faca fosca, ficam melhor luvas escuras e foscas; com faca brilhante, luvas vibrantes.

## Luvas roxas: o que existe e quanto custam

- **Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point** — roxo-rosadas com estampa, a entrada mais barata: [price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point" wear="FT"] em Field-Tested.
- **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** — roxo e preto com branco: [price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"] em Field-Tested. Parecem mais caras do que são — o melhor custo-benefício visual.
- **Specialist Gloves | Mogul** — roxo-escuras e foscas: [price name="Specialist Gloves | Mogul" wear="FT"]. A melhor dupla para a Ultraviolet.
- **Driver Gloves | Plum Quill** — novidade da Sealed Dead Hand Terminal, em roxo-ameixa: [price name="Driver Gloves | Plum Quill" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** — também da Dead Hand Terminal, com miçangas roxas: [price name="Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** — roxo e azul-claro vibrantes, da mesma caixa: [price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box** — a referência para Doppler Phase 2: [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"] em Field-Tested, e até em Battle-Scarred sai a partir de [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="BS"].

[skins names="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point;Moto Gloves | Finish Line;Specialist Gloves | Mogul;Driver Gloves | Plum Quill;Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork;Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent"]

## Dupla até R$ 730

**Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet + Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point** — cerca de R$ 430 pela dupla. Ou **Gut Knife | Ultraviolet + Specialist Gloves | Mogul** — cerca de R$ 670: as duas foscas, as duas roxo-escuras, e o visual fica de conjunto.

[cta color=3 budget=12000 text="Montar um set roxo com essa dupla por R$ 730" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Dupla até R$ 2.100

**Flip Knife | Doppler Phase 2 + Specialist Gloves | Mogul** — cerca de R$ 1.800: faca brilhante contrastando com luvas foscas. Alternativa: **Flip Knife | Ultraviolet + Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** — mesmo valor, mas o destaque passa para as luvas, que aparecem maiores na tela do que a faca.

[cta color=3 budget=35000 text="Montar um set roxo com essa dupla por R$ 2.100" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Dupla até R$ 6.700

**Karambit | Doppler Phase 2 + Moto Gloves | Finish Line** — cerca de R$ 6.100, um clássico dos inventários de streamer. Ou **M9 Bayonet | Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** — cerca de R$ 5.500.

## Dupla a partir de R$ 21.000

**Pandora's Box** só faz sentido com uma faca do mesmo nível — Karambit ou Butterfly Doppler Phase 2. Juntas, dá algo entre R$ 21.000 e R$ 27.500. Com uma faca mais barata, as luvas vão valer mais que todo o resto do inventário, e isso raramente fica harmônico.

## O que evitar

- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** e **Moto Gloves | Eclipse** — azuis e pretas, não deixam o set roxo, só diluem a paleta. Além disso, a Eclipse em Field-Tested custa [price name="Moto Gloves | Eclipse" wear="FT"] — mais que a Mogul.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** — turquesa e rosa, não combinam com Doppler Phase 2.
- **Mogul e Finish Line em Battle-Scarred** escurecem muito e perdem o roxo — a economia não compensa.

## Armas para fechar o set

Tem arma roxa para todos os slots, e elas são baratas perto da faca e das luvas:

- AK-47 | Baroque Purple ([price name="AK-47 | Baroque Purple" wear="FT"]) ou AK-47 | Neon Rider ([price name="AK-47 | Neon Rider" wear="FT"])
- M4A4 | Neo-Noir ([price name="M4A4 | Neo-Noir" wear="FT"])
- AWP | POP AWP ([price name="AWP | POP AWP" wear="FT"]) ou AWP | Fever Dream ([price name="AWP | Fever Dream" wear="FT"])
- Desert Eagle | Night Heist ([price name="Desert Eagle | Night Heist" wear="FT"]), USP-S | Purple DDPAT ([price name="USP-S | Purple DDPAT" wear="FT"]), Glock-18 | Sacrifice ([price name="Glock-18 | Sacrifice" wear="FT"])

[skins names="AK-47 | Baroque Purple;M4A4 | Neo-Noir;AWP | POP AWP;Desert Eagle | Night Heist;USP-S | Purple DDPAT;Glock-18 | Sacrifice"]

Os valores das duplas foram calculados com os preços em 15 de outubro de 2026; os preços dos itens são ao vivo e atualizados todo dia. No montador, fixe a faca em “Escolher”, e o resto do orçamento é distribuído entre luvas e armas na mesma paleta.

tr.title: Mor bıçağa hangi eldiven yakışır: dört bütçeye göre kombinler
tr.desc: CS2'de mor bıçak demek Ultraviolet ya da Doppler Phase 2 demek. Yanına hangi eldiven: Mogul, Finish Line, Needle Point, Violet Beadwork, canlı fiyatlarla.
tr.lead: Mor, yayında en çok göze çarpan renk. Ama bu tonda eldiven az, fiyatlar da birbirinden yüzlerce kat farklı. O yüzden “bıçak + eldiven” kombinlerini dört bütçeye göre inceliyoruz; hisse göre değil, pazar yerlerindeki gerçek fiyatlara göre.
tr.md:
## Hangi bıçaklar mor sayılır

CS2'de mor bıçakların iki ailesi var ve fiyatları birbirinden çok farklı:

- **Ultraviolet** — mat, koyu mor, neredeyse siyah. Mor bıçağa sahip olmanın en ucuz yolu: Navaja — [price name="Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Shadow Daggers — [price name="Shadow Daggers | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Gut — [price name="Gut Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"] (Field-Tested). Falchion — [price name="Falchion Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Flip — [price name="Flip Knife | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], M9 Bayonet — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"], Karambit — [price name="Karambit | Ultraviolet" wear="FT"].
- **Doppler Phase 2** — mor-pembe parlak kaplama. Sadece Factory New ve Minimal Wear olarak çıkıyor, yani aşınma görünümü neredeyse hiç etkilemiyor: Navaja — [price name="Navaja Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"] başlayan fiyatlarla, Gut — [price name="Gut Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"] başlayan fiyatlarla, Flip — [price name="Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"] başlayan fiyatlarla, Bayonet — [price name="Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 2)"] başlayan fiyatlarla, M9 Bayonet — [price name="M9 Bayonet | Doppler (Phase 2)"] başlayan fiyatlarla, Karambit — [price name="Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"] başlayan fiyatlarla, Butterfly — [price name="Butterfly Knife | Doppler (Phase 2)"] başlayan fiyatlarla.

Gamma Doppler bu listeye girmiyor: fazları yeşil-mavi, mor eldivenlerin yanında yabancı duruyor.

[skins names="Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet;Flip Knife | Doppler (Phase 2);Karambit | Doppler (Phase 2)"]

İşin özü: **Ultraviolet mat, Doppler parlak.** Mat bıçağa koyu mat eldiven, parlak bıçağa canlı renkli eldiven daha iyi gider.

## Mor eldivenler: neler var, ne kadar

- **Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point** — desenli mor-pembe, en ucuz giriş: Field-Tested'da [price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point" wear="FT"].
- **Moto Gloves | Finish Line** — mor-siyah, üstünde beyaz: Field-Tested'da [price name="Moto Gloves | Finish Line" wear="FT"]. Fiyatından pahalı görünüyor; fiyat/görünüm oranında bir numara.
- **Specialist Gloves | Mogul** — koyu mor, mat: [price name="Specialist Gloves | Mogul" wear="FT"]. Ultraviolet için en iyi eş.
- **Driver Gloves | Plum Quill** — Sealed Dead Hand Terminal'den yeni gelen, erik moru: [price name="Driver Gloves | Plum Quill" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** — yine Dead Hand Terminal'den, mor boncuk işlemeli: [price name="Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent** — aynı kasadan, canlı mor-mavi: [price name="Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent" wear="FT"].
- **Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box** — Doppler Phase 2 için referans eldiven: Field-Tested'da [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="FT"], Battle-Scarred bile [price name="Sport Gloves | Pandora's Box" wear="BS"] başlayan fiyatlarla.

[skins names="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point;Moto Gloves | Finish Line;Specialist Gloves | Mogul;Driver Gloves | Plum Quill;Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork;Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent"]

## 130 $'a kadar kombin

**Navaja Knife | Ultraviolet + Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point** — ikisi birlikte yaklaşık 80 $. Ya da **Gut Knife | Ultraviolet + Specialist Gloves | Mogul** — yaklaşık 120 $: ikisi de mat, ikisi de koyu mor, tek parça bir set gibi duruyor.

[cta color=3 budget=12000 text="Bu kombine uygun mor seti 130 $'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## 390 $'a kadar kombin

**Flip Knife | Doppler Phase 2 + Specialist Gloves | Mogul** — yaklaşık 330 $: mat eldivenlerin önünde parlayan bir bıçak. Alternatif: **Flip Knife | Ultraviolet + Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** — aynı para, ama vurgu eldivene kayıyor; ekranda da eldiven bıçaktan büyük görünüyor zaten.

[cta color=3 budget=35000 text="Bu kombine uygun mor seti 390 $'a topla" btn="Oluşturucuyu aç"]

## 1.200 $'a kadar kombin

**Karambit | Doppler Phase 2 + Moto Gloves | Finish Line** — yaklaşık 1.100 $, yayıncı envanterlerinin klasiği. Ya da **M9 Bayonet | Doppler Phase 2 + Sport Gloves | Violet Beadwork** — yaklaşık 1.000 $.

## 3.900 $ ve üzeri kombin

**Pandora's Box** ancak aynı sınıftan bir bıçakla mantıklı: Karambit ya da Butterfly Doppler Phase 2. İkisi birlikte 3.900–5.000 $ tutuyor. Daha ucuz bir bıçakla alırsan eldiven envanterin geri kalanından pahalı olur, bu da nadiren uyumlu görünür.

## Nelerden uzak durmalı

- **Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls** ve **Moto Gloves | Eclipse** — mavi ve siyah; seti mor yapmıyor, aksine dağıtıyorlar. Üstelik Eclipse Field-Tested'da [price name="Moto Gloves | Eclipse" wear="FT"] — Mogul'dan pahalı.
- **Sport Gloves | Vice** — turkuaz-pembe, Doppler Phase 2 ile uyuşmuyor.

На 5 000 ₽ ножа и перчаток не будет: самые дешёвые ножи стоят от 3 500 ₽, перчатки — от 2 500 ₽, и они съедят весь бюджет. Поэтому работает одна стратегия: **один цвет на всех шести стволах**. At $55 there's no room for a knife or gloves: the cheapest knives start at around $40, gloves at around $28, and either one eats your whole budget. So there's one strategy that works: **one color across all six guns**. When your AK-47, M4, AWP and three pistols share a palette, the eye reads them as a set, and nobody's counting what each one cost.

pt.title: Inventário bonito no CS2 por R$ 300: três sets que não parecem baratos
pt.desc: O que dá para montar no CS2 com R$ 300: três sets prontos em azul, vermelho e verde, sem faca nem luvas — com preços ao vivo de cada skin.
pt.lead: R$ 300 é o orçamento com que a maioria compra uma skin de AK e esquece o resto. Se você dividir esse valor entre seis armas da mesma cor, o inventário fica com cara de montado — e parece mais caro do que é. Hoje, os três sets abaixo custam entre R$ 180 e R$ 240.
pt.md:
## O princípio básico de um set barato

Com R$ 300 não rola faca nem luvas: as facas mais baratas custam a partir de R$ 210, as luvas a partir de R$ 150, e elas comem o orçamento inteiro. Então só uma estratégia funciona: **uma cor só nas seis armas**. Quando AK-47, M4, AWP e três pistolas estão na mesma paleta, o olho lê tudo como um conjunto, e ninguém fica contando quanto custou cada uma.

A maior parte do dinheiro vai para a AK-47 e a AWP: são as que mais aparecem. As pistolas podem sair quase de graça.

## Set 3. Verde — cerca de R$ 210

Existem menos skins verdes, mas em compensação quase ninguém usa — o set fica diferente.

- **AK-47 | Green Laminate** — [price name="AK-47 | Green Laminate" wear="FT"]
- **M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S** — [price name="M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S" wear="FT"]
- **AWP | Phobos** — [price name="AWP | Phobos" wear="FT"]
- **Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike** — [price name="Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike" wear="FT"]
- **USP-S | Caiman** — [price name="USP-S | Caiman" wear="FT"], a pistola mais cara do set, mas uma USP-S verde é quase insubstituível
- **Glock-18 | Weasel** — [price name="Glock-18 | Weasel" wear="FT"]

[skins names="AK-47 | Green Laminate;M4A1-S | Emphorosaur-S;AWP | Phobos;Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike;USP-S | Caiman;Glock-18 | Weasel"]

[cta color=4 budget=5000 text="Montar o set verde por R$ 300" btn="Abrir o montador"]

## Como não pagar a mais

- **Float importa mais que raridade.** Em skins baratas, a diferença entre Field-Tested e Well-Worn costuma ser de 30–40% do preço, e no jogo quase não dá para notar. A exceção são skins com estampa grande e clara (Redline, Asiimov): nelas o desgaste aparece.
- **Compare os marketplaces.** A mesma skin pode variar 10–20% entre a DMarket e a Lis-Skins. No montador, cada item tem dois botões — abra os dois.
- **Não compre stickers.** Nesse orçamento eles só aumentam o preço, sem melhorar o visual.

## O que comprar depois

Quando sobrar mais R$ 180–300, não troque as armas — adicione luvas: elas aparecem em todo round. As luvas mais baratas que combinam: verdes, Hydra Gloves | Emerald ([price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"]); vermelhas, Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red ([price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]); roxo-rosadas, Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point" wear="FT"]).

Os valores dos sets foram calculados com os preços em 15 de outubro de 2026; os preços dos itens são ao vivo e atualizados todo dia.

tr.title: 55 $'a şık CS2 envanteri: ucuz durmayan üç set
tr.desc: CS2'de 55 $'a ne toplanır: bıçak ve eldiven olmadan mavi, kırmızı ve yeşil üç hazır set, her skin için canlı fiyatlarla.
tr.lead: 55 $, çoğu oyuncunun AK'ye tek bir skin alıp gerisini unuttuğu bir bütçe. Ama bu parayı aynı renkte altı silaha bölersen envanterin derli toplu, olduğundan da pahalı görünür. Aşağıdaki üç setin her biri bugün 35–45 $ civarında.
tr.md:
## Bütçe setinin temel kuralı

55 $'a bıçak ve eldiven yok: en ucuz bıçaklar 40 $'dan, eldivenler 28 $'dan başlıyor ve bütün bütçeyi yiyorlar. O yüzden tek bir strateji işe yarıyor: **altı silahın hepsinde tek renk**. AK-47, M4, AWP ve üç tabanca aynı tondaysa göz onları bir set olarak algılıyor ve kimse hangisinin kaça olduğunu saymıyor.

Paranın çoğu AK-47 ve AWP'ye gitsin: en çok onlar görünüyor. Tabancaları neredeyse bedavaya alabilirsin.

## Set 3. Yeşil — yaklaşık 38 $

Yeşil skin daha az, ama başkalarında pek görmezsin — set farklı duruyor.

## Fazla ödememek için

- **Float, nadirlikten önemli.** Bütçe skinlerinde Field-Tested ile Well-Worn arasındaki fark çoğu zaman fiyatın %30–40'ı, oyunda ise neredeyse fark edilmiyor. İstisna: büyük, açık renkli desenli skinler (Redline, Asiimov) — orada aşınma belli oluyor.
- **Pazar yerlerini karşılaştır.** Aynı skin DMarket ve Lis-Skins'te %10–20 farklı olabilir. Oluşturucuda her ürünün altında iki buton var — ikisini de aç.
- **Sticker alma.** Bu bütçede görünüme bir şey katmadan sadece fiyatı şişiriyorlar.

## Sırada ne alınmalı

Elinde 35–55 $ daha olunca silahları değiştirme, eldiven ekle: her round görünüyorlar. Renge uyan en ucuz eldivenler: yeşil Hydra Gloves | Emerald ([price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"]), kırmızı Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red ([price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]), mor-pembe Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point" wear="FT"]).

Set toplamları 15 Ekim 2026 itibarıyla fiyatlarla hesaplandı; ürünlerdeki fiyatlar canlı ve her gün güncelleniyor.

pl.title: Ładny ekwipunek CS2 za 220 zł: trzy sety, które nie wyglądają tanio
pl.desc: Co złożysz w CS2 za 220 zł: trzy gotowe sety w niebieskim, czerwonym i zielonym, bez noża i rękawic — z cenami na żywo dla każdego skina.
pl.lead: 220 zł to budżet, za który większość kupuje jeden skin na AK i zapomina o reszcie. Jeśli rozłożysz tę kwotę na sześć broni w jednym kolorze, ekwipunek będzie wyglądał na przemyślany — i na droższy, niż jest naprawdę. Każdy z trzech setów poniżej kosztuje dziś 130–180 zł.
pl.md:
## Główna zasada budżetowego setu

Za 220 zł noża i rękawic nie będzie: najtańsze noże kosztują od 160 zł, rękawice — od 110 zł, i zjedzą cały budżet. Dlatego działa tylko jedna strategia: **jeden kolor na wszystkich sześciu broniach**. Kiedy AK-47, M4, AWP i trzy pistolety są w jednej palecie, oko odbiera je jako komplet i nikt nie liczy, ile kosztowała każda sztuka.

Najwięcej kasy wydaj na AK-47 i AWP: widać je najczęściej. Pistolety możesz brać praktycznie za darmo.

## Jak nie przepłacić

- **Float jest ważniejszy niż rzadkość.** Przy budżetowych skinach różnica między Field-Tested a Well-Worn to często 30–40% ceny, a w grze prawie jej nie widać. Wyjątek to skiny z dużym, jasnym wzorem (Redline, Asiimov): tam zużycie rzuca się w oczy.
- **Porównuj markety.** Ten sam skin na DMarket i Lis-Skins może różnić się ceną o 10–20%. W kreatorze pod każdym przedmiotem masz dwa przyciski — otwórz oba.
- **Odpuść naklejki.** Przy tym budżecie tylko podbijają cenę, a do wyglądu nic nie wnoszą.

## Co dokupić w następnej kolejności

Kiedy uzbierasz kolejne 130–220 zł, nie wymieniaj broni, tylko dołóż rękawice: widać je w każdej rundzie. Najtańsze rękawice pod kolor: zielone Hydra Gloves | Emerald ([price name="Hydra Gloves | Emerald" wear="FT"]), czerwone Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red ([price name="Driver Gloves | Rezan the Red" wear="FT"]), fioletowo-różowe Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point ([price name="Broken Fang Gloves | Needle Point" wear="FT"]).

Sumy setów policzyliśmy według cen z 15 października 2026, a ceny przy przedmiotach są na żywo i aktualizują się codziennie.
